An MP asked whether detaining Maagdenhuis occupiers in immigration detention merely for refusing identification is lawful and proportionate. The Secretary of State answered that refusing identification can justify immigration detention to continue identity checks, noted the court found the police's grounds insufficient in April 2015 and awarded small damages, and said training will reflect that ruling.

The court ruled in judgments of 30 April 2015 (incl. reference AWB 15/7645) that the circumstances invoked by the police were not sufficient to justify the suspicion that foreign nationals without lawful residence were among those found at the Maagdenhuis.
De rechter heeft bij uitspraken van 30 april 2015 (o.a. kenmerk AWB 15/7645) geoordeeld dat de door de politie aangevoerde omstandigheden niet voldoende zijn om het vermoeden te rechtvaardigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Recourt over de roep om een aparte juridische status voor vermisten

MPs Arib and Recourt asked ministers whether a separate legal status for missing persons should be created, given practical and financial problems for relatives who cannot act on behalf of a missing family member. Minister Van der Steur answered that a separate official document would have the same legal effects as a declaration of presumed death and could cause confusion, preferring practical solutions such as protocols, case managers, a central register and existing guardianship arrangements.
I am of the opinion that introducing an official document confirming that someone is missing, alongside the existing declaration of presumed death, is not a good solution.

Ik ben echter van mening dat het invoeren van een officieel document, waarin bevestigd wordt dat iemand is vermist naast de bestaande verklaring van rechtsvermoeden van overlijden geen goede oplossing biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over "het flitsfaillissement bij Princen Transmission"

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the ministers about the Princen TransMission flash bankruptcy, the pre-pack method, the alleged selection of workers by health records, and whether the planned bankruptcy fraud law should address this misuse. Minister Asscher answered that pre-pack is a court practice aimed at preparing bankruptcy, that dismissal protection is lost through bankruptcy rather than pre-pack, that the curator and judge-commissioner should safeguard creditors including workers, and that a study on workers in bankruptcy will be sent before summer.
I will send that study to your House before the summer.
Dat onderzoek zal ik voor de zomer aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de rol van advocaten en accountants bij fraudeonderzoeken

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the differing duties and powers of lawyers and accountants in forensic fraud investigations at companies, including legal privilege, reporting duties and whether the public prosecution's use of settlements serves the public interest. The minister answers that neither profession has specific rules for forensic work, that lawyer privilege is necessary and under review with the Public Prosecution Service and the bar, and that settlements follow case-by-case reasoning, while deferring the independence question to the earlier answer.

In the general consultation with your House on 8 April on the government-wide approach to fraud, I promised to inform you around the summer recess of the outcomes of the talks currently being held with the NOVA, the KNB and the Public Prosecution Service.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 8 april jl. over de rijksbrede aanpak van fraude heb ik toegezegd u rond het zomerreces te informeren over de uitkomsten van de gesprekken die momenteel worden gevoerd met de NOVA, de Koninklijke Nederlandse Beroepsorganisatie van Notarissen (KNB) en het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht ‘Wegpiraat ontloopt zijn straf’

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether the number of fines for serious traffic offences had fallen sharply, what explains the drop in stops since 2007, and how the government will respond. The Minister answered that criminal traffic stops have been stable (around 84,000 a year), attributed the earlier decline mainly to lower traffic volume and the abolition of ticket quotas, said the actual detection probability cannot be determined, and noted an early start to a new repeat-offender approach from 1 January 2015.
The number of stops for criminal traffic offences has been stable in recent years.
Het aantal staandehoudingen voor strafrechtelijke verkeersovertredingen is de laatste jaren stabiel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de regels met betrekking tot de meldplicht van accountants

Two MPs asked whether an Accountantskamer ruling narrows accountants' confidentiality duty when they suspect large tax fraud, and whether it conflicts with earlier rulings and with the Wwft reporting duty. The minister answered that the ruling reflects existing rules, that no conflict exists, and that no new legislation is needed.
No. The existing laws and regulations offer sufficient starting points for the accountants' duty to report fraud.
Nee. De bestaande wet- en regelgeving biedt voldoende aanknopingspunten voor de meldplicht van accountants bij fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Jacobi over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Leeuwarden

MPs Recourt and Jacobi asked whether plans could cost at least 54 jobs at the Leeuwarden Court of Appeal and how this fits earlier assurances of no relocations. The Minister replied that no decision has been taken, that four scenarios are being explored (three involve moving jobs within the court's area, two of them moving 54 jobs from Leeuwarden), and that the Rvdr will report soon.
The Rvdr will inform me shortly of its findings following the discussions with court boards and its own research.
De Rvdr informeert mij binnenkort over zijn bevindingen naar aanleiding van de gesprekken met gerechtsbesturen en eigen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Albert de Vries en Çegerek over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Arnhem

MPs asked whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal may relocate from Arnhem to Zwolle, with possible job losses, and how this fits the goal of spreading government jobs. The Minister said the court board is only exploring housing scenarios with no decision taken, that some scenarios move posts out of Arnhem, and that a decision on locations would be made after the Rvdr's review rather than waiting for the 2018 evaluation.
The board of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal is currently exploring the future housing needs of the court's organisational units.
Het bestuur van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden voert op dit moment verkenningen uit naar de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht «Bonnenregen onterecht»

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether many motorists were wrongly fined on the N261 near Tilburg due to roadworks and unclear speed limits, and what would be done about it. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecutor found no evidence the fines were wrong, that individual appeals remain possible, that no separate count of wrongful fines is kept, and that no new measures are planned beyond the earlier answer.
I cannot provide such an overview. No separate registration is kept of this.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet geven. Hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch over het bericht dat allochtone daders een grotere kans op een zware straf hebben

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research showing foreign-origin offenders face a higher chance of prison sentences, and whether judges may be discriminating. Minister Opstelten answered that the differences largely disappear after controlling for factors such as prior record and employment, so no conclusion of judicial bias can be drawn, while the Judiciary Council has commissioned further research including talks with judges.
It cannot be concluded from this that judges, consciously or unconsciously, take the ethnic background of the suspect into account.
Hieruit kan niet afgeleid worden dat rechters, bewust of onbewust, rekening houden met de etnische achtergrond van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Staaij over de fouten die zijn gemaakt in de zaak Van U.

MPs Recourt and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Justice and Security about errors in the Van U case, including whether civil-law measures and broader psychiatric-detention options were considered, and whether dangerous suspects are being released pending appeal. The minister replied that an independent commission has been set up by the College of Procurators-General to investigate the DNA sampling, enforcement of pre-trial detention and BOPZ detention, and that it will answer these questions in its outcome, expected before the summer recess.
The College of Procurators-General asked the commission to establish the facts and circumstances surrounding the DNA sampling of the suspect after his conviction(s) in 2012.
Het College van Procureurs-generaal heeft de commissie gevraagd de feiten en omstandigheden te achterhalen rond de afname van het DNA van verdachte na zijn veroordeling(en) in 2012
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over afbetalingsregelingen door het CJIB

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about payment arrangements at the CJIB after a television broadcast showed citizens financially ruined by unpaid traffic fines and their escalation. The state secretary acknowledged the need for instalment payments, announced a generic instalment option for Wahv fines of 225 euro and above to be implemented in 2015 via a pending bill, and described an interim CJIB facility for hardship cases with criteria.
For that reason, it is being made possible to pay Wahv decisions of 225 euro and higher in instalments.
Om die reden wordt het mogelijk gemaakt om Wahv-beschikkingen van 225 euro en hoger in termijnen te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over de gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de hoogte van de te betalen kinderalimentatie

Two MPs asked whether the government was aware that the Wet hervorming kindregelingen could trigger reassessment of existing child maintenance orders and how many reassessments were expected. The State Secretary confirmed the law's measures can affect the maintenance criteria, cited the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice that the number of reassessments cannot be reliably estimated, and said the effects on courts, legal aid and the LBIO are uncertain.
The Council indicates that it is not possible to make a concrete estimate of this.
De Raad geeft aan dat het niet goed mogelijk is om hiervan een concrete inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt over langdurige vreemdelingenbewaring zonder bijstand van een advocaat

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked the State Secretary about a detainee who spent 182 days in immigration detention without contact with a lawyer. The State Secretary said detainees are assigned a state-paid duty lawyer, courts review detention automatically at 28 days and six months, and the lawyer concerned was reprimanded by the disciplinary board while the new supervision regime is being strengthened.
This is laid down in the Vreemdelingenwet in line with the European Return Directive.
Dit is conform de Europese Terugkeerrichtlijn vastgelegd in de Vreemdelingenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Rebel over de afdoening van strafbare feiten bij festivals

MPs Recourt and Rebel asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the handling of drug possession cases at the Lowlands festival, including criminal records, VOG consequences and the absence of lawyers on site. The Minister answered that 119 drug cases were settled mostly by OM penalty orders, that registration in JDS is legally required with VOG assessed case by case, and that no permanent lawyer presence was deemed necessary since suspects are informed of rights and can call a lawyer.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that 122 cases were settled at the Lowlands festival this year, 119 of them for drug possession.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij meegedeeld dat tijdens het festival Lowlands dit jaar in totaal 122 zaken zijn afgedaan, waarvan 119 zaken wegens drugsbezit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Rebel en Fokke over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Recourt, Rebel and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising organised crime in southern Netherlands, including threats against mayors, drug-related crime, police funding and coordination. The minister answered that threats are handled under the prosecution service's protection directive, that police capacity in the south will be intensified within existing staffing from 1 October 2014 via regional structures, and that no national crime coordinator is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it makes no statements about possible threats against public administrators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat cybercrime Nederland jaarlijks 8,8 miljard euro kost

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that cybercrime costs the Netherlands 8.8 billion euro a year, whether the government should play a bigger role, who coordinates cyber security, and whether companies are reluctant to report crimes. The minister disputes the cost estimates as hard to verify, says the government is strengthening its role in cyber security and enforcement, describes coordination between ministries and private partners, but leaves the NaWas anti-DDoS project to private initiative and declines to give companies anonymous reporting beyond exceptional cases.
The economic damage caused by cybercrime is difficult to quantify.
De economische schade als gevolg van cybercrime is lastig te becijferen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Health, and Interior about the planned tendering of forensic medical care and examination by the National Police, including quality, fragmentation, and ministerial responsibility. The government answered that the tender is in its preparatory phase under the light regime of the Aanbestedingswet, that existing providers may bid, and that it rejects a single-ministry responsibility, while declining to disclose some preparatory information.
For the second part of your first question, answering it would release information that may not be disclosed during the preparation of this tender.
Voor het tweede deel van uw eerste vraag geldt dat antwoord geven op deze vraag leidt tot het vrijgeven van informatie die tijdens de voorbereiding van deze aanbesteding niet vrijgegeven mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het misbruik van een faillissement

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack practice) are used to cheaply dismiss staff and disadvantage creditors. The Minister defended the pre-pack practice as beneficial for creditors and employment, said abuse would be refused by courts, and pointed to a forthcoming bill and a civil director ban and shareholder register.

Moreover, when the power to file for bankruptcy is used for a purpose other than the one it is meant for – for example to reduce staff quickly and 'cheaply' – this constitutes abuse of rights according to settled case law.

Daarnaast geldt dat wanneer de bevoegdheid tot het doen van een faillissementsaanvraag wordt gebruikt met een ander doel dan waarvoor zij is bedoeld – bijvoorbeeld om het personeelsbestand snel en « goedkoop » te kunnen terugbrengen – dit volgens vaste jurisprudentie misbruik van recht oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Recourt over lijkschouwers die nog steeds misdrijven missen door gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Wolbert and Recourt asked whether forensic doctors with a short 30-day course get the same powers as those with a four-year profile training, and whether national figures on missed unnatural deaths exist. The minister answered that no such figures are kept, that the professional body's register is considered sufficient guarantee of quality, and that the supply of forensic doctors is not seen as requiring short-term measures.
I do not have figures on the number of times it later became apparent that a natural cause of death had been wrongly assumed.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal keren dat in een later stadium is gebleken dat aanvankelijk onterecht is uitgegaan van een natuurlijke doodsoorzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse staat bij de beveiliging van een woning van de koning in Griekenland

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch state is involved in securing the King's holiday home in Greece, including a fence and a private harbour, and who pays. The government answered that state security responsibility extends to the royal family abroad in coordination with host authorities, the state pays security costs, a servitude covers a strip of land for a fence, and Greek authorities granted the necessary permits.

For the activities mentioned in the answer to question 4, aimed at securing the King, his family and their surroundings, the necessary permits and/or consents were granted and published by the Greek authorities.

Voor de in het antwoord op vraag 4 genoemde activiteiten ten behoeve van de beveiliging van de Koning, zijn gezin en hun omgeving zijn de benodigde vergunningen en/of toestemmingen verleend en gepubliceerd door de Griekse overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over ‘Drugslabs steeds gevaarlijker’

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that drug labs are growing larger, more professional and more dangerous, and whether police and justice have enough capacity to tackle them. The Minister confirmed the trend, said the LFO's protective equipment is top-level, declined to earmark police capacity for drugs, and said the LFO's specialist capacity has doubled in recent months.
The starting point is that we do not specifically earmark police capacity.
Het uitgangspunt is dat we politiecapaciteit niet specifiek oormerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Eijsink over berichten met betrekking tot de beëindiging van de treinkaping bij De Punt

MPs Recourt and Eijsink asked whether reports that the FBI assumed the Moluccans would be liquidated during the 1977 De Punt train hijacking, and that the FBI persuaded the marines, are known and whether the review underway includes these archival materials. The minister confirmed knowledge of the reports, said they are part of the ongoing review, and stated the working group found the information known to it insofar as relevant, with three external experts assessing completeness.
As I informed your House by letter of 1 April 2014, I asked three external experts to assess the working group's work for care and completeness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb laten weten bij brief van 1 april 2014 2 heb ik drie externe deskundigen verzocht het werk van de werkgroep te beoordelen op zorgvuldigheid en volledigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de mogelijke fraude bij de nieuwbouw van het hoofdkantoor

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about alleged tax-return fraud by a KPMG-linked joint venture building KPMG's headquarters, and whether accountancy fraud is structural and calls for stricter rules. The minister declined to give details while the criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to AFM supervision and recent reforms, and said the sector must change its culture.
Given that the criminal investigation is still ongoing, no further information can be provided on this matter.
Gelet op het feit dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog gaande is, kunnen daarover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over het verdwijnen van het Openbaar Ministerie uit Vlissingen

MPs Recourt and Albert de Vries asked the Justice Minister about the disappearance of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) from Vlissingen, including when the hearing room closed and how Zeeland suspects can account for traffic offences. The minister denied the hearing room was closed, said CVOM hearings remain in Vlissingen for now, and promised telehearing at one location in Zeeland by around June 2014.
The aim is an introduction date for this location in the course of June 2014.
Het streven is naar een invoeringsdatum voor deze locatie in de loop van juni 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Recourt over meer vechtscheidingen door het verplichte ouderschapsplan

MPs Ypma and Recourt asked whether the mandatory parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces and what support children in such divorces receive. The government says no study shows the parenting plan causes more conflict, describes existing child support and planned early-signalling pilots, and points to parents' and their networks' responsibility.
I am not aware of any research on the basis of which it can be concluded that the parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces.
Mij is geen onderzoek bekend op basis waarvan de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het ouderschapsplan voor meer vechtscheidingen zorgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug over het afwijzen van een geboorteakte van het geadopteerde kind van een homostel

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked about a Florida birth certificate for an adopted child of a same-sex couple that omitted the biological mother, which the civil registry office Landelijke Taken did not register. State Secretary Teeven answered that there is no flaw in the law since the mother is the legal parent, that no formal application or refusal was made so no court appeal arose, and that the registry checks for conflict with Dutch public order.
In my view there is no flaw in the law.
Er is in mijn optiek geen sprake van een weeffout in de wet.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Jihadisten in Den Haag trouw aan Al-Qaida zweren (ingezonden 30 december 2013).

Labour MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice and Security Minister about a video in which jihadists in The Hague pledge allegiance to Al-Qaida, asking whether this is punishable, whether it threatens security, whether participants may be preparing armed struggle, what tools exist to act against them, and whether the group can be treated as part of a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that recruitment for armed struggle is punishable under article 205 Sr but the video does not clearly meet that threshold, listed measures taken (passport invalidation, benefit cuts, asset freezes, prosecutions, local interventions), declined to discuss individual cases citing intelligence sensitivity, and said Arabic-language expertise is not deemed necessary because police can call interpreters.
I cannot make further public statements on the application of the aforementioned measures on an individual basis because this partly concerns intelligence information.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over toepassing van voornoemde maatregelen op individuele basis omdat het hier (deels) inlichtingeninformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de tenuitvoerlegging van de levenslange gevangenisstraf

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about life imprisonment in the Netherlands, following a Sint Maarten Constitutional Court ruling, ECtHR case law (Vinter, Murray), gratia practice, resocialisation and victims' positions. The State Secretary answers that the Sint Maarten ruling is not binding and gives no reason to change the gratia system, that the ECtHR case law does not require a statutory conditional release or periodic review in the Netherlands, and that gratia remains the mechanism for reassessing life sentences.
I therefore see no reason in these judgments to include in the Criminal Code a provision allowing conditional release of life-sentenced prisoners.

Ik zie dan ook in deze arresten geen aanleiding om een bepaling in het Wetboek van Strafrecht op te nemen die voorziet in de mogelijkheid tot voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling van levenslanggestraften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het omzeilen van telefoontaps door verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether suspects can disable police phone taps by hiding behind a lawyer's number, and what the consequences are for lawyer-client confidentiality and ongoing cases. The minister replied that the aspects of spoofing are being inventoried and that the results, including these questions, will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform your House by letter before the summer recess about the results of the inventory.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het zomerreces per brief informeren over de resultaten van de inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Maij over de gevolgen van het beperken van de rechtsbijstand voor de rechtsbescherming in vreemdelingenzaken

MPs Recourt and Maij asked State Secretary Teeven how the reduced legal aid fees for manifestly unfounded (kennelijke) decisions in immigration cases affect legal protection, and whether he will reverse them. Teeven answered that he will revisit the measure across the legal aid system and will restore the pre-October 2013 fee structure, while providing caseload figures for the Council of State and IND.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1 and 5, I intend to revise the measure under which a lower fee is awarded to legal aid providers in cases ending in a manifestly unfounded ruling.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vragen 1 en 5 heb aangegeven ben ik voornemens om de maatregel waarbij een lagere vergoeding aan de rechtsbijstandverlener wordt toegekend in zaken die met een kennelijke uitspraak eindigen te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de steekpenningenaffaire van Ballast Nedam

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about KPMG's role in the Ballast Nedam bribery affair, the AFM's handling of it, and accountant oversight. The minister answered that the AFM helped arrange a gradual handover of the 2012 audit, that the criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, and that existing rules already cover integrity and fraud signalling, with a response to a pending motion promised.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de inlichtingenvergaring in Burum naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Nieuwsuur op 13 januari 2014

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence and Interior ministers about signals intelligence activities at Burum after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, including US equipment, oversight, and payments. The minister replied that Inmarsat provides commercial telecom services under Dutch law supervised by the Agentschap Telecom, that AIVD and MIVD have no indications of intelligence activity at Burum, and gave general answers on cooperation with partner services and US Government Network questions.
No public statements can be made about the partner services.
Over de partnerdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht “Politie en Justitie tappen te veel af”

MP Recourt asked the minister whether Dutch police and prosecutors tap too often and whether this harms privacy and investigative quality. The minister answered that the tap is a valuable tool subject to strict legal safeguards, that the legal framework is adequate, and that he will report to parliament in a year on restrained use.
During the budget debate in November this year I committed to informing your House in a year about using the tap as an investigative tool as restrainedly as possible.
Tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van november dit jaar heb ik toegezegd 3 uw Kamer over een jaar te berichten over het zo terughoudend mogelijk inzetten van de tap als opsporingsmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de invoering van een pro-deotaks

MP Recourt asked whether all lawyers should be obliged to take legal aid (pro deo) cases or pay a levy, given the Bar's mission to serve everyone seeking justice. Minister Teeven answered that the Bar as a whole fulfils its duty, that 44% of lawyers did legal aid cases in 2012, that legal aid supply and demand are in balance, and that voluntary contributions by non-legal-aid lawyers would be welcome, with no levy planned.
It is primarily for the Dutch Bar Association to determine what practical form the mission statement quoted in question 2 requires in the current era.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten om te bepalen welke praktische invulling de in vraag 2 genoemde zinsnede uit de missie in de huidige tijd behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over DNA-afname bij jongeren

An MP asked whether a Rotterdam court ruling on taking DNA from a 15-year-old in a criminal case was accepted, how often DNA was or was not taken in 2012 and how many juveniles are in the databank, and whether the exceptions had been widened. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said no exceptions were widened and the sample was destroyed, and explained that the government does not yet record the number of refused cases but expects to by March 2014.

At present the number of cases in which it was decided not to take DNA material is not yet recorded, but once the GPS and GPS-DNA systems are linked, expected in March 2014, these figures will become available.

Op dit moment vindt nog geen registratie plaats van het aantal zaken waarin is besloten geen DNA-materiaal af te nemen, maar na koppeling van de systemen GPS en GPS-DNA, die naar verwachting in maart 2014 zal worden gerealiseerd, zullen deze cijfers wel beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over misstanden in franchiseland en de mogelijke aanpassing van de franchiseovereenkomst

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether franchise abuses are increasing, whether the franchise agreement should be made a named contract in the Civil Code, and whether franchisees can get legal aid for business disputes. The minister denied clear signs of a sharp rise, said no new research is planned, did not prioritise codifying franchise agreements, and explained that legal aid for business disputes is generally excluded with narrow exceptions.
At this moment I see no reason to commission new research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de vestiging van een nieuwe nertsenhouderij in Gemert

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about a new mink farm in Gemert that appears to expand or relocate mink farming despite the 2013 ban, and about distance rules and whether such expansion is undesirable. The government answered that the relocation is permitted if animal numbers do not increase, that the permit is under appeal, and that the NVWA will check compliance on site.
The NVWA monitors the standards of the Fur Animal Farming Ban Act and will determine whether specific situations fit within the purpose and scope of that Act.
De NVWA controleert de normen uit de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij en zal constateren of specifieke situaties binnen doel en strekking van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Recourt over malafide incassobureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about allegedly fraudulent debt collection agencies, including over-charging of consumers and a possible fraud case, and whether a legal quality mark is needed. The State Secretary answered that the sector's voluntary membership suffices for now, that a dialogue with the sector and a letter on enforcement of the Wet incassokosten would follow before Christmas, that legal aid is available only where gedupeerden fall under the Wet op de rechtsbijstand, and that no specific government body supervises compliance, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt possibly acting in some cases.
No government body is specifically charged with supervising compliance with this law.
Er is geen overheidsinstantie specifiek met het toezicht op de naleving van deze wet belast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de vrijheid voor internetdienstverleners om geaggregeerde informatie over gegevensvorderingen openbaar te maken

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether internet providers may publish aggregated information about government data requests, and why an earlier civil-rights letter went unanswered. The State Secretary admitted the letter was mishandled, said providers need not report request numbers, and urged providers not to publish aggregated data because the Public Prosecution Service considers it harmful to investigations.
While respecting providers' own responsibility, the government can do nothing other than make an urgent appeal to providers not to disclose this kind of information.
Met inachtneming van de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieders kan de overheid niet anders dan een dringend appèl op de aanbieders doen om dit soort informatie niet te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether Dutch law can reach directors of foreign legal entities in cases of pauline acts or bankruptcy fraud, whether the cross-border director-liability rules and the civil director ban are effective, and what was done after a 2011 Supreme Court ruling. The minister answered that cross-border cases are inherently complex, that the Netherlands raised the issue in the EU insolvency regulation review, that foreign director liability is governed by the law of the company's home state, and that the director-ban bill is still pending at the Council of State.
Precisely because of the inherent cross-border aspects, we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level.
Juist vanwege de inherente grensoverschrijdende aspecten achten wij het overigens van belang om over dit vraagstuk op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over het bericht “Via virtueel Filipijns meisje 1000 kindermisbruikers getraceerd”

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Terre des Hommes data on Dutch people linked to child abuse, traced via a virtual Filipino girl, can be used as evidence, whether virtual minors are protected under Dutch law, and whether police can use decoys. The Minister answered that Europol will analyse the data and pass Dutch cases to police, that virtual minors are not covered by the corruption offence but virtual child pornography is, and that a law change and a Groningen review of the sex offences title are underway.
With the law of 29 November 2009, implementing the Lanzarote Convention, the so-called corruption of minors was made punishable (article 248d Sr).
Met de wet van 29 november 2009 is, ter uitvoering van het Verdrag van Lanzarote, het zogenaamde corrumperen van minderjarigen strafbaar gesteld (artikel 248d Sr).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het bericht dat de AIVD politici op Bonaire heeft bespioneerd

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD secretly spied on Bonaire politicians between 2005 and 2010, whether the operation was legal, who ordered it and whether it influenced constitutional negotiations and led to criminal investigation. The minister's supplementary answer refers the MPs to a separate letter on the NRC reporting, so the substance is not given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Recourt and Van Laar (both PvdA), question number 2013Z22947, have been answered by way of the letter 'Response to the reporting in NRC on AIVD investigation on Bonaire'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van leden Recourt en Van Laar (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2013Z22947 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op de berichtgeving in het NRC over onderzoek van de AIVD op Bonaire» (Kamerstuk 30 977, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over notarissen die uitbuiting van hun cliënten moeten melden

MP Recourt asked whether notaries should be obliged to report exploitation or financial abuse of clients despite professional secrecy, and about disciplinary action and anonymous reporting. The government answered that notaries must refuse services in cases of suspected illegality and have reporting duties under the WWFT, that a voluntary meldcode and pilots are being used, and that anonymous reporting is not permitted.
I consider it important that notaries practise their profession in accordance with their professional code and legal obligations.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat notarissen conform hun beroepscode en wettelijke verplichtingen hun beroep uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht ‘Geheime dienst wijst legerliefjes af’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Defence personnel may only have relationships with partners from countries with which the MIVD or AIVD cooperates, how security clearance criteria work, and whether the policy breaches the right to family life under article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that partners are checked in security investigations, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens found an objective justification for the policy, and that in September 2010 to December 2012 five clearances were withdrawn and 25 refused due to insufficient data from time abroad.
If the security investigation yields insufficient data on the (partner of the) (prospective) position-of-trust holder, an assessment is not possible.
Indien het veiligheidsonderzoek onvoldoende gegevens oplevert over de (partner van) de (aspirant)vertrouwensfunctionaris, is een beoordeling niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over belastingontduiking door misdaadondernemers

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether criminals can evade tax by deregistering from the municipal population register (GBA), why conservatory assessments on emigration are limited, whether immediate settlement on emigration could replace them, and why a RIEC study on this fraud has not yielded an effective approach. The State Secretary answered that residence for tax purposes is assessed on all circumstances, that GBA deregistration alone does not end tax liability, that EU law makes immediate collection on emigration doubtful, and that an FIOD investigation into the phenomenon is underway with measures to follow depending on its outcome.
To gain further insight into the possible scale of this specific phenomenon, the FIOD is currently conducting an investigation.
Om nadere duiding over de mogelijke omvang van dit specifieke fenomeen te krijgen, voert de FIOD momenteel onderzoek uit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether foreign-company directors of Dutch companies can escape joint liability under Dutch law, and whether EU legislation is needed to change this. The minister replied that liability depends on the foreign law of the company's seat, that the Netherlands will raise harmonisation in the Commission's consultation, and that the upcoming civil director-ban bill will address misuse of foreign legal entities.
Because we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level as well, we will raise this in the consultation the European Commission is currently holding.

Omdat wij het van belang achten om over dit vraagstuk ook op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen, zullen wij dit opbrengen in het kader van de consultatie die de Europese Commissie momenteel houdt
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) inzake levenslang (ingezonden 15 juli 2013).

Recourt (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the 2013 ECtHR ruling against the UK on life sentences affects Dutch practice, including whether clemency gives lifers a real prospect of release, how often clemency was granted, and whether victims' interests are weighed. Teeven answered that Dutch law offers a real prospect of release through clemency, that clemency is effective (147 unconditional and 51 conditional grants in January–August 2013, one lifer's request granted in ten years), and that victims' interests are part of the assessment.
Life-sentenced prisoners can after all also be eligible for clemency.
Levenslanggestraften kunnen immers ook in aanmerking komen voor gratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over onduidelijke regels omtrent identificatieplicht voor zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether self-employed workers (zzp'ers) face unclear and contradictory identification rules when accepting assignments, and how their privacy is protected. Minister Kamp replied that identification is only required when a client demands a Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie, that the client must keep copies for seven years, and that the Chamber of Commerce only shares business addresses unless legal exceptions apply.
Self-employed workers are not obliged to identify themselves when accepting assignments.
Zzp'ers zijn niet verplicht zich te identificeren bij het aannemen van opdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de hoofdelijke aansprakelijkheid van volksvertegenwoordigers

Two Labour MPs asked the Interior Minister whether elected councillors and MPs can be held personally and jointly liable for democratic decisions, such as zoning changes causing planning damage. The minister answered that such personal liability is excluded by immunity provisions, that liability for damage rests with the public body, and that regress against representatives for voting is not possible.
That is not possible. Representatives must be able to speak and decide in their meetings without fear or threat of being personally involved in legal proceedings for doing so.

Dat is niet mogelijk. Volksvertegenwoordigers dienen in hun vergaderingen te kunnen spreken en besluiten zonder de vrees of dreiging daarvoor persoonlijk te worden betrokken in gerechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de (mogelijke) inhuur van private bedrijven of particulieren door de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence Minister about outsourcing of military work to private firms and individuals, including a full overview of contractors, staffing figures, legal frameworks applicable to civilian contractors, and whether they may do more than government personnel. The minister said a complete overview is not readily available, provided a 2011 list of the top 100 contractors and an external-hire expenditure table (about 2.3 percent of wage bill), and stated that civilian contractors are not hired to perform work that law forbids the military to outsource.
A complete overview is not directly available and would be very extensive.
Een compleet overzicht is niet direct beschikbaar en zou zeer omvangrijk zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt over verschillende berichten over het bestuur op Bonaire

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked about reports of strained relations between the Bonaire governor, executive councillors and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, alleged loss of trust over integrity, the removal of the supervision directorate from the governor's portfolio, and officials under criminal investigation remaining in office. The minister answered that reports are not always accurate, that portfolio allocation is a political matter for the college, that the governor informed the Rijksvertegenwoordiger in writing, and that integrity measures such as BIOS support and codes of conduct are underway.
It is and remains difficult to make statements with exact certainty about the motives of those involved on Bonaire.
Het is en blijft lastig om met exacte zekerheid uitspraken te doen over motieven van de betrokkenen in Bonaire.

Vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afschaffen van het 500-eurobiljet en de oprichting van een Europees Openbaar Ministerie (Ingezond

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about abolishing the 500-euro banknote, the AIV advice on crime and corruption, a European Public Prosecutor, financial crime investigation capacity, and FATF implementation. The government declined to back abolition, noted that only the ECB can decide on it, committed to drawing DNB's attention to the note, and said it opposes a European Public Prosecutor for now while expanding financial investigation capacity.
The Minister of Finance asked DNB to give special attention to the 500-euro banknote in future research into the use of euro banknotes.
De Minister van Financiën heeft DNB verzocht in toekomstige onderzoeken naar het gebruik van eurobiljetten speciale aandacht te geven aan het 500-eurobiljet.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gebruik van DigiD door bewindvoerders ten gu

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked whether professional guardians (bewindvoerders) routinely request clients' DigiD login credentials, whether this is desirable, and whether fraud is possible. The state secretary answered that DigiD is personal and should not be shared, that DigiD Machtigen is not yet connected to most agencies, that a review and consultation with the professional associations are underway, and that no evidence of fraud is known.
Because DigiD is a personal means of identification, it is not desirable for guardians to appeal to beneficiaries to hand over their login details.
Omdat DigiD een persoonsgebonden middel is, is het niet wenselijk dat bewindvoerders een appèl doen op rechthebbenden om hun inloggegevens te verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over oplichting bij Marktplaats (ingezonden 30 mei 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether fraud on Marktplaats, which Article 326 of the Criminal Code only covers when a false name or quality is used, should be addressed more broadly given online trade. The minister replied that the Landelijk Meldpunt tool and civil remedies suffice for now, while a review of new criminal options after a Supreme Court ruling on embezzlement is ongoing.

As I informed you in my answers to earlier written questions, following a Supreme Court ruling on embezzlement I am consulting the Public Prosecution Service on whether, and if so how, new criminal law options should be created.

Zoals ik u in mijn antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen 2 heb laten weten, ben ik naar aanleiding van een arrest van de Hoge Raad ter zake van verduistering met het Openbaar Ministerie in overleg om te bezien of, en zo ja op welke wijze, nieuwe strafrechtelijke mogelijkheden moeten worden gecreëerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de AT5 uitzending “Voortvluchtige A.A. werd steeds crimineler"

Labour MP Recourt asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about an AT5 broadcast on a fugitive who cut his ankle monitor, asking whether this occurred, what procedure applies, what actions followed, and how often offenders do this. The state secretary confirmed the bracelet was cut, described the notification procedure and the registration in the search register, acknowledged that monitoring cannot prevent all incidents, and said such cases occur only two to three times a year.
In the present case, the procedure was followed in full.
In de onderhavige casus is volledig conform genoemde procedure gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt  over het falende Nederlandse anti-dopingbeleid

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about reports that Dutch anti-doping policy is failing, including claims of a doubling of doping laboratories, online doping sales and cross-border cooperation with Belgium. The government answered that the picture is not recognised by the IGZ and the OM, outlined existing EU and national cooperation, announced an inter-ministerial consultation and a symposium, and said it sees no need to revise sports self-regulation for now.
The picture sketched in the broadcast is not recognised by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het in de uitzending geschetste beeld wordt door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het openbaar ministerie (OM) niet herkend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over toezicht op advocaten

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the supervision of lawyers after a Haarlem court case involving two advocates and a possible criminal plot, and how a dean can act on complaints or concerns. The state secretary answered that the dean is responsible for investigating the lawyers' conduct, that anyone may report concerns to the dean, and that the roles of both lawyers are currently under investigation, while also referring to a bill proposing a supervisory college for the legal profession.
It is not for me but for the dean to carry out such an investigation.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de deken om een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het rapport ‘DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelde minderjarigen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Children's Ombudsman's report on DNA collection from convicted minors, which argues it breaches children's rights under the IVRK, was sound and whether the government would act on its recommendations. The state secretary rejected the recommendations, arguing the DNA Act applies equally to minors and adults, is limited to serious offences, and is consistent with ECHR case law.
For the reasons set out in the answers to questions 4 through 6, I do not adopt any of the Children's Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik neem om de redenen zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 4 tot en met 6 geen van de aanbevelingen van de Kinderombudsman over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de opslag van vingerafdrukken

Oosenbrug and Recourt (PvdA) asked the Justice Minister whether the ECtHR ruling M.K. v France on retaining fingerprints of acquitted persons affects Dutch law and practice, and whether it limits the planned retention rule under the Herziening ten nadele act. The minister answered that the ruling does not change Dutch rules since acquitted persons' fingerprints are destroyed, and that the planned rule includes restrictions absent in France, so it is compatible with Article 8 ECHR.

The ruling has no consequences for current Dutch regulations and practice, because under the Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden the fingerprints of a suspect are destroyed after an acquittal or dismissal.

Het arrest heeft geen gevolgen voor de Nederlandse geldende regelgeving en praktijk, reeds omdat op grond van het Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden de vingerafdrukken van de verdachte na een vrijspraak of sepot worden vernietigd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over mogelijke verspilling van belastinggeld door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether the Public Prosecution Service pays an IT provider for 11,000 accounts, including accounts with no employee attached, and whether other government bodies do the same. The minister replied that billing is currently a fixed price rather than per account, that talks are underway on per-account billing, and that no central register of accounts exists across government.
There is no central register of accounts within central government.
Er is binnen het Rijk geen centraal register van accounts.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de reactie op een grote botnet-infectie door het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police and the NCSC allegedly reacted slowly to a large Pobelka botnet infection, and about IP-address sharing, notice-and-take-down, investigation, vital-sector cooperation and the need for regulation. The minister rejected the claim of inaction, explained the data handling and legal limits, reported an ongoing criminal investigation, and promised an updated cyber security strategy and forthcoming incident-reporting legislation.
The NCSC had no legal basis to view and process the remaining substantive and possibly sensitive data.
Het NCSC had geen rechtsbasis om de resterende inhoudelijke en mogelijk gevoelige gegevens in te zien en te verwerken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Ypma over een illegale verstandelijk gehandicapte jongen die in een schoolbus is opgepakt en een week in vreemdelingenbewaring heeft verbleven

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Ypma asked the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice about a mentally disabled undocumented youth stopped in a car and held in immigration detention for about a week, asking why he was detained, whether his vulnerability was considered, and whether a 48-hour judicial review should be introduced. The state secretary answered that the vulnerability was unknown to police and not reported, detention was justified by the risk of absconding, compensation was offered, and a future policy vision would follow, while declining to examine the case further beyond answering the questions.
Personal information about the person concerned and his immigration status has been limited as much as possible in these answers, given his privacy.
Persoonlijke informatie over betrokkene en zijn vreemdelingrechtelijke status is zo veel als mogelijk beperkt in deze antwoorden, gelet op zijn privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de prejudiciële vragen die de Raad van State heeft gesteld over de beoordeling van de homoseksualiteit van vreemdelingen

MP Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the Council of State's preliminary questions to the EU Court on how to assess the claimed homosexuality of asylum seekers, including effects on pending cases, assessment standards, and reports of observation in psychiatric facilities in Poland, Bulgaria and Romania. The State Secretary replied that the questions do not change IND policy, that the IND's approach is careful and respects personal integrity, that the courts decide on suspension, and that Poland and Romania denied the practice while Bulgaria's information is still awaited.
It is up to the judge whether appeal procedures will be suspended.
Het is aan de rechter of procedures in (hoger) beroep zullen worden aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de sluiting van de basisschool op het asielzoekerscentrum in Gilze wegens geldgebrek

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the primary school at the Gilze asylum centre would close for lack of funds, why money was not spent, and whether children's right to education would be guaranteed. The government said the school board decides on closure, housing was resolved via COA funds, the financial problem is being examined with the board, and that a solution aims to prevent closure.
The decision whether or not to keep a school open rests with the school board concerned.
Het besluit om een school wel of niet open te houden is aan het betreffende schoolbestuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Recourt en De Wit over een ontslagen notaris die als kandidaat op zijn eigen kantoor verder werkt

MPs asked why a notary struck from the office could re-register as a candidate notary and continue working at his own firm, and whether the law should be amended to close this gap. The minister answered that the candidate notary works under a notary's responsibility, that disciplinary and supervisory tools already address such cases, and that amending the law is not warranted given pending appeal proceedings.
Supervision and disciplinary law are therefore effective instruments to intervene in situations like this.
Het toezicht en het tuchtrecht zijn dus effectieve instrumenten om in situaties als deze in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over interlandelijke adoptie uit Ethiopië

Member Recourt (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about intercountry adoptions from Ethiopia, following a Brandpunt broadcast alleging fraud and irregular procedures, and asked whether Vereniging Wereldkinderen should be suspended and how adoption safeguards are controlled. The State Secretary Teeven answered that no fraud was found but procedural irregularities occurred, extra safeguards were introduced in 2010, no new adoptions via Wereldkinderen occurred after 2010, and he sees no reason to suspend procedures.
There was no fraud in adoptions from Ethiopia.
Er is niet gefraudeerd met adopties vanuit Ethiopië.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Ypma over het geadopteerde Chinese meisje dat na drie weken bij een pleeggezin is ondergebracht

MPs Recourt and Ypma asked the state secretaries about a Chinese adopted girl placed with a foster family after three weeks, the Inspectorate's findings, whether the Central Authority was informed, adoption-matching failures and aftercare. The government answered that the adoptive parents did not inform the intermediary or Central Authority, that the Central Authority of China was informed afterwards, that the Inspectorate's recommendations will feed into an evaluation of the quality framework, and that VWS will report on aftercare in the first half of 2013.
The quality framework for intercountry adoption intermediaries is currently being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het kwaliteitskader voor de vergunninghouders interlandelijke adoptie geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over het negeren van een rijverbod door een dronken chauffeur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a drunk bus driver who kept driving despite a driving ban and whether employers are informed when an employee loses their licence. The minister said employers are not named in the licence regulations, that the public prosecutor can inform transport employers case by case, and that no general employer notification duty is planned.
In view of this, I see no reason to create, for example, a general notification duty for employers.
Gelet hierop zie ik geen aanleiding om bijvoorbeeld een algemene meldplicht aan werkgevers in het leven te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over rechters die hun nevenfuncties niet opgeven

MPs Recourt and Van der Steur asked the Justice Minister why some judges have not fully registered their ancillary positions, and whether this undermines trust in the judiciary. The minister answered that the registration duty took effect on 1 January 2013, that the courts' boards are checking the register, that he will press the Council for the judiciary and the judges' association to keep it complete, and that a bill on sanctions against judges will go to consultation by 1 April 2013.
I consider it, like the Council and the NVvR, of great importance that the register of ancillary positions is current and complete.
Ik acht het – evenals de Raad en de NVvR – van groot belang dat het register nevenbetrekkingen actueel en volledig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over uitspraken van de president van het gerechtshof Den Bosch

MPs Recourt and De Vries asked the Justice Minister about remarks by the president of the Den Bosch appeals court suggesting higher-appeal hearings would not in principle be held in Middelburg, Zeeland, despite earlier assurances. The minister confirmed the zitting location designation, said court management decides venues, and rejected the claim that no appeal hearings would be held in Middelburg, reaffirming his commitments to Zeeland.
I cannot agree with the claim that in principle no appeal hearings will be held in Middelburg.
Met de stelling dat in beginsel geen hoger beroepzaken in Middelburg worden gedaan, kan ik mij niet verenigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat kantonrechters regelmatig dubieuze beslissingen nemen

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a study claiming cantonal judges often make wrong decisions (about 12,500 of 250,000 criminal cases) is valid, whether judges are swayed by prosecutors and whether further research is needed. The minister replied that the Judiciary Council rejects the study's methodology and conclusions, which are not solid enough to base policy or further research on.
Taking this into account, I consider the study's conclusions insufficiently solid to base policy measures or further research on them.
Dit in aanmerking nemende acht ik de conclusies van het onderzoek onvoldoende solide om hier beleidsmaatregelen of nader onderzoek mijnerzijds op te baseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de achterstand van Nederland in de strijd tegen matchfixing

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers why the Netherlands lags behind criminal networks in combating match-fixing, including whether football associations can detect it and whether reporters are protected. The minister answered that a study by the ministries started on 23 January 2013, that anonymous reporting is possible, and that protective measures will be considered after the study's results.
For that reason, reporters are given the opportunity to tell their story anonymously within the ministries' study, via a web survey and a telephone reporting option.
Om die reden wordt melders in het kader van het onderzoek van onze ministeries via een webenquête en een telefonische meldingsmogelijkheid de mogelijkheid gegeven om anoniem hun verhaal te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Jacobi en Van der Steur en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie verlaat Leeuwarden’

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is leaving Leeuwarden for Groningen, what that means for Leeuwarden as a justice city, and whether Friesland was promised anything to protect jobs. The minister answered that Leeuwarden remains a full justice city with OM workplaces, that the regional ZSM and local cooperation are secured, and that no specific commitments were made to Leeuwarden or Friesland beyond attention to employment effects.
No commitments have been made to Leeuwarden and Friesland.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen gedaan aan Leeuwarden en Friesland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de positie van forensische accountants bij onderzoek naar fraude

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether forensic accountants must report suspicious past fraudulent transactions under the Wwft, and whether an advocate-led investigation exempts them from that duty. The minister answered that reporting duties apply, with administrative and criminal sanctions for non-reporting, and that the derived legal privilege of a lawyer only exempts accountants where the lawyer's role is restrictively defined as legal representation.
It must be prevented that merely engaging a lawyer renders supervision and the reporting duty illusory (abuse of the derived legal privilege).
Voorkomen dient te worden dat door het enkel inschakelen van een advocaat het toezicht en de meldplicht illusoir worden gemaakt (misbruik afgeleid verschoningsrecht).
Antwoord vragen Recourt en Marcouch over het afluisteren van telefoongesprekken van gedetineerden

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked about the recording of detainees' phone calls, including with lawyers, after an RSJ ruling that standard recording must end. Minister Teeven answered that the current rules already allow standard recording, that a number-recognition system with the NOvA is planned for 2013, and that interim alternative phones will be arranged for calls with lawyers.
I point out that the amendments to the Penitentiary Principles Act and underlying regulations in force since 1 January 2011 already provide a basis for standard recording.
Ik wijs er op dat met de sinds 1 januari 2011 inwerking getreden wijzigingen in de Pbw en onderliggende regelgeving al is voorzien in een grondslag voor het standaard opnemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over het gevaar van matchfixing in het Nederlandse voetbal

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the danger of match-fixing in Dutch football, citing a criminologist's claim that police and prosecutors do not take it seriously. The minister denied this, pointed to an ongoing study of match-fixing, noted the new gambling regulator's enforcement, and welcomed the KNVB's own anti-match-fixing plans.
As your House is aware, the Ministries of Health, Welfare and Sport and of Security and Justice are currently commissioning research into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend is laten de Ministeries van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie momenteel onderzoek doen naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over onredelijke schuldeisers waardoor er onnodig bedrijven failliet gaan

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Dutch bankruptcy law gives creditors too strong a position, causing firms to fail unnecessarily or relocate abroad, and whether a court could bind unreasonable creditors before bankruptcy. Minister Opstelten acknowledged the problem, announced a bankruptcy law reform programme with stakeholder consultation and comparative research, but gave no firm commitment to a quick bill and said fraud prevention currently has priority.
That is why I have also announced legislation providing for the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.
Daarom heb ik ook wetgeving aangekondigd die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht ‘Chaos troef bij Topklasser FC Chabab; zwart geld, witte lijnen.’

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a former main sponsor of FC Chabab used the club to launder drug money, whether drug money laundering via football clubs has occurred before, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the investigation concerned drug dealing rather than laundering through the club, that no convictions for laundering via football clubs are known, and that anti-laundering measures and a bill raising penalties are in preparation.

The criminal investigation by the National Public Prosecutor's Office into the former main sponsor of FC Chabab, referred to in the article cited in question 1, did not concern laundering drug money through this club.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Landelijk Parket dat plaatsgevonden heeft naar de voormalige hoofdsponsor van FC Chabab en waaraan in het in vraag 1 aangehaalde artikel wordt gerefereerd had geen betrekking op het witwassen van drugsgelden via deze vereniging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het bericht dat er jaarlijks ongeveer voor 1 miljard euro faillissementsfraude wordt gepleegd

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked ministers whether they recognise the estimate of about 1 billion euro yearly losses from bankruptcy fraud, whether the 2.5% detection rate is adequate, and what has been done since the last committee debate. Minister Opstelten answered that about 700 million euro of the 4 billion euro in bankruptcy debts stems from fraud, that the FIOD handles about 40 complex cases a year, and referred to a letter of 27 November 2012 for the measures taken.
For that reason I am of the view that the detection rate must go up further and work on this is under way.
Mede daarom ben ik van mening dat de pakkans verder omhoog moet en wordt daar ook volop aan gewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over de gebrekkige handhaving van de wet controle rechtspersonen en faillissementsfraude

Two MPs asked why the Wet controle rechtspersonen and its Radar system, meant to block convicted bankruptcy fraudsters from founding companies, have produced only about ten referrals, why costs rose to 18.7 million euro, and whether the law is a paper tiger. The minister replied that the system was deliberately started small, that Radar already can analyse other legal persons, that risk reports are valued by users, and that a separate letter on bankruptcy fraud was sent on 27 November 2012.

Supervision of legal persons was started in a limited and controlled way, in consultation with the supervisory and investigative bodies, and was tailored as far as possible to the needs of the receiving parties.
Het toezicht op rechtspersonen is, in overleg met de toezichthoudende en opsporende instanties, beperkt en beheerst gestart en is zoveel mogelijk toegesneden op de behoefte van de afnemende partijen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dikkers en Recourt over het bericht dat er tritium in het grondwater is gekomen door een lek van de reactor in Petten

MPs Jan Vos, Dikkers and Recourt asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports of tritium in groundwater from a leak at the Petten reactor, including how long the leak went unnoticed, the amount released, health risks, and prevention. Minister Kamp answered that the leak was found on 11 November 2012, roughly 10 GBq was estimated released, RIVM saw no direct health risk, and NRG is repairing the pipe and cleaning up under KFD supervision, with further inspection and tightened maintenance.
The KFD has instructed NRG to tighten and carry out the inspection and maintenance programme.
De KFD heeft NRG opgedragen om het inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma aan te scherpen en uit te voeren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over medische verzekeraars

An MP asked the government about medical insurers' handling of malpractice claims after a TROS Radar broadcast, including dossier delays, the GOMA code, and transparency of medical advisers' reports. The government answered that it considers such practices unacceptable, cites insurers' commitments under the GOMA and the Letselschade Raad's oversight, and says it will monitor developments.
Losing files on purpose and threatening lengthy procedures I do not consider acceptable.
Zoekgemaakte dossiers en dreigen met langdurige procedures acht ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Recourt over identiteitsfraude door slecht bewaarde paspoortkopieën

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked about identity fraud risks from copies of passports that self-employed contractors must give each client and clients must keep for seven years. The minister replied that the retention duty is legally required, that the government lacks data on fraud involving such copies, suggested contractors write purpose and date on copies, and said the VAR web module will not change the identification requirement.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will start a campaign at the end of this year to point people to this option.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties start eind dit jaar een campagne om mensen op deze mogelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over adoptie in afrikaanse landen

An MP asked the state secretary about adoption practices from African countries, including professionalism of adoption organisations, the suppressed Fruits of Ethiopia report, and Ethiopia and Uganda adoptions. The state secretary answered that the system is sound but needs stronger controls, that the report was withheld for privacy reasons and unverified findings, and that no evidence of abuses exists in other African countries.
The reason the report was not published is the privacy sensitivity of the information and the inaccuracies found in the report.
De reden dat het rapport niet naar buiten is gebracht is vanwege de privacygevoeligheid van de informatie en de geconstateerde onjuistheden die in het rapport stonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over de NODO-procedure in de praktijk

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked why the Child Death Review was dropped, why only two instead of five NODO centres were set up, and whether forensic doctor knowledge gaps affect NODO referrals. The state secretary answered that the CDR could not be funded given budget limits, that two centres were chosen for expertise and cost reasons with a startfase evaluation until October 2013, and that enough qualified forensic doctors are now available.
The available budget has been used to introduce the NODO procedure.
Het beschikbare budget is ingezet om de NODO-procedure in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over de sterk gestegen criminaliteit in Noord-Holland

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a sharp rise in burglaries, car theft and public violence in Noord-Holland, and what is being done about it. The minister confirmed the increases over 2008-2011 (burglary tracking the national trend, car theft and violence diverging), reported declines in 2012, and said an intensified approach already exists through burglary teams and a regional taskforce on robberies, with the new national police expected to help.
For burglaries this matches the national trend in that period, but the rise in car thefts and public violence deviates from the national picture.

Ten aanzien van woninginbraken komt dit overeen met de landelijke ontwikkeling in die periode, maar de stijging van het aantal autodiefstallen en openlijke geweldplegingen wijkt af van het landelijk beeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether the government would improve information to carers about the inheritance tax exemption linked to the mantelzorgcompliment, and whether the exemption should rest on receiving that compliment. The state secretary replied that information has already been improved, including SVB letters, and that the compliment is not meant for the exemption, so the statutory condition cannot be waived through the hardship clause.
Since this is an explicit choice by the legislature, I have no room to deviate from it by applying the hardship clause.
Nu sprake is van een uitdrukkelijke keuze van de wetgever, heb ik geen ruimte om daarvan met toepassing van hardheidsclausule af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing in Nederland

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about the arrest of Paul R. for handling stolen masterpieces, whether Germany seeks to prosecute him over the Bochum bribery scandal, and whether they should hear him and launch criminal investigation into match-fixing. The minister confirmed the German prosecution and European arrest warrant, said a thorough in-depth study of match-fixing is being commissioned, but no criminal investigation will start because the Netherlands lacks information on possible offences committed here.
Since the Netherlands does not currently have such information, no criminal investigation will be started.
Nu Nederland tot op heden niet over dergelijke informatie beschikt, wordt dan ook geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kuiken over het niet afnemen van criminele winsten van henneptelers

MPs Recourt and Kuiken asked why the Public Prosecution Service reduced confiscation claims against cannabis growers in Breda, whether this reflected backlogs or poor case files, and how many other prosecutors have weak confiscation. Minister Opstelten answered that the claims were lowered because initial calculations of illegal gains were too high, denied backlog or horse-trading motives, and said no further investigation was needed, promising a 2012 target of 49 million euros which he expects to meet.
In the relevant cases the adjustments were necessary because the initial calculation of the confiscation amount was too high.
In de desbetreffende zaken waren de aanpassingen noodzakelijk door een te hoge initiële berekening van het ontnemingsbedrag.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Recourt over de rechtsmacht over militairen die koopvaardijschepen tegen piraten beschermen

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Dutch military protection teams on merchant ships could be prosecuted by other states, who holds jurisdiction in different maritime zones, and whether SOFAs are needed. The government answered that UNCLOS gives clear jurisdiction, Dutch flag vessels remain under Dutch criminal law, the Dutch prosecutor reviews any use of force, and there is no criminal immunity.
There is no question of criminal immunity.
Van strafrechtelijke immuniteit is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het verdwijnen van het Openbaar Ministerie uit Zeeland

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether promises were made to keep a local public prosecution office in Zeeland, and about the consequences of its closure for the criminal justice chain, proximity to mayors, jobs, and the court's status. The minister replied that no decision on housing the prosecution offices has been taken yet, no promises were made for the new Zeeland-West-Brabant district, service quality is paramount, consultations with three regions are ongoing, and Middelburg will be designated a court location.
Contrary to what the question assumes, I have not yet taken a decision on the housing of the various OM prosecution offices in the new districts.
Anders dan in de vraagstelling wordt verondersteld heb ik nog geen beslissing genomen over de huisvesting van de verschillende OM-parketten in de nieuwe arrondissementen.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afluisteren van advocaten (ingezonden 7 september 2012).

MP Recourt asks the state secretary whether lawyer-client conversations were recorded or listened to in real time despite rules, how that happened, and whether confidentiality can be guaranteed. The state secretary admits real-time listening occurred in about 0.1% of taps because the automatic number-recognition system did not cover it, says the gap is being fixed, and orders an external audit with the Dutch Bar.
