The KLPD has taken action to ensure that, in a very short time, real-time privileged lawyer-client conversations are also blocked.
Het KLPD heeft actie genomen om ervoor te zorgen dat op zeer korte termijn ook «real time» geheimhoudergesprekken worden geblokkeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans, Recourt en Marcouch over neonazi’s in Duitsland

MPs Timmermans, Recourt and Marcouch asked the Justice minister about the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia banning three far-right groups and a large police raid, and whether this threatens spillover into the Netherlands and whether closer cooperation is needed. The minister answered that cooperation with German police and the AIVD is good and structural, that the raid led to no Dutch link so far, and that action will follow if Dutch links emerge.
Should facts emerge later in the investigation that relate to the Netherlands, action will be taken on this.
Mochten er in het verdere verloop van het onderzoek alsnog feiten boven tafel komen die verband houden met Nederland, dan zal hier actie op worden ondernomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over oplichters werkzaam in de schuldsanering

Recourt (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knew of a rise in fraudulent debt-restructuring trustees and budget coaches, what was being done about it, and whether emotional support is addressed for people with debts. Minister Opstelten answered that the growth is unproven, pointed to a pending bill setting quality standards for protective trustees and the Wet op het consumentenkrediet and DNB/BEH supervision, and noted municipalities' responsibility for quality of debt assistance.
It is not certain that the number of fraudulent trustees and budget coaches is increasing rapidly.
Het is niet zeker of het aantal malafide bewindvoerders en budgetcoaches snel toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over het gebrek aan regels bij het opzetten van een filefuik bij autoachtervolgingen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why police officers deciding on creating a traffic blockade (filefuik) during car chases have no clear rules, and about prosecution after the A2 incident. The minister said a national framework is being drafted within three months, police will show restraint meanwhile, and the Public Prosecution Service found the risk to road users too high, but corporate criminal liability and individual prosecution were ruled out.
In the meantime, restraint will be exercised in creating a traffic blockade to arrest a suspect.
In afwachting hiervan zal terughoudendheid worden betracht met het creëren van een filefuik ter aanhouding van een verdachte.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot over de werkwijze van gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs Recourt and Groot asked whether bailiffs allocate collected payments first to costs, then interest, then principal, and whether this creates tax or legal issues, notably in ABN AMRO cases. The government answered that the Article 6:44 BW order applies, found no indications of tax avoidance or criminal conduct, and said the Bureau Financieel Toezicht is conducting an exploratory investigation into bailiffs' interest calculations, expected to conclude in October.
In January 2012 the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) started an exploratory investigation into interest calculation by bailiffs.
In januari 2012 is het Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) gestart met een verkennend onderzoek naar renteberekening door gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat de belastingbetaler moet opdraaien voor de schade die criminelen veroorzaken

MP Recourt asked the state secretary whether the taxpayer is left paying for damages criminals owe to victims of violent and sexual offences, and how the state recovers them. The state secretary explained that advance payment schemes are recovering only part of the money, that the CJIB has enforcement tools including substitute detention, and that most sentenced offenders pay in full.
Perpetrators must bear the cost of the damage they cause.
Daders moeten opdraaien voor de schade die zij aanrichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt over het toezicht op vrijgekomen ernstige zware delinquenten

Two MPs asked whether police supervision of released violent and sex offenders is unclear and poorly coordinated with probation, and whether dangerous offenders are reliably checked. The state secretary answered that a 2011 national cooperation agreement and the new conditional sanctions law (in force 1 April 2012) clarify roles, with probation primarily responsible and police providing a signalling function, and that mayors are informed of certain returning offenders.
Probation is primarily responsible for supervision and always contacts the neighbourhood police officer when restrictive conditions have been imposed (and in other cases when necessary).

De reclassering is primair verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht en neemt indien vrijheidsbeperkende voorwaarden zijn opgelegd altijd (en in andere gevallen indien daar noodzaak toe is) contact op met de wijkagent.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de kritiek van de Nationale Ombudsman op de benoemingsprocedure van de vice-president van de Raad van State

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked why the government will not implement a motion giving parliament a role in appointing the Raad van State vice-president, and whether the appointment procedure lacked transparency as the Ombudsman found. The ministers answered that appointments are a government power, that a constitutional change would be needed for a parliamentary role, and that the procedure was transparent, with the speculation not proving coordinated conduct.
Giving the Tweede Kamer a statutory role in the appointment procedure, for example in the form of a nomination right, is therefore only possible if the Constitution is amended in this respect.

Het toekennen van een wettelijke rol aan de Tweede Kamer in de benoemingsprocedure, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van een voordrachtsrecht, is daarom slechts mogelijk als de Grondwet in deze zin wordt gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether carers can qualify for the raised inheritance tax exemption of 600,000 euro, what conditions apply, and whether citizens have been adequately informed. The state secretary confirmed the partner exemption conditions (including the carer allowance, cohabitation contract or five-year registration, and no other partner), said no specific agreements on information were made with parliament, and committed to working with Mezzo on improving information to carers.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport will consult with Mezzo to examine whether information to carers on inheritance tax and the exemption could be further improved.
De staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal in overleg met Mezzo bezien of zij de voorlichting aan mantelzorgers over erfbelasting en vrijstelling verder zouden kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over identiteitsfraude

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked about identity fraud in which a criminal opened a PostNL business mail-forwarding account in a victim's name and redirected post, including private mail. The state secretary said attempts are rare (under 0.03%), PostNL has taken measures, the police investigation found no suspect, and the matter is being looked into, but declined to give details on the specific case.
In the interest of the investigation and with a view to possible future fraud attempts, no further information can be given about specific cases.
In het belang van het onderzoek en met het oog op eventuele toekomstige fraudepogingen kan over specifieke zaken geen verdere mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over trage teruggave van gestolen goederen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why stolen goods recovered by police were returned to the victim only after more than half a year, and what will be done to speed up such returns. The minister agreed goods should be returned once no prosecutorial interest remains, regretted the one-month delay after the investigation ended, denied the return was forced by publicity, and pointed to victim-care policy and pending legislation without giving a fixed timeframe.
The importance of prompt handling of seizures, including the options of article 116 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, will be emphasised within the Public Prosecution Service.
Het belang van een snelle afhandeling van beslag, waaronder de mogelijkheden van artikel 116 Sv., zal binnen het OM worden benadrukt.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het afnemen van crimineel vermogen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the FIOD interview on fragmented expertise and cooperation in confiscating criminal assets, and whether a single national confiscation agency would help. The minister answered that expertise overlap is efficient, that cooperation problems are being addressed through an integrated approach and a letter to parliament, and that a single agency is not decisive for success.
I sent your House a letter this week describing all the efforts and the related results.
Ik heb uw Kamer deze week een brief gestuurd waarin alle inspanningen en de bijbehorende resultaten worden beschreven
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Jacobi over de gevolgen voor Den Oever van een dijkverhoging door het Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the consequences for Den Oever of a dike raising by the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier, including whether an integrated approach was considered and whether a commission's recommendations were taken into account. The state secretary replied that the water board is primarily responsible under a subsidy programme, that an integrated alternative was studied and rejected on cost grounds, and that the concept preferred option can still be adjusted with the parties while the province safeguards regional interests.
The manager, in this case the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK), is primarily responsible for carrying out this project.
De beheerder, in dit geval Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK) , is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van dit project.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over antiterrorisme controles op Utrecht Centraal Station

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about a large police 'spotter' control at Utrecht Centraal station in March 2012 and its legal basis, purpose, frequency, public impact and proportionality. The minister answered that it was a preventive KLPD action without a terrorism threat, that such actions recur without advance notice, that citizens are not informed beforehand, and that the method is proportionate and effective, but declined to commission a new study.
The usefulness and necessity of the spotter actions have been proven during earlier actions.
Het nut en de noodzaak van de spotteracties zijn tijdens eerdere acties bewezen.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de betrekkelijkheid van anonieme gegevens

An MP asks whether anonymised government data can be re-identified using postcode and birth date, and whether current privacy law and the EU privacy proposal adequately protect citizens. The state secretary says he had not yet studied the underlying thesis, that anonymised data must not remain easily traceable to individuals, and that the existing and proposed legal framework appears adequate, pointing instead to weak safeguards by some processors and citizen carelessness.
Rather, the reporting seems to point to inadequate protective measures taken by certain processors of personal data
Veeleer lijkt de berichtgeving te wijzen op ontoereikende beschermingsmaatregelen die bepaalde verwerkers van persoonsgegevens hebben getroffen
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing in Finland, reports of exploitation of young foreign players, and whether the government would investigate and take responsibility. The minister answered that she lacks knowledge of Finland, sees no concrete signs of such practices in the Netherlands and no reason for a study, while placing primary responsibility on players and the KNVB, relying on the existing criminal law system.
Because there are no concrete indications that such practices occur in the Netherlands, I also see no reason to start such an investigation.
Omdat er geen concrete aanwijzingen zijn dat dergelijke praktijken zich in Nederland voordoen zie ik ook geen aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over DNA-afgename bij jongeren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the NFI annual report showing a rise in juveniles in the DNA database and whether DNA sampling of minors is disproportionate due to pedagogical sentences. The government said the study is not yet finished, with the Chamber to be informed before the summer recess, and that the rise reflects stable proportions tied to the 2010 expansion of the DNA Act.
The House of Representatives will be further informed about this before the summer recess.
De Tweede Kamer zal hierover voor het zomerreces nader geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Recourt over de rapportage van gerechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a study of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists in criminal cases, including whether reports are based on seeing the suspect, whether recidivism tools are used, and whether the findings link to the Visser committee on tbs. The state secretary's answer, sent as a reply to the parliamentary agenda request, is a cross-reference to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 143) dated 30 March, with no substantive answers included in this document.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt (both PvdA) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the reporting of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists (submitted 23 March 2012) were answered on 30 March.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rapportage van rechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters (ingezonden 23 maart 2012) zijn beantwoord op 30 maart

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over der artikelen “De Alpenzwendel. In het spoor van de voetbalmaffia”en “Enveloppen in Huis ter duin. Talloze lijntjes lopen naar Nederland”en matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether Dutch police and prosecutors had contact with German authorities about match-fixing, whether Interpol and Dutch participation in anti-match-fixing cooperation were adequate, and whether new legislation was needed. The government answered that only a 2009 German mutual legal assistance request concerned a Dutch national, that no Dutch criminal offences were found, that existing criminal law (art. 328ter) suffices, and that prevention is mainly the responsibility of the Dutch football sector and KNVB.
For tackling criminal conduct related to match fixing in our country, the national criminal law system is sufficient.
Voor de aanpak van criminele gedragingen gerelateerd aan match fixing in ons land volstaat het nationale strafrechtelijke stelsel.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over financiering in de rechtspraak

MP Recourt asks whether the government will change the court financing system, including linking court fees to pre-trial hearings and adding incentives for efficiency. Minister Opstelten rejects a new system, defends the current budget and fee structure as best practice, and declines to consult on alternatives.
No. See the answers to questions 1 through 4.
Nee. Zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 tot en met 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het verschoningsrecht van bedrijfsjuristen

An MP asked the state secretary about legal privilege for in-house lawyers after a Groningen court ruled they lack it, citing EU case law. The state secretary said the ruling is under appeal, declined to take a position or commit to legislation yet, and said he would consult stakeholders on the scope of the privilege.
Pending a final judicial ruling, I will consult with the parties concerned to further explore the scope of the legal privilege.
In afwachting van een definitief rechterlijk oordeel zal ik in overleg met betrokken partijen mij nader oriënteren op (de reikwijdte van) het verschoningsrecht.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Recourt over de berichtgeving dat er vals spel wordt gespeeld op de huizenveiling

MPs Monasch and Recourt asked about reports of cheating at house auctions and the WEW's decision to stop auctioning NHG-guaranteed homes. The minister said the WEW works with financiers to avoid auctions, a bill on forced-sale procedures is planned, existing sanctions suffice against cartel conduct, and the WEW refused 25% of executive auction requests in 2011.
This proposal is expected to be submitted to your House this summer.
Dit voorstel wordt naar verwachting in de zomer van dit jaar bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de verklaring van erfrecht

MP Recourt asks whether bank declarations replacing the certificate of inheritance give the same safeguards, whether heirs understand them, and whether banks must warn heirs that signing accepts the estate. The state secretary answers that the NVB form is not an equivalent safeguard, that banks will advise or refer heirs to a notary, and that the NVB will revise the form to flag pure acceptance of the estate.
The NVB has promised to look at how the NVB form can be adjusted on this point in the short term.
Zij heeft toegezegd op korte termijn te bekijken hoe het NVB-formulier op dit punt kan worden aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over omkoping en bedrog in het internationale voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing and betting-syndicate involvement in international football, including risks to Dutch youth players and whether the Dutch authorities acted after German arrests. The minister said the Dutch federation KNVB leads prevention, that no Dutch cases of youth players being approached are known, and that the German case produced no Dutch investigation, while the government will join Council of Europe negotiations on a match-fixing convention.
First and foremost, sport is in the lead and is doing a great deal on this front with various preventive measures.
Eerst en vooral is de sport aan zet en die zetten hier fors op in met verschillende preventieve maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het bericht dat verdachten met een buitenlands uiterlijk strenger gestraft worden dan andere verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Leiden study suggesting suspects with a foreign appearance receive harsher sentences, and whether judges are trained against stereotyping. The minister answered that appearance and language must play no role in sentencing, that the WODC found the study's conclusions insufficiently justified, and that judicial training already covers impartiality and no new measures are needed.
The appearance and language proficiency of the suspect may not play a role in sentencing.
Het uiterlijk en de taalbeheersing van de verdachte mogen geen rol spelen bij de straftoemeting.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt met betrekking tot het gebrek aan tijd bij de politie om winkeldieven aan te pakken

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked whether police lack time to tackle shop theft and whether municipal enforcement officers (BOA's) should handle minor shop theft. The minister replies that shop theft is a serious crime but that BOA's are a complement to police, that a pilot with shop-theft BOA's runs in five municipalities, and that a convenant on sharing camera images with retailers has been signed.
To speed up the handling of shop theft, a pilot with shop BOA's is now being carried out in five municipalities.
Om de afhandeling van winkeldiefstal te versnellen wordt er nu een proef uitgevoerd met winkelboa's in een vijftal gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over veroordeelde criminelen die nog niet in de gevangenis zitten

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about convicted offenders who have not yet served their prison sentences, including figures on warrants, statute-of-limitations expiry and the TES team. State Secretary Teeven answered that the government takes the problem seriously, gave case figures from the CJIB and OPS, and listed measures to speed up enforcement, though he could not give a precise forecast of future non-enforcement.
I therefore consider it of great importance that the sentences imposed by the judge are actually enforced.
Ik acht het daarom van groot belang dat de door de rechter opgelegde straffen ook daadwerkelijk ten uitvoer worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over het tekort aan capaciteit bij de College bescherming persoonsgegevens

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked the state secretary about the Dutch data protection authority's (CBP) shortage of capacity, reports that over half its cases remain unhandled, whether companies should self-report data breaches, and whether CBP fines could fund its staffing. The state secretary answered that enforcement must fit available resources, expects around 66,000 breach notifications a year under the planned duty, and said fine revenue cannot be directly used by the CBP under budget rules, while studying a broader administrative fine regime.
As stated in the attached draft explanatory memorandum, the notification duty is estimated to lead to 66 thousand notifications per year.
Zoals in het daarbij gevoegde concept van de Memorie van Toelichting wordt vermeld zal de meldplicht naar schatting leiden tot 66 duizend meldingen per jaar.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het oprukken van ‘Ndrangheta in de Nederlandse samenleving’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Ndrangheta poses a serious threat in the Netherlands, whether intelligence and investigative capacity are fragmented, and whether it may infiltrate government. The minister acknowledges some involvement in drug trafficking and money laundering, says existing structures (National Recherche, Public Prosecution Service, National Threat Picture) are adequate, sees no signs of government infiltration, declines to set up a dedicated team, and promises a working group review.
It is important that the matter in question is looked at again carefully.
Wel is van belang dat de desbetreffende problematiek nog eens goed tegen het licht wordt gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch over het strafrechtelijk afkopen van vervolging na het lastigvallen en bedreigen van een scheidsrechter

MPs asked why three men who harassed and threatened a referee received a 210 euro settlement offer roughly ten months after the incident, and how this fits the government's tough approach to football violence. The minister replied that evidence was insufficient for harassment and threats, that the suspects were offered a 210 euro transaction for theft in association, and that the delay stemmed from further investigation needed after the first report.
For this offence, in line with the applicable guidelines, the Public Prosecution Service offered each of the suspects a transaction proposal of 210 euros.
Het OM heeft voor dit feit – overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen – aan ieder van de verdachten een transactievoorstel van € 210,– aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het digitaal rechercheren

An MP asked whether current legislation is still suitable for digital investigation, after the head of the National Police Investigation Service reportedly said it was not, and whether the minister had been contacted about these concerns. The minister acknowledged the reports, said new legislation on cybercrime is being prepared with proposals expected by summer 2012, and said there was no direct contact with the National Investigation head but extensive contact with police and prosecution services.
Before the summer of 2012 I will inform your House further on this.
Voor de zomer van 2012 zal ik uw Kamer hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing en het verkopen van de voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the ministers about match-fixing in football, criminal bookmakers' influence, and whether the KNVB's concerns warrant investigation. The minister answered that data is insufficient to judge the scale, that the sports sector and betting operators bear primary responsibility for prevention, and that existing criminal law suffices, with no concrete information yet of bribery in the Netherlands.
I do not have hard research data indicating how large the influence of criminal bookmakers in football is.
Ik beschik niet over harde onderzoeksgegevens die aangeven hoe groot de invloed is van criminele gokbazen in het voetbal.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Van Dam over het Haarlems Dagblad

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Van Dam asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Haarlems Dagblad and Gooi- en Eemlander might disappear under Telegraaf Media Groep plans, and whether legal means exist to prevent it. The minister replied that TMG and HDC Media had stated no plan exists to close titles, that the press sector is primarily responsible for its own market problems, and that the government sees no reason to intervene.
The government therefore pursues a very restrained policy towards the press sector.
De overheid voert dan ook een zeer terughoudend beleid ten aanzien van de perssector.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voorlopige hechtenis van dhr. R (ingezonden 28 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a suspect held in pre-trial detention for over five years, questioning the presumption of innocence, the limits on detention length, judicial independence, and the adequacy of legal remedies. The state secretary replied that the statutory 90-day limit and judicial review at each extension protect the suspect, that no absolute maximum is needed given the gravity of such offences, and that no new motivation rules or remedies are required.
I do not consider it desirable to include an absolute maximum in the law for this, precisely because of the seriousness of the offences and the risk to public safety if such suspects were released.

Ik acht het niet wenselijk om hiervoor een absoluut maximum in de wet op te nemen, juist vanwege de ernst van de strafbare feiten en het risico voor de maatschappelijke veiligheid als dergelijke verdachten op vrije voeten komen.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de voorlopige hechtenis van dhr.R.

MP Recourt asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the pre-trial detention of a man R., who has been held for over five years awaiting first-instance trial, and whether the answers will take that duration into account. State Secretary Teeven replies briefly that he is aware of the earlier questions and will take the five-year detention into account.
Will you take into account in answering these questions that R. has already been in pre-trial detention for more than five years pending his first-instance trial?
Wilt u bij de beantwoording van de vragen betrekken dat R. al meer dan vijf jaar in voorlopige hechtenis zit hangende zijn berechting in eerste aanleg?
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «doorgesnoven» en «ladderzatte» hooligans die de benefietwedstrij

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers why about 100 Feyenoord hooligans, some under stadium bans, attended and allegedly disrupted a charity match in Spakenburg and why the riot police were not deployed earlier, and whether the Football Act should bar banned fans from friendly matches. Minister Opstelten answered that the group left without disrupting the event, police lacked validated prior information, the ME was only kept on standby, the Wmbveo already offers tools such as area bans and that the law is being evaluated early, and the club can recover its own damage.
This is also the conclusion from the press release of VV IJsselmeervogels of 12 January 2012.
Dit is ook de conclusie uit de persverklaring van de VV IJsselmeervogels van 12 januari 2012

Vragen van de leden Heijnen, Dijsselbloem en Recourt (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mogelijkheden om veroordeelde gemeenteraadsleden uit

PvdA MPs asked whether convicted municipal councillors can be removed from office, how article 28 of the Criminal Code applies to elected representatives, whether prosecutors know of a suspect's mandate, and whether councils should be able to appeal or the Electoral Act should include integrity rules. The government answered that removal from office of representatives can only occur via loss of voting rights under article 28(1)(3), that a council cannot appeal a sentence because prosecution has a monopoly, and that integrity checks beyond disenfranchisement would be an unconstitutional restriction of passive suffrage.
Removing a people's representative from "office" can therefore only take place on the basis of article 28, first paragraph, under 3, of the Criminal Code.
Het uit »het ambt» ontzetten van een volksvertegenwoordiger kan derhalve alleen geschieden op basis van artikel 28, eerste lid, onder 3, van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de Nederlandse politie nog nooit grote bendes koperdieven heeft opgespoord (ingezonden 17 november 2011

MPs Recourt and Monasch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reported figures on copper theft were accurate, whether the Koperslag action plan and ID requirement were in force, whether organised copper theft exists in the Netherlands, and how copper theft is registered. The minister answered that theft is increasing, that a recent KLPD analysis shows both individuals and organised groups are being tracked, that a convenant was signed in June 2011 with amendments in preparation, and that police use a separate project code for copper theft reports.
To enable nationwide introduction of the identification requirement, the implementing decree under article 437 of the Criminal Code is being amended.
Ten behoeve van de landelijke invoering van de legitimatieplicht wordt het uitvoeringsbesluit bij artikel 437 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht aangepast.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het ontnemen van wederrechtelijk verkregen vermogen («pluk ze») (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the July 2011 tightening of the criminal asset confiscation (pluk ze) rules can be applied retroactively, given differing views from the Public Prosecution Service and legal commentators. The minister answered that no special transitional provision exists, procedural changes apply immediately, article 1(2) Sr applies the most favourable rule, and that these questions are for the courts to decide, while noting the financial target was set without accounting for the amendment.
A judgement on which of the amended statutory provisions falls under article 1(2) of the Criminal Code in a specific case is therefore reserved for the court.
Daarmee is een oordeel over de vraag welke van de gewijzigde wettelijke bepalingen in een concrete zaak onder de werking van artikel 1, tweede lid, Sr vallen aan de rechter voorbehouden.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat het aantal diefstallen bij ouderen schrikbarend is (ingezonde

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about a report that theft against elderly care-home residents is alarmingly high, asking whether the figures are representative, whether care homes have adequate policy, and what role police and neighbourhood officers play. The state secretary said the government strongly condemns such theft, expects care boards to protect residents, cannot verify the figures because the prosecution service does not record victim age or residence, and that police handle this case by case.
The Public Prosecution Service does not differentiate by age and residence of theft victims in its registration system.
Het Openbaar Ministerie differentieert in zijn registratiesysteem niet naar de leeftijd en de verblijfplaats van slachtoffers van diefstal.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat jongeren worden ingezet als informant voor het OM (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

The MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that minors are used as informants for the Public Prosecution Service, including how the CIE prosecutor is involved, the conditions applied, how often it happens, whether parents are involved, and whether minors are paid. The Minister answered that minors are approached only in exceptional cases for very serious crimes under a 'no, unless' principle requiring CIE prosecutor approval, that no national statistics exist, that no contracts are signed and parents are involved case by case, and that tipping money is in principle not paid to minors.
No national statistical information is available.
Er is geen landelijke statistische informatie beschikbaar.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Ierse klusjesmannen in Nederland (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MPs Recourt and Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice about itinerant Irish handymen suspected of fraud and coercion in the Netherlands, including whether a central registry or coordinated approach is needed. The minister said the practices are undesirable and may be criminal in some cases, pointed to police warnings, consumer information and labour and tax enforcement, and declined a central registry or coordination because no such signals had been received.
I do not have data on the number of groups that are active or their size.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over het aantal groepen dat actief is of hun omvang.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Recourt (PvdA) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gedragingen van bewindsperson

MPs Pechtold, Recourt and Dibi asked whether ministers pressured Geert Wilders not to broadcast Fitna, whether intelligence services were used against him or Parliament members, and related conduct shown in the HUMAN documentary. The minister answered that conversations with Wilders are public, declined to disclose Council of Ministers deliberations or the Landsadvocaat advice, denied AIVD involvement in a decision, and confirmed that the Wiv 2002 bars surveillance of parliamentarians absent serious threat grounds.
As is known, no statements may be made about the deliberation and decision-making in the Council of Ministers.
Zoals bekend mogen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de beraadslaging en de besluitvorming in de Raad van Ministers.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over haatcriminaliteit tegen het openbaar gezag (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a tweet insulting the Rotterdam mayor, hate crime via social media, and whether mayors should report hate crime against officials. The minister said such insults could fall under criminal insult provisions, no separate hate-crime data exists, and officials should report offences, with registration and a support website promoted.
No data are available on the total number of criminal offences that could be classed as hate crime.
Over de omvang van alle strafbare feiten die als haatcriminaliteit te betitelen zijn, zijn daarom geen gegevens voorhanden.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over marktwerking in het notariaat (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

Rep. Recourt asked the state secretary whether restricting the number of notary offices limits market competition, and how many notaries were refused a post, in light of a Commissie van Deskundigen Notariaat recommendation. The state secretary answered that formal entry requirements are by definition a market restriction justified by public interests, that the three-year viability test protects clients rather than incumbents, and that he is content with the current regulation of the notarial market.
The requirement that a new office must be able to operate cost-covering after three years serves to protect the (potential) clients of that office.
De eis dat een nieuw kantoor na drie jaren kostendekkend moet kunnen draaien dient ter bescherming van de (potentiële) klanten van dat kantoor
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de Utrechtse serieverkrachter (ingezonden 1 november 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service refused to act on new profiling information about the Utrecht serial rapist, whether the case remains open, and what steps are taken on new information. The minister replied that the investigation covered the whole Utrecht region including the area named by the experts, that all relevant tips were checked, and that a cold case team monitors the case.
The assumption that the Public Prosecution Service refuses to act on the information provided is incorrect.
De veronderstelling dat het Openbaar Ministerie weigert aan de slag te gaan met de aangedragen informatie, is onjuist.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het anoniem aangifte doen doo

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked whether healthcare workers can file anonymous reports (aangifte) of violence, including by using staff numbers, and whether this should be rolled out nationally. The minister answered that the existing OM options suffice, staff-number reports are possible only exceptionally, and anonymity cannot always be guaranteed given defendants' rights to test testimony.
Because this concerns an exception to general policy, I do not wish to speak of a nationwide rollout.
Omdat het gaat om een uitzondering op het algemene beleid wil ik echter niet van een landelijke uitrol spreken.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Europees arrestatiebevel in relatief kleine strafzaken (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the European arrest warrant should be used for Mr E., who faces surrender to Poland over a suspected bribe of about 25 euro, and whether Poland could use alternatives and proportionality could be raised. The minister replied that the warrant concerns two sentences totalling over three years plus prosecution for bribing a prison guard, that surrender was ordered with a guarantee of return, that Poland's changing warrant practice has been noted without specific action, and that no special intervention with Polish authorities is considered necessary.
Given the seriousness of the facts, I find it understandable that the Polish authorities issued a warrant in this case.
Gelet op de ernst van de feiten vind ik het begrijpelijk dat de Poolse autoriteiten in deze zaak een EAB hebben uitgevaardigd.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over miljoenenfraude met levensverzekeringen (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

MPs Recourt and Plasterk asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about alleged large-scale fraud with life-insurance-linked products sold by Quality Investments, including the damage, seizures, earlier AFM oversight, and why the product fell outside AFM supervision. The government answered that ongoing criminal investigation limits disclosure, described the seizures and the AFM's earlier investigation and its correction of misleading information, and explained the prospectus threshold that exempted the product from AFM licensing.
Given the ongoing criminal investigation, no substantive statements can be made about the background of the suspicion.
Gelet op het lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kunnen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over de achtergrond van de verdenking worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de invloed van de hoogte van griffierechten op de gang naar de rechter (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Recourt (PvdA) asks the minister of Justice about a Synovate survey, commissioned by the Dutch Bar Association, showing that higher court fees could deter people from going to court and that many see justice as class-based. The minister defends the survey's limitations, argues the fee increase keeps access within acceptable margins with compensation for lower and middle incomes, and says the bill was adjusted after impact analyses.
In that balance, it is responsible to ensure that cuts do not lead to lower quality of justice or longer processing times, but to higher court fees within the margins of accessibility.

In die afweging is het verantwoord bezuinigingen niet te laten leiden tot lagere kwaliteit van rechtspraak of langere doorlooptijden, maar tot hogere griffierechten binnen de marges van de toegankelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over de belastingvrijstellingen voor leden van het koninklijk huis (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Recourt (PvdA) asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he knew of reports on royal tax exemptions, why the Constitution exempts the King and his heir from inheritance tax, and what criteria and who decide which royal assets are excluded from the wealth return tax base. Rutte answered that the exemptions are functional, explained the historical rationale from the 1967 Simons commission and the 1972 constitutional revision, and said the tax inspector determines which assets serve the royal function.
Thus Article 40 of the Constitution provides that assets of members of the royal house that serve the exercise of the monarchy are not included in calculating the base for the wealth return tax.

Zo is in artikel 40 van de Grondwet bepaald dat vermogensbestanddelen van leden van het koninklijk huis, die dienstbaar zijn aan de uitoefening van het koningschap, niet worden meegenomen bij de berekening van de grondslag voor de vermogensrendementsheffing.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over teruglopen van het aantal rechters (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the number of judges in training has fallen sharply due to budget cuts and what this means for judge numbers and court backlogs. The state secretary confirmed the cut in training places from 60 to 25 per year and the shortening of the training, and said the judiciary expects no undercapacity or longer case times because of the expected drop in case inflow from court fees, while acknowledging uncertainty.
These are expectations and estimates, which are inevitably subject to a certain degree of uncertainty.
Het betreffen verwachtingen en schattingen, die onvermijdelijk met een bepaalde mate van onzekerheid zijn omgeven.

Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP), Voortman (Groenlinks) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over arbeidsvoorwaarden in de gemeentelijke thuiszorg (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about a quality covenant requiring signalling in home care, its use in tendering, and why signalling is graded lower in the care job classification, and about a salary cut at a care provider. The state secretary said the Healthcare Institutions Quality Act already binds providers to the quality norms, declined to rule on classification disputes that belong to collective agreement procedures, and said salary matters are for employers and employees to settle.
In those procedures it is not fitting for a minister to make statements about labour disputes concerning working conditions.
In die procedures past het niet dat een bewindspersoon uitspraken doet over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke geschillen.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kritiek op het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked the state secretary about press reports that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) barely protects privacy, its limited powers and budget, and whether individual complaints are handled poorly. The state secretary rejected the picture, said the CBP has successes and adequate staff and budget relative to other EU states, and noted planned powers to impose administrative fines.
I cannot confirm that the CBP is relatively underfunded compared with supervisory authorities in other EU countries.
Ik kan niet bevestigen dat het CBP relatief onderbedeeld is in vergelijking met toezichthouders in andere EU-landen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbreuk op de privacy door LinkedIn (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

Labour MPs Van Dam and Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about privacy intrusions by LinkedIn, including the Dutch Data Protection Authority's (CBP) guidelines for social networking sites, whether commercial use of personal data without prior consent is objectionable, and whether the CBP should be instructed to change account settings. The State Secretary answered that the CBP applies privacy-friendly default settings and strict consent standards, that consent must be unambiguous under the Wbp, and that the government has no power to instruct the independent CBP on individual supervisory matters.
In view of this, I do not have the powers to instruct the CBP on how to act in individual supervisory cases.
Gelet hierop beschik ik niet over bevoegdheden om het Cbp voor te schrijven hoe zich te gedragen in individuele toezichtszaken.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Groningse advocaten zouden frauderen met overheidsgeld (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Recourt and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether Groningen lawyers defrauded legal aid funds, how it happened, and what action followed. The secretary confirmed two lawyers circumvented the 250-unit cap, roughly 450 files were affected, a criminal complaint and disciplinary complaint were filed, and recovery of an estimated 300,000 to 400,000 euros is underway.
The Council will reclaim the wrongly granted allowances from both lawyers.
De Raad zal de ten onrechte verstrekte vergoedingen terugvorderen van beide advocaten.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het geld van de Bruinsma dat terugvloeit naar de Bruinsmagroep (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Swiss errors allow criminal money to flow back to the Bruinsma group and what Dutch options exist to seize or claw back about seven million euros, including confiscation law, limitation periods, and a straw man. The minister referred to earlier answers on most points and said that, under tax secrecy, he could not comment on individual taxpayers, while explaining general collection powers such as personal detention and passport flagging.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opnameapparatuur in gespreksruimtes (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether microphones or cameras can be present in rooms where lawyers confidentially meet clients, in prisons and police stations, and whether clients and lawyers are told beforehand. The state secretary confirmed recording equipment can be present in prison consultation rooms for order and security reasons, said police-station consultations normally avoid recording rooms, and said the prison service will inform lawyers in advance and show that equipment is switched off, while the Dutch Bar pushed for rooms without recording.
It has therefore been proposed to the Bar that from now on it always be made clear to the lawyer whether recording equipment is present in a consultation room.
Daarom is aan de Orde voorgesteld om in het vervolg altijd duidelijk aan de advocaat te maken of er opnameapparatuur in een spreekkamer aanwezig is.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van verdachten van een overval op een Amsterdamse juwelier (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice why suspects in an Amsterdam jewellery robbery were released by a court, and why victims learned of it from a journalist rather than from the prosecution, and what the OM and courts do to inform victims and the neighbourhood. The state secretary answered that the OM has appealed, that victims' information duties are clear and the OM did not inform them promptly, that local mayors are responsible for informing residents, and that the OM does not consider the released suspect a flight risk.
It is not for me to take action in an individual criminal case or to pass judgment on a court ruling.
Het is niet aan mij om actie te nemen in individuele strafzaak of om een oordeel te vellen over een uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afname van DNA-materiaal bij jeugdigen (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about taking DNA from juvenile offenders, including Defence for Children's objections, backlogs in DNA orders, the absence of a duty to justify DNA orders for minors, and the handling of objections. The state secretary answers that DNA orders for juveniles follow from the law and the Supreme Court, that no separate minors' article is needed, that a review of unequal treatment between minor and adult offenders will be commissioned, and that objections are rarely upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record how long on average it takes before young people receive an order to surrender DNA material after committing an offence.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert niet hoe lang het gemiddeld duurt voordat jongeren na het plegen van een misdrijf een bevel krijgen tot het afstaan van DNA-materiaal.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet aanhouden van een verdachte in verband met noodweer (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

MP Recourt asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the 2010 prosecution guideline on self-defence claims (not arresting suspects) harms the suspect's position, notably regarding legal aid before first interrogation and the right to silence. The State Secretary defends the guideline, says the right to counsel and Salduz case law are respected, and commits to promoting a change so that non-arrested suspects get legal aid without a contribution.
I consider it desirable to remove this difference for non-arrested suspects within the meaning of the guideline on invoking self-defence.
Ik acht het wenselijk dit verschil op te heffen voor niet-aangehouden verdachten in de zin van de Aanwijzing handelwijze bij beroep op noodweer.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over frauderende bewindsvoerder(s) (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a debt-administration firm that defrauded around sixty clients, how the fraud went undetected, whether the firm belonged to a trade association, how victims are being helped, and how professional administrators' quality is ensured. The minister explained the fraud via a linked account and pass, noted that supervision by the court-appointed judge happens largely after the fact, pointed to the quality-audit and registration system, and said the firm has been declared bankrupt with its successor administrator pursuing damages.
Question 4: Did the supervision of the administrator fail? If so, how?
Vraag 4 Heeft de controle op de bewindvoerder gefaald? Zo ja, op welke wijze?
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de recente vastgoedfraude (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

MPs Recourt and Groot asked how the FIOD and Tax Authority uncovered large-scale real estate tax fraud, whether the Public Prosecution Service was involved, and whether prosecution capacity and the natural persons behind companies are pursued. The government answered that cases were handled through a tripartite consultation with a threshold for prosecution, that 8 cases went to criminal investigation involving 17 suspects, and that 9 of them are being prosecuted.
Between the participants in the tripartite consultation there is good and close cooperation.
Tussen de deelnemers aan het tripartiete overleg is sprake van een goede en nauwe samenwerking.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over corruptie bij Eurojust (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the EU anti-fraud office OLAF is investigating corruption at Eurojust, whether the suspected head of information management remains in post, whether evidence could disappear, why the Eurojust president resigned in 2009, and whether the minister finds this painful. The minister replied that OLAF and the investigation fall under the European Commission, that he cannot comment, that the resignation reasons are not officially disclosed, and that he will assess any reaction once the investigation concludes.
As far as I am aware, OLAF, the European Anti-Fraud Office, has indeed started an investigation at Eurojust.
Voor zover mij bekend is OLAF, het Europees Bureau voor Fraudebestrijding, inderdaad een onderzoek begonnen bij Eurojust.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over misbruik van het Europees Arrestatiebevel (EAB) voor «onzin»-misdrijven (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

Labour MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the European Commission's report on misuse of the European Arrest Warrant for trivial offences (such as bicycle theft) is accepted, and whether the Commission's claim of systematic misuse undermines trust. The Minister agrees trivial EAWs are undesirable but disputes the claim of systematic misuse, attributes the proportionality problem mainly to Poland, notes a 20% drop in Polish EAWs in 2010, and proposes bilateral consultation rather than amending the framework decision.
I do not endorse the Commission's cited claim and base this partly on the many EAWs Dutch judicial authorities have received from other EU member states over the years.

Ik onderschrijf de geciteerde stelling van de Commissie niet en baseer mij daarvoor mede op de vele EABs die deNederlandse justitiële autoriteiten in de loop der jaren uit de andere lidstaten van de Europese Unie hebben ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het zwartboek met kritiek van jeugdreclasseerders op het VOG-systeem (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman, Recourt and Berndsen asked the state secretary of Security and Justice how he would respond to a black book in which youth probation workers criticised the VOG (certificate of good conduct) system for unfairly excluding young people, and whether he would ease or clarify the system. The state secretary answered that only 54 of about 800 youth probation workers complained, that refusals affect fewer than 1% of applicants, that the assessment framework is sufficient after a Rotterdam pilot, and that he will discuss the matter with Jeugdzorg Nederland before deciding on follow-up steps.
I will discuss with Jeugdzorg Nederland where the needs lie regarding information about the VOG system.
Ik zal met Jeugdzorg Nederland bezien waar de behoeften liggen met betrekking tot voorlichting over de systematiek van de VOG.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over forensische pathologie (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a shortage of forensic pathologists, possible missed criminal deaths certified as natural, and whether medical training covers forensic medicine. The minister answered that six forensic pathologists work in the Netherlands, that the NFI is training more, that missed cases cannot be quantified, and that a guideline on death certification is being drafted.
It is not possible for me to establish how often a death certificate attributing death to a natural cause has been issued wrongly.
Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoe vaak ten onrechte een verklaring van overlijden ten gevolge van een natuurlijke oorzaak is afgegeven.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) aan minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de executie van een schadevergoedingsmaatregel (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

MP Recourt asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a court ruling on enforcement of a damages measure, the CJIB's discretion under the hardship clause in the enforcement guideline, and whether a single-parent welfare recipient with no capacity to pay should qualify as a hardship case. The state secretary confirms awareness of the ruling and guideline, says the CJIB has never yet granted a hardship claim, and explains that lack of means alone is insufficient, noting the court upheld the CJIB's rejection of a payment plan running to the enforcement limitation period.
The mere fact that the convicted person has insufficient capacity to pay is not sufficient to qualify as a hardship situation.
Het enkele feit dat veroordeelde onvoldoende draagkracht heeft, is niet voldoende om als schrijnende situatie gekwalificeerd te worden.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over taakstraf in de buurt (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the state secretary about community service (taakstraf) carried out in the offender's neighbourhood, failure rates, arrests and speed of enforcement. The state secretary answered that work in the neighbourhood will be explored with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, that enforcement timelines and protocols are being reviewed, and that the pilot evaluation results will feed into quality improvements.
I will explore with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming the possibilities to further expand carrying out community service in the neighbourhood.
Ik ga met de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming de mogelijkheden verkennen om het uitvoeren van werkstraffen in de buurt verder uit te breiden.

Vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «KNVB gaat vechtende speler harder straffen» (ingezonden 18 maa

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether violence on football pitches (brawls, attacks on referees) is rising, whether criminal prosecution should complement KNVB sanctions, and whether reporting such incidents should be encouraged. The ministers answered that roughly 25-30 incidents occur per weekend among about 32,500 matches, that incidents are not treated differently from comparable violence off the pitch, that the KNVB requires reporting to police, and that an action plan on safer sport addresses the issue.
On what scale prosecution follows a report of a (violent) incident inside or outside a playing situation on a football pitch is not known.
Op welke schaal vervolging plaatsvindt na het doen van een aangifte van een (gewelds)incident binnen of buiten een spelsituatie op een voetbalveld, is niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rechtsbijstand aan minderjarigen in strafzaken (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

Recourt (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about delays before minors suspected of crimes can consult a lawyer and are first questioned, including whether a standing duty lawyer at police stations would help and whether such waits should be capped at three hours. Teeven answered that the two-hour maximum wait is currently not always met, that the frequency is unknown pending the Salduz evaluation, that a broad impact analysis on on-site lawyers is underway with results expected before summer 2011, and that he cannot anticipate those outcomes; police record waiting times only locally with no national overview.
I am aware that in practice the lawyer does not always arrive within the two hours during which his arrival must be awaited after a detained minor suspect requests consultation assistance.
Ik ben ermee bekend dat in de praktijk de raadsman niet altijd arriveert binnen de twee uren, gedurende welke zijn komst moet worden afgewacht

Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van voorzitter van het College van procureurs-generaal over advocaat bij verhoor (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the Chief Public Prosecutors' view that closed police interrogations are no longer tenable, whether the government will align with ECtHR case law granting lawyer presence at interrogation, the consequences for evidence, recording practice, and how many EU states allow physical lawyer presence. The minister answers that a draft bill on lawyer presence is in consultation and expected before the Council of Ministers this autumn, the existing prosecutors' directive stays in force until then, evidence assessment is for the judge, and interrogation recording occurs mainly in serious cases with no count kept.
I have set out my appreciation of the case law of the ECtHR and the Supreme Court in a draft bill on the presence of counsel at and during police interrogation at the suspect's request.

Ik heb mijn waardering van de jurisprudentie van het EHRM en de Hoge Raad neergelegd in een conceptwetsvoorstel over de aanwezigheid van de raadsman bij en tijdens het politieverhoor op verzoek van de verdachte.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Alzheimerpatiënten (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

MP Recourt asks the Minister of Security and Justice about TV reports that Alzheimer patients are easy financial prey, including proposals for a public register of trustees, a longer cooling-off period under the Colportage Act, and whether patients are sufficiently protected against trustee misconduct given limited court oversight. The minister says the government is not opposed in principle to a longer cooling-off period but awaits EU negotiations, and that patients are adequately protected by law, with a forthcoming bill expanding the curatele register and introducing quality requirements for trustees but no trustee register.
A new bill on curatele, beschermingsbewind and mentorschap will be sent to the Council of Ministers and the Council of State within a few weeks.
Een nieuw wetsvoorstel over curatele, beschermingsbewind en mentorschap zal binnen enkele weken aan de Ministerraad en de Raad van State verzonden worden.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de financiële problemen op Sint Maarten (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Recourt asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about Sint Maarten's financial problems, including the premier's rejection of the Financial Supervision College's advice to issue a binding instruction on financial transparency and budget control. The minister answered that the Kingdom Council of Ministers has not yet decided, that requesting an instruction falls within the Rijkswet financieel toezicht, and that the Kingdom's guarantee function is a last resort.
The Cft has clearly stated that it needs access in order to assess whether there are no obligations that would hinder the possible use of any reserves.
Het Cft heeft duidelijk aangegeven de inzage nodig te hebben om te kunnen beoordelen of er geen verplichtingen zijn die het eventuele gebruik van mogelijke reserves zouden belemmeren.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers die hulp moeten ontberen vanwege een falend computersysteem bij de politie (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police IT failures left about 15,000 crime victims without referral to Slachtofferhulp Nederland. The state secretary denied a system fault, acknowledged that officers often do not tick the referral box, and said he asked police leadership to make referral automatic and to ensure correct entry in all forces.
I have therefore asked the police to introduce such a 100% referral in the system as soon as possible.
Ik heb daarom aan de politie gevraagd om op zo kort mogelijke termijn een dergelijke 100%-doorverwijzing in het systeem in te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van elektronisch huisarrest (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice whether he would scrap electronic house arrest (thuisdetentie) for convicted offenders, and about its preventive value, recidivism, costs and the cell shortage. The state secretary confirmed the plan, arguing that converting a prison sentence into home detention undermines the judicial sentence and retribution, that the government will instead pursue conditional sentences, and that the cell shortage no longer applies while electronic detention cost EUR 43 per day versus EUR 231 for a prison place.
This cabinet considers it fundamentally wrong that the administration decides that a prison sentence is carried out in a different way than in a prison.
Dit kabinet acht het principieel onjuist dat de administratie beslist dat een gevangenisstraf op andere wijze ten uitvoer wordt gelegd dan in een gevangenis.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kwetsbare ouderen (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Recourt and Klijnsma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about financial abuse of vulnerable elderly people, notaries' duty to check testamentary capacity, and whether the Dutch professional protocol on capacity should be made binding. The state secretary said no figures are available on the scale of abuse, considered the protocol sufficient while acknowledging that capacity defects are hard to detect, and saw no added guarantee in formalising it given existing disciplinary and civil consequences.
Formalising the protocol in itself offers no additional guarantee of careful treatment by the notary.
Het formaliseren van het protocol biedt op zich geen extra waarborg voor een zorgvuldige behandeling door de notaris.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over oproepen tot jihad en invoering van de shariah (ingezonden 18 januari 2011).

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a online interview with a Sharia4Belgium spokesman calling implicitly for violence and discrimination against homosexuals and critics, and about links between Sharia4Belgium, Sharia4Holland and arrests in Belgium and the Netherlands. The minister answered that the prosecutor judged the passages not punishable under the criminal code, that Dutch jurisdiction exists, that the three arrested persons were handed over to Belgium at its request, and that ongoing investigations cannot be discussed.
Because of the possible disruption of investigative interests, I cannot provide information about any ongoing criminal investigations.
In verband met het mogelijk doorkruisen van opsporingsbelangen kan ik geen mededelingen doen over eventueel lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van onzichtbare sms-jes bij de opsporing (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

MPs Recourt and Berndsen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and the AIVD use invisible SMS messages to track mobile phones, on what legal basis, and with what safeguards. The minister confirmed the police use the method only alongside a wiretap with prior written authorisation from the investigating judge, that it is used in a small minority of wiretap cases, and that the AIVD's use is governed by the 2002 Intelligence and Security Services Act and supervised by the CTIVD.
This means it is used only when a wiretap is running on the relevant phone number.
Dit middel wordt alleen ingezet wanneer er een telefoontap op het desbetreffende telefoonnummer loopt.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen op het gemeentelijk veiligheidsbudget (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt ask the Minister of Security and Justice about cuts to municipal safety funding, including whether 94 million euro a year is lost and whether local safety initiatives and Veiligheidshuizen will suffer. The minister replies that the cut concerns temporary extra funds ending after 2011, that structural safety funds through the municipal fund continue, that municipalities are best placed to set priorities, and that no inventory of municipal choices is needed.
The amount of 94 million euros does not seem familiar to me.
Het bedrag van 94 miljoen euro komt mij niet bekend voor.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over verklaringen omtrent gedrag voor criminele jongeren (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice minister why so few conditional certificates of conduct (VOG) were issued to young offenders under the Rotterdam pilot, and whether rigid application of the rules hinders resocialisation. The state secretary answered that only three conditional VOGs were issued, the pilot runs until October 2011 without extension, and the VOG is a preventive administrative tool rather than a punishment.
Because of the limited demand for a conditional VOG, a conditional VOG was also issued in only a limited number of cases.
Vanwege de beperkte vraag naar een VOG onder voorwaarden, is ook slechts in een beperkt aantal gevallen een VOG onder voorwaarden verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over koperdieven die anoniem hun koper kunnen verkopen (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about copper theft, the societal damage it causes, and whether a identification requirement for copper buyers, like pawnshops, should be introduced. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, cited ProRail damage estimates, said measures are being inventoried with a letter expected mid-2011, and listed existing prevention steps.
I have no insight into the total extent of the damage suffered annually as a result of copper theft.
Ik heb geen zicht op de totale omvang van de schade die jaarlijks wordt geleden als gevolg van koperdiefstal.

Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 8 februari 2011 over de halvering van de vergoeding voor rechtsbijstand (ingezonden 10 februari 20

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a Nieuwsuur broadcast claiming criminal-defence legal aid fees were halved, and whether enough lawyers will keep working at the reduced rate. The State Secretary answers that the draft decree is still under consultation and paused, that in practice the fee is not halved (1.5 points in total, split into two 0.75-point parts after the Salduz ruling), and that the Brusco ruling does not require lawyer presence during interrogation.
At the request of your House not to take irreversible steps regarding this draft decree, I have put the decree on hold pending a general consultation on 9 March.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer om ter zake van dit ontwerpbesluit geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen, heb ik het besluit aangehouden in afwachting van een algemeen overleg op 9 maart aanstaande.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de telefoontaps in de zaak Baybasin (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Baybasin wiretap evidence, including why copies of eight recordings were sent to examiners in Israel and the United States, why originals or clones were not used, and whether the analyses were consistent with forensic norms. The minister explained the examiners were chosen at the request of the defence and the prosecution, that originals are never released, that the Dutch forensic norm was followed, and that the Toegangscommissie commissioned further analysis and forwarded all technical reports to the College of Procurators-General and the defence lawyer.
After the examiners were able to respond to each other's findings, the reports were summarised by a Dutch professor in a summary document.
Nadat de onderzoekers over en weer op elkaars bevindingen hebben kunnen reageren, zijn de rapportages door een Nederlandse hoogleraar beschreven in een samenvattend document.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een alarmerende stijging van identiteitsfraude (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported rise in identity fraud, including whether police register it separately, whether government databases are easy to breach, public awareness, police powers and whether a separate criminal offence is needed. The minister answered that existing data-protection rules apply, awareness campaigns already exist with no need for further measures, police act within current capacity, and a separate offence is not needed for now.
There is no reason for me to take additional measures.
Er bestaat voor mij geen aanleiding voor het nemen van aanvullende maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Recourt en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over vrijwilligerswerk in een Afrikaans Kindertehuis door verdachte Robert M (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government had information about a children's home in Kenya where suspect Robert M. allegedly volunteered, whether children there may have been abused, and whether an investigation would be launched. The minister said the government has no concrete information, offered full cooperation with judicial authorities, but declined to order its own inquiry so as not to interfere with the criminal investigation.

I want to prevent an investigation initiated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs from interfering with this important criminal investigation, and therefore cannot answer your questions further at this time.

Ik wil daarbij voorkomen dat een op initiatief van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken ingesteld onderzoek dit belangrijke strafvorderlijk onderzoek doorkruist en kan daarom op dit moment uw vragen niet verder beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Belastingbetaler draagt bij aan schikking» (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

Opposition MP Recourt asked whether taxpayers effectively contribute to prosecution settlements, since settlement damages and confiscated illegal gains may be tax-deductible, and whether listing and OM-fiscus coordination affect settlement amounts. Minister Opstelten answered that settlement and confiscation elements are not deductible in the relevant sense, that cunning does not affect the calculation of illegal gains or damages, and that the OM does not take tax consequences into account in setting amounts.
The penalty element of a transaction is not deductible.
Het boeteelement van een transactie is niet aftrekbaar.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over moordenaars die vrijuit gaan door geldgebrek (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

The MP asks whether murderers are going free for lack of funds, whether cold-case teams are too understaffed, how many cold cases have been solved, and whether animal cops could be deployed. The minister acknowledges the importance of cold cases, plans to abolish limitation periods for serious offences, but says no national overview of solved or reviewable cases exists and animal cops will not be structurally deployed.
There is no national overview of the number of cases that have been solved or are ripe for further investigation.
