This limits the period of application of article 8 without further intervention by the minister or the Chamber being needed
Dit begrenst de toepassingsduur van artikel 8 zonder dat daarvoor verdere interventie van de minister of Kamer nodig is
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over het bericht dat truckchauffeurs ecocombi’s bij de grens moeten splitsen

MPs Visser and Verheijen asked the minister about reports that trucks carrying flowers and longer combined vehicles (ecocombi's/LZVs) must be split at the border, and whether this reflects protectionism and obstructs the EU internal market, along with questions on Benelux and German cooperation. The minister answered that member states disagree on cross-border LZVs, that a compromise on Directive 96/53 allows bilateral arrangements, that a Benelux decision and a Netherlands-Flanders pilot are being prepared, and that North Rhine-Westphalia does not permit LZVs at all.
From May 2013 negotiations were held on the revision of Directive 95/53/EC.
Vanaf mei 2013 is onderhandeld over de herziening van richtlijn 95/53/EG
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Verheijen over activiteiten van Turkije in de exclusieve economische zone van Cyprus

MPs Van Bommel and Verheijen asked whether Turkish seismic survey activity in Cyprus's exclusive economic zone is illegal and whether the government will condemn it. The minister said Turkey is not party to UNCLOS, the maritime boundary is disputed, the survey is provocative and unhelpful, and the Netherlands regrets it, but did not call it illegal.
Nederland betreurt de acties van Turkije.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Verheijen over de massale arrestatie van journalisten, de afkeurende reactie van de Europese Commissie en de mogelijke gevolgen voor de steun vanuit de EU aan Turkije

MPs Omtzigt and Verheijen asked the Foreign Minister about the mass arrest of Turkish journalists, the Commission's condemnation, and whether EU pre-accession aid to Turkey should be frozen or cut. The minister agreed the arrests are incompatible with EU values, noted the IPA performance reward mechanism, and said Netherlands pushed for consequences for aid at the General Affairs Council, though no broader support existed and it is for the Commission to propose measures.

At the Council, the Netherlands also pointed to the performance reward anchored in the new IPA regulation and argued that current developments should have consequences for financial support to Turkey.

Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad eveneens gewezen op de prestatiebeloning die in de nieuwe IPA-verordering verankerd zit en ervoor gepleit dat de huidige ontwikkelingen consequenties zouden moeten hebben voor de financiële steun aan Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Verheijen over het bericht “Controles op EU-subsidies moeten slimmer”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Verheijen asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' call for mandatory Member State declarations and related calls for smarter EU subsidy controls. The Minister replied that Nederland supports a national declaration and will keep pushing for transparent accountability, noting an EU working group's final document, but gave no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands continues to work unremittingly towards good accountability for the European budget and supports a National Declaration.
Nederland blijft zich onverminderd inzetten om te komen tot een goede verantwoording over de Europese begroting en is voorstander van een Nationale Verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Ten Broeke en Verheijen over de Sanctiewet van Curaçao

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers how the Curaçao parliament's rejection of the Kingdom sanctions law affects implementation of EU sanctions against Russia and whether a national Kingdom sanctions law (Rijkssanctiewet) is needed. The government answered that EU sanctions must apply across the Kingdom, that Aruba and Sint Maarten have adapted their rules, that work on a national law continues because Curaçao has not yet adapted its ordinance, and that Curaçao's autonomous legislative competence cannot be overridden.
The draft national sanctions law does allow each country to determine separately which parts of the law enter into force.
De concept Rijkssanctiewet voorziet overigens in de mogelijkheid om voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over de voornemens inzake tolheffing op de Duitse wegen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about German plans to extend a road toll (vignette) to local roads, including its effects on cross-border residents, transport, EU law and possible joint action with neighbouring countries. The minister opposed the plan, said the Commission will be asked to assess it under EU law, and said Nederland will consider joint action with other countries if useful.
I will ask Commissioner Kallas to examine whether this planned measure and its implementation are compatible with EU law.
Ik zal Eurocommissaris Kallas verzoeken na te gaan of deze voorgenomen maatregel en de uitwerking ervan verenigbaar is met het EU recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over Blokkade Turkije YouTube

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's blocking of Twitter and YouTube, whether the EU has tools to respond, and whether a country blocking such sites can join the EU. The minister says the government is concerned, welcomes the lifting of the Twitter block after a Turkish constitutional court ruling, reports EU and Dutch critical dialogue with Turkey, and states that the blocks conflict with the Copenhagen criteria.
The cabinet is concerned about the decision to block access to Twitter and YouTube.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over het besluit om toegang tot Twitter en YouTube af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over het bericht 'Geen hoger loon voor EU-functionarissen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the ruling that EU officials will not receive a higher salary, and about the Commission's options, the pension premium proposal and the status of the EU civil service statute. The minister welcomed the Court's ruling, said the Commission's pension premium proposal is still pending in the Council, and said the government's position on EU salaries and pensions has not changed.
It is currently not known what the European Commission will do following this ruling.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend wat de Europese Commissie naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak zal doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over het bericht 'EU aid lost in Palestine'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether she knew of a report claiming over a billion euros of EU aid was lost in Palestinian territories through corruption and mismanagement, and whether aid should be halted and a programme-wide audit requested. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, said she had not yet seen the unpublished European Court of Auditors report, and declined to prejudge its findings while promising to inform parliament by letter once it is published.
I am not aware of the content of the report since it has not yet been released.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van het rapport aangezien het nog niet is vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Verheijen en Taverne over de dreigende deportatie van een journalist uit Turkije

Three VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Turkey threatens to deport NRC correspondent Vermeulen as a security risk, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the government does not know what the alleged security problem is, that the ministry has raised the case with Turkish authorities and pressed for his right to return and work, and that the government is concerned about press freedom in Turkey.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has raised attention with the Turkish authorities for Mr Vermeulen and urges that he be able to enter Turkey, where he lives, and carry out his work as a journalist there.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft bij de Turkse autoriteiten aandacht gevraagd voor de heer Vermeulen en dringt er op aan dat hij Turkije – waar hij woont – binnen kan komen en daar zijn werkzaamheden als journalist kan verrichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over verdwenen EU-gelden in Congo

Two MPs from the VVD asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU aid to Congo was largely wasted and whether the EU overlooked corruption. The minister agreed the European Court of Auditors found serious shortcomings, said the government will press the Commission to follow the recommendations, and answered the remaining questions on Congo's fragility, Dutch funding shares, Mali and aid levels.

The cabinet agrees with the Court's recommendations to increase aid effectiveness and will, now that programming of the Eleventh EDF begins, press Commissioner Piebalgs to have the EU follow up on these recommendations.

Het kabinet is het eens met de aanbevelingen die de Rekenkamer doet om de effectiviteit van steun te vergroten en zal er, nu de programmering van het Elfde Europees Ontwikkelingsfonds (EOF11) van start gaat, bij Commissaris Piebalgs op aandringen dat de EU gevolg geeft aan deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Fokke over de toekomst van het European Institute of Public Administration

MPs Verheijen and Fokke asked whether EIPA may leave Maastricht after the Dutch government cuts its subsidy, who will be responsible for its support, and whether the government will consult Limburg and Maastricht. The minister answered that the government is considering an additional regional contribution, that responsibility is still open, and that letters requesting a regional contribution were sent on 2 July, with the Chamber to be informed once EIPA's financial position is clear.
Once there is clarity about EIPA's financial position, the cabinet will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is rondom de financiële positie van EIPA zal het kabinet de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht «EU-miljard voor Egypte verdween in zwart gat»

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a newspaper report that EU aid of a billion euros to Egypt had disappeared, and about the European Court of Auditors' critical findings on the use of the funds. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings, said the Netherlands had pressed the Commission and EEAS for stricter conditions, noted that Egypt's remaining aid is withheld pending IMF-linked reforms, and said Dutch bilateral aid carries negligible risk of misuse.
The Netherlands argued that this critical report again confirms the need to set clearer conditions on the use of funds for the Arab region.
Nederland heeft ingebracht dat dit kritische rapport nog eens de noodzaak bevestigt van het stellen van duidelijkere voorwaarden aan de besteding van fondsen voor de Arabische regio
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Verheijen over de voorschriften met betrekking tot de presentatie van olijfolie in horeca gelegenheden

Two VVD MPs asked why the European Commission planned to ban refillable olive oil bottles in restaurants, on what powers, and whether it breached subsidiarity and burdened hospitality businesses. State secretary Dijksma answered that the Netherlands opposed the measure, voted against it, welcomed its withdrawal, and will send the Commission a list of EU rules causing unnecessary burden.
For these reasons, the Netherlands voted against the measure.
Nederland heeft om deze redenen tegen de maatregel gestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht "EU diplomats to spend more on salaries, less on security"

MPs Verheijen and Ten Broeke asked the foreign minister about reports that EU diplomatic service spending would shift toward salaries and away from security, and about high pay levels and allowances at the EEAS. The minister said the figures could not be confirmed as they come from draft budgets not yet public, defended the higher grades as a legacy of merged structures, and pledged to push for lower staff conditions and to inform the House after the EEAS evaluation.
The content of the report cannot be confirmed.
De inhoud van het bericht kan niet bevestigd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verheijen over Hongaarse onderscheidingen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Hungary's constitutional amendments and the award of state honours to people with antisemitic and far-right views, and how the EU and bilateral channels would respond. The minister shares the concern, condemns the honours, notes that Hungarian journalist Szaniszló returned his decoration, and says the Commission and Council of Europe are examining the amendments with action to follow depending on their findings.
The Netherlands will continue to urge these bodies to keep fulfilling this role.
Nederland zal deze instanties blijven aansporen deze rol te blijven vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over Tsjechische corruptie en de rol van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that the Commission treated Czech misuse of EU funds leniently, whether public reports differed from confidential drafts, and whether controls are adequate. The minister answered that the Commission's final report follows a hearing process, that the Commission's audits show control-system failures and imposed financial corrections (10%, 5%, 22%), and that a fuller overview of error rates per member state is not yet available.
The Netherlands has asked the European Commission for such an overview.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie verzocht om een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over de mogelijke stijging van de salarissen van EU-ambtenaren

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would push back against proposed pay rises for EU civil servants, the lapse of the solidarity levy, and the stalled reform of the EU staff regulations. The minister confirmed the stalemate, said the Netherlands opposes the 1.7% rise and wants deeper pension and pay reforms tied to the MFK negotiations, and committed to keep raising the issue.
The Netherlands will continue to actively pursue this issue.
Nederland blijft zich hier actief voor inzetten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Hennis-Plasschaert en Verheijen over het veiligheidsrisico van Chinese telecomproducenten

Three VVD MPs asked the government whether Chinese telecom producers pose a security risk to Dutch critical infrastructure, what steps will be taken to map such risks, and whether KPN and others will be questioned. The minister answers that vulnerabilities are a conceivable risk but there is no direct evidence of espionage use, that intelligence services remain alert and will warn relevant parties if concrete indications emerge, and that the matter will be raised actively with companies.
For the time being there is a conceivable risk, but there are no direct indications that these vulnerabilities are actually being used for espionage purposes.
Vooralsnog is hier sprake van een voorstelbaar risico, maar zijn er geen directe aanwijzingen dat deze kwetsbaarheden daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt voor spionagedoeleinden.

Dit amendement creëert een mogelijkheid en grondslag voor gemeenten om een leegstandsheffing voor woningen in te voeren.

the competent authority promotes, where possible, the application of section 3.5 of the General Administrative Law Act in preparing decisions on separate environmental permit applications

by amending article 12 of the Housing Act 2014 in the bill strengthening housing regulation

Asks the government to designate drinking water infrastructure project decisions as decisions of overriding public interest, enabling procedural acceleration.
requests the government to designate project decisions for drinking water infrastructure as decisions of overriding public interest

Extends the occupancy restriction on affordable owner-occupied homes to the resale period within the retention term, so they can only be sold to the target household group.
This amendment ensures that also after the first sale of a new affordable owner-occupied home, during the retention period, the home can only be sold to a household from the target group.

Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat ook na de eerste verkoop van een nieuwe betaalbare koopwoning, gedurende de instandhoudingstermijn, de woning alleen kan worden verkocht aan een huishouden uit de betreffende doelgroep.

with particular attention to the processing time of permit grants

requests the Minister to explore whether, how and within what period housing projects can also work with project decisions

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Welzijn en Grinwis ter vervanging van nr. 43 over voortgangsrapportages per kwartaal
Amendment asks that the minister for housing be required, via a general administrative order, to report quarterly on progress of the housing construction target with a dashboard of deliveries.
The submitters call on the government to guarantee that, when drafting the reporting rules in proposed article 20.15a, quarterly reports are produced.

De indieners roepen de regering op te garanderen dat bij de uitwerking van de te stellen regels over de verslaglegging als bedoeld in het voorgestelde artikel 20.15a wordt verwezenlijkt dat er per kwartaal verslag wordt uitgebracht.

Vergunningen die betrekking hebben op een en dezelfde activiteit en ter beoordeling aangeboden zijn aan de vergunningverlener moeten in één keer vergund kunnen worden.

Asks the government to explore how to make shared housing for older people more attractive and report by October.
requests the government to explore the possibilities to make shared housing for older people more attractive

Permits that are inseparably linked and submitted for assessment to the permit granter must be able to be granted in one go.
Vergunningen die onlosmakelijk verbonden zijn en ter beoordeling aangeboden zijn aan de vergunningverlener moeten in één keer vergund kunnen worden.
