verjaart de rechtsvordering tot betaling van een huurprijsverhoging door verloop van twee jaren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the room-rental tax exemption, its lack of monitoring data, budget figures, and options to double it for a second room, and whether these options are feasible. The minister answered that effectiveness cannot be firmly established due to missing data, that monitoring would require structural changes to the tax return, that the second-room option is not feasible before 2030, and that no firm policy choice or cost-benefit analysis has yet been made.
In the tax return it does not have to be declared that use is made of this.
In de belastingaangifte hoeft niet opgegeven te worden dat hier gebruik van wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel ‘Arbeidsinspectie luidt noodklok over misstanden bij asbestsaneringen’

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the government about an Arbeidsinspectie signal that over a third of asbestos inspection firms perform final assessments poorly, including homes wrongly declared asbestos-free, possible commercial dependence between sanitation firms and inspectors, and falsified measurements. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said existing rules and controls are sufficient for now, that health effects cannot be tracked, and that the planned licensing requirement from 2027 plus a review with stakeholders are the main responses, rejecting structural measures like forced rotation or removing inspections from commercial parties.

With the implementation of the Asbestos Directive 2, this will additionally be supplemented with a licensing requirement for asbestos removal, making it much easier to keep poorly performing companies off the market.

Met het implementeren van de Asbestrichtlijn 2 wordt dit bovendien aangevuld met een vergunningplicht voor het verwijderen van asbest, waardoor het veel beter mogelijk wordt om slecht presterende bedrijven van de markt te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Grinwis over het artikel 'Doek valt voor Winst Uit je Woning, dat gemeenten helpt met isolatie van woningen'

MPs Welzijn and Grinwis asked the Minister of Housing about the bankruptcy of Winst Uit Je Woning, an intermediary used by municipalities for insulation under the national insulation programme, and its effects on delays, costs, monitoring and contract lessons. The Minister said the matter is mainly between municipalities and the firm, noted a doorstart, offered regional support funds, and largely declined to change municipal freedom, giving partial answers on costs, monitoring and energy poverty.
This is mainly a matter between the municipalities concerned as clients and Winst uit je Woning.
Dit is voornamelijk een zaak tussen de betreffende gemeenten als opdrachtgever en Winst uit je Woning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Noodpakket vaak te duur voor mensen in armoede, ze hebben die spullen nu al dagelijks nodig'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the state secretary whether government emergency-preparedness campaigns on emergency kits are fair to low-income households and how resilience policy will reach the most vulnerable. The state secretary answered that the campaign is voluntary and low-cost, that alternatives such as shared kits and local support are being examined, and that a broad evaluation will not specifically cover emergency kits.
The emergency kit is not specifically named for that reason because it involves tailored provision.
Het noodpakket wordt om die reden niet specifiek benoemd omdat sprake is van maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de kabinetsreactie op het adviesrapport STOER en de uitvoering van het amendement-Welzijn (fatale beslistermijnen bij omgevingsvergunningen)

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about the government's rejection of the STOER advice and the amendment on fatal decision deadlines for environmental permits, questioning why the government will not implement it. The minister answers that an implementation assessment showed the amendment would not speed up housing construction, would create implementation risks, and so will be removed via a novelle, while pointing to other measures.

Based on the UDO, I conclude that this amendment will not lead to faster permit granting, while it does have significant consequences for implementation practice and disproportionately intervenes in administrative relations.

Op basis van de UDO kom ik tot de conclusie dat dit amendement niet tot versnelling van de vergunningverlening zal leiden, terwijl er wel significante gevolgen zijn voor de uitvoeringspraktijk en het disproportioneel ingrijpt in de bestuurlijke verhoudingen.
Antwoord op van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Kabinet plant grootschalige woonwijken bij vier Nederlandse steden'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about land ownership, pre-announcement land purchases, speculation, planbaten recovery and public land acquisition for the large-scale housing locations in the draft Nota Ruimte. The minister answered that the ministry has no complete overview of ownership, that some municipalities bought or used pre-emption rights, that no planbatenheffing agreements exist, and that public acquisition was chosen only at some specific locations.
The ministry does not have a complete overview of the ownership situation of the plots within the nationally large-scale housing locations.
Het ministerie heeft geen compleet overzicht van de eigendomssituatie van de percelen binnen de nationaal grootschalige woningbouwlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over hospitaverhuur en het Huurregister

An MP asked the housing minister why the hospitaverhuur (room rental) bill and the rental register keep slipping, and whether timelines and effects can be made public. The minister answered that the bill goes to the Raad van State and parliament in the first half of 2026, cited complexity and stakeholder consultation as causes, and said the register will be outlined in an early-2026 note, without committing to earlier dates or phased entry into force.
My aim is to submit the bill to your House for consideration in the first half of 2026.
Mijn inzet is om het wetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2026 voor te leggen aan uw Kamer ter behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Migratie is niet hét probleem van de woningmarkt: 'Dat is onzin'’ geschreven voor nu.nl.

Two MPs from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Housing about the role of migration in the housing shortage, including its share of housing demand, its effect on starters, and measures for migrant housing and quality. The minister answered that migration drives most population growth and thus housing need, outlined existing instruments such as flexible housing funding and the Wet goed verhuurderschap, and acknowledged gaps in data on migrant housing, though many answers referred to general policy or other responsibilities.
No data are available on the number of dwellings owned by temporary employment agencies and private investors who rent housing to such agencies.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal woningen dat in handen is van uitzendbureaus en private investeerders die woonruimtes verhuren aan uitzendbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de toepassing van de kostendelersnorm

The MP asks the State Secretary about uneven municipal use of discretion (maatwerk) under the kostendelersnorm, including national guidelines, monitoring, financial neutrality, complaints, and fairness for vulnerable groups. The State Secretary answers that maatwerk is governed by article 18 of the Participatiewet and that municipalities bear responsibility, declines to monitor or create new national guidelines, points to ongoing revision work and a study due March 2026, and says complaints go through existing objection and appeal routes.
There are no signals known to me that municipalities deviate from this.
Er zijn bij mij geen signalen bekend dat gemeenten hiervan afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de oproep van de Kinderombudsman inzake kinderarmoede

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the Children's Ombudsman's call for an integrated approach to child poverty, including structural support, national guidelines for municipalities, child participation, debt prevention and monitoring. The government answered that it shares the integrated approach, points to ongoing exploratory work with VNG and Divosa, and promises updates in the NPAS progress report in early 2026.
Progress will be reported to the House in the first NPAS progress report in early 2026.
Over de voortgang wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd in de eerste voortgangsrapportage van het NPAS begin 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Welzijn over het Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland

MPs Saris and Welzijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the legal basis, supervision, Woo coverage and accountability of the Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland (BIDN), formerly the Inlichtingenbureau. The minister said tasks are largely statutory or performed as processor for public bodies, that the statutes change will be pre-submitted later this year, and that a conversion into an independent administrative body is left to that decision.

After advice on this intention from the Ministry of Finance's Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen and the Algemene Rekenkamer, the cabinet will take a decision, which is expected to be pre-submitted to the Eerste and Tweede Kamer by the end of this year.

Na advisering over dit voornemen door de Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen van het Ministerie van Financiën en de Algemene Rekenkamer neemt het kabinet hierover een besluit, dat naar verwachting voor het eind van dit jaar zal worden voorgehangen bij de Eerste en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het NOS-artikel ‘Raad van State kraakt plan om voorrang statushouders te schrappen, Keijzer zet door’

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked Minister Keijzer how she reconciles the planned abolition of priority for refugee status holders (statushouders) in social housing with the equal treatment principle and the Council of State's critical advice, and about the share of vacated social rentals going to them. The minister defended the ban as objectively justified, pointed to accompanying measures and a phased entry into force, and said several data questions could not yet be answered fully or on time.
I have studied this advice carefully.
Ik heb dit advies zorgvuldig bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitzending Pauw & De Wit van 9 oktober 2025

An MP asked the minister for the formal and factual basis of the claim that statushouders received 25-30% of vacant social rental homes, and asked for an answer by 29 October. The minister answered that the share depends on the comparison group, cited a 32% estimate from Jan van de Beek for a comparable group in 2015-2018, and said general allocation rates of 6-10% are less representative of pressure on the housing market.
The allocation share of statushouders to social rental housing depends on the group of housing seekers with which the comparison is made.
Het toewijzingspercentage van statushouders aan sociale huurwoningen is afhankelijk van de groep woningzoekenden waarmee de vergelijking wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Kamerbrief 'Evaluatie CO-stelsel - nadere informatie opvolging aanbevelingen'

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about simplifying the CO-certification scheme for sole traders and small firms, stronger enforcement by municipalities, a maintenance obligation for gas appliances, and public information on certified installers. The Minister responds that simplification initiatives are underway within the legal framework, rejects a mandatory maintenance check for now, says enforcement is being studied with the VNG and IPO, and promises further monitoring and information only in part.
I am in consultation with the VNG on the state of supervision of the legal provisions arising from the Building Works Living Environment Decree (Bbl), which also involves the CO-system.
Ik ben in overleg met de VNG over de staat van het toezicht op de wettelijke bepalingen volgend uit het Besluit Bouwwerken leefomgeving (Bbl), waarbij ook het CO-stelsel wordt betrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Saris over de berichten ‘Meer buitenlanders kopen woning in Nederland, verdubbeling in vijf jaar’ en ‘Steeds meer woningen verkocht aan expats, ‘terwijl zoveel Nederlanders juis

MPs Welzijn and Saris asked the government about reports that expats and international buyers are increasingly purchasing homes, and about calls to end the 30% tax ruling, restrict expat admission and require municipal consent in scarcity areas. The minister answered that international buyers account for about 1.6% of purchases, with local price effects, that existing municipal tools suffice, that the 30% ruling is kept for business continuity, and that the government will address the shortage by building more homes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'gemeente Utrecht treedt op tegen verkoop losse kamers'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the sale of individual rooms as exclusive use rights outside formal apartment splitting, asking about legal basis, transparency, mortgage financing, buyer protection and possible national measures. The Minister answered that municipalities can enforce via their housing ordinances under the Huisvestingswet, that no national data or measures exist, and that no new legislation or policy is currently planned.
I will keep in contact with the VNG on this point and inform the House if that changes.
Ik zal contact houden met de VNG op dit punt en de Kamer informeren als dat verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over hospitaverhuur en het landelijk huurregister

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the rise of room rental (hospitaverhuur) and the delayed national rental register, including tenant protection and timing. The minister agreed room rental can ease the housing shortage, defended a bill that weakens tenant protection, and said the rental register will be delayed until scenarios are consulted in early 2026.
However, tenant protection for tenants will become more limited.
De huurbescherming voor huurders wordt echter beperkter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel ‘Spanje wil 53.000 vakantiehuizen van onlineplatforms verwijderen’

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about Spain's plan to remove 53,000 holiday homes from online platforms and whether the Netherlands should follow. The minister replied that Dutch municipalities already have tools under the 2021 short-stay law, that no national figures on non-compliant listings exist, and that the impact on the housing crisis would be very small.
National figures on how many dwellings do not meet the requirements set by municipalities are not available.
Landelijke cijfers hoeveel woningen niet voldoen aan de eisen die gemeenten stellen zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het benoemen van vier nieuwe grootschalige woonwijken

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about land ownership, prior land purchases, land-value effects, planning-gain recovery and public land acquisition for four newly announced large housing sites. The minister answered every sub-question with a single cross-reference, stating that the named locations do not match those designated in the June Bestuurlijke Overleggen and that final designation will follow the Nota Ruimte.
The locations you refer to in the question do not correspond with the municipalities named in June in the Bestuurlijke Overleggen Leefomgeving.
De locaties waarna u verwijst in de vraag komen niet overeen met de gemeenten die afgelopen juni zijn benoemd in de Bestuurlijke Overleggen Leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het programma Verbouwstromen

An MP asked the minister about the Verbouwstromen renovation programme: its preconditions, success factors, funding, evaluation and continuation. The minister answered at length, describing the programme's adaptation after weak initial partnerships, its evaluation, unspent funds of about 1.5 million euro, and a 2026-2029 continuation with no additional money freed for parliamentary reallocation.
No additional funds will become available for alternative use and decision-making by the House.
Er komen geen (aanvullende) middelen alsnog beschikbaar voor alternatieve inzet en besluitvorming door de kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Massale antikraak: hedgefondsen Capreit en Rubens Capital mogen verbod op leegstand omzeilen’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing whether landlords using bruikleen (loan) contracts to fill vacant flats circumvent the ban on temporary leases and lack tenant protection, and what will be done. The minister replied that bruikleen contracts are not rentals, that Utrecht successfully enforced occupation under the Leegstandwet, and that a bill to make forced occupation structural is being prepared.
The possibility of enforcing occupation I will anchor structurally.
De mogelijkheid om een ingebruikname af te dwingen ga ik structureel verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Kamerbrief ‘Voortgang versterking NRVT’

MPs asked the minister how foundation risks are addressed in strengthening oversight of the valuers' register NRVT, including convenant targets, independence, fallback to a ZBO, cooperation with supervisors and fraud signalling. The minister answered that foundation information is a standard part of valuation reports, that a convenant with NRVT is being prepared with evaluation and monitoring details still to come, and deferred several specifics.
I aim to inform the House as soon as possible about the content of this convenant.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer zo snel mogelijk nader te informeren over de inhoud van dit convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over berichtgeving over bijbetalen aan verwarming door ‘slecht onderhoud flat’

An NSC MP asked the Ministers of Housing and Climate about reports of residents in IJmuiden protesting high district-heating bills linked to poor building maintenance, asking about transparency, verification, cost structure, overpayments and whether the government will publish data and act. The minister answered that current rules (Warmtewet, Wcw, tenancy law) already provide sufficient safeguards, that data on back-payments is not held by government, and promised only limited further steps such as reporting on complaints via the ACM and monitoring the upcoming Wcw implementation.
The cabinet is of the view that the policy to safeguard transparency, reliability and affordability is in order.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het beleid om de transparantie, betrouwbaarheid en betaalbaarheid te borgen op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Welzijn over het Interdepartementale Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) Huursector

MP Welzijn (NSC) asked the Minister for Housing about the IBO Huursector report, including its conclusions on tax advantages, housing for starters and middle incomes, a rental register, housing reuse, and a national allocation system. The minister declined to go into the report's substance pending a cabinet response this autumn, but described concrete steps on hospitaverhuur, home sharing and splitting, and said a national allocation system would require the central government to take the lead.
I will not anticipate this cabinet response in this letter and therefore will not go into the conclusions and recommendations of the report on substance.
Ik zal in deze brief niet vooruitlopen op deze kabinetsreactie en ga daarom niet inhoudelijk in op de conclusies en aanbevelingen van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over tegengaan van versnippering in regelgeving en hulp bij armoede en schulden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reducing fragmentation in rules, counters and access to help for poverty and debt, including a pilot with a single coordinator, work incentives in debt relief, relapse prevention, use of experiential experts, and monitoring of bureaucracy. The government answered that it pursues integrated debt and poverty policy, simplification of income support and minimum-income rules, a national debt-help entry point, and aftercare, while declining a dedicated monitoring of regulatory burden and promising a progress report in Q1 2026 on possible pilots.
The cabinet is pursuing simplification of the income support system, easier access to help, simpler poverty policy and a strengthened debt assistance service.

Het kabinet zet in op het vereenvoudigen van het stelsel van inkomensondersteuning, het eenvoudiger maken van de toegang tot hulp, het eenvoudiger maken van het armoedebeleid en het versterken van de schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over verduurzaming van huurwoningen en energiearmoede, zie 'Energiearmoede steeg vorig jaar fors door stopzetten steunmaatregelen'

An MP asked the government about agreements with private landlords on home insulation, annual insulation numbers for housing corporations and private landlords, how to speed up renovation, phase-out timing for low energy labels, tenants' options to push landlords, progress on a motion about nature permits, and funding for an energy-poverty fund. The minister answered that no performance agreements exist with private landlords, that a 2012 covenant missed its target, outlined planned minimum energy requirements from 2029, a support package for private landlords, and that the public energy fund could be operational by late 2026 with funding subject to a new cabinet.
The cabinet has decided, subject to approval by the European Commission, to use €174.5 million from the SCF funds for a public energy fund to be set up.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, onder voorbehoud van goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie, uit de middelen voor het SCF € 174,5 miljoen in te zetten voor het in te richten publiek energiefonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de Omgevingswet

An MP asks the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning whether the first monitoring results of the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) show integrated, one-government working, and whether the transition will stall, with municipalities relying on temporary BOPA instruments and old working methods. The Minister answers that implementation is a gradual cultural change managed by each competent authority, that the monitoring and independent evaluation commission will track progress, and that participation support and the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting are being backed by ministry-led support measures.
I, but certainly also the evaluation commission, will continue to pay attention to this in the coming years within the framework of monitoring and evaluation.
Ik, maar zeker ook de evaluatiecommissie, zullen hier de komende jaren in het kader van de monitoring en evaluatie aandacht voor blijven hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Nieuwbouwhuis raakt hitte slecht kwijt, we bouwen voor klimaat van 15 jaar geleden'

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about news reports that new homes overheat and that building rules reflect a climate of 15 years ago, asking about health risks, cooling, building standards, neighbourhood greenery and integrating heat stress into housing projects. The Minister answers that current rules limit overheating risk, outlines the 2025 heat approach and the planned national adaptation strategy, and commits to further instruments and reviews.
To limit the effects of heat in the built environment, an integrated approach is required.
Om de effecten van de gevolgen van hitte in de gebouwde omgeving te beperken, is een integrale benadering vereist.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitvoering en effecten van het programma Schrappen Tegenstrijdige en Overbodige Eisen en Regelgeving (STOER)

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the implementation, expected housing gains, costs, monitoring and energy-grid constraints of the STOER deregulation programme, and about the timing of EU energy-performance rules. The minister mostly deferred quantification to the cabinet response after summer, outlined which laws would change and committed to further review and a joint consultation, while stating that quality remains a benchmark.

At the committee debate on building regulations on 12 June I indicated that further clarification of this motion will be included in the cabinet response after the summer to the committee's final report.

Tijdens het commissiedebat Bouwregelgeving van 12 juni jongstleden heb ik aangegeven dat verdere duiding op deze motie wordt meegenomen in de kabinetsreactie ná deze zomer op het eindrapport van de commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt als omslag naar duurzaam ontworpen woningen uitblijft'

An MP asked the housing minister about a news report warning that a new construction crisis looms unless buildings shift to sustainable design, and about the Rli advice, sustainable materials, heat resilience and the STOER deregulation project. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to the EPBD-IV whole-life carbon rules and a routekaart due by 2027, but rejected the crisis framing, gave no firm timeline for STOER changes beyond a 2026 voorhang, and left some questions (heat research, biobased effects) pending further study.
Before 1 January 2027 the Minister of VRO will publish a roadmap and notify the European Commission of it.
Voor 1 januari 2027 zal de Minister van VRO een routekaart publiceren en daarover de Europese Commissie in kennis stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Meer woningen krijgen vergunning zonder bouwstart

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that homes receive permits but construction does not start, and about the financial consequences for builders and buyers. The Minister acknowledged the problem, attributed it mainly to economic conditions and listed measures (Woontop agreements, parallel planning, nitrogen and appeal-procedure measures, investment incentives), while declining to offer financial compensation.
I do not have a complete and up-to-date picture of the precise financial consequences.
Ik heb geen volledig en actueel beeld van de precieze financiële gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het publiceren van lijst met vermeende fraudeurs door de gemeente Zaanstad

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the municipality of Zaanstad publishing a list of people owing Participatiewet debts, including whether the privacy regulator's advice was obtained only after publication and whether the measure is proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the list concerns established debts of people unreachable by the municipality, that the municipality's legal review found a legal basis, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the competent supervisor and is investigating, and that no national guidelines are needed beyond existing GDPR proportionality rules.
It is up to the AP as supervisor to form a judgment on whether privacy legislation and the protection of personal data were sufficiently observed.
Het is aan de AP als toezichthouder om een oordeel te vormen of de privacywetgeving en de bescherming van persoonsgegevens voldoende in acht zijn genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitvoering van de motie-Welzijn (Kamerstuk 34 293, nr. 143) inzake risicobeheersing Binnenhofrenovatie naar aanleiding van de 13de voortgangsrapportage Binnenhof

An MP asked the Minister of Housing whether the Binnenhof renovation risk management, as requested by a parliamentary motion, goes beyond identifying risks to adding mitigating measures such as independent audits, a political stop point, a scope freeze, a public risk dashboard and benchmarking. The Minister answered that risks are managed at several levels with described strategies, but declined to provide per-risk detail for confidentiality and practicality reasons, said an independent audit is not planned, rejected an extra political stop point, said a scope freeze is already in place, and was willing only to explore a risk dashboard within confidentiality limits.
Given the number of risks and associated control measures, the information per risk is too extensive to send to your House in progress reports.
Gegeven de hoeveelheid risico's en bijbehorende beheersmaatregelen is de informatie per risico te uitgebreid om in voortgangsrapportages aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Mooiman over recente artikelen ’Zonnepanelen ontploffen en zorgen voor problemen' en 'Expert: Stop met brandbare isolatie'

Two MPs asked the minister about fires involving external insulation and solar panels in Arnhem and Didam, and about fire safety rules for renovation and sustainability projects. The minister answered that existing Bbl fire rules apply, that monitoring and follow-up research (TNO, NIPV, Royal Haskoning DHV, NEN) are underway, and that no new national rules, action plan or structural programme is considered necessary.
Banning combustible insulation materials in the building envelope of homes is not appropriate.
Het verbieden van brandbare isolatiematerialen in de gebouwschil van woningen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de position paper van TNO 'Goede binnenluchtkwaliteit voor onze gezondheid'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about a TNO position paper on indoor air quality, its proposed health-policy, ventilation, monitoring and regulatory measures. The minister largely judged existing building and tenancy rules sufficient, while committing to a ventilation-focused awareness campaign and declining a national monitoring programme, a TNO structural role, and fixed ventilation subsidies for now.
However, I see no need for a large-scale monitoring programme in the existing building stock to shape policy on the indoor environment.
Ik zie echter geen noodzaak voor een grootschalig monitoringsprogramma in de bestaande bouw om beleid ten aanzien van het binnenmilieu vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitspraak van de rechter dat achterafbetaaldienst Klarna verdient aan Incassokosten

An MP asked the government about court rulings finding that buy-now-pay-later provider Klarna earns from reminder and collection fees and may fall under consumer credit rules, and about measures against such practices. The ministers answered that the rulings concern one creditor failing to prove fees were not part of the business model, that BNPL providers will fall under the revised EU consumer credit directive by November 2026 with AFM supervision, and that the industry code and talks with Klarna are being tightened.
It is up to the AFM to assess whether this ruling has consequences for supervision.
Het is aan de AFM om te beoordelen of deze uitspraak gevolgen heeft voor het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Zaanstad publiceert lijst met vermeende bijstandsfraudeurs'

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Zaanstad's publication of a list of alleged welfare fraudsters was proportionate, and what steps preceded it, including privacy and child-harm concerns. The State Secretary answered that all prior attempts at contact were exhausted, that the approach fits current law, that the municipality requested AP advice, and that national privacy frameworks are unnecessary because such weighing is case-specific.
I consider it desirable that such a step is taken with care and that account is taken of the consequences of publication for the people concerned.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat het zetten van een dergelijke stap zorgvuldig gebeurt en dat daarbij rekening wordt gehouden met de gevolgen van publicatie voor de mensen die het aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de overhandiging van de ‘Housing Hotline Policy Brief 2024’ vanuit de LSVb

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the LSVb's Housing Hotline 2024 policy brief on rental abuses, uneven municipal tenant support, a national quality mark for tenant teams, data sharing between municipalities, and online rental scams targeting students. The Minister answered that existing laws and municipal complaint points suffice, that municipalities decide on tenant teams, that a national mark is not seen, and that the scam signal will be passed to the Justice Minister.
At the table of the National Platform for Student Housing I will speak with the Network of Knowledge Cities to encourage them to have their information provision to tenants in order.
Aan tafel van het Landelijk Platform Studentenhuisvesting zal ik in gesprek gaan met het Netwerk Kennissteden om ze aan te moedigen hun informatievoorziening richting huurders op orde te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Woningbouw in het nauw; Onderzoek: kwart van miljoen nieuwe huizen op de tocht door milieubeleid'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about a Telegraaf report that a quarter million planned homes are threatened by water, soil subsidence and nitrogen rules, and whether the risk map and grounds for building restrictions are justified. The minister disputed the newspaper's reading of the EIB report, said the water and soil framework is non-binding, and outlined measures such as raising ground levels, subsidies and a nitrogen permitting overhaul.
The decision-making framework with its accompanying maps was made to support authorities in choosing locations for new spatial developments, and has no legally enforceable status.
Het afwegingskader met daarbij behorende kaarten is gemaakt ter ondersteuning voor overheden bij de locatiekeuze voor nieuwe ruimtelijke ontwikkelingen, en heeft geen juridisch afdwingbare status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over antwoorden op Kamervragen over risico op hogere prijzen in nieuw kinderopvangstelsel van 17 februari 2025

An MP asked the State Secretary whether childcare is a Service of General Economic Interest under EU state-aid rules, and whether the planned new childcare financing system, with direct government payments to providers, complies with those rules. The State Secretary answered that the new system does create state aid in principle, that it must be made compatible via the DAEB exemption decision with reporting to the European Commission, and that the 2027 start date is not affected.
This means that the new financing system in principle involves state aid.
Dit leidt ertoe dat er in het nieuwe financieringsstelsel in beginsel sprake is van staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'De bonafide particuliere belegger kan niet meer rendabel verhuren'

The MP Welzijn asked Minister Keijzer about a Volkskrant article claiming private investors can no longer rent profitably, about first-time buyers, family gifts with tax exemptions, the share of middle-rent homes held by private landlords, and the rent levels of those homes from 2015 to 2024. The minister answered in detail with WoON survey data, acknowledging that many private rental homes are in the low segment and that rents often diverge from maximum prices, and admitted the answers were delayed because the data could not be published before 10 April 2025.
Answering the questions properly required data from the WoON2024 survey.
Voor goede beantwoording van de gestelde vragen waren gegevens uit het WoON2024-onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Gemeente checkt of huurders niet te veel betalen; ‘Het is bij de beesten af’'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a news report on tenants paying hidden extra rent above the legal rent, and what the Wet goed verhuurderschap has achieved so far. The minister acknowledges such practices are unlawful, says no central data exist on their scale or on municipal reports and enforcement, promises monitoring and a report by year end, and points to tenants' existing remedies.
The number of reports at municipal reporting points and the number of enforcement actions are not centrally registered, so precise figures are not available.
Het aantal meldingen bij gemeentelijke meldpunten en het aantal handhavingsacties wordt niet centraal geregistreerd, waardoor precieze cijfers hierover niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Welzijn over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen over het bericht ‘Woningsplitsing levert nog weinig extra huizen op’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about data on home splitting and conversions, the BAG registry, the delay in 2024 figures, and the progress of housing projects and policy programs. The minister answered that CBS derives splitting figures from the BAG, that splitting and other conversions cannot always be separated, that a new scan and a Kamerbrief will follow, and that data gaps are not a major problem because total new homes are known.
I want to emphasise that the total number of new homes is fully known to CBS and that in that sense no information is missing.
Ik hecht er daarbij aan te benadrukken dat het totaal aantal nieuwe woningen dus volledig bekend is bij het CBS en dat in die zin geen informatie wordt gemist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de ontwikkelingen van hypotheken in 2024

An MP asked the minister for housing about 2024 mortgage and home price developments, including breakdowns by price segment, the share of mortgages used for energy-saving and foundation repair, and the effect of these on mortgage sizes. The minister gave quarterly price figures, said price-segment data for new builds is not available and is being investigated by CBS, and reported that about 15% of 2024 mortgage applications financed energy-saving measures while foundation-repair financing data is limited.
The ministry does not have a breakdown by price segment per quarter of sales prices for existing and new-build homes.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over een onderverdeling in prijssegmenten per kwartaal van de verkoopprijzen bij bestaande en nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op n van de leden Welzijn en Lahlah over "het bericht dat het aantal gemeentelijke meldpunten (kliklijnen) voor uitkeringsfraude blijft stijgen."

MPs Welzijn and Lahlah asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the rising number of municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for benefit fraud and whether they fit a trust-based view of citizens, citing Rotterdam's experience with many unfounded accusations. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on their own enforcement instruments, that a hotline is one enforcement tool, that complaints are checked before any action, and that exact figures on hotlines and reports are not available.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het AD-artikel 'Starter moet vette spaarpot hebben voor eerste woning: eigen vermogen van 91.000 euro vereist'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about an AD article claiming starters need about 91,000 euro in own funds for a first home, and whether official data on equity contributions exist and what effects larger equity contributions have. The minister answered that HDN data show equity contributions of starters have been fairly stable 2020-2024, that larger equity is not clearly driving house prices, and that the questions were answered before the committee debate.
I do not consider further figures necessary.
Verdere cijfers acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Woningsplitsing levert nog weinig extra huizen op’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that home splitting yielded few extra homes in 2024, the causes, and how the government will force a breakthrough toward 100,000 homes. The minister said full 2024 figures are not yet available, that the split/merge balance is small, and listed measures such as the housing regulation bill, funding, and planned guidance and possible permit-free splitting.
Precise figures on the number of splits are not known.
Precieze cijfers over het aantal splitsingen zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel '’Expats only’: Nederlandse woningzoekers buitenspel door nieuwe wet'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that short-stay rentals are being used to bypass the Wet vaste huurcontracten and to exclude permanent housing seekers, including questions on segments, prices, enforcement and fiscal treatment. The minister answered that the data is not available nationally, that short-stay contracts must be applied very restrictively and fall to the courts to judge, that gemeenten handle permit questions, and that the government will consider broader amendments to the sale-related termination rule and the Leegstandwet.
It is not for me as legislator to pass judgment on specific cases mentioned in the article.
Het is niet aan mij als wetgever om een oordeel te geven over specifieke (in het artikel genoemde) gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het debat Staat van de Volkshuisvesting op 23 januari 2024

An MP asked the housing minister, in 14 questions, about the corporation sector's ability to fund 30,000 social rental homes a year, the box 3 tax timing, flex housing, hospitality rental, and conditional municipal subsidies. The minister answered that financing is broadly feasible nationally with regional gaps, that the target is now 2029 with 2027 as an ambition, and that subsidy design is still being worked out, but gave no answer to question 14 on timing.
The definitive budgetary decision-making, including the coverage for box 3, however takes place in the spring.
De definitieve budgettaire besluitvorming, inclusief de dekking voor box 3, vindt echter plaats in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het risico op hogere prijzen in het nieuw kinderopvangstelsel

An MP asks the State Secretary how the planned childcare financing reform, including a 2.9 billion euro investment, can avoid price increases for parents, whether price regulation is possible, and how state aid rules apply. The government answers that a phased increase in subsidies is planned, that tariff regulation is rejected for now pending studies, and that the reform's state aid status is still being worked out with the European Commission.
I expect to be able to share these studies with your House, with a cabinet response, in September.
Ik verwacht dat ik deze onderzoeken voorzien van een kabinetsreactie in september met uw Kamer kan delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Onnodig veel geld kwijt aan dubieuze huursites’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that dubious rental websites mislead housing seekers, and whether the ACM lacks capacity to intervene and whether a national platform should be created. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said the ACM is independent and prioritises cases, pointed to existing consumer remedies and rules for intermediaries, rejected a national platform as not a government task, and saw no need for additional measures.
Because of the ACM's independent position, I see no possibilities to actively have the ACM intervene in signals of misleading practices by rental websites;
De onafhankelijke positie van de ACM maakt dat ik geen mogelijkheden zie om de ACM actief in te laten grijpen bij signalen van misleidende praktijken door huursites;
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de ATAD-richtlijn per 31 juli 2024

Member Welzijn asks whether the earnings stripping rule under the ATAD implementation in the Dutch corporate tax Act disproportionately burdens housing associations, which must finance through debt, and asks why no exemption is possible or what other EU states do. Minister Keijzer answers that the rule is a generic interest-deduction limit required by ATAD1, that exemptions for housing associations are not permitted under the directive or state aid rules, that the government raised the deduction percentage to 24.5% for a relief of 69 million euros for housing associations, and that the ATAD evaluation by the European Commission is awaited before further steps are decided.
To determine our specific position, we first await the outcomes of the ATAD evaluation currently being carried out by the European Commission.
Voor het bepalen van onze specifieke inzet wachten wij eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van ATAD af die momenteel wordt uitgevoerd door de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'De Raad van State versnelt de bezwaarprocedures woningbouw'

An NSC MP asked the Minister of Housing why she distinguishes between the acute housing shortage and other projects, what would be needed to bundle permits and tackle obstacles across the whole shortage, and how many projects are stalled by delays and costs. The minister answered that she treats all housing equally, relies on local acceleration tables and the STOER programme to remove conflicting rules, and gave partial figures while deferring some questions to letters.
Realising 100,000 homes a year is our shared goal.
Het realiseren van 100.000 woningen per jaar is ons gezamenlijk doel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omzigt, Welzijn en Joseph over de Woontop, waar pensioenfondsen schitteren door afwezigheid

MPs Omtzigt, Welzijn and Joseph asked why pension funds were absent from the Woontop housing summit, whether they had been invited and how their participation would be secured. Minister Keijzer answered that the Pensioenfederatie was invited but declined to sign commitments on individual investment decisions, and that talks with the pension sector and a joint investment-climate picture within six months would continue.
I cannot make statements about confidential conversations.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over vertrouwelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Woontopafspraken 2024

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked Minister Keijzer about the 2024 Woontop housing agreements: which parties signed, the potential for densification and splitting, the role of banks, pension funds and cooperatives, the 100,000-homes target, grounds for withholding information, rent and middle-segment shares, land-price instruments and subsidy earmarking. The minister answered most questions substantively, committed to further analyses and a Raad van Woningzoekenden, and declined to give a figure for middle-rent homes and some other numbers, citing ongoing work or lack of data.
It is not possible to state what the cost reductions would be from removing rules and requirements that are still unknown.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de kostenverlagingen zijn als gevolg van het schrappen van, nog onbekende, regels en eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Omtzigt, Mooiman en Wilders over het bericht ‘Maximale huurverhoging vanaf 1 januari 2025: 4,1% voor vrije sector en 7,7% voor middenhuur’

MPs asked the Minister of Housing whether the 7.7% maximum rent increase for mid-segment rentals in 2025 is acceptable for households, and whether additional measures, a transitional arrangement, or a structural change to the mid-rent increase system are planned. The minister answered that the increase follows from the Wet betaalbare huur tied to collective wage growth, that the actual increase will often be lower, and that no legislative change is planned before the 2027 evaluation, while declining to calculate household income effects.
I therefore cannot make a calculation of the effects on the purchasing power figures.
Ik kan dan ook geen doorrekening maken van de effecten in de koopkrachtplaatjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitzending van Pointer ‘Ik mag niet kleiner wonen’ op donderdag 24 oktober 2024 over woningruil

An MP asked the minister about a Pointer broadcast on housing swaps, long social-housing waiting times, and corporations refusing swap requests due to passend toewijzen rules and rent increases. The minister said no data exists on how many tenants want to swap, pointed to municipal and corporation tools, noted limited use of the 5% discretionary allocation room, and said it will be reviewed in 2025.
In 2025 we will review the passend toewijzen instrument and examine, among other things, whether it is necessary to widen the 5% free allocation room.
In 2025 bekijken we het instrument passend toewijzen en onderzoeken we onder andere of het noodzakelijk is de 5% vrije toewijzingsruimte te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over een plan om het verhuren van een kamer aan studenten veel gemakkelijker te maken

MPs Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven and Omtzigt asked the government about making it easier to rent rooms to students through hospita arrangements, covering housing shortages, mortgage and bank consent, the WWSO rent rules, the kostendelersnorm, huurtoeslag and the income-dependent rent increase. The minister answered that the rent-rule and hospita exception is already in place, that a bill to end hospita contracts on sale is being prepared, that banks' consent is being pursued, and that several questions (MKBA, huurtoeslag, exemption thresholds) are under study or not feasible now.
At present I am preparing a legislative amendment that should allow the rental contract to be terminated upon sale, only in the case of hospita rental.
Op dit moment bereid ik een wetswijziging voor die er toe moet leiden dat het huurcontract – alleen in het geval van hospitaverhuur – bij verkoop kan worden beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen en Six Dijkstra over het artikel inzake het plegen van hypotheekfraude door drugscriminelen

MPs Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen and Six Dijkstra asked about reports that criminal networks, including drug criminals, commit large-scale mortgage fraud and whether police and prosecutors can detect and prosecute it. The government answered that the problem is recognised but not systematically registered, that data-sharing options with banks and the Tax Authority are being explored, and that police knowledge of new modus operandi will be shared with lenders.
Mortgage fraud is not registered separately by the police or the Public Prosecution Service, because it consists of the offences of forgery, fraud and/or money laundering.
Tot slot wordt hypotheekfraude niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd bij de politie of het OM, omdat hypotheekfraude bestaat uit de delicten valsheid in geschrifte, oplichting en/of witwassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht “Grote verhuurders: geen verkoopgolf door middenhuurwet, huren dalen beperkt”

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about press reports that large institutional landlords will not sell off housing due to the middle-rent law and that rents will fall only modestly, and why private landlords depend on high rents and what would help both private and institutional investors. The Minister acknowledges the picture, explains the differing position of institutional and private landlords, outlines tax measures and a Housing Investment Monitor, and largely answers the questions on substance without committing to new concrete legislative change.
I recognise this picture. One of the starting points of the Affordable Rent Act is that it must remain attractive for (institutional) investors to invest in middle-segment rental housing.
Ik herken dit beeld. Een van de uitgangspunten van de Wet betaalbare huur is immers dat het voor (institutionele) beleggers aantrekkelijk moet blijven om te investeren in middenhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht «Bijstand veel voorkomende bron van schulden»

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about an ESB article finding that welfare benefit debts are widespread (286,000 people, 1.4 billion euro) and linked to strict enforcement and weak prevention. The State Secretary largely accepts the authors' conclusions, clarifies the figures, and points to prevention measures, the Participatiewet in balans and Handhaving sociale zekerheid bills, and the Team Preventie follow-up, without committing to a new prevention programme.
In short, I think it is important that we are lenient where possible and strict where necessary, with more discretionary room for professionals in implementation.
Ik vind het kortom van belang dat we zacht zijn waar het kan, en streng zijn waar nodig, met meer beslisruimte voor professionals in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Joseph over hittestress

MPs Welzijn and Joseph asked the minister about heat stress in homes, including the claim that half of Dutch residents live in overheating homes and whether heat should count as a defect. The minister partly recognises the problem, says the claimed figures cannot be confirmed, outlines existing measures and says the heat-as-defect question is under review.
The cited Investico research refers to 1 in 2 people, whereas the recently published Statistics Netherlands (CBS) research refers to 1 in 3 households.
Het aangehaalde onderzoek van Investico spreekt namelijk van 1 op de 2 mensen terwijl het recent gepubliceerde Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) 9 onderzoek spreek van 1 op de 3 huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de Europese Commissie naar de Anti Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD)

An MP asked the Minister whether the ATAD interest-deduction limit should apply to housing associations, how Dutch implementation differs from the EU directive, and its effect on social housing construction. The Minister answered that the earnings-stripping rule is deliberately stricter than the EU minimum, that a specific exemption for housing associations is not possible under ATAD1, and that the effect on construction cannot be determined, while promising to review the directive after the Commission's evaluation.
To determine our specific position, we will first await the outcomes of the evaluation of ATAD1 currently being carried out.
Voor het bepalen van onze specifieke inzet wachten wij eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van ATAD1 af die momenteel wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Welzijn over de vermogensgrenzen voor lokale kwijtscheldingen

MPs Lahlah and Welzijn asked about the asset limits for local tax exemptions after a Council of State ruling that municipalities must follow national rules even when they want to allow beneficiaries a savings buffer. The minister acknowledged the wish for a buffer, noted the existing €2,000 allowance, and said a study on raising the asset limit is underway, with the Chamber to be informed before the budget debate.
I am now having a study carried out, partly in response to the amended motion by Palmen and Mohandis, into the questions in that motion and the policy issues.
Ik laat nu, mede naar aanleiding van de Nader gewijzigde motie van de leden Palmen en Mohandis 5 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de vragen uit deze motie en de beleidsvraagstukken

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de brief van de regering, Herziening Wet bijzondere maatregelen grootstedelijke problematiek; Nationaal Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid van 7 december 2023

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the minister about municipal problems with sharing personal data for the national neighbourhood liveability and safety programme, the use of confiscated criminal money in deprived neighbourhoods, and waste containers jamming. The minister answered that data sharing needs a legal basis and points to ongoing legislation and best-practice support, that a model agreement alone is insufficient, and that waste problems are primarily municipal matters, with the issue to be raised with the VNG.
The ministry does not have national data on how often municipalities face jamming underground waste containers.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over landelijke gegevens over hoe vaak gemeenten te maken hebben met klemmende ondergrondse containers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht “Betaalbare Krapte” uit de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the minister whether the government should pursue high object subsidies to steer housing supply, given criticism that demand-side stimulation fails to add homes. The minister rejected the demand-only framing, weighed the costs and risks of object subsidies, and promised to consider them in drafting the coalition government programme.
I am including object subsidies in the considerations on how to deploy the five times one billion from the Main Lines Agreement to stimulate housing construction.
Ik neem objectsubsidies mee in de overwegingen hoe de vijf keer één miljard uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord om de woningbouw te stimuleren te gaan inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Britse belegger sluist uitpondwinst Nederlandse woningen weg naar Bermuda’

Two MPs asked whether Dutch rental homes bought by a British investor and sold off to owner-occupiers via Luxembourg and Bermuda vehicles constitute tax avoidance, and what the government will do. The minister says Dutch treaties allocate tax on Dutch property income to the Netherlands, sees no reason for intervention or new rules, and declines to discuss individual tax files.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Welzijn over het bericht ‘Erfpacht oneerlijk, CDA-Raadslid wil ACM dwingen naar systeem te kijken’

MPs asked whether municipalities should inform residents better about erfpacht (leasehold) formulas, whether general erfpacht conditions favour municipalities, and whether the guidance should be binding and supervised by the AFM. The minister replied that the existing guidance is voluntary and sufficient, that the ACM rightly declined an enforcement request, that erfpacht is a private-law matter, and that the AFM is not the appropriate supervisor.

Intervening in the local trade-offs, the local autonomy and contractual freedom of municipalities (within the general principles of good governance) are very far-reaching measures and I see no need for them at this time.

Ingrijpen in de lokaal te maken afwegingen, de lokale autonomie en contractvrijheid van gemeenten (uiteraard binnen de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur) zijn zeer vergaande maatregelen en ik zie daar op dit moment niet de noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Veel woningen met (te) weinig bewoners: corporaties willen vaker huizen delen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a news report on housing associations wanting more shared housing, questioning the 61% under-occupation figure, the scope for setting occupancy norms in allocation, the effect of the cost-sharing norm on single benefit recipients, and the potential savings on rent allowance. The minister answered that shared housing suits some groups but not all, disputed the 61% figure as an artefact of the Eurostat definition, and deferred most substantive questions to a broader exploration on shared housing due in the third quarter of 2024.
I am working on a broader exploration of shared housing.
Ik werk aan een bredere verkenning van woningdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Welzijn over de Atlas van de lokale lasten, die is opgesteld door het instituut COELO van Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Van Hijum and Welzijn asked the Minister of Interior about rising local taxes and charges per the COELO Atlas, including whether increases reflect autonomous choices or statutory obligations, their effect on rents, the large municipal surpluses, and the share of specific grants versus the municipal fund. The minister answered that local councils and water boards set their own charges democratically, that the data on the cause of increases is not known, and provided tables on grants and tax shares.
It is not known to what extent the increase in charges is related to autonomous choices by municipalities or results from statutory obligations.
Het is niet bekend in hoeverre de lastenstijging samenhangt met autonome keuzes van gemeenten dan wel het gevolg zijn van wettelijke verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Corporaties blijven ver achter met de bouw van betaalbare huizen, als gevolg van sloop en verkoop'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a press report that housing corporations lag far behind on affordable construction due to demolition and sales, and about the feasibility of the housing target, land prices and land availability. The minister says the national agreements remain binding, that corporations have the financial room to build, that demolition is largely followed by rebuilding, and gives no figures on municipal land holdings or prices.
I do not have figures on what share of municipal building land is made available for social housing.
Ik heb geen cijfers van welk deel van de bouwgronden van gemeente beschikbaar worden gesteld voor sociale woningbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Welzijn over het artikel ‘Zeker negen gezondheidscentra in conflict met commerciële huisbaas'

MPs Jansen and Welzijn asked the minister about reports that health centres are in conflict with commercial landlords over maintenance costs and rent increases, and whether this threatens access to care. The minister said the lease terms are unknown, that practices are primarily responsible for their own housing, that commercial leasing can be acceptable, and that he will provide an updated housing guidance by end 2024 without committing to structural measures.
The content of the lease in this case is not known to me, so I cannot go into this specific case substantively.
De inhoud van de huurovereenkomst in deze casus is mij niet bekend, dus ik kan niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen 5, 6 en 11 van het lid Welzijn over de brief van de VN-rapporteur van 21 december 2023 getiteld Statement at the conclusion of the country visit to the Netherlands

An MP (Welzijn, NSC) asked the Minister of the Interior about the UN Special Rapporteur's finding that government levels lack concrete housing targets and steering power, the number of planned homes lacking locations per province, and how the government will speed up building permits and planning/objection procedures. The Minister replied citing the National Housing and Construction Agenda, the Versterking Regie Volkshuisvesting bill, a province-by-province table showing 129% planned capacity against housing targets, and procedural acceleration measures, but did not commit to a crisis plan and promised a fuller response in May.
I hope to be able to inform the House about this soon.
Ik hoop uw Kamer hier snel over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Postma over het artikel 'De bouw van snelle flexwoningen ligt mijlenver achter op schema'

MPs Welzijn and Postma asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report that flexible housing lags far behind schedule, including causes such as grid congestion, objection procedures, site availability and optimistic planning. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it to multiple factors, and listed measures including a legislative amendment to speed up appeals and several support and subsidy schemes.
No data are available on the number of objection and appeal procedures concerning flexible housing or the number of flexible homes delayed as a result.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures aangaande flexwoningen of het aantal flexwoningen dat daardoor wordt vertraagd.

m: Motie van de leden Bamenga en Thijssen over de investeringshorizon van de RED III-wetgeving verlengen tot 2040
Asks the government to extend the investment horizon of the RED III renewable energy rules from 2030 to 2040 to match Germany and secure a level playing field.
requests the government to extend the investment horizon of the RED III legislation to 2040
verzoekt de regering om de investeringshorizon van de RED III-wetgeving te verlengen tot 2040
Motie van het lid Thijssen over uitspreken dat de staat van de economie verbetert door fossiele brandstoffen uit te faseren en massaal in te zetten op schone en innovatieve technologieën
Declares that the economy would improve by phasing out fossil fuels quickly and investing heavily in clean technologies.
declares that the state of the economy would improve by phasing out fossil fuels as quickly as possible
spreekt uit dat de staat van de economie zou verbeteren door fossiele brandstoffen zo snel mogelijk uit te faseren
Motie van het lid Thijssen over het inventariseren van opties om de balans tussen geld voor winst en geld voor lonen te herstellen
Asks the government to explore options for restoring the balance between profits and wages to 1980s levels and report to the House by 1 November.
requests the government to inventory options for how the balance between money for profit and money for wages can be restored
verzoekt de regering om opties te inventariseren hoe de balans tussen geld voor winst en geld voor lonen hersteld kan worden
Motie van het lid Thijssen over als voorwaarde aan de garantstelling verbinden dat werknemers meeprofiteren als het weer goed gaat met Royal IHC
Asks the government to attach a condition to the guarantee for Royal IHC that employees also benefit when the company recovers.
requests the government to attach as a condition to the guarantee that employees benefit
verzoekt de regering om als voorwaarde aan de garantstelling te verbinden dat de werknemers meeprofiteren
Motie van het lid Thijssen over ambitieus klimaatbeleid voor onze leiderschapspositie in schone technologie
