qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de resultaten van PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's Q3 2025 results, how infrastructure, labour and internal cost allocations are split between UPD post, non-UPD post and parcels, whether UPD losses are overstated, and working conditions at PostNL. The minister declined to disclose the detailed cost split citing competition sensitivity, stated there are no signs of overstated UPD losses given accountant checks and ACM oversight, and said he would convey the working-conditions signals and talk with unions and the Inspectie SZW without committing to a new meeting.

Further breaking down infrastructure and labour costs by separate activities such as UPD post, non-UPD post and parcels is not part of the KTS and directly concerns competitively sensitive information.

Het verdergaand uitsplitsen van infrastructuur- en arbeidskosten naar afzonderlijke activiteiten zoals UPD-post, niet-UPD-post en pakketten is geen onderdeel van het KTS en raakt direct aan concurrentiegevoelige informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over inflatie

The MP Thijssen asks why inflation stays high, how wages and prices have moved over ten years, whether profits rather than wages drive inflation, and what a shift of income from wages to profits would mean for government revenue. The minister answers with CPI and CAO wage figures, notes that wages have outpaced inflation and purchasing power has risen, states that there are no concrete signs profits drove October 2025 inflation, and declines to quantify the wage-profit shift, citing uncertainty about investment effects.
Because of this it is not possible to give an accurate answer to this question.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk om een accuraat antwoord te geven op deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over Nexperia

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for an update on the Nexperia intervention, the options considered, an overview of critical production capacities and companies, and a target for keeping them in Europe. The minister referred to earlier letters and briefings, said the wet beschikbaarheid goederen was the only suitable measure, and described existing industrial and economic security policy without providing a new overview or formal target.
These letters also regularly refer to which capacities are important for the Netherlands and Europe, though for example for commercial confidentiality reasons not everything is always made public.

In deze brieven wordt ook regelmatig verwezen naar welke capaciteiten er belangrijk zijn voor Nederland en Europa, waarbij om bijvoorbeeld bedrijfsvertrouwelijke redenen niet altijd alles openbaar wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Thijssen, Sneller en Inge van Dijk over de kabinetsinzet bij de Ministeriële Conferentie van ESA 2025

MPs Postma, Thijssen, Sneller and Inge van Dijk asked the Economy Minister why the Netherlands would hold its ESA contribution at 170 million euro nominal, why this falls well short of the ESA norm and the NSO warnings of a real cut of about 25%, and what the consequences are for industry, geo-return and ESTEC. The minister answered that budget constraints under the caretaker cabinet limit funding, that the cabinet is exploring additional funds before the conferences, and that detailed programme allocations and results will only be shared after the conference.
No, I cannot commit to this, since the final distribution of ESA funds across the various programmes is only determined during the Ministerial Conference.
Nee, dit kan ik niet toezeggen aangezien de definitieve verdeling van de ESA-middelen over de verschillende programma’s pas tijdens de Ministeriële Conferentie wordt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thijssen over de arbeidsinkomensquote (AIQ), de investeringsquote en pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Economy Minister about the fall in the labour income share since 2019 and 1980, the investment ratio, profit ratio, and whether extra profits reach workers via pensions or wages. The minister answered with figures (labour share down 3.6 points since 2019, profit ratio up 2.3 points) and argued profits fund investment and that pension funds benefit from profits, without committing to any action.
As is well known, there is no public shareholder register for all Dutch companies.
Er is zoals bekend geen publiek aandeelhouderregister voor alle Nederlandse bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Kamerbrief ‘Investeren in een weerbare en toekomstbestendige economie: het 3%-R&D-actieplan’

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the 3% R&D target is still upheld despite past R&D budget cuts, and presses on wage sharing, the role of business tax revenue, ARPA exploration, the R&D launch platform, institutional investors, defence, TTO/KTO funding, the EU cofinancing facility, regulatory burden and climate change. The minister replies that the action plan aims to mobilise private R&D with public funds, that more public money will be needed but is for a future cabinet, and that most items are at exploration or design stage with no concrete budgets or measurable targets yet.
Decisions on this are now for a next cabinet.
Beslissingen ten aanzien hiervan zijn nu aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Kamerbrief 'Voortgang Maatwerkafspraken Verduurzaming Industrie' van 30 juni 2025 en het artikel van FTM over het afschaffen van de CO2-heffing

An MP (Thijssen, GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the sustainability maatwerk agreements with industry are stalling, what economic and geopolitical conditions are meant, and whether the abolition of the CO2 levy weakens the incentive to decarbonise. The Minister attributes the stall mainly to high energy costs, grid and infrastructure bottlenecks, permitting and nitrogen problems, and says a plan B will be developed, with the levy's financial effects still under study and clarity promised before Prinsjesdag.
The cabinet remains committed to getting the preconditions for sustainability in order and is investing in steps towards a level playing field for our industry.
Het kabinet blijft zich inzetten om de randvoorwaarden voor verduurzaming op orde te krijgen en investeert in stappen richting een gelijk speelveld voor onze industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de reactiebrief van de brancheorganisaties op het gepubliceerde Windenergie Infrastructuurplan Noordzee

MP Thijssen asks the minister why offshore wind and industrial electrification deals failed despite joint industry calls, whether prices and renewable hydrogen costs were discussed, and whether correspondence can be shared. The minister acknowledges risks materialised, reduces the 2040 offshore wind ambition to 30–40 GW with an action plan due in September, defends confidentiality of maatwerk talks, and declines to release that correspondence.
The talks within the maatwerk approach are confidential, partly because companies share business-confidential information.
De gesprekken in het kader van de maatwerkaanpak zijn vertrouwelijk, onder andere omdat de bedrijven bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Thijssen over de aangenomen motie voor het afschaffen van de CO2-heffing industrie

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the adopted motion to abolish the industrial CO2 levy, covering its impact on companies, revenue, legal consequences, the Herstel- en Veerkrachtplan funding, and climate policy credibility. The government replied that the levy will be temporarily suspended for the period up to 2030 pending further study, an independent Overlegtafel will advise on post-2030 options by 1 November, and it will assess legal, revenue and funding consequences and explore alternative measures.
The cabinet will investigate the extent of the negative impact that a possible suspension of the industrial CO2 levy would have on companies that have already invested in sustainability.

met de Kamer is gedeeld gaat het kabinet onderzoeken in welke mate er sprake is van een negatieve impact van het eventueel opschorten van de CO 2 -heffing industrie op bedrijven die reeds hebben geïnvesteerd in verduurzaming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over de berichtgeving rondom de levering van kritieke grondstoffen uit China

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked about China's export licensing requirement on rare earths and magnets, its impact on Dutch industry, the role of the Netherlands Materials Observatory (NMO), and possible copper shortages. The ministers answered that the government was informed only hours before the measure, that companies face delivery delays and uncertainty without quantifying sectoral impact for security and confidentiality reasons, and that the government is raising the issue with the European Commission and working on supply security under the national raw materials strategy.
For security reasons and commercial confidentiality, no further statements can be made about specific Dutch sectors or individual companies most affected by the export control measure.

Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt en bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen nadere uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke Nederlandse sectoren of individuele bedrijven waarop de exportcontrolemaatregel de grootste impact heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht 'FNV-economen: Europese bedrijven in de knel? De winsten zijn nog nooit zo hoog geweest'

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a newspaper report claiming European regulation harms productivity, citing the Draghi report, EIB investment survey data, OECD PMR benchmarks and productivity gaps with the US. Minister Karremans answers that regulation is one factor among several, that EU-level regulation and market fragmentation are a real burden, and that the cabinet pursues a competitiveness agenda while defending the value of proportionate regulation.
I intend to take further steps in this area in the coming period.
Ik ben voornemens om hier de komende periode verdere stappen op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Postma over het tekort aan installatiehavens voor wind op zee

MPs Kröger, Thijssen and Postma asked the minister about a shortage of installation ports for offshore wind, the government's position relative to other North Sea countries, and support for the Energiehaven IJmond project, including whether the state would close an unprofitable business case gap before summer recess. The minister acknowledged the port capacity shortage and said the cabinet supports the project and signed a convenant committing to seek solutions, but will only inform parliament on concrete state support around Prinsjesdag.

As soon as there is clarity on whether the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth and the Ministry of Economic Affairs can support the project, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is of het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken het project kunnen ondersteunen zal het kabinet daar de Kamer over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over het artikel “Europa hééft wel grondstoffen voor halfgeleiders, maar kan er niet bij”

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Economic Affairs about a newspaper article claiming EU critical-raw-materials partnerships have not proven effective, and how to reduce dependence through local value addition, recycling and concrete targets. The government answered that it is too early to judge the partnerships, stressed reciprocity, circularity and the National Raw Materials Strategy, and said it will study setting national targets once risks are better mapped.
It is a long process, so it is still too early to judge whether MoUs have proven effective.
Het is een lang proces, waardoor het nog te vroeg is te oordelen of MoU’s effectief zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked about the financial report on the bankruptcy of KHN Rekenwerk, the causes and responsibility for its financial problems, and whether Minister Beljaarts was liable, including the 550,000 euro paid by his D&O insurer and his use of a private spokesperson. The minister answered that the curator is responsible for investigating the bankruptcy, declined to draw conclusions on liability or the insurer's motives, and said the matter is private and predates his appointment.
It is for the curator to draw a conclusion on that basis and possibly assess the conduct of the directors in this matter.
Het is aan de curator om op basis daarvan een conclusie te trekken en daarmee eventueel een beoordeling te geven over het handelen van de bestuurders in deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het financieel verslag inzake het faillissement van KHN Rekenwerk

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked the Prime Minister why his answers to earlier questions on the KHN Rekenwerk bankruptcy report were referred to the minister involved, and when he would send his reflection on financial and business interests of incoming ministers. The Prime Minister said ministers answer for their own personal matters, that the earlier answers were sent on his behalf on 17 March 2025, and that a reflection letter will come by Q3 2027 at the latest.
As I noted in the letter, my aim is to review the existing framework ahead of a next formation.
Zoals ik heb opgemerkt in de genoemde brief is mijn oogmerk het bestaande kader tegen het licht te houden ten behoeve van een volgende formatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat Talpa jaarcijfers aan het zicht onttrekt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked whether Talpa's use of the 'Blokker construction' to withhold annual accounts from public view is lawful, and what sanctions and changes are available. The state secretary answers that failing to publish a required subsidiary account breaches the publication duty, that the fine is modest but further civil and personal liability remedies exist, and that no legislative change is planned.
Failing to file the annual accounts is an economic offence.
Het niet deponeren van de jaarrekening is een economisch delict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht dat de maatwerkafspraken met Nobian zijn getekend

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth 23 questions about the signed tailor-made climate agreements with chemical company Nobian, covering scope 3 emissions, residual emissions, state subsidy design and clawback, force majeure, the possible sale of the company, and nitrogen rights. The minister answered in detail, defending the subsidy structure and stating that the agreements were designed to secure additional CO2 reduction and remain binding even if the company is sold.
The exact WACC used is commercially confidential and therefore cannot be made public.
De exacte WACC die is gehanteerd is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan daarom niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht dat Nederland inzet op een bilaterale handelsrelatie met de VS

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands was pursuing a bilateral trade relationship with the US, including contacts with Trump's team, the role of the EU, and the risk of undermining joint EU trade policy. The government answered that it maintains broad stakeholder contacts, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence while member states may pursue bilateral economic cooperation, and that it will keep coordinating within the EU while strengthening bilateral economic ties with the US.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Teunissen en Rooderkerk over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over de rechtszaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and D66 asked the minister how the Hague appeal court's ruling in the Milieudefensie v. Shell climate case affects climate targets, corporate duties, and whether new oil and gas fields should be restricted. The minister replied that the case is a private civil dispute, that corporate responsibility is addressed through EU CSDDD and existing climate policy, and that no new measures on new fossil licences will be taken.
This concerns a civil case between private parties. The government is not a party to this case.
Het betreft een civielrechtelijke zaak tussen private partijen. De overheid is geen partij in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht dat er grote zorgen zijn voor de transportsector door de aankomende grenscontroles

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government had analysed the economic impact of border checks and whether it would meet transport sector representatives about their concerns. The minister said no detailed economic analysis was done because checks would be targeted, that measures were taken to limit impact, and that the government is already in contact with the transport sector.
Therefore no detailed analysis was carried out on the economic consequences of these border checks, and none is planned.
Daarom is er geen gedetailleerde analyse gedaan over de economische gevolgen van genoemde grenscontroles en is deze ook niet voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thijssen over Ebusco

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Ebusco's financial problems, the role of electric buses in climate-neutral public transport, and whether the state should keep such firms afloat. The government answered that emission-free buses are on track for 2030, that support is market-based and not for individual firms, and that it will not comment on a listed company's fortunes.
It is not for the government to support individual companies, but to ensure a level playing field and to pursue policy that promotes innovation and sustainability across the whole sector.

Het is daarbij niet aan de overheid om individuele bedrijven te ondersteunen, maar om te zorgen voor een gelijk speelveld en een beleid te voeren dat innovatie en duurzaamheid bevordert binnen de hele sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het schrappen van het huidige stikstofbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs which sectors need nitrogen space, how permits can be obtained, and what the economic damage of the nitrogen policy stalemate is. The minister answers that agriculture, housing, mobility, industry and energy need space, that uncertainty delays investments, and that a study on the economic damage is due in early 2025.
In the debate of 4 September, the minister committed to inform the House about this in early 2025.
In het debat van 4 september heeft MLVVN toegezegd de kamer hier begin 2025 over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Kathmann en Inge van Dijk over de opkomst van niet-Europese online marktplaatsen en de impact hiervan op concurrentievermogen, consumentenbescherming en productveiligheid

MPs Thijssen, Kathmann and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the flood of parcels from Chinese online marketplaces, unequal competition, consumer protection and product safety, and asked what the government itself can do. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, points to EU instruments (DSA, DMA, customs reform, Digital Product Passport) and to supervisors' responsibility, and commits to talks with the Consumentenbond and retail associations and to coordination with Germany and at EU level.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the Consumentenbond and the retail industry associations and to inform the House about relevant outcomes.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de Consumentenbond en de retailbrancheverenigingen en de Kamer te informeren over relevante uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over Chinese dreigementen om ASML van Chinese markt te weren

MPs Hirsch and Thijssen asked whether China has threatened to exclude ASML from its market, what the consequences would be, and whether the Netherlands will adopt additional US-style export restrictions. Minister Klever declined to discuss diplomatic contacts or speculate on impacts, stating that Dutch export controls are national security decisions and that further measures would be pursued multilaterally and in EU coordination.
The cabinet cannot go into the content of confidential diplomatic conversations.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van vertrouwelijke diplomatieke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het artikel «Koninklijke Horeca Nederland vordert 1,3 miljoen van failliet bedrijf Beljaarts»

An MP asked the Prime Minister about KHN's 1.3 million claim against a bankrupt KHN subsidiary and about Minister Beljaarts' former role as director, including potential conflicts of interest with his current economic affairs portfolio. The minister replied that the claim is a KHN decision, that he and the PM do not contact the curator, that the curator's report will be made public in due course, and that his past work raised no obstacle to his appointment.
The curator's report will be made public in due course.
Het rapport van de curator zal te zijner tijd openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Maatoug over het bericht «650 miljoen belastingschuld en toch dividend uitkeren: zo werkt kunstmestfabriek Yara»

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about reports that fertiliser producer Yara pays dividends despite a large tax debt, receives green subsidies, and used transfer pricing to shift profit abroad. The minister answered that companies are free to decide their profit use within legal frameworks, that subsidies are capped to avoid overcompensation via claw-back mechanisms, and that the Tax Authority rejects profit shifting without real activity changes.
Nevertheless, the maatwerk agreements aim to prevent oversubsidy of projects, for example by including a claw-back mechanism.
Wel wordt er binnen de maatwerkafspraken op ingezet oversubsidiëring van projecten tegen te gaan, bijvoorbeeld door het opnemen van een terugvorderingsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gabriëls over het overnemen van de adviezen van de Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond als harde voorwaarde bij de onderhandelingen over de maatwerkafspraken

MPs Thijssen and Gabriëls asked how health of residents and workers is systematically included in the Tata Steel maatwerkafspraak negotiations, and whether the government's commitments go beyond the motion on adopting the Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond advice. The government answers that health is an integral part of the negotiation mandate, that a health paragraph will be included in the Joint Letter of Intent, that the health impact assessment (GER) is delayed and expected in 2025, and that most correspondence cannot be shared because it would harm the state's negotiating position.
Many of the documents and correspondence contain information that could harm the State's negotiating position.
Veel van de documenten en correspondentie bevatten informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat kunnen benadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over vervuilende bedrijven die grootaandeelhouders verrijken ten koste van mens en klimaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Milieudefensie report claiming polluting companies enrich major shareholders at the expense of people and climate, and how subsidies, shareholder payouts and possible windfall taxes relate. The minister acknowledges large payouts, rejects the claim that companies enrich shareholders at climate cost, defends subsidies for unprofitable decarbonisation, and declines a sector-specific windfall tax as legally difficult and undesirable.
This is public information that can be found in the annual reports of the individual customised-agreement companies.
Dit is openbare informatie die te vinden is in de jaarverslagen van de individuele maatwerkbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over hoge energieprijzen voor de industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about high electricity prices for heavy industry compared with neighbouring countries, which factors besides energy prices drive location choices, and whether support should be conditional. The minister answered that energy prices are a competitive disadvantage, outlined compensation (CEI and IKC-ETS), an infrastructure cost study, and efficiency measures, while noting that other location factors and company-level closure decisions involve many considerations.
We currently see a competitive disadvantage on electricity costs compared with neighbouring countries.
We zien dat er op dit moment sprake is van een concurrentienadeel op elektriciteitskosten ten opzichte van buurlanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over te late postbezorging in Zeeland en slechte arbeidsvoorwaarden voor postbezorgers bij PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about late mail delivery in Zeeland, whether other regions are affected, what steps will be taken to restore quality, and whether poor working conditions for PostNL couriers contribute to the problem. The minister acknowledged that PostNL falls short of the statutory 95% on-time standard, pointed to ACM oversight, a pending Postwet amendment and a forthcoming policy letter, but said no signals link the problem to working conditions and largely deferred labour matters to general labour law.
It is not acceptable that PostNL does not meet the legally prescribed quality.
Het is niet acceptabel dat PostNL de wettelijk voorgeschreven kwaliteit niet haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het NOS-bericht dat milieuproblemen onbelangrijk waren voor een miljoenensubsidie aan DuPont begin jaren 80

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that environmental concerns were deemed unimportant when a DuPont chemical plant received a multi-million subsidy in the early 1980s, and about how subsidies and permit processes prevent such outcomes today. The minister said the files do not show the predecessor dismissed environmental problems, pointed to EU state aid rules, the environmental permitting and enforcement system, and EU chemical rules, but could not reconstruct the earlier weighing of arguments and could not assess the company report's role.
From the documents that have been made public, I cannot conclude that my predecessor considered environmental problems unimportant.
Uit de stukken die openbaar zijn gemaakt kan ik niet concluderen dat mijn voorganger milieuproblemen onbelangrijk vond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Pijpelink over wachtrijen voor netaansluitingen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about grid connection queues in Zeeland and other provinces, including effects on jobs, firms affected, and investment in renewables. The minister answered that company-level queue data is confidential, the province warned only in general terms, and congestion research and flexible grid solutions are ongoing, without committing to a new concrete step.
Applications for a grid connection by individual companies with the grid operator are commercially confidential information.
Aanvragen voor een netaansluiting door individuele bedrijven bij de netbeheerder zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de Rabobank en de ontbossers

MPs asked the government about Rabobank financing deforestation actors, whether financial services should be regulated like deforestation-free products, and whether Dutch and EU policy on livestock reduction and financing is consistent with the Paris goals. The ministers answered that banks are responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines, that the Commission will assess regulating financial institutions by mid-2025, and that the Finance Minister will report on financial-sector measures by year end.
The cabinet expects financial institutions to act in line with international standards for responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht van financiële instellingen dat zij handelen conform de internationale standaarden voor internationaal verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het faciliteren van fossiele investeringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the Finance Minister whether banks that underwrite fossil-fuel bonds share responsibility for green-washing and the failure to green bond markets, and why a motion on sustainability legislation for the financial sector had not been implemented. The minister acknowledged the findings and said underwriting would be discussed with the financial sector and its umbrella bodies, but ruled out a ban and said the legislative exploration is still ongoing, with an update promised by year-end.
I aim to inform your House further on the progress before the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar nader te informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de aardbevingen in Afghanistan

MPs asked about the humanitarian needs after the October 2023 Herat earthquakes in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch aid could be provided without supporting the Taliban. The minister listed needs and aid channels (Dutch Relief Alliance, CERF, OCHA fund, EU funding) and stated that aid runs under strict conditions barring direct Taliban involvement.
They work in line with humanitarian principles, without interference from the de facto authorities or direct support to the Taliban regime.
Zij werken conform de humanitaire principes, zonder inmenging van de de facto autoriteiten of directe steun aan het Taliban-regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Teunissen, Alkaya, Dassen en Thijssen over fossiele subsidies

MPs asked the government about a report estimating fossil fuel subsidies at 37.5 billion euro per year, the reconciliation with the Miljoenennota annex, EU constraints, revenue use, and effects on competitiveness and the budget. The minister answered that the annex gives a range of 39.7 to 46.4 billion euro, that concrete tax measures were proposed in Belastingplan 2024, and that further proposals await a cabinet with full powers.
Given its caretaker status, the cabinet will not make further proposals for phasing out fossil fuel advantages.
Het kabinet zal, gezien zijn demissionaire status, geen verdere voorstellen doen voor afbouw van fossiele voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen en Ceder over het onderzoek Oxfam “From Development to Deterrence”

MPs Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen and Ceder asked whether EU development aid (ODA) under NDICI is being used for migration deterrence, citing an Oxfam report on Libyan and Tunisian coast guard funding and weak EU transparency. The minister says the Commission must check ODA eligibility and that the Netherlands will press for better reporting and human rights risk analysis, but gives no firm new commitments and says there is no misuse so far.

In the context of the mid-term evaluation of NDICI, the Netherlands has asked the Commission for insight into the calculation of migration-related expenditure and access to the markers used to attribute spending to NDICI's migration objective.

In het kader van de mid-term evaluatie van NDICI heeft Nederland de Commissie gevraagd om inzicht in berekening van migratie gerelateerde uitgaven en inzage in de markers die worden gebruikt om uitgaven aan de migratiedoelstelling van NDICI toe te rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Thijssen over kwijtschelding van de waterschapsbelasting

MPs Kathmann and Thijssen asked whether water boards can grant remission of the water board levy to people earning above the welfare norm, whether a progressive levy should be studied, and about social collection practices. The minister answered that boards already may extend remission (cost-of-living norm up to 100% of the welfare norm, higher asset threshold) and that a progressive levy will not be studied because the levy principles of the water system must be preserved.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de uitzending van EenVandaag (d.d.4 sept 2023) 'Fors financieel tekort dwingt NVWA tot bezuinigingen en personeelsstop, Kamerleden bezorgd: 'Wat betekent dit voor al die belan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA food and product safety inspectorate's financial shortfall, a hiring slowdown, and possible cuts to veterinary outsourcing and inspection quality. The Minister acknowledged the deficit from inflation, wage agreements and lower fee income, denied a full hiring freeze, and said inspection quality and slaughterhouse oversight would be maintained with mitigating measures.
There is no hiring freeze, but the opening of new vacancies until the end of 2023 is limited.
Er is geen sprake van een vacaturestop, wel vindt de openstelling van nieuwe vacatures tot ultimo 2023 beperkt plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel “Yara tekent voor 1,5 megaton CO2-reductie in 2030”

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked why the Expression of Principles with Yara was signed without first being shared with parliament, and about its legal status, timing, CCS share, green electricity deals and government obligations. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding, will be followed by a JLoI reviewed by an independent advisory committee and shared with parliament, and that the government's contribution will be analysed, while giving only high-level detail on several points.
In line with this reasoning, the EoP with Yara, like other EoPs signed before the cabinet became caretaker, was not shared with your House first.
In lijn met deze redenering is de EoP met Yara, net als bij andere EoP’s die zijn gesloten voordat het kabinet demissionair werd, niet eerst met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal en het lid Thijssen over de rol van ijzerpoeder in het energiesysteem van de toekomst

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of iron powder (iron power technology) in future energy storage, including its maturity, seasonal storage potential, NOx emissions, and support instruments. The minister answered that iron powder is a promising but still-to-be-proven option that could play a role in seasonal storage and heat supply, with NOx depending on application, and that support could come through existing instruments while noting business case uncertainties.
Iron powder is a potentially promising technology for which the necessary knowledge base is present in the Netherlands to develop it further.
IJzerpoeder is een mogelijk veelbelovende techniek waarvoor in Nederland ook de benodigde kennisbasis aanwezig is om dit verder door te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel 'Vrees voor stijging gasprijs: Nederland onderschat de risico's'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the government underestimates gas price risks, at what price it would intervene in the market, what alternative to the price cap is planned, how households could be protected, and how to reduce dependence on the spot market. The Minister replied that the market has calmed, supply risks are limited, no intervention is currently needed, the monitoring will continue, and the budget and buyback measures will follow later, without committing to specific figures.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to intervene in the market, but I of course keep the situation under observation.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen reden om in te grijpen in de markt, maar ik houd uiteraard de situatie in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman en Thijssen over PFAS

MPs Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman and Thijssen asked about PFAS: licensed emitters, drinking water, health and economic effects, contaminated sites, enforcement against Chemours and 3M, and whether the government knew of harms. The minister answered that no central emissions register exists, outlined permitting and monitoring responsibilities, and said ongoing RIVM research and legal action continue, while declining to comment on several pending matters.
No, there is no centralised overview of this.
Nee, hiervan is geen gecentraliseerd overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de aanpak van piekbelasting

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the peak-load nitrogen approach, including the Gelderland interbestuurlijke aanpak, buyout scheme terms, land use after buyouts, industrial peak emitters, and advisory desks. The minister answered each sub-question, largely describing the existing voluntary framework and promising further analysis, while deferring some matters to provinces and declining to name a list of peak emitters.
The Ministry of LNV does not have a list of possible peak emitters.
Het Ministerie van LNV beschikt niet over een lijst met mogelijke «piekbelasters».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over een betaalbare energierekening

Two MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how an affordable energy bill will be secured for 2024, including targeted income support, lessons from the price cap process, and relief for tenants in low-label housing. The Minister answered that options are being prepared for the August purchasing-power decision, that targeted support is still under review, and pointed to planned energy-label phase-outs, a new lower first tier for gas energy tax, and extra funding for municipalities.
Decision-making on purchasing power will take place in August.
Besluitvorming over de koopkracht zal plaatsvinden in augustus.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'OESO tikt Just Eat Takeaway op de vingers om tegenwerking vakbondsvorming'

MPs Thijssen and Van der Lee asked the minister whether the government will hold Just Eat Takeaway to account after the OECD National Contact Point found it violated trade union rights and the OECD Guidelines, and what consequences apply when a firm rejects such a ruling. The minister answered that the Guidelines are voluntary but the government attaches consequences to non-compliance, such as withholding trade support, procurement exclusion options and talks with the company, and noted the NCP ruling supports Israeli couriers without a direct Dutch role.
Compliance is not legally enforceable. The NCP is a non-judicial complaints mechanism.
Naleving is niet juridisch afdwingbaar. Het NCP is een niet-juridisch klachtenmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over enkele berichten over de voorkeurslocatie van een militaire kazerne in Zeewolde

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports on the preferred location of a military barracks in Zeewolde, including nitrogen space, PAS-melders, farmland, flood risk and nature impacts. The government answered that the Zeewolde site is only a provisional preferred location, no permit has been filed, nitrogen needs are not yet calculated, and the final choice will be communicated to parliament later.
Once a final location choice is made, Defence will inform your House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er een definitieve locatiekeuze is, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd door Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over berichten over export van goedkoop vlees en melkpoeder naar Ghana en Kenia

An MP asked the trade and development minister, with agriculture, whether Dutch exports of cheap meat and milk powder to Ghana and Kenya undermine local food security and whether trade policy conflicts with development goals. The minister denied an active export-promotion policy, said trade is compatible with local food systems, and argued the EPA would not affect tariffs on dairy.
The cabinet has no policy intention to actively stimulate the export of meat and milk powder to developing countries in the coming years.
Het kabinet heeft geen beleidsvoornemen om de export van vlees en melkpoeder naar ontwikkelingslanden de komende jaren actief te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over de Nederlandse steun voor het project van Boskalis in Manila

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the government about Dutch support (export credit insurance) for Boskalis's New Manila International Airport project, including alleged rights and environmental harms, information-sharing, compensation of fishers and the Global Witness allegations. The government answered that ADSB and Boskalis meet OECD/UN standards, that compensation is being carried out under monitoring by independent consultants, and that it sees no need for additional measures or an independent investigation, while commissioning a monitoring review by Steward Redqueen.
This picture is confirmed by ADSB, which had an independent consultant investigate this aspect.
Dit beeld wordt bevestigd door ADSB die een onafhankelijke consultant onderzoek heeft laten doen naar dit aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over ‘procedures door de overheid’

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked how many administrative objection, appeal and enforcement procedures on nitrogen (stikstof) had been run since the Council of State ruling on the PAS, who was party to them, what they cost, whether the government commonly takes external legal advice, and why government often fails to respond to enforcement requests. The minister answered that such figures are not registered centrally, gave a partial overview of cases per competent authority, said costs are unknown, and argued that enforcement is an obligation in principle but may be set aside in exceptional cases, with reasons to be given.
No, this is not possible because this information is not registered.
Nee, dit is niet mogelijk omdat deze informatie niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de bijdrage van de sector aan verduurzaming van de landbouw

MPs Thijssen and Bromet ask the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will make banks, suppliers, processors and retailers contribute to the agricultural sustainability transition, and whether the polluter-pays principle applies. The Minister answers that binding but non-voluntary contributions from supply-chain parties will be agreed in the Landbouwakkoord, and that the government is studying policy options such as this, without committing to a specific measure yet.
The coalition agreement announced that the government will make binding agreements with supply-chain parties to strengthen the position of the farmer in the chain.
In het coalitieakkoord is aangekondigd dat de overheid bindende afspraken met ketenpartijen maakt om de positie van de boer in de keten te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat teakhout uit Myanmar illegaal bij Nederlandse superjachtbouwers belandt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that illegal teak from Myanmar reaches Dutch superyacht builders despite EU sanctions on Myanmar Timber Enterprise, and about enforcement differences across member states, a total import ban, and humanitarian support. The government answered that sanctions are strictly implemented in the Netherlands, that enforcement is a national competence, that companies are responsible for compliance, and that it is pursuing EU-level clarification, while offering no commitment to a total ban beyond the existing de facto ban via MTE sanctions.
The Netherlands interprets and implements EU sanctions in a strict manner. Enforcement of sanctions is a national competence.
Nederland interpreteert en implementeert EU-sancties op een strikte manier. Handhaving van sancties is een nationale competentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over enkele berichten over de stand van zaken van energieprijzen en de energiemarkt

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked the minister about energy price declines, variable and dynamic contracts, ACM investigations into suppliers, and market liberalisation. The minister answered that consumers should benefit from falling prices through switching, that ACM oversees tariff reasonableness independently, and that a 12-month fixed-contract obligation will be introduced in the Energy Act.
I do not think the duration of these contracts is long enough and I consider it desirable that fixed contracts have a term of at least 12 months.
Ik vind de duur van deze contracten niet lang genoeg en vind het wenselijk dat vaste contracten in ieder geval een looptijd van 12 maanden kennen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Thijssen over de overstromingen op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Thijssen asked the government about flooding on Bonaire, including damage, coordination with the island authority, flood-risk and climate adaptation, and support for homeowners. The minister answered that no national intervention was needed because the island coped with local pumps, that the island authority is primarily responsible for infrastructure and climate adaptation, and that the Rijk offers support such as a climate effect atlas, though damage is not systematically mapped.
The public body does not map this.
Het openbaar lichaam brengt dit niet in kaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de voorgenomen verkoop van het Zeeuwse energiebedrijf PZEM aan het Tsjechische energiebedrijf EPH

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the ministers about the planned sale of the publicly owned Zeeland energy company PZEM to Czech firm EPH, raising concerns about privatisation, fossil fuel assets, climate targets and risk allocation. Minister Jetten answered that the province as shareholder may decide on the sale, that he raised no objection under the Electricity Act while noting climate concerns, that the government will respond to the Segers-Marijnissen motion next year, and that the transaction structure is for the shareholders to decide.
As a shareholder, the province of Zeeland is free to decide on its own shareholding.
Als aandeelhouder staat het de provincie Zeeland vrij om over het eigen aandeelhouderschap te beslissen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van der Lee en Thijssen over de intentieverklaring tussen Nederland en met Oman over samenwerking op het gebied van groene waterstof

MPs Kröger, Van der Lee and Thijssen asked why the Dutch-Omani green hydrogen memorandum lacks safeguards on human rights, environment and labour rights, given Oman's weak labour record and the port of Sohar joint venture. The government answered that MoUs are non-binding, that Dutch companies must apply OECD due diligence, that an IMVO risk analysis on hydrogen chains is under way, and that future MoUs may refer to the SDGs.
A letter of intent does not create legally binding agreements from which safeguards, rights or obligations can be derived.
In een intentieverklaring worden geen juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt waaraan waarborgen, rechten of plichten kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Thijssen over het bericht 'Grote energieleverancier in de problemen; scholen ongerust'

MPs De Hoop and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that energy supplier DVEP had stopped sending invoices and closed to new customers, leaving schools worried. The minister said billing delays were caused by a system upgrade, that the ACM was alerted but does not comment on specific investigations, and that no emergency plan exists beyond general rules for small consumers, with compensation for school energy costs being considered in the budget.
The ACM, however, makes no statements about whether investigations into specific suppliers are ongoing or not.
De ACM doet echter geen uitspraken over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken naar specifieke leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Nijboer en Kröger over hoge energietarieven voor nieuwe klanten

MPs Thijssen, Nijboer and Kröger asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether it is acceptable that new customers pay up to three times more for energy than existing customers, and whether energy suppliers shift risks onto new customers or use postcode-based risk assessments. The minister acknowledged the unfairness, said the ACM is revising early-termination fee rules and suppliers will offer fixed contracts again in 2023, and referred to general income-support measures, while denying knowledge of postcode-based risk profiling.
I share the view that it is galling when people who have to move pay three times as much for energy as existing customers.
Ik deel de mening dat het wrang is als mensen die moeten verhuizen drie keer zo veel moeten betalen voor energie als bestaande klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Nederlandse rechtstatelijke steun aan Oeganda

MP Thijssen asked why Dutch rule-of-law support to Uganda was paid out despite suspension threats after violent 2020 elections, and questioned the contractual limits and the lack of parliamentary notice. Minister Schreinemacher answered that the agreement cannot be shared, the final €850,000 payment was withheld as a signal, the €2.4 million was paid for already incurred costs, and the Netherlands will continue selective JLOS support.
No, the agreement cannot be shared with the House, because it is an arrangement signed in confidence with the Ugandan authorities.
Nee, de overeenkomst kan niet worden gedeeld met de Kamer, omdat het een in vertrouwen getekend arrangement met de Oegandese autoriteiten betreft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Thijssen, Peters en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit'

Four MPs asked the ministers about schools forced to cancel energy contracts with Gazprom and face sharply higher costs, including the scale of the problem, scenarios, quality of education, building insulation and inequality. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that schools in acute liquidity problems can report to OCW, that a motion asks for targeted support to be reported by 1 December, and that a subsidy scheme for sustainable public buildings opens on 3 October.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en De Hoop over het bericht Acht boerderijen (deels) dicht voor extra stikstof door verbreding A27 en A12 bij Utrecht

MPs Thijssen, De Hoop, Bromet and Kröger asked why nitrogen capacity is being allocated to widening the A27 and A12 near Utrecht while an alternative is being developed, which other projects could use that capacity, and whether road widening really reduces congestion. Minister Harbers answered that the Raad van State appeal cannot be paused, that other projects such as the A28/A1 junction may need the capacity, that a 2020 traffic study shows congestion more than halved, and that the government is committed to sustainable mobility alongside road investment.
When the region has an alternative ready, I will enter into discussion with them.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, ga ik met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht ‘Klanten van budget Energie geschokt door prijsverhoging van honderden euro’s per maand’

An MP asked whether energy suppliers may raise advance payment amounts faster than tariffs, whether ACM should monitor such increases, and whether consumers lose their money if a supplier fails. The minister answered that advance payments are agreed in contracts and should match annual bills, that consumers can object or complain to ACM ConsuWijzer, that failed-supplier claims follow bankruptcy law, and that ACM supervises markets generally but does not enforce individual contracts.
It is not for ACM to enforce compliance with individual agreements on advance payment amounts in private contracts between suppliers and their customers.
Het is niet aan de ACM om naleving van individuele afspraken over de hoogte van voorschotbedragen in private contracten tussen leveranciers en hun klanten af te dwingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de subsidieregeling Indirecte kostencompensatie ETS die zij stelden naar aanleiding van berichtgeving van de Europese Commissie over haar goedkeuring van deze regel

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the government sought EU approval for an indirect ETS cost compensation scheme worth up to €835 million for about 62 energy-intensive firms without first consulting parliament, and whether firms should bear carbon price risk themselves. The minister answered that the scheme is delegated legislation not requiring parliamentary involvement, that only the 2022 budget is currently covered, and that the scheme carries a 3% CO2 reduction obligation with clawback if firms fail to comply.
The reason the subsidy scheme was not submitted to the House is that this concerns delegated legislation in which parliament has no formal involvement.
De reden dat de subsidieregeling niet aan de Kamer is voorgelegd is dat dit gedelegeerde wetgeving betreft waarbij het parlement in casu geen formele betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the ministers about the Rabobank's opposition to the nitrogen policy and whether banks and other supply-chain parties should contribute financially to the agricultural transition. The minister answered that all chain parties, including banks, have a shared responsibility, that a non-voluntary contribution is expected, that existing funds of 24 billion euro suffice, and that questions were answered separately but not before the debate.
The cabinet expects a non-voluntary contribution from supply-chain parties (banks, suppliers, processing industry and retail), as included in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet verwacht een niet-vrijblijvende bijdrage van ketenpartijen (banken, toeleveranciers, de verwerkende industrie en de retail), zoals is opgenomen in het coalitiekakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het volle stroomnetwerk in Limburg en Noord-Brabant

MP Thijssen asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid transport shortages in Limburg and North Brabant, their effects on businesses, municipalities and households, and progress on measures such as faster grid expansion, connection prioritisation and better use of existing capacity. The minister explained that demand for grid capacity caused congestion, that new large-connection requests are on hold, and pointed to ongoing measures and a forthcoming Energiewet, while declining to give timelines for some measures and referring to a separate letter on prioritisation.
I have informed your House in the letter on grid transport scarcity in the Netherlands of 9 September about how I intend to handle prioritisation.
Ik heb uw Kamer in de Kamerbrief Transportschaarste op het elektriciteitsnet in Nederland van 9 september geïnformeerd hoe ik met de prioritering om wil gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de Klimaatcrisis-Index van Milieudefensie

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the Minister for Climate and Energy to react to Milieudefensie's Climate Crisis Index, which found no major polluter adequately addressing climate change, and asked about tackling scope 3 emissions and imposing climate obligations on firms receiving public green funds. The minister responded that the responsibility lies with companies and financial institutions supported by government instruments such as the EU ETS, CO2 levy, the planned EU due diligence directive and sector agreements, that scope 3 is addressed through subsidies and EU state-aid reform, and that subsidised firms are already bound by emission-reduction conditions.
When companies receive public funds for sustainability, these are already tied to conditions such as greenhouse gas emission reduction or circularity.
Als bedrijven publieke middelen ontvangen voor verduurzaming, zijn deze reeds gerelateerd aan voorwaarden zoals bijvoorbeeld broeikasgasemissiereductie of circulariteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de Afrikaanse varkenspest naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Zorgen over uitbraak varkenspest pal over de grens in Duitsland'

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the minister about African swine fever near the German border, including risk assessment, transport restrictions, prevention measures, preventive culling, a breeding ban, a 1 km farm distance rule and NVWA capacity. The minister said the risk is real, that the expert group reassessed the risk, that transport risk is small but measures are in place, and that a breeding ban is disproportionate for now, while answering most questions substantively and committing to updates.
I expect to provide an update in the short term on the results of the actions carried out over the past two years within this framework, and I will inform the House of Representatives about this.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een update te geven van de resultaten van de acties die de afgelopen twee jaar in het kader hiervan zijn uitgevoerd en ik zal de Tweede Kamer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Piri over het bericht ‘’Honderden gemartelde homo’s in Tsjetsjenië, toch doen PwC, Deloitte en KPMG er zaken’

MPs Thijssen and Piri asked the ministers about reports that PwC, Deloitte and KPMG do business in Chechnya despite serious human rights abuses, and whether the Dutch government will hold these firms to account under OECD guidelines and due diligence rules. The ministers said the government has concerns about Chechnya, that sanctions target individuals rather than firms, that the firms are largely not Dutch-registered, and that the government will pursue IMVO legislation at EU level without committing to a specific action against the firms.
The cabinet cannot assess whether these companies have insufficiently met their due diligence obligation.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of deze bedrijven hun due diligence-verplichting onvoldoende zijn nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over fijnstof en stankoverlast

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked about odour and particulate nuisance from livestock farms, including enforcement gaps, combi-scrubber performance, permit practice and recovery of subsidies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the problem and pointed to area-based approaches, WUR research on chemical odour measurement and an e-learning module, but largely deferred permit and enforcement questions to municipalities and provinces and declined to give farm-level data citing GDPR.
Due to the General Data Protection Regulation, the data on agricultural businesses from the top 100 ammonia sources were supplied anonymised by the RIVM.
In verband met de Algemene verordening persoonsgegevens zijn de gegevens van de agrarische bedrijven uit de top100 ammoniakbronnen geanonimiseerd aangeleverd door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over besmettelijke dierziekten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Varkens in Nood slaat alarm: Nederland niet klaar voor Afrikaanse varkenspest’

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about Dutch preparedness for African swine fever, including animal transports, the contingency plan dating from 2013, the NVWA's capacity, minimum distances and areas between pig farms, and vaccine funding. The minister acknowledged the risk, pointed to existing preventive measures, the roadmap and EU rules, and rejected a breeding ban and a 1 km minimum distance as disproportionate for now, promising further action within the area-based approach.
I share the author's concern that an outbreak of African swine fever (ASF) could occur in the Netherlands.
Ik deel de zorgen van de auteur dat zich een uitbraak van Afrikaanse varkenspest (AVP) kan voordoen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Thijssen en Piri over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor gaslevering

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister about gas supply risks from the war in Ukraine, including scenarios for a halt in Russian gas, low storage levels, and the Groningen phase-out. The minister answered at length, referring to ENTSO-G outlooks, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, storage subsidies and earlier Kamerbrieven, while committing to share future analyses with the Kamer.
As soon as new ENTSO-G analyses are public, they will be shared with the Kamer.
Zodra er nieuwe analyses van ENTSO-G openbaar zijn, zullen die met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Lee, Kröger, Piri en Thijssen over het bericht dat Rusland stopt met het leveren van aardas aan Polen en Bulgarije

MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Russia halting gas supplies to Poland and Bulgaria, Dutch firms' dealings with Gazprom and Gazprombank, EU and Dutch preparedness for next winter, and whether Russian state firms like Gazprom can be sanctioned out of the Dutch energy system. The minister answered that Dutch firms' use of Gazprombank and new Gazprom contracts is unknown, that the Dutch plans are set out in earlier letters, that the Bergermeer storage cost levy is still being designed, and that the legal options to exclude Russian firms are under study with a further letter promised.
The House will be further informed about this.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Levend koken van varkens in slachthuizen gaat nog altijd door'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report that pigs are still alive when entering scalding tanks in Dutch slaughterhouses, and about enforcement failures, the coalition agreement, camera supervision and independent investigation. The Minister called such cases unacceptable, said slaughterhouses must take more responsibility, and promised a camera-monitoring bill, though it is delayed to spring 2023 and no external investigation will be commissioned.
I see no added value in commissioning a new external investigation in response to the inspection results.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde om naar aanleiding van de inspectieresultaten een nieuw extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Voedselmakers zoeken met spoed alternatief voor zonnebloemolie'

MP Thijssen asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports of a sunflower oil shortage, the sustainability of substitute oils such as palm and rapeseed oil, certification reliability, and price effects. The minister said substitution is possible but prices will rise, the NVWA will temporarily not enforce label accuracy, and the government supports the EU deforestation-free products regulation while relying on industry to supply sustainable oils.
I therefore support the Commission's proposal that only deforestation-free products may be placed on the EU market.
Ik steun daarom het voorstel van de Commissie dat uitsluitend Ontbossingsvrije producten op de EU-markt mogen worden gebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Thijssen over de berichten ‘Studenten zien warmtekosten verdubbelen: ‘Het is mijn vakantiebudget’ en ‘Forse prijsverhoging voor huishoudens met ‘duurzame’ stadsverwarming: ‘We s

MPs Nijboer and Thijssen asked about reports of doubled heating costs for students and steep price rises on district heating, asking whether students should get the extra energy allowance, whether heat tariffs should be decoupled from gas prices, and whether tenants should be protected from passed-on costs. The minister answered that students are excluded from the categorical energy allowance in favour of individual assistance, that the new heat supply act will decouple tariffs from gas prices by late 2022, and that passing on higher energy costs is reasonable.
I am currently looking at how to submit this bill to the Council of State before the summer and then to the House of Representatives at the end of 2022.
Ik bekijk momenteel hoe ik dit wetsvoorstel voor de zomer aan kan bieden aan de Raad van State en daarna eind 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de zogenaamde “vleespropaganda” van de Europese Unie (EU)

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether EU-cofinanced meat promotion campaigns, criticised in a TV segment, conflict with climate and healthy-diet goals and whether national taxpayer money funds them. The minister replies that the campaigns are EU-financed (80%, with the rest paid by producer organisations), that no national money is involved, and that the Netherlands is lobbying in the EU review to exclude meat from promotion funding.
