It is up to the organiser of the relevant subsidised EU promotion programme to decide whether to buy airtime for the product.
Het is aan de organisator van het betreffende gesubsidieerde EU-promotieprogramma om voor het product al dan niet zendtijd in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Experts: kabinet kan levering gas deze winter niet garanderen'

MP Thijssen asked the government whether the Netherlands can guarantee gas supply this winter, why it did not fill strategic reserves or require long-term contracts like other states, and whether it had acted irresponsibly. Minister Jetten answered that the Norg Akkoord and a statutory supply-security regulation protect household supply, that the market is integrated and the government does not leave security fully to the market, and that the government is considering mandatory storage fill levels while maintaining that long-term contracts for Dutch supply would be impractical.
The cabinet has taken various measures to ensure supply security for protected customers.
Het kabinet heeft diverse maatregelen genomen om de leveringszekerheid te borgen voor beschermde afnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over overlast door windmolens

An MP asked the Minister about nuisance from wind turbines: timing of new distance rules, comparison with other noise sources, resident participation, municipal enforcement options, insulation subsidies, and night shutdown of turbines in testing. The minister answered that new rules via a plan-MER and AMvB are expected by mid-2023, that the noise standards are equivalent to other sources, and that municipalities can enforce permits and measure noise, while testing turbines are already bound by the same legal framework and no extra rule is considered necessary.
A plan-environmental impact assessment is currently being prepared to set new general environmental rules for wind turbines.
Er wordt momenteel gewerkt aan de plan-milieueffectrapportage (plan-mer) voor het vaststellen van nieuwe algemene milieuregels voor windturbines.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Van Raan over het bericht 'Shell moet reclame over 'miljoenen schone kilometers' direct aanpassen'

Three MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that Shell must amend misleading 'clean kilometres' advertising, and about whether fossil fuel advertising slows the energy transition, whether the Commission is effective, and whether a ban on fossil advertising is warranted. The Minister welcomed the Commission's scrutiny of advertising accuracy, said advertising is permitted if not misleading, and declined to assess the Commission's functioning or to commit to a fossil advertising ban, citing existing climate instruments.
In this capacity I have no view on the conduct or functioning of the Reclame Code Commissie.
Ik heb in deze hoedanigheid geen oordeel over het optreden of het functioneren van de Reclame Code Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Windparken veel rendabeler dan de overheid vooraf inschat'

MP Thijssen asked whether subsidies for onshore wind projects under the SDE++ scheme are excessive, given a study finding high equity returns (47%), and about profit-sharing with local residents. The minister acknowledges the risk of overstimulation, says the true extent cannot be determined yet, points to an ongoing independent evaluation and PBL advice, and rejects mandatory profit-sharing as impractical.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of the evaluation as soon as possible.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Nijboer, Thijssen en Kröger over de rode loper voor datacenter Zeewolde

MPs asked whether ministries actively courted Facebook/Meta for a Zeewolde data centre, gave it priority on the high-voltage grid, and whether the data centre's energy, heat and diesel backup impacts were addressed. The ministers answered that NFIA was approached by Meta, that the connection was legally permissible without priority, and that many questions on energy, heat and jobs are left to the municipality or are unknown, while promising a national data centre strategy later.
There is no question of "priority" for Meta's connection to the high-voltage grid.
Er is geen sprake van «voorrang» voor aansluiting van Meta op het hoogspanningsnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kathmann over het bericht dat 5G zorgt voor een toename in het energieverbruik van telecommunicatie

MPs Thijssen and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the energy use of 5G networks was studied beforehand, why 5G masts are not yet used efficiently, and whether the government should accelerate greening of the telecom sector. The minister answered that energy efficiency has been an ongoing concern, that industry has strong incentives to reduce consumption, and that the government sees no need for a specific state role, pointing to EU-level cooperation instead.
I am of the view that the telecommunications sector is making considerable efforts to deliver its services as energy-consciously as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat de telecommunicatiesector zich aanzienlijk inspant om zijn diensten zo energiebewust als mogelijk te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de sluiting van de Onyx-centrale

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the 212.5 million euro subsidy for closing the Onyx coal plant is so high, whether it could be corrected for market developments, how the workers' social plan is secured, and whether ETS allowances and sensitive documents will be withdrawn or disclosed. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was checked for overcompensation, is conditional on a social plan and state-aid approval, that a letter on ETS allowances will follow, and that confidential business information prevents publication of the subsidy decision, though the documents were made available to parliament confidentially.
Because of business-confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Thijssen over energieleverancier Enstroga dat omvalt door de hoge gasprijs

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Thijssen asked whether the government will help households and businesses left without a supplier after Enstroga's bankruptcy, whether a sector guarantee fund and sector screening are possible, and how other suppliers at risk will be protected. The state secretary answered that a general tax cut and a municipal support scheme provide relief, that individual compensation is impractical, that a guarantee fund has drawbacks, and that the ACM is independent so no screening can be ordered, while a stricter legal framework and an external study on consumer protection will follow.
Because of commercial confidentiality of data, the ACM cannot provide information on whether more energy suppliers are in acute financial trouble.
De ACM kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van gegevens geen informatie verstrekken of er meer energieleveranciers in de acute financiële problemen verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Energiebedrijf loost klanten vanwege hoge gasprijs'

MPs asked whether an energy company unilaterally terminating contracts because of high gas prices is lawful, what protection consumers have, and what the government will do. The Minister answers that such unilateral termination is not allowed, points consumers to the ACM, complaints committee and courts, reports an ACM order-with-penalty against one supplier, and announces tax relief and extra funding for vulnerable households.
Unilaterally changing the agreed terms is not permitted, unless the parties have explicitly agreed to it.
Het eenzijdig wijzigen van de gemaakte afspraken is niet toegestaan, tenzij partijen dit expliciet zijn overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de nationale CO2-heffing in relatie tot de SDE++

An MP asked whether not netting the national CO2 levy against SDE++ subsidies for CCS risks overstimulating CCS and distorting investment choices versus sustainable alternatives. The State Secretary rejected these concerns, arguing the levy is a stick not meant to reduce subsidy gaps, the SDE++ correction applies uniformly, and an overstimulation test and ETS-price correction guard against excess subsidy.
Finally, an overstimulation test applies whereby the actual costs and revenues of a project are examined afterwards to prevent overstimulation.
Ten slotte geldt een overstimuleringstoets waarbij achteraf wordt gekeken naar de daadwerkelijke kosten en opbrengsten van een project om overstimulering te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Thijssen and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising energy bills, energy poverty, insulation, ISDE subsidy conditions, long-term gas contracts and the gas curtailment plan. The government answered by pointing to temporary energy tax cuts worth about 430 euro per average household in 2022, a 150 million euro insulation fund via municipalities, and a planned Gaswet amendment, while declining to give precise forecasts and stating that gas prices are outside its control.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the Gas Act to provide for this and expect to be able to present this proposal to the House next year.
Ik bereid daarom een wijziging van de Gaswet voor om hierin te voorzien en verwacht dit voorstel volgend jaar aan de kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan en Thijssen over de herkomst van biomassa

MPs Van Raan and Thijssen asked about the origin, sustainability and certification of biomass used for energy in the Netherlands, citing an EU JRC report, a CE Delft report, and reports on forest loss in the Baltic states. The Secretary of State answered that the origin is traceable to country level, that a 'carbon debt' study has been requested from PBL, that the emissions authority will examine the Greenpeace/SOMO report, but that plot-level certificates and detailed sourcing data are commercially confidential and cannot be disclosed.
The information needed to break down the source of wood for category 5 biofuel raw materials by country and region is competitively sensitive and not publicly available.
De informatie die nodig is om de bron van het hout voor biogrondstoffen categorie 5 uit te splitsen naar land en regio is concurrentiegevoelig en niet publiekelijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Thijssen en Amhaouch over de maatregelen om de energietransitie bij de maakindustrie in het ‘zesde cluster’ te bevorderen

MPs Palland, Thijssen and Amhaouch asked how the government will promote energy transition, hydrogen infrastructure and financing for energy-intensive manufacturers in the 'sixth cluster' (ceramics, carpets) in eastern Netherlands, fearing they are overlooked. The minister and state secretary answer that the cluster has equal support via existing subsidies (VEKI, TSE, DEI+), a hydrogen transport network plan due spring 2022, regional energy strategies, and reject a dedicated transition fund for now.
The sixth cluster receives the same support as the rest of industry to achieve a reduction in energy consumption and CO2 emissions, including the switch to hydrogen.
Het zesde cluster krijgt dezelfde ondersteuning als de overige industrie om een vermindering van het energieverbruik en van CO 2 -emissies, waaronder de omschakeling naar waterstof, te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over het bericht 'De bedreiging van de natuur door stikstofhandel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that industry and farms hold unused nitrogen emission room that could be traded or used, potentially harming nature, and about the adequacy of the 30% deduction rate and the legal basis of the nitrogen policy. The minister answered that permitted emissions exceed actual emissions, that external netting only uses realised capacity with a 30% deduction, that the government is consulting provinces on preventing emission increases, and that the legal framework remains defensible.
I have no insight into the size of the latent space in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de omvang van de latente ruimte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de oorzaken van de wateroverlast in Limburg

MP Thijssen asked the government whether climate change causes more extreme weather and flooding like in Limburg, and whether the Green Deal and climate targets must be met to prevent such disasters. The government answered that climate change raises the chance of extreme rainfall, stressed reducing emissions and climate adaptation, announced a policy table on the Limburg flooding, and said it supports the EU 55% target and will respond to the Fit for 55 proposals in September.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management announced to the House on 27 July the intention to set up a policy table.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft op 27 juli jongstleden aan uw Kamer het voornemen gemeld om een beleidstafel in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including subsidence, the role of regional authorities, climate consistency with the Paris Agreement, and financial benefits. The Minister answered that subsidence is managed under a 'hand on the tap' principle with monitoring and independent audit, that regional advice is weighed within legal limits, that extraction is climate-neutral compared to imports, and that no additional study is needed.
On the basis of an integral weighing of the advice and the studies carried out, I conclude that there are no grounds to refuse (partially) the approval of the extraction plan.

Op basis van een integrale afweging van de adviezen en de onderzoeken die zijn gedaan, kom ik tot de conclusie dat er geen gronden zijn om de instemming met het winningsplan (gedeeltelijk) te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over het webartikel 'Grenswaarden stikstof ter discussie'

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked the minister about a web article claiming nitrogen critical-load ranges are unreliable and that habitat quality declines below the threshold, and why the official report reads differently. The minister answers that the article's conclusions are not in the report, that only the empirical part is reliable while the statistical part is only plausible, and that no policy change is needed now, while the results are being fed into a European review of critical loads.
The conclusions from the report do not for now give reason to tighten the emission reduction targets.
De conclusies uit het rapport geven vooralsnog geen aanleiding om de emissiereductiedoelstellingen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Schiermonnikoog vreest een blijvend litteken van de windstroomleiding'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about the proposed wind power cable route under Schiermonnikoog in the Wadden Sea UNESCO area, its ecological risks, and alternatives. The state secretary defended the western route as the preferred option, said the eastern route is constrained, and committed to further research and regional consultation without irreversible steps.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd zet ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de stijgende energienota op lange termijn

An MP asked the minister about the projected rise in long-term energy bills, network investment of over 100 billion euros, the fairness of network tariffs between businesses and households, and whether the energy tax credit should be raised. The state secretary answered that the investment estimate is uncertain but not judged wrong, that tariff rules are set by the ACM, that cost-sharing changes are a matter for a future cabinet, and that a study on financing the energy transition has been sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over de ontbossing van het Amazonegebied door soja-invoer van Nederland

MPs Thijssen and Gijs van Dijk asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch soy imports drive deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon, including whether soy from post-2008 cleared land is imported and whether importers will be held to account. The ministers answered that about 5% of Brazil's soy exports go to the Netherlands, most Dutch-bound soy is covered by sustainability certificates, and the government will push for EU-level measures such as legislation, with a proposal expected in summer 2021.

The cabinet expects companies established in the Netherlands that operate internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van in Nederland gevestigde bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principle's on Business and Human Rights naleven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.

verzoekt de regering, een brede, meerjarige pilot te starten met een combinatie van gebiedsgerichte maatregelen
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en De Groot over verlenging van de extra ondersteuning voor SZH
Asks the government to extend for one more year the extra support for the Stichting Zeldzame Huisdierrassen after its capacity was strained by phosphate rules.
requests the government to extend the extra support for one more year, given the exceptional situation in 2017
verzoekt de regering, de extra ondersteuning, gelet op de uitzonderlijke situatie in 2017, voor nog een jaar te verlengen
Motie van het lid Lodders c.s. over de voortgang van de Impulsagenda Greenport 3.0
Motion asks the cabinet to meet regularly and proactively with the Greenports on progress of the Impulsagenda Greenport 3.0.
requests the cabinet to consult the Greenports regularly and proactively on the progress of the Impulse agenda Greenport 3.0
verzoekt het kabinet om, op regelmatige basis en proactief met de Greenports in overleg te treden over de voortgang van de Impulsagenda Greenport 3.0
Motie van de leden Grashoff en De Groot over afspraken over de bestrijding van mestfraude
Asks the government to talk with police regions, municipalities and provinces about clearer arrangements to strengthen cooperation against manure fraud and to inform the House of the outcome.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the police regions Oost-Brabant and Limburg
verzoekt de regering, in gesprek te treden met de politieregio's Oost-Brabant en Limburg
Amendement van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. over een subsidie voor Stichting Q-Support
Moves 100,000 euro within the health budget from departmental operating costs to Volksgezondheid to fund knowledge retention at Stichting Q-Support.
the commitment and expenditure amounts increased by € 100 (x € 1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 100 (x € 1.000)
Motie van het lid Weverling c.s. over verbeteringen in het informatieproces van begrotingen en jaarverslagen

Asks the government to improve information to parliament on budgets and annual reports, including policy changes, links between goals and resources, and effects, and to involve the House in this process.
requests the government, in future and insofar as budget rules allow, to supplement its information provision
verzoekt de regering, in de toekomst, voor zover de begrotingsregels dat toelaten, haar informatievoorziening aan te vullen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over de verplichtingen voor financiële instellingen om financiering aan ontbossing te voorkomen

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister about obligations for financial institutions to prevent financing deforestation, citing a Greenpeace and Milieudefensie report and asking about the EU Forest Law, CSRD transparency, climate-risk reporting, a green bank tax and the WRR. The minister acknowledged the sector's responsibility under OECD and UN guidelines, said mandatory due diligence for financial institutions was not secured in the CSDDD, and pointed to pending EU effect assessments and a climate-measures exploration with a letter promised around summer.
I intend to inform the House around the summer on the main outlines of the outcomes of the exploration.
Ik ben voornemens om de Kamer rond de zomer te informeren op hoofdlijnen over de uitkomsten van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het opschalen en toepassen van waterstof in de industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about hydrogen use in steel (TSN IJmuiden, Thyssenkrupp Duisburg), the FUREC project at Chemelot, grid congestion and offtake. The minister answered that negotiations with TSN are starting, gave a technical view of Thyssenkrupp's plans without judging their feasibility, and said the ministry is in talks with RWE and OCI but that offtake and grid prioritisation are largely for companies and network operators.
I can well understand this response from RWE.
Ik kan me deze reactie van RWE goed voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht '#SIA2024: lancement du plan gouvernemental renforcé de reconquête de notre souveraineté sur l’élevage'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a French government plan on livestock sovereignty, including its framing of livestock farming, its push for an EU ban on cultivated meat, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with France. The minister answered that the French plan is vague on its claims, that cultivated meat is seen as complementary to conventional farming, that the Netherlands opposes an early ban and will seek a coalition of like-minded member states, and that the French policy choices are not a reason to doubt French government independence.
The cabinet will, together with like-minded member states, consider with which member states constructive discussions can be held on this topic.
Het kabinet zal, samen met gelijkgestemde lidstaten, bezien met welke lidstaten er constructieve gesprekken gevoerd kunnen worden over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de berichten 'Costs overruns and delays risk nuclear’s place in energy transition' en 'Komt er nu wel een Borssele 2?’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about cost overruns at Hinkley Point C and Vogtle, their implications for the planned Dutch nuclear plants, the feasibility of two additional plants, land needs, waste storage capacity and the CO2 footprint of nuclear power. The minister explained the causes of overruns and mitigation measures, said the site and cost questions depend on pending studies, and said the cost per MWh and land use cannot yet be determined.

I am aware of the significant cost overruns in the construction of nuclear power plants in other countries and attach great importance to a good understanding of the causes and implications for the new build project in the Netherlands.

Ik ben mij bewust van de significante kostenoverschrijdingen bij de bouw van kerncentrales in andere landen en hecht groot belang aan een goed begrip van de oorzaken en de implicaties voor het nieuwbouwproject in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de illegale spieringvisserij in de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister about large-scale illegal smelt fishing in the Wadden Sea, enforcement failures after a 2023 court ruling, the fishing techniques of shrimp fishers, and the delayed introduction of fishing-free zones near fish migration structures. The Minister said unlicensed fishers were formally warned, that inspectors monitor the fishing and will act on further violations, and that the fishing-free zones are still being decided, with results to be shared shortly.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen has formally warned three fishers about this.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof heeft drie vissers hierop formeel gewaarschuwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel “Wadplaten verdrinken, schelpen leggen het loodje: opwarming bedreigt Waddennatuur''

An MP from D66 asks the Ministers of Nature and Nitrogen and of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government's Wadden Sea policy squares with research showing climate change is salinising the Wadden Sea, drowning tidal flats and threatening its ecosystem, and how this bears on gas drilling permits near Ternaard. The ministers answer that climate pressure is acknowledged, point to the Beleidskader Natuur Waddenzee and a range of short- and long-term measures, and say a separate permit decision on the drilling will take into account the advisory assessment.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate is currently conducting a study into the sediment-supplying capacity of the Vlie storage basin.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat heeft op dit moment een studie lopen naar het sediment leverend vermogen in de komberging Vlie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sneller over het bericht 'Werkgevers: bedrijven verplaatsen nieuwe investeringen naar het buitenland'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that firms are shifting new investment abroad, the causes, the effects of nitrogen (stikstof) uncertainty, cuts to the National Growth Fund and R&D, and whether the government will commission studies. The minister acknowledges the concerns, attributes relocation mainly to firm-specific growth constraints, and commits to a study of the economic effects of nitrogen and to a letter on securing earning capacity, while leaving other questions to the next cabinet.
However, I can commit to a study to objectively map the main economic consequences of the nitrogen problem.
Wel kan ik een onderzoek toezeggen om de belangrijkste economische gevolgen van de stikstofproblematiek objectief in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Tjeerd de Groot, Kostić en Koekkoek over de controle op visfraude door de NVWA

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, PvdD and Volt asked the minister about the court ruling on NVWA fish-fraud controls, overfishing, the adequacy of staffing and EU compliance of the inspection system. The minister acknowledged ongoing EU infringement procedures and announced capacity expansion and a revised steekproefplan, while largely defending current staffing levels and declining to share confidential Commission advice.
These advice and remarks are confidential.
Deze adviezen en opmerkingen zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Tjeerd de Groot over de ‘Verzamelbrief bodem en ondergrond’

MPs Bamenga and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the ILT report does not justify a notification or permit requirement for steel slag, why a decision is taking so long, and whether standards for heavy metals and pH should be set quickly. The State Secretary answered that a decision on the best measure will be taken within weeks, that an updated circular on steel slag will be published by end of March, and that the evaluation of the standards framework will be reported in mid-2024.
I want to take a decision within a few weeks on which measure best fits.
Ik wil binnen enkele weken een besluit nemen over welke maatregel het beste past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, De Hoop en Soepboer over het bericht 'Hoe komt het met het Frysk in de Kamer, nu zoveel voorvechters van het toneel verdwijnen?' van 13 december 2023

MPs asked whether the duty of care for the Frisian language and culture is maintained during a change of minister, and how to finalise the delayed new Frisian language and culture administrative agreement (BFTK). The minister answered that the duty remains in force, that the existing agreement and visibility accord continue until a new one is signed (expected spring 2024), and that the successor will be briefed on the file.
A change of guard may not lead to reduced commitment to the duty of care for Frisian language and culture.
Wisseling van de wacht mag niet leiden tot een verminderde inzet voor de zorgplicht voor de Friese taal en cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Raan over het rapport van bureau Profundo 'Rabobanks share in the Brazilian bill, accountable for € 9,5 billion to € 61 billion'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Van Raan asked how bank financing of Brazilian deforestation-linked projects fits Rabobank's climate commitment, and how the polluter-pays principle, supervision, transparency and pricing of climate and nature risks apply to financial institutions. The minister answered that the climate commitment sets no concrete measures, that the government expects alignment with 1.5 degrees, that a sustainable finance policy and consultation on legislation are underway, and that some questions (consumer switching data, pricing of past damage) fall outside its information or legal reach.
I do not have this information and, to my knowledge, it is also not publicly available.
Deze informatie heb ik niet en is naar mijn weten ook niet openbaar beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot  over de stemming omtrent de verlenging van glyfosaat

Parliamentarian Tjeerd de Groot asked whether the European Commission will extend glyphosate approval for ten years despite the lack of a committee majority, what conditions attach, and whether the Netherlands will push for stricter EFSA criteria. Minister Adema replied that the Commission will adopt a positive decision by 14 December 2023, listed the conditions in the Commission proposal, noted the Dutch call for neurodegenerative-effects testing, and said the Netherlands will keep contributing to the scientific assessment framework.
At this appeal committee again no majority was reached for or against the Commission's proposal, so the Commission is now empowered to take an independent decision on the proposal.
Tijdens dit beroepscomité is wederom geen meerderheid vóór of tegen het voorstel van de EC bereikt, waardoor de EC nu gemachtigd is om een eigenstandig beslissing op het voorstel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de Unesco brief over de voorgenomen gaswinning

D66 MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers whether UNESCO's concerns about the planned Ternaard gas extraction under the Wadden Sea justify refusing the nature permit, how cumulative effects and the World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value will be assessed, and whether the NAM's notice of default and the Mining Act grounds for refusal apply. The government answered that the permit decision cannot be prejudged, that Natura 2000 and World Heritage tests apply, that it will report to UNESCO by 1 February 2024 and assess cumulative effects, but declined to guarantee no leakage or to commit to refusing the permit.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen cannot anticipate a formal decision on the permit application at this stage.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof kan nu niet vooruit lopen op een formeel besluit op de vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de motie De Groot c.s. (Kamerstuk 33576-290)

An MP asked the minister about the status of the area-based nitrogen approach, the number of organic and nature-inclusive farmers applying to cessation schemes, and how the De Groot motion is implemented. The minister reported that provinces submitted programmes, explained the organic action plan and a new extensification scheme, and stated that no distinction is made between farm types for the case supervisors, with the motion's implementation to be included in a handbook.
Under the cessation schemes, applicants are not asked whether they farm conventionally, organically or nature-inclusively, so this is not known.
In het kader van de beëindigingsregelingen wordt van aanvragers niet gevraagd, en is dus ook niet bekend, of men gangbaar, biologisch dan wel natuurinclusief boert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'De gezondheidsrisico’s van glyfosaat'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether pesticide approval authorities (Ctgb) properly prioritise public health, whether an independent review of the Ctgb should be held, and whether the government will act on a motion to phase out glyphosate. The Minister rejected the claim of insufficient duty-fulfilment, pointed to improved frameworks, committed to an independent analysis of approval procedures, and said the motion is being implemented.
To find out whether the current approval procedures deliver the best results, I want to commission an independent analysis of gaps in the approval procedures
Om inzichtelijk te krijgen of de huidige toelatingsprocedures de beste resultaten opleveren, wil ik een onafhankelijke analyse laten uitvoeren naar lacunes in de toelatingsprocedures
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot vragen gesteld over de wateroverlast in Zuid-Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about flooding in South Limburg, including damage, sewer capacity, funding and regional responsibility. The minister answered that damage is still being assessed, that sewer systems are designed for lower-intensity rainfall, and pointed to existing funds, regional programmes and planned standards without new commitments on funding.
Over 1,200 reports of various kinds have now been received in Maastricht.
Er zijn in Maastricht inmiddels ruim 1.200 meldingen binnengekomen van uiteenlopende aard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over (het toelatingsbeleid van) gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether the Ctgb's pesticide approval practice adequately addresses cocktail and cumulative environmental effects, neurotoxicity, Parkinson's as an occupational disease, buffer zones near residences and alignment with the Water Framework Directive, following a court ruling. The minister answered that the Ctgb assesses risks within the EU framework, that cumulative assessment methods are still being developed at EU level, that RIVM will study exposure and health effects, and that the government is exploring legal options on the Water Framework Directive.
I have asked the European Commission to take up the development of such a methodology.
Ik heb daarom de Europese Commissie gevraagd de ontwikkeling van zo’n methodiek op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de stand van zaken van het NPLG

An MP asked the minister for an overview of the status of regional area programmes and nature-target analyses under the NPLG, and whether the nature, nitrogen, water and climate targets are expected to be met. The minister answered that most provinces have submitted programmes but these are not yet concrete enough to judge target attainment, that the Ecological Authority is still reviewing the nature analyses, and that a 2024 rijksbijdrage depends on provinces committing to a better next version.
At this moment no statement can be made on whether the targets for nature, nitrogen, water and climate will be met, because the area programmes are not yet concrete enough.
Op dit moment is nog geen uitspraak te doen of de doelen voor natuur, stikstof, water en klimaat gehaald worden, omdat gebiedsprogramma's nog niet concreet genoeg zijn uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Waterschappen helpen boeren met 'onverbloemde greenwashing' voor EU-subsidie'

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether allowing farmers to count water board ditches toward the four-percent landscape-element requirement for EU subsidies undermines genuine biodiversity gains, and whether the Commission was informed. The minister rejected that view, said the rules are unchanged and approved in the national strategic plan, but admitted the choice was not explicitly submitted to the Commission and committed to no new action.
The choices referred to in these written questions were not explicitly submitted to the European Commission for approval.
De gemaakte keuzes waarop in deze schriftelijke vragen wordt gedoeld, is niet expliciet voorgelegd aan de Europese Commissie voor goedkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Nederlandse vissers gebruiken illegale netten om extra sliptong te vangen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how the government will stop Dutch fishers using illegal nets (binnenkuilen) to catch extra sole, and what steps it takes to strengthen enforcement with the NVWA. The minister acknowledges illegal fishing is unacceptable, points to a third NVWA inspection team, EU cooperation, and new control measures, but admits heterdaad detection is difficult and that no integrated enforcement strategy will be drawn up, with progress to be reported by year end.
Due to the necessary coordination, answering these questions within the requested deadline unfortunately was not achieved.
Vanwege de benodigde afstemming is de beantwoording van deze vragen binnen de gevraagde termijn helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over scheepvaartveiligheid op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about ship-safety risks from offshore wind farms in the North Sea, including the Petra L collision, whether the Programma Noordzee safety targets are met, and whether a quantitative safety norm will be set. The minister confirmed that more wind farms raise collision risk without extra measures, listed mitigation measures, said quantified effects cannot yet be given, and promised a quantitative-norm assessment with results expected in spring 2024.
That cannot yet be indicated given the short analysis period.
Antwoord 9 Dat is nu nog niet aan te geven gezien de korte analyseperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over het gebruik van chemische middelen zoals glyfosaat door ProRail

D66 MPs asked the state secretary about ProRail's slower-than-expected move away from glyphosate and other chemical weed control, and whether the 2025 phase-out target still stands. The government answered that the 2025 aim remains, that alternatives are still being tested, that no extra agreements with ProRail are needed, and that a ban on avoidable use will follow once adequate alternatives exist.
The aim is to end use before 2025, but the exact timing is ultimately determined by meeting the condition from the 25 October 2019 letter that usable and feasible alternatives must be available.
Inzet is beëindiging vóór 2025, maar het exacte moment van beëindiging wordt uiteindelijk bepaald door de vervulling van de randvoorwaarde uit de brief van 25 oktober 2019

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, Boulakjar en Van Ginneken over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (hierna: KRW) en het rapport ‘Een KRW-risicoanalyse voor de vergunningverlening voor de bouw- en infrasector’

MPs from D66 asked the government whether the Water Framework Directive (KRW) targets will be met, and about the construction-sector risk analysis claiming large losses if permits are restricted by missed targets. The minister answered that no guarantee can be given, disputes the report's conclusions and scale of risk, and says the government will consult the European Commission on possible exceptions.
However, guarantees that all KRW targets will be met cannot be given.
Garanties dat alle KRW-doelen gehaald worden kunnen echter niet gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over overtredingen in slachthuizen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about repeated animal welfare violations in slaughterhouses, including animals stuck or bled while conscious and placed live in scalding tanks, and whether slaughter speeds should be lowered and camera monitoring expanded. The minister acknowledged the violations as unacceptable, explained that slaughter-speed reduction is an available NVWA intervention already in policy, deferred on camera-technology and criminal prosecution questions, and declined to provide some data (e.g., share of pigs stuck while conscious observed by inspectors) because it is not recorded.
Lowering the slaughter speed is one of the most important corrective instruments the NVWA has when things go wrong in a slaughterhouse.
Het verlagen van de slachtsnelheid is een van de belangrijkste corrigende instrumenten die de NVWA heeft als het misgaat in een slachthuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Grote stalbrand in Sint Oedenrode, 9000 varkens omgekomen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a barn fire in Sint Oedenrode that killed 9,000 pigs, and about measures against fatal barn fires, escape routes for animals, municipal and provincial fire-safety powers, and an advisory body's recommendation. The minister says a reinforced approach aims to halve fatal barn fires by 2026, a draft decree on fire-safety rules is in consultation, and an amendment created a statutory basis in the Animal Welfare Act for fire-safety requirements.
I am therefore committed to a reinforced approach to barn fires with the aim of halving the number of fatal barn fires and fatal animal victims by 2026.
Ik zet mij daarom in voor een verstevigde aanpak voor stalbranden met als doel een halvering van het aantal dodelijke stalbranden en het aantal dodelijke dierlijke slachtoffers in 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over et bericht ‘Landbouwlobby liet beleid voor water en bodem afzwakken’

An MP from D66 asks the minister why measures on groundwater abstraction (permit requirement, 1 km buffer around nature areas) and extensification were weakened under agricultural lobby pressure, and why nature and environmental groups were not consulted. The minister answers that a meet-and-register obligation is introduced instead, that a blanket permit requirement and buffer are not structural choices, that consultation took place with many parties, and that the agricultural transition remains part of other policy tracks.
That is why a blanket permit requirement and a hard boundary of at least 1 km from nature areas are not part of the structuring choices.
Daarom is een algehele vergunningplicht en een harde grens van tenminste 1 km van natuurgebieden geen onderdeel van de structurerende keuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Pesticide use and incident Parkinson's disease in a cohort of farmers and their spouses'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study linking pesticide use to Parkinson's disease in farmers, and about glyphosate reduction, authorisation rules and the Landbouwakkoord. The minister answered that RIVM will start a long-term health study, that a glyphosate-substitution obligation is being prepared for 2025, and that authorisation frameworks will be improved, while stressing the independence of Ctgb and EFSA.

To interpret the scientific signals in Dutch practice, I have asked RIVM to start as soon as possible a long-term study into possible health effects of exposure to crop protection products for farmers and residents.

Om de wetenschappelijke signalen te duiden in de Nederlandse praktijk heb ik het RIVM verzocht om zo spoedig mogelijk een lange termijn studie te starten naar mogelijke gezondheidseffecten van de blootstelling aan gewasbeschermingsmiddelen van agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de derogatieregeling

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrates derogation: enforcement against manure fraud, dam-ditch enforcement by water boards, the late 1 March 2023 start of buffer-strip rules and its consequences, and whether this conflicts with the derogation decision. The minister answered that the VHS Mest enforcement strategy continues, that the late buffer-strip implementation has negligible effects, and that the Commission was informed but the derogation conditions are not fully met.
Before the summer I will inform the House further about the progress of the VHS Mest and my efforts to strengthen it in the coming years.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer verder informeren over de voortgang van de VHS Mest en mijn inzet op de versterking die ik in de VHS Mest de komende jaren wil doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Meerderheid boeren wil sloten dempen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a poll showing farmers want to fill in ditches, and the risks for biodiversity, climate resilience, and nature and nitrogen targets. The minister answered that ditch-filling requires permission from water boards, that ditches matter for biodiversity and water systems, and that no steps need reversing, though the answers to some questions were delayed.
It is therefore important that farmers always first consult the relevant water board to request permission to fill in a ditch.
Het is dan ook van belang dat landbouwers altijd eerst in overleg treden met het desbetreffende waterschap om toestemming te vragen voor het dempen van een sloot

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel van het platform voor onderzoeksjournalistiek Follow the Money met als titel ‘Steenwolfabriek in Roermond mag van de provincie twee keer zoveel st

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Rockwool stone wool plant in Roermond may emit twice the ammonia and phenol limits of other plants under a 2020 provincial permit. The State Secretary answered that Rockwool is the second-largest ammonia emitter, that the province chose permit limits within the EU BREF range, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord lowest-end principle is a starting point rather than an automatic cap, and that the government will talk with Rockwool and push for BAT revisions and sustainable insulation alternatives without committing to tighter national limits.
The competent authority prioritised limiting the emissions of these two substances, even if phenol emissions are higher as a result.
Het bevoegd gezag heeft prioriteit gegeven aan het beperken van de uitstoot van deze twee stoffen, ook als daarbij de emissie van fenol hoger is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Uren vergaderd, maar bespreken Landbouwakkoord moet nog beginnen'

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the Landbouwakkoord (agricultural agreement) will be finished by April 2023, how the process and the reflection table's membership and independence are safeguarded, and how nitrogen, climate and water targets are secured. The minister answered that work is on track for an April agreement, described the process and reflection table composition, and said the targets and coalition agreement frame the talks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Schiphol Group heeft boeren uitgekocht voor extra stikstofruimte Schiphol en Lelystad Airport

D66 MPs asked whether Schiphol's buyout of farms for nitrogen space is known, how much space is freed, the status of Schiphol's nature permit, and how Lelystad Airport's nitrogen offsetting and a planned pre-emption right fit together. The government answered that nine farms were bought for Schiphol and three for Lelystad Airport, that the appropriate assessment is still being supplemented, and that a pre-emption right bill is targeted for entry into force on 1 January 2024.
It is important that Schiphol obtains the required nature permit as soon as possible.
Het is van belang dat Schiphol zo spoedig mogelijk over de vereiste natuurvergunning beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het vangen van kippen

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling requiring the NVWA to enforce the ban on catching chickens by the legs, and about the government's position on animal welfare and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said catching by the legs is not animal-friendly, outlined re-inspections and possible enforcement with penalties, and stated her opposition to exempting poultry from the ban on EU level.
Following the ruling, the NVWA will first carry out re-inspections at those companies that were visited under the original enforcement request.
Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak zal de NVWA eerst herinspecties doen bij die bedrijven die in het kader van het oorspronkelijke handhavingsverzoek zijn bezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over (onder andere) het bericht ‘Belgische garnalenvissers leveren vergunning in, Waddenvereniging wil rechtspraak'

An MP asked why Belgian shrimp fishers surrendered their Nature Conservation Act permit two months early, whether they may reapply, how the government will prevent harm to nature, and whether the assessment should be independently reviewed, and asked about fishing after the permits expire. The minister answered that the permit was withdrawn to avoid litigation costs, reapplication is allowed, the government will assess applications under existing law, declined an independent review, and granted a limited tolerance period with conditions.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen sees no reason to do this.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof ziet geen aanleiding om dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over het protest op 26 november tegen de gaswinning in de Waddenzee

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the 26 November 2022 protest against gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, and whether he would urge Shell (NAM) to withdraw its permit application. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said no new Wadden Sea extraction permits will be issued and that the Ternaard procedure is the last one, but postponed any talks with NAM until the outcome of a supplementary nitrogen assessment ordered after the Porthos ruling.
At this moment I first want to await those outcomes before I can take a next step in the decision-making on the Ternaard project together with the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen
Op dit moment wil ik eerst die uitkomsten afwachten, voordat ik samen met de Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof een volgende stap kan zetten in de besluitvorming over het project Ternaard
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Boulakjar over de gevolgen van de Porthos uitspraak van de Raad van State voor de vergunningaanvraag voor gaswinning bij Ternaard

Two D66 MPs asked how the Council of State's Porthos ruling affects the permit process for gas extraction near Ternaard and when a decision can be made. The minister answered that construction-phase nitrogen deposition must now be assessed, that the NAM has until Q1 2023 to supplement its application, and that she cannot yet give a completion date.
At this moment I cannot yet indicate when the decision-making can be concluded exactly.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming precies kan worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de brief van 372 wetenschappers met zorgen over de mijnbouw in de Waddenzee

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers how concerns from 372 scientists about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea would be weighed in the Ternaard permit decision and whether the permit is legally sound. The minister answered that the concerns are taken into account, that a permit must be based on an appropriate assessment showing no harm to Natura 2000 sites, and that the decision is delayed because nitrogen effects of the construction phase must be reassessed after a Council of State ruling, with no firm timeline given.
I cannot currently state concretely when the decision-making will be concluded.
Ik kan op dit moment niet concreet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over 9000 vroegtijdige doden per jaar ten gevolge van fijnstof (PM2,5) uit onder andere de landbouw

An MP asked the government about roughly 9,000 premature deaths a year from fine particulate matter, the share attributable to agricultural ammonia, and related policy questions. The Staatssecretaris answered substantively, citing RIVM figures (about 7,500 deaths, agriculture responsible for roughly 11-12% of life-years lost by mass-based calculation), and said the government is working stepwise toward WHO guideline values with an action agenda due end 2023.
My aim is to set out, when the SLA implementation agenda 2024–2030 is adopted at the end of 2023, the pace and interim steps by which the Netherlands can work toward the WHO guideline values.

Mijn streven is om eind 2023 bij het vaststellen van de SLA uitvoeringsagenda 2024–2030, op te nemen in welk tempo, en met welke tussenstappen, wij in Nederland naar de WHO-advieswaarden toe kunnen werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat chemiefabriek Chemours maandenlang veel meer GenX in water loosde dan toegestaan

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether Chemours discharged far more GenX into water than permitted, and whether monitoring data pointed to illegal discharges. Minister Harbers answered that the national monitoring data are not suited to attributing discharges to a single firm, that Chemours' permits allow 2 kg and 5 kg per year, and that enforcement was not possible because the source could not be identified.
None of these measurements show that Chemours exceeded the set GenX standard at the end of 2021.
Uit geen van deze metingen blijkt dat Chemours eind 2021 de gestelde norm voor GenX heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over aanspoelen stookolie langs de kust

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about oil washing ashore along the Dutch coast, the timing of Rijkswaterstaat's response, cleanup, polluter liability, illegal bilge discharges, the revision of cleanup and bird-rescue arrangements after the MSC Zoe incident, volunteer involvement, and monitoring and Coast Guard capacity. The minister answered that cleanup and daily inspections were carried out, the polluter will be held liable once identified, the revised regulations are expected in the first half of 2023, and existing monitoring and equipment are sufficient.
Rijkswaterstaat acted immediately upon reports of washed-up oil pollution following the applied approach and launched an investigation into the extent of the pollution.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft direct na melding van aangespoelde olieverontreiniging ingegrepen volgens de gehanteerde aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat burgers in het buitengebied onvoldoende worden beschermd tegen stank uit de veehouderij

An MP from D66 asked the government how it will respond to a court ruling that residents of rural areas are insufficiently protected against livestock odour, including its plans for the Biesheuvel commission's recommendations and whether it will appeal. The state secretary answered that the ruling is being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and noted that municipalities already have tools under the Crisis- and herstelwet and the Omgevingswet.
At this moment the ruling is being studied. I take the ruling and the problem very seriously for all those involved.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd. Ik neem de uitspraak en de problematiek voor alle betrokkenen zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over nieuwe risicogrenzen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about new RIVM risk limits for PFAS in surface water and their consequences for the Hedwige polder de-embankment and the Westerschelde. The minister confirmed the new limits, said a decision on adopting them as norms is still pending, and maintained that PFAS levels do not obstruct the nature goals of the de-embankment.
I will, partly on the basis of RIVM's advice, decide whether the PFAS standards for surface water need to be adjusted.
Ik zal mede op basis van het advies van het RIVM een besluit nemen of de normen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater aangepast moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel ‘Belangenverstrengeling van Statenleden bij stemmingen over stikstofbeleid’

MPs Sneller and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether provincial councillors working in agriculture who voted on nitrogen policy motions, and sometimes filed motions themselves, breached the conflict-of-interest rule in article 28 of the Provinciewet. The Minister answered that the rule only bars voting where a councillor has a direct personal interest, that no conflict of interest can be concluded from the rules, and that commissioners of the King will be informed.
On the basis of this legal framework, the conclusion cannot be drawn that there would have been a conflict of interest.
Op basis van dit wettelijk kader kan niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat sprake zou zijn geweest van belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Boze boeren kappen uit frustratie 100 oude bomen én hangen houten koe op aan trekker'

An MP asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about farmers felling about 100 old willows in protest against nitrogen policy, asking whether damage to nature should be restored and whether protest-related felling is penalised. The minister regretted the felling but said the willows were exempt from replanting duties under the Nature Conservation Act, no regional rules applied, the province saw no grounds to act, and EU subsidy recipients face cross-compliance checks with possible clawback.
I do not have that data. Apart from a few exceptions, that competence lies with the provinces.
Over die gegevens beschik ik niet. Op enkele uitzonderingen na ligt die bevoegdheid bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie bereid is derogaties toe te staan van milieuvereisten uit het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister whether the Netherlands will use EU derogations from Common Agricultural Policy environmental conditions (GLMC 7 and 8a) to protect food security, and what the expected effects on water, soil, nitrogen and nature are. The minister answered that the Netherlands will apply the derogation to ensure a level playing field and give farmers more time, that environmental ambitions remain unchanged over the full CAP period, and that no new environmental impact assessment was made.
I have decided that the Netherlands will use this derogation option to ensure a level playing field within the EU
Ik heb besloten als Nederland gebruik te maken van deze mogelijkheid tot derogatieverlening uit hoofde van het waarborgen van een gelijk speelveld binnen de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat er wetenschappelijke tekortkomingen zitten aan de beoordeling dat glyfosaat niet potentieel kankerverwekkend is

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the minister whether EU regulators wrongly dismissed animal-study evidence linking glyphosate to cancer, whether the Dutch AGG member should explain this, and whether the 2015 IARC conclusion is supported by newer studies, and asked how the precautionary principle applies. The minister replied that the AGG and ECHA's RAC kept the existing hazard classification, did not classify glyphosate as carcinogenic, will publish a detailed RAC opinion in August 2022 explaining the animal-study assessment, and will send it to parliament.
I will send this to your House.
Ik zal uw Kamer deze doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de UNESCO-brief over gaswinning in het Waddengebied

An MP from D66 asked the ministers how UNESCO and IUCN's concerns about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea fit with the government's position, what Netherlands' World Heritage obligations require, and whether a ban on new permits will be proposed. The government replies that it is weighing the submitted objections, will take UNESCO/IUCN concerns into account in the final decisions, and will send the Mining Act proposal and Wadden policy framework later, without committing to a permit ban before the summer.
Substantive concerns of UNESCO and IUCN on that point, I will take into account in the final decisions.
Inhoudelijke zorgpunten van UNESCO en IUCN op dat punt, zal ik betrekken bij de definitieve besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de veiligheid van maritieme en energie gerelateerde activiteiten op de Noordzee

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about safety measures around offshore wind farms for shipping and energy supply, including ship collisions, risks to energy supply, and innovative solutions. The minister outlined existing and planned measures (ERTVs, Kustwacht oversight, MOSWOZ research, Programma Noordzee 2022-2027), said a full wind-farm outage is unlikely and that no specific scenarios or new integral study are planned, while committing to further collision-consequence research with results expected in 2023.
A follow-up study is underway. The next interim results are expected in the first half of 2023.
Een vervolgonderzoek loopt. De eerstvolgende tussenresultaten worden in de eerste helft van 2023 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Megaclaim in de maak voor schade door droogte: waterbedrijven voor 300 miljoen aangeslagen’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported claim by farmers for drought damage that would burden water companies, raising concerns about drinking water supply, the legal basis, the priority order (verdringingsreeks) and whether the system should be revised. The minister answered that the claim stems from the Waterwet compensation scheme, that drinking water supply is not affected, that the existing priority order is sufficiently future-proof, and that no legal revision is currently planned.
There is currently no intention to change this system.
Er is op dit moment geen intentie om dit systeem aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over MIRT-projecten

D66 MPs asked the government to reconcile its 2019 pledge to reserve nitrogen room in the SSRS for seven MIRT infrastructure projects, funded partly by a national speed reduction, with its 2021 decision not to use that speed reduction for MIRT projects, and asked about the nitrogen mitigation for the A27 and the consequences of a April 2022 court ruling. The minister answered that the 2021 decision merely nuanced the 2019 pledge because the speed-reduction yield could not be guaranteed, that no SSRS nitrogen room from the speed reduction is used for these projects, that the A27/A12 amendment is still being prepared, and that the court ruling and the decision have no consequences for the pending plans.

With the second statement, your House was informed that the national speed reduction will not be used, because there is a risk that after each annual update and due to the effects of COVID-19 on mobility, the precise yield of the national speed reduction is not certain at the required level of detail.

Met de tweede uitspraak is uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat geen gebruik wordt gemaakt van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging, omdat het risico bestaat dat na elke jaarlijkse actualisatie en vanwege de effecten van COVID-19 op de mobiliteit de precieze opbrengst van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging niet op het vereiste detailniveau zeker is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de bescherming en het behoud van het koraal en de natuur in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked about a resort on Bonaire that built an artificial beach without permits, the threat to coral, why the permit was granted quickly against advice, and enforcement of nature protection in the Caribbean Netherlands, totalling 15 questions. The government confirmed unpermitted sand dumping, a fine of 1.2 million US dollars, and a later permit with coral-protection conditions, while describing shared responsibilities between the island council and the Rijk and listing planned reforms to permitting and enforcement.
The island executive did not follow the advice of the Bonaire nature commission. It is also not obliged to do so.
Het bestuurscollege heeft daarbij niet het advies van de natuurcommissie Bonaire gevolgd. Het bestuurscollege is daartoe ook niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht 'Levend koken van varkens in slachthuizen gaat nog altijd door'

MPs De Groot and Van Campen asked the minister about reports that pigs were still being scalded alive in slaughterhouses, repeat violations, sanctions, late reporting, camera surveillance and the Beter Leven label. The minister answered that repeat cases were handled with maatwerk interventions and fines, promised a verscherpt toezicht procedure and a camera-surveillance bill, but declined to lower slaughter speeds generically and left the label question to private bodies.
The report the questioners refer to concerns information the NVWA made public following a Wob request.
Het bericht waarop de vragenstellers doelen, ziet op informatie die de NVWA heeft openbaargemaakt op grond van een Wob-verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over ‘berichten dat het kabinet het midden in de stikstofcrisis makkelijker maakt om in een aantal gebieden makkelijker stikstof uit te stoten’

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether the 25-kilometre maximum calculation distance for nitrogen deposition weakens environmental protection, since it may leave much nitrogen emitted by projects outside the calculation and allow permits for projects despite the species-protection duty. The minister answered that the distance rule is a technically justified modelling choice, that mitigation and the broader package of measures cover deposition beyond 25 km, and that the courts will judge its legal defensibility.
The maximum calculation distance is not aimed at making permit granting for infrastructure projects easier.
De maximale rekenafstand is niet gericht op het gemakkelijker maken van vergunningverlening van infrastructurele projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Honger dreigt in Hoorn van Afrika, te weinig hulpgeld door 'concurrerende rampen''

MPs Hammelburg and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the minister about a warning that hunger threatens the Horn of Africa and that aid is insufficient, covering food security, WFP funding, the aid budget, UN coordination, food import dependence and geopolitical risks. The minister replied that the Netherlands is engaging partners and the UN, cites existing funding (EUR 44 million to WFP), says no room exists in the emergency aid budget for increases but that the Chamber will be informed in the spring memorandum, and promises further UN talks.
If additional funds become available, a decision on additional contributions will be taken based on an analysis of needs worldwide.
Indien additionele middelen beschikbaar komen, wordt op basis van een analyse van de noden wereldwijd een besluit genomen over aanvullende bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de zuidelijke vaarroute op de Waddenzee voor grote containerschepen

The MP asks the minister about large container ships using the southern shipping route over the Wadden Sea despite Coast Guard warnings to take the northern route, including counts of such voyages and the state of more active traffic guidance. The minister confirms several incidents, reports the figures from AIS data, notes that the southern route lies largely outside territorial waters so closing it requires IMO agreement, and says a non-binding IMO proposal is planned.
During the Maritime Two-Minute Debate on 2 February I committed to examining the options for letting the captain know in such cases that the Coast Guard's advice is not non-binding.

Tijdens het Tweeminutendebat Maritiem op 2 februari jl. heb ik toegezegd te zullen bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de kapitein in voorkomende gevallen te laten weten dat het advies van de Kustwacht niet vrijblijvend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Tjeerd de Groot over de schrijnende situatie rondom arbeidsmigranten in de grensregio

MPs Podt and Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the poor housing of Romanian agency workers in a German border area working for a Dutch agency, and how cross-border enforcement and the separation of housing and work contracts would be addressed. The minister said cooperation with Germany and Belgium is being intensified, the Goed Verhuurderschap bill will require separate housing contracts, a ban on employers also acting as landlord was judged too far, and a certification regime for agencies will be informed later this year.
I hope to be able to inform the House in the coming autumn.
Ik hoop uw Kamer in het komende najaar te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Tjeerd de Groot over de toename van het stikstofoverschot en nieuwe gerechtelijke uitspraken die het huidige stikstofbeleid afkeuren

MPs Ouwehand and Tjeerd de Groot asked whether nitrogen surpluses in agriculture rose after the 2019 PAS ruling, whether unused permit space and old permits are being used for external netting, and how court rulings against intra- and extra-netting rules are being handled. The minister acknowledged rising surpluses and rulings against certain practices, defended existing netting rules within legal limits, and promised to inform the House before summer on restricting unused permit space and on netting measures.
I do not consider it opportune to temporarily halt all netting possibilities now.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om alle mogelijkheden voor salderen nu tijdelijk stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sjoerdsma over VN Intergovernmental Conference on Marine Biodiversity of areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ)

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ), including protection gaps, Dutch participation and ambition at the UN conference, and environmental impact assessment standards. The government answered that the BBNJ treaty process is ongoing, that Dutch ministerial participation is not yet appropriate at this stage, that it supports the High Ambition Coalition statement and 30% protection goals, and that it favours strategic and project environmental impact assessment in the treaty.
Participation at political level is not yet on the table at this stage of the negotiations.
Deelname op politiek niveau is in deze fase van de onderhandelingen nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de verdere stappen in het project over de aanlanding van de Kabel Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden (TNW)

Two D66 MPs asked the minister about the next steps for the cable landing of Net op Zee Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden, including routes through the Ems and the Westerschelde precedent for stability and maintenance. The minister answered that a stable route is preferred, that an eastern Ems route will be examined in the new programme, and that the route under the shipping channel will be included in the study, pending contact with German authorities.
I intend to include the route variant under the shipping channel in the study.
Ik ben voornemens de routevariant onder de vaargeul op te nemen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over de aandacht voor de Friese taal bij de introductie van bewindspersonen

Two MPs asked why the introduction dossiers and CVs of new ministers are translated into English, French, German and Papiamento but not Frisian, and why the rijksoverheid.nl website lacks Frisian content. The minister replied that translation decisions are left to departments under the government translation policy, that Frisian-speaking residents are a designated target group, and that Frisian versions of some information exist, while agreeing that some key information should be available in recognised languages.
It is up to the individual departments to decide whether translations into other languages are desirable.
Het is aan de individuele departementen om de afweging te maken of vertalingen in andere talen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Limburgse grensgemeente verrast door volstorten recreatieplas”

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that a Flemish Maas lake near the Dutch border was designated for dumping excavated soil from Antwerp, possibly polluted like the Westerschelde, and about risks to Dutch municipalities, boaters, agriculture and drinking water. The State Secretary answered that no soil is currently being applied, the Flemish authority is responsible, the permit excludes heavily polluted soil, no monitoring report or MER exists yet, and that the Netherlands will be closely involved in monitoring approval.
It is not possible to send you a report regarding ecological or environmental requirements.
Het is niet mogelijk om u een rapportage met betrekking tot ecologische of milieueisen toe te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Na 40 jaar verwaarlozing ligt het lot van Lange Jaap in de handen van Mark Harbers'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the Lange Jaap lighthouse's maintenance history unfolded, why cracks noted in 1998 led to no action, and who would bear costs of repair, demolition or rebuilding. The minister answered that cracks were found in 1998, reinforcements were agreed with the municipality and heritage body in 2001-2002, the priority is preserving the tower, costs cannot yet be estimated, and an external review of the process has been requested.
My attention is now first focused on preserving the tower if that is technically and safely possible.
Mijn aandacht is nu eerst gericht op het behouden van de toren indien dat technisch en veilig mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over zwendelkruiden

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether herb mixes containing very little actual herb, and high salt and sugar, amount to consumer deception and what steps will be taken. The minister replied that the labels comply with EU food information rules, that producers should be transparent, that a review of enforceable product-improvement agreements is underway, and that the Warenwet adequately protects consumer perception.
I am currently having an official exploration carried out into options to make agreements on product improvement legally enforceable, should this be desirable in the future.
Ook laat ik momenteel een ambtelijke verkenning uitvoeren naar opties om afspraken over productverbetering ook juridisch afdwingbaar te maken, mocht dit in de toekomst wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Risico’s gaswinning onder Waddenzee vanuit Ternaard onvoldoende onderzocht'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boucke (D66) asked the minister about reports that the environmental impact assessment for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea from Ternaard was incomplete, and whether a permit could lawfully be granted, including compensation and UNESCO/IUCN issues. The minister answered that the NAM was asked to supplement the MER, that the advice and objections will be weighed before a decision expected in March 2022, and that no new IUCN advice is needed, but she declined to pre-judge the permit decision or any compensation liability.
Following the advice of the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment (m.e.r.), the previous Minister of EZK and my predecessor asked the NAM to supplement the Environmental Impact Report (MER)

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage (m.e.r.) hebben de vorige Minister van EZK en mijn voorganger de NAM verzocht om de Milieueffectrapportage (MER) aan te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over bedrijven die nauwelijks gecontroleerd worden op milieudelicten

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether companies are hardly inspected or fined for environmental offences, how often omgevingsdiensten should visit polluting firms, and about ammonia emissions by cacao factory Cargill Aurora in Zaandam that were not reported to the RIVM for 2010-2018. The State Secretary answered that inspection frequency is risk-based, that the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie and the VTH reform are being used, that Cargill's unreported emissions were discovered in 2019 and are being addressed through a planned last onder dwangsom, and that the omission does not create new nitrogen effects.

I find this a worrying conclusion, and it was partly the reason for my predecessor to inform you, in the letter on strengthening the VTH system, about the actions planned to follow up the recommendations of the Van Aartsen committee.
