Dit vind ik een zorgwekkende conclusie en het is voor mijn voorganger mede aanleiding geweest om u met de Kamerbrief versterking VTH-stelsel 5 te informeren over de acties die worden voorzien om de aanbevelingen van de commissie Van Aartsen op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Vogelgriep grijpt heftiger dan ooit om zich heen’

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of more severe bird flu symptoms, whether dead birds are cleared by municipalities and provinces, and related measures and cross-border comparisons. The minister answered that severity claims cannot be confirmed, that research and a joint protocol are underway, that responsibility depends on location, and that Dutch infection levels are not clearly out of line with other countries.
I do not recognise this picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Midden in de stikstofcrisis maakt het kabinet het in sommige gebieden juist makkelijker stikstof uit te stoten'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report that the 25-kilometre maximum calculation distance for nitrogen deposition creates zones without permit requirements and may weaken scrutiny of large polluting projects. The minister answered that the release of the updated AERIUS Calculator is delayed to 13 January 2022, that the 25-km limit does not create permit-free zones, and that additional mitigation measures and individual permit conditions are being examined.
No, that is not correct. If there are no nitrogen aspects, a nature permit may still be required because of other aspects such as disturbance.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Als er geen stikstofaspecten zijn, kan een natuurvergunning alsnog aan de orde zijn vanwege andere aspecten zoals bijvoorbeeld verstoring.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over ‘Foute’ soja in duurzaam veevoer

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about RTRS soy credits used in Dutch livestock feed, deforestation risks, and EU consumer guarantees. The minister answered that RTRS is an effective instrument, that about 69% of soy used in feed is deforestation-free, and pointed to the EU deforestation regulation proposal and national sustainability efforts.
I cannot confirm the figures you have stated.
Ik kan de door u aangegeven cijfers niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Biodiversiteitstop worstelt met vage doelen en beloften'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the minister about a report that the biodiversity summit was struggling with vague goals, Nizza commitments, the Aichi targets being largely missed, and how Dutch positions and follow-up monitoring would ensure implementation. Minister Schouten answered that Dutch positions are set at EU level and reflect the High Ambition Coalition's 30% target, that stronger monitoring and reporting will be pushed in the new framework, and that implementation of CBD agreements will be assessed after COP-15's second part.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de invoering Richtlijn beroepskwalificaties binnenvaart

MPs asked why the Netherlands has not implemented the EU inland shipping qualifications directive four years after entry into force, and about the impact on small passenger boats and ferries and on Dutch training approvals. The minister answered that the implementation is complex and needs more time, that a transitional arrangement and interim national scheme are planned, and that an adapted certificate for sightseeing boats is under discussion with the sector.
In addition, I am conducting international consultations to reach mutual acceptance of documents by 17 January 2022.
Daarnaast voer ik internationaal overleg om voor 17 januari 2022 tot wederzijdse acceptatie van documenten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over zieke dieren die alsnog op transport gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA allowing sick and injured pigs and cattle to be transported to foreign slaughterhouses, and about enforcement, reporting figures, the sector transport protocol, camera supervision and the intervention ladder. The minister answered that the NVWA registers all reports, that the sector bears primary responsibility, that reports have been counted, that a protocol was agreed and camera supervision and the intervention policy are being considered, but gave no concrete new enforcement measures beyond periodic updates.
I will inform your House about the state of compliance with the transport regulation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken van de naleving van de transportverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over varend ontgassen in Flevoland

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of structural venting of carcinogenic gas from ships in Flevoland lakes, the apparent tolerance shown on a ministry map, the enforcement gap between provincial bans and national waters, the ratification status of the CDNI waste convention, and the readiness of venting alternatives and enforcement. The minister answered that there is no toleration policy, that provincial bans do not apply on national waters, that the ban depends on ratification by all states (Belgium, France and Switzerland still pending), and that enforcement and alternatives are being prepared with the sector and provinces.
There is no question of a toleration policy.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de interpretatie van artikel 6 van de Habitatrichtlijn (92/43/EEG)

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked whether the current nitrogen approach meets the European Commission's interpretation of Article 6(2) of the Habitats Directive (non-deterioration), and asked for internal notes and Landsadvocaat advice on this. Minister Schouten answered that the structural approach is designed to prevent deterioration, that the government will adjust measures if needed, and that the nature-target analyses will follow mid-2022, but did not release the internal notes or advice.
Will you share with the House the internal notes between May 2019 and February 2021 that address the consequences of the non-deterioration obligation in Article 6(2)?
Wilt u de interne nota's tussen mei 2019 en februari 2021 waarin wordt ingegaan op (de consequenties) van het verslechteringsverbod uit artikel 6 lid 2 met de Kamer delen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het Westnijlvirus en de tijgermug

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about whether the NVWA's publication of tiger mosquito finds, including business names and neighbourhood-level locations, is consistent with a Council of State ruling on Wob requests. The Minister replies that the ruling concerned passive disclosure only, that the NVWA is reviewing more detailed active disclosure for 2022, and that the current approach aims to inform residents without conflicting with that ruling.
The NVWA is currently examining how information on mosquito finds can be made public at a more detailed level.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment op welke wijze informatie over muggenvondsten op een meer gedetailleerd niveau openbaar gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over de campagne “Iedereen doet Wat”

MPs Boucke and De Groot ask why reducing meat consumption was dropped from the 'Iedereen doet wat' climate campaign despite internal documents treating it as low-threshold, and why flying less is omitted, and who is responsible among ministries. The state secretary answers by pointing to the campaign's positive-behaviour-change approach and the ministries' shared responsibility, without fully explaining the March 2019 decision or the ministry's arguments for dropping the measure.
Can you answer these questions separately?
Vraag 13 Kunt u deze vragen los beantwoorden?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Stikstofdeal met zes boeren die stoppen, A15 kan volgens ministerie daardoor alsnog doorgaan’ in de Gelderlander

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether deals with six livestock farmers allow the A15 extension to proceed despite the 25-km nitrogen limit, and why farms were bought out where external netting is not permitted. The minister confirmed agreements were signed (some before the 25-km rule was set), stated only businesses with a realised capacity were included, cited the Rijk's lifted netting limits and the province's permit withdrawal, and said no irreversible steps will be taken until the Raad van State rules.
Are you willing to take no irreversible steps on the A15 until this has been discussed in the House of Representatives during the MIRT committee consultation?
Bent u bereid geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten op de A15 tot hierover is gesproken in de Tweede Kamer tijdens het notaoverleg MIRT?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Milieuorganisaties vrezen dat nieuwe gasboringen oesterbank bij ‘Schier’ vernielen'

MPs De Groot and Boucke asked whether planned gas drilling north of Schier could damage an oyster restoration project and how this fits the North Sea Agreement and Natura 2000 rules. The minister answers that extensive assessments found no significant harm, that permits contain safeguards, and that definitive decision-making follows after objections are processed.
The concerns of the environmental organisations were raised in consultation responses. The consultation responses and advice will be taken into account in the definitive decision-making.
De zorgen van de milieuorganisaties zijn naar voren gebracht in inspraakreacties. De inspraakreacties en adviezen worden meegenomen bij de definitieve besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over 'De miljarden die de Rotterdamse haven misloopt door de stikstofcrisis'

An MP asked whether the nitrogen policy is sufficient to address the Rotterdam port's missed sustainable investments, how many investments were lost and how many permits granted, what nitrogen space exists, and whether Project Mainportontwikkeling Rotterdam compensation is complete. The minister acknowledged investment concerns, said the total lost investment cannot be stated because firms are reticent, pointed to a facet plan due end 2021 and to ongoing analysis of Voordelta compensation, and said permit data lies with the province.
I therefore cannot give a conclusive answer to the question of how many sustainable investments the Rotterdam port has missed due to the nitrogen problem.
Ik kan daarom geen sluitend antwoord geven op de vraag hoeveel duurzame investeringen de Rotterdamse Haven is misgelopen door de stikstofproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Dierenwelzijnsorganisatie wil verkoop van acht dolfijnen aan China tegenhouden'

An MP asked the minister how animal welfare is guaranteed for dolphins sold to a Chinese park, whether checks are made on receiving facilities, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that welfare is paramount, that the zoo must show welfare is secured at the destination under the Besluit houders van dieren, and that talks with the Dolfinarium are ongoing; several answers referred to earlier answers.
I will ensure that the Dolfinarium complies with this.
Ik zal erop toezien dat het Dolfinarium zich hieraan houdt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de berichten ‘Te ruime regels voor stikstofhandel gevaar voor toch al overbelaste natuur’ en ‘Nieuwe vergunningsregels bieden ruimte voor meer stikstofuitstoot’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether extensive unused nitrogen permit space enables external netting that could increase nitrogen emissions and harm nature, and questions the Nieuwkoop pilot and the reinstated external netting rules. The minister answers that external netting only uses actually realised capacity with 30% deducted, that emissions generally fall, that data on latent space is lacking, and that she is exploring with the provinces how to prevent emission increases.
I have no insight into the extent of latent space in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de omvang van de latente ruimte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over het bericht ‘IJzeretende bacterie gevonden in Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of an iron-eating bacterium in the Ghent-Terneuzen canal, its risks to ships and dams, whether it has reached the Dutch side, and whether the canal should be closed. The minister answered that no damage on the Dutch side is known yet, that Rijkswaterstaat will inspect locations with results expected in October, and that closure is not an option, while cooperation with Flanders on the cause is ongoing.
Rijkswaterstaat will participate in the investigation announced by Flanders and carry out targeted inspections itself.
Rijkswaterstaat zal participeren in het onderzoek dat Vlaanderen heeft aangekondigd en zelf gerichte inspecties uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de vervolgacties naar aanleiding van het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof

An MP asked the minister whether the 25 km cut-off for nitrogen deposition calculations is justified given RIVM findings, whether emissions beyond that distance still harm nature, and whether it creates a threshold favouring large 'peak' emitters. The minister answered that no clear model break exists but 25 km is a defensible limit where deposition is reasonably attributable to a project, that surrounding nature is protected through the structural nitrogen approach and extra source measures, and that no drempelwaarde is introduced.
25 kilometres is the maximum distance up to which calculated deposition contributions are reasonably attributable to a project.
25 kilometer is de maximale afstand tot waar berekende depositiebijdragen redelijkerwijs toerekenbaar zijn aan een project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht Exotische huisdieren blijken reservoir van zoönosen

An MP asked the minister about an AAP report finding zoonoses in exotic pets and the adequacy of EU animal health rules, and about a positive list for pets. The minister said the risk is not yet assessed, that EU rules focus on trade and disease listing with the Animal Health Regulation addressing zoonoses, and promised a review of a possible ban on trade in certain species and the advisory list for mammals this autumn.
I cannot currently form a judgement on the portion (one in ten) of non-domesticated species reported by Stichting AAP where zoonoses were found.
Ik kan op dit moment geen oordeel vormen over het door Stichting AAP genoemde gedeelte (één op de tien) van niet-gedomesticeerde diersoorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over ‘Uiterlijk 16 juli besluit over heropening Gosschalk’ en ‘Slachthuis Gosschalk blijkt onverbeterlijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the reopening of slaughterhouse Gosschalk after animal welfare abuses, including whether the plant could realistically fix problems in such a short time, staff training, slaughter speed, past enforcement failures, and whether it should be permanently closed. The Minister answered that the NVWA reopened the plant under intensified supervision after the fifth plan of action was found sufficient, and that the slaughter speed is being restricted in a phased way pending further research.
With my letter today I inform the House that the NVWA will lift the suspension of the slaughterhouse's approval with effect from 31 August.
Met mijn brief van heden informeer ik uw Kamer dat de NVWA met ingang van 31 augustus a.s. de schorsing van de erkenning als slachthuis opheft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en De Groot over het bericht ‘Chemelot mag 14.000 kilo microplastics per jaar in de Maas lozen’

MPs De Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether the water permit allowing Chemelot to discharge about 14,040 kg of microplastics per year into the Maas is compatible with environmental and health protection, the precautionary principle, the Water Framework Directive and BBT, and how oversight works. The minister answers that the permit is the competence of the Limburg water board, that a research obligation with a report due January 2024 was included, and mostly refers back to earlier answers, committing to no new concrete action.
The competent authority is responsible for supervising the permits issued.
Het bevoegd gezag is verantwoordelijk voor het houden van toezicht op de afgegeven vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Kan zonnebrand koraal aantasten?’

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that sunscreen chemicals harm coral, the Bonaire ban on oxybenzone-containing products, and whether Dutch waters are polluted by UV filters. The minister acknowledged the Bonaire motion and the need for regulation, said UV-filter levels in Dutch surface water were below reporting limits, noted monitoring around the BES islands is planned, and pointed to ongoing EU REACH assessments of octinoxate and oxybenzone without committing to new national measures.
A monitoring programme around the BES islands is currently being prepared and will likely start in 2022.
Op dit moment wordt een monitoringsprogramma rond de BES-eilanden voorbereid dat waarschijnlijk in 2022 van start kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Vaarweg naar Stellendam gevaarlijk voor schepen: ‘Hier kunnen doden vallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Slijkgat shipping channel to Stellendam is silting up and dangerous for boats, and why this has not been fixed despite an accident in April. The minister answered that there is no current danger, that the channel can silt up quickly under high river discharge, that Rijkswaterstaat dredges and re-buoys it and will look at faster communication to recreational shipping, and that responsibility for the 5.5 m depth is shared between Rijkswaterstaat and the Port of Rotterdam under an agreement.
Rijkswaterstaat will look at whether communication can be sped up and/or recreational shipping better informed in advance about the unpredictability of the Slijkgat.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt of de communicatie nog kan worden versneld en/of de scheepvaart, met name de recreatievaart, vooraf beter geïnformeerd kan worden over de grilligheid van het Slijkgat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht `Steekproef- Veel vishandelaren maken er een potje van en informeren hun klanten slecht'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Consumentenbond survey finding that most fishmongers fail to give required product information and rarely carry sustainability labels, including inspection frequency and enforcement plans. The minister answered that labelling duties are partly EU-mandated, that NVWA inspections focus on food safety every two to three years, that no enforcement action is warranted, and that the sector will be encouraged to improve information provision.
Violations of the statutory labelling obligations under the Common Market Organisation pose no risk to the safety or health of people, animals or the ecosystem.
Overtredingen op de wettelijke etiketteringsverplichtingen uit de Gemeenschappelijke Marktordening, leveren geen risico op voor veiligheid of gezondheid van mensen, dieren of het ecosysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Veehouderij schrikt van vondst giftige schimmel in partij veevoer'

The MP asked the minister about aflatoxin found in animal feed, including why detection took a month, how contaminated feed and milk were handled, and how imported feed and certificates are controlled. The minister answered that a routine quarterly sector sampling found the contamination, that affected feed and milk were blocked and milk was excluded where limits were exceeded, and that NVWA and COKZ oversight applies.
Based on the dilutions in farm milk, the NVWA was able to estimate that the limits were not exceeded in the final consumption milk.
De NVWA heeft op basis van de verdunningen in boerderijmelk kunnen inschatten dat de limieten niet werden overschreden in de uiteindelijke consumptiemelk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het toevoegen van illegale middelen aan traditionele medicijnen

Two MPs asked the ministers about illegal painkillers (paracetamol, meloxicam) found in the herbal supplement Montalin sold in Dutch webshops, the trade in endangered species in traditional medicines, and the need for follow-up research into the goods flow. The minister confirmed that the NVWA inspected five webshops, which stopped selling Montalin, that samples are being tested, and that follow-up research into the goods flow is complex and is being handled through existing NVWA and customs efforts.
The NVWA immediately started an investigation into the sale of Montalin in the Netherlands.
De NVWA is direct een onderzoek gestart naar de verkoop van Montalin in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Geen Q-koortsvergoeding voor een op de vijf slachtoffers'

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about roughly 600 rejected Q-fever compensation applications (about 20%) and whether applicants were wrongly excluded. The minister replied that rejected applicants did not meet the eligibility criteria, that the scheme was broadened after consultation with parliament, and that appeal procedures and an independent medical commission already reviewed the refusals.
For the rejected applications, objection and appeal procedures were available.
Voor de afgewezen aanvragen heeft er bezwaar en beroep opengestaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Paternotte over de brandbrief van de Ondernemingsraad KDS en het FNV over het stijgend aantal besmettingen in slachthuizen en het niet naleven van de coronamaatregelen

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked ministers about a works council letter reporting rising COVID-19 infections in slaughterhouses, non-compliance with measures, and weak NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the NVWA and inspectorates use an escalation ladder, including halting inspections, and that the Apeldoorn slaughterhouse was closed temporarily and restarted under conditions, while stating she finds the reported conduct undesirable and commits to continued close monitoring.
I do not recognise that these concerns are widely shared among employees in the food industry.
Ik herken niet dat die zorgen breed gedeeld worden bij medewerkers in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Vrachtschip verliest ten noorden van Ameland vijf containers'

An MP from D66 asked the minister, after the Baltic Tern lost five containers north of Ameland, why the Coast Guard has not yet been given binding guidance powers, whether contingency plans exist, and how Germany and Denmark were engaged. The minister answered that route guidance is complex and requires international coordination, that the Coast Guard lacks capacity to warn feeders, that an inspection and criminal investigation are underway, and that a progress letter will follow before the 2 June hearing.
The instrument of traffic guidance is far-reaching and complex, and requires international coordination.
Het instrument van verkeersbegeleiding is ingrijpend en complex, en vraagt om internationale afstemming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over vertragingen bij de herbeoordeling van TVL-aanvragen

MPs Romke de Jong and Tjeerd de Groot asked about delays in re-assessing TVL aid objections caused by SBI-code problems, including progress, the Q4 2020 backlog, sailing-vessel skippers, and the application form. The State Secretary answered that 97.5% of re-assessments are done, the remainder will follow shortly, RVO has added capacity to prioritise these cases, and the system was adjusted so entrepreneurs see the correct SBI code.
The objections relating to the SBI problem are being handled with priority, also because of the effect on an application in the next application period.
De bezwaren die betrekking hebben op de SBI-problematiek worden met voorrang opgepakt, ook vanwege het effect op een aanvraag de volgende aanvraagperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Toezichthouder NVWA stond kwekers het gebruik van een verboden middel toe'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that the food safety inspectorate NVWA tolerated illegal use of the plant-protection agent V10 by tomato growers, and why nothing was done for years. The minister answered that inspectors and the predecessor plant health service repeatedly warned about restricted use, that enforcement was limited, and that an external expert will examine how the matter was handled.
I will ask the external expert to investigate how this was handled with regard to V10.
Ik zal de externe deskundige vragen te onderzoeken op welke wijze dit ten aanzien van V10 gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en De Groot over het ILT-onderzoeksrapport Stichting Waternet

Two D66 MPs asked the minister how she assesses the ILT finding of an elevated, hard-to-quantify cyber risk to drinking water at Waternet, whether that risk is acceptable under intensified supervision, what will speed up remedies, whether governance is examined, and what other steps are taken. The minister answered that Waternet was placed under intensified ILT supervision, submitted an improvement plan, that the ILT will monitor it, and that responsibility for risk acceptance primarily lies with Waternet's board and the municipality of Amsterdam.
It is now up to the ILT to actively monitor the implementation of the improvement plan within the framework of intensified supervision.
Het is nu aan de ILT om in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht de uitvoering van het verbeterplan actief te bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de schepen met vee die vast kwamen te zitten bij het Suezkanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about livestock ships stuck at the Suez Canal, asking whether Dutch traders were involved, whether NVWA permits were issued, how the export ban on live animals applies to sea transport, and whether sea transports should be banned in the EU transport regulation. The Minister answered most questions substantively, stated that Dutch involvement is unknown, that a sea-transport ban on export is not possible under current rules, and that a Council discussion will follow.
It is possible that Dutch traders were involved, but I have no insight into this.
Het is mogelijk dat er Nederlandse handelaren betrokken waren maar daar heb ik geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Tata Steel overtreedt opnieuw milieuregels: loost zonder vergunning kwik in het riool'

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about press reports that Tata Steel discharged mercury into the sewer without a permit, and about an Omgevingsdienst letter demanding incomplete emissions data. The minister replied that the data are still under assessment by the competent authority, that the discharge is not expected to cause additional harm, and that the company must supply missing data within set deadlines.
I will inform you as soon as a judgement has been made on this.
Ik zal u informeren zodra hierover geoordeeld is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Tjeerd de Groot en Wuite over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about delayed and narrowly defined support for the historic sailing 'bruine vloot' affected by the COVID-19 crisis, including why advance payments are not possible and why ideal-purpose and other heritage vessels are excluded. The state secretary answered that existing TOGS/TVL schemes fit these entrepreneurs, that advances are legally barred, that the dedicated scheme targets commercial sailing ships aged 50+ under specific SBI codes, and that opening is still expected by end of the second quarter 2021 pending European Commission approval.
It is not possible to pay advances before a scheme is published because under the General Administrative Law Act subsidies may only be granted on the basis of a statutory provision.

Het is niet mogelijk voorschotten uit te betalen voorafgaand aan publicatie van een regeling omdat volgens de Algemene wet bestuursrecht subsidies alleen op grond van een wettelijk voorschrift mogen worden verstrekt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de Puppy Express

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the 'Puppy-Express.nl' campaign offering home delivery of puppies, its welfare risks, missing seller information, and the surge in impulse and illegal puppy purchases during the coronavirus crisis. The minister answered that the site was a House of Animals awareness campaign with no animals actually sold, that NVWA inspections and Marktplaats agreements exist, and that a mandatory cooling-off period for pet purchases is being studied.
I am also examining whether and how a mandatory cooling-off period for pet purchases could help reduce impulse purchases of animals.
Ik ben ook aan het onderzoeken of en hoe een verplichte bedenktijd voor de aanschaf van huisdieren bij kan dragen aan het terugdringen van het aantal impulsaankopen van dieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het Westnijlvirus en de tijgermug

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA withholds business names and precise coordinates of exotic mosquito finds, why counts are published only annually, and why the website omits some species, despite a Council of State ruling on public access. The minister answered that the NVWA publishes finds at neighbourhood level under the ruling, that counts are given annually to avoid misleading alarm, and that the website covers all designated vector species, but did not supply the requested historical data beyond an annex and disputed the applicability of the ruling to enforcement requests.
The NVWA actively publishes information on mosquito finds at neighbourhood level.
De NVWA maakt actief informatie openbaar van de muggenvondsten op wijkniveau.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot en Diertens (beiden D66) over de berichten ‘Verzet tegen nieuwe vrachthaven Bonaire, aanleg zou ‘ecocide’ zijn’ en het bericht ‘conservebonaire.org opposes Hato port’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that a proposed new cargo port on Bonaire would harm the coral reef, its financing, environmental impact assessment, and transparency. The minister answered that no decision to build a port has been taken, that feasibility studies and an MER are still pending and will be shared later, and that the island council (Bestuurscollege) is responsible for the decision.
For now, there is no decision to build a new cargo port (location).
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van een besluit tot het bouwen van een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Noodkreet sectoren: zonder groene middelen, geen vergroening’

An MP asked the minister about long assessment waits at the Ctgb for low-risk and biological plant protection products, and whether the transition to such products is being delayed. The minister acknowledged limited EU assessment capacity, said the Ctgb has already accepted many new biological substance and product applications for coming years, and described ongoing efforts such as the Green Team and EU simplification advocacy.

The Ctgb has already accepted a considerable number of applications for new substances and new products as rapporteur member state for the coming years and included them in the planning, including many new biological substances and products.

Het Ctgb heeft voor de komende jaren al een behoorlijk aantal aanvragen voor nieuwe stoffen en nieuwe middelen als rapporterend lidstaat geaccepteerd en in de planning opgenomen, waaronder veel nieuwe biologische stoffen en middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Nieuwkoopse stikstofboeren krijgen tonnen subsidie van minister Schouten voor project - 'Dit moeten we een kans geven''

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a pilot in which Nieuwkoopse dairy farmers receive subsidy for low-emission farming and may lease out nitrogen emission space to other businesses, questioning whether this undermines emission ceilings, the 70% rule, and the level playing field. The minister answered that the pilot is designed so 44% of the gains go permanently to nature, that subsidy targets knowledge rather than physical measures, and that the pilot will test whether leasing creates a viable model.
What is important here is that not all of the profit gained through innovation will be offset, but 56% of it.
Van belang daarbij is dat niet de volledige door innovatie verkregen winst zal worden gesaldeerd, maar 56% hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over vangletsel bij kippen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the NVWA's enforcement on catching injuries to chickens is adequate, given that the catching method by the legs may breach EU transport rules and that enforcement uses a 2% intervention threshold. The minister said the transport rules are unclear on catching by the legs, that NVWA does not enforce during catching due to limited capacity, and that a 2% threshold is applied in line with realistic practice, while promising a public-private research project on catching injuries.
The NVWA is not present during the catching of chickens and carries out spot-check, risk-based inspections for catching injuries at the slaughterhouses.
De NVWA is niet aanwezig bij het vangen van kippen en voert in de slachthuizen steekproefsgewijs en risicogericht inspecties op vangletsel uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over de tegemoetkoming aan de leveranciers van schoolfruit

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture about compensation for school fruit suppliers who lost income during the first COVID-19 school closures, and about longer supplier recognition periods. The minister said only about 148,000 euro had been paid for documented costs against roughly 600,000 euro claimed, pointed to national support schemes, and said the recognition duration will be reconsidered when the scheme is revised, without committing to compensation.
I am awaiting the results of this study.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de brandbrief van Dier & Recht over ‘extreem gebruik van antibiotica door ongezonde kalversector’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a Dier & Recht letter claiming antibiotic use in the veal sector remains excessive and asked about ESBL bacteria, reduction options, and the sector's targets. The Minister answered that antibiotic use fell 51% since 2009, that ESBL prevalence is still high and further study is commissioned, and that the sector is implementing agreed reduction measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘BAM sloopt koraalrif en de Curaçaose overheid haalt de schouders op’

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about BAM's damage to a coral reef on Curaçao and whether BAM can be held accountable in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the matter is a Curaçao responsibility, that Curaçao has sued BAM for compensation, and that the Dutch government expects companies to follow OECD guidelines, while no concrete Dutch action was announced.
It is up to the Curaçao government to hold the construction company responsible for the damage it has caused.
Het is aan de Curaçaose overheid om het bouwbedrijf verantwoordelijk te stellen voor de schade die zij hebben aangericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sjoerdsma over ‘De quota worden duur betaald‘

D66 MPs asked whether PM Rutte threatened the EU-Faroe trade relationship in 2017 to block a Faroese fisheries law affecting Dutch quota holdings, and questioned the government's intervention and the role of an honorary consul with fishing interests. The government denied an explicit threat, said it raised concerns via bilateral contacts and the EU, declined to publish conversation reports, and defended the honorary consul's appointment as serving Dutch economic interests.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vattenfall mag in de Maas doorgaan met massaal vermalen van vissen'

D66 MPs Schonis and De Groot asked about fish mortality at Vattenfall's Maas hydropower plants (Lith, Linne), eel survival, the legal footing of the 10% mortality norm after a Council of State ruling, and Rijkswaterstaat's remedies. The minister acknowledged substantial eel and smolt mortality, said the 10% norm can no longer be applied without legal anchoring after the Council of State ruling, and committed to restoring the permit framework and reporting to parliament by June 2021.
Unlike before, however, the Council of State has in a recent ruling held that the 10% norm can no longer be applied without further legal anchoring.
Anders dan voorheen heeft de Raad van State in een recente uitspraak echter geoordeeld dat die 10%-norm niet meer zonder nadere juridische verankering gehanteerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over vismonitoring in het Eems estuarium

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the government would expand fish monitoring frequency in the Ems estuary, following a Waddenvereniging pilot showing year-round sampling gives a fuller picture. The minister answered that monitoring is under evaluation by Rijkswaterstaat, with results expected end 2021, and that the current frequency meets KRW requirements.
Based on the outcomes, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management will decide whether the monitoring programme needs to be adjusted.
Op basis van de uitkomsten besluit de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat of het monitoringsprogramma aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over satellietgegevens landbouwgrond

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how farmers report parcels to RVO for subsidies, how satellite and aerial checks work, whether natural-inclusive farming and trees in pastures are correctly classified, and whether farmers can receive pre-filled satellite data. The minister explained the Gecombineerde Opgave process, controls and payment timelines, said natural-inclusive farming cannot be recognised by satellites, and committed to pursuing more national flexibility in the new CAP.
I agree with Mr De Groot that natural-inclusive farming can make an important contribution to multiple goals in the agricultural area.
Ik ben het met het lid de Groot eens dat natuurinclusieve landbouw een belangrijke bijdrage kan leveren aan meerdere doelen in het agrarisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het bericht 'Wereldleiders willen ambitieuzere aanpak natuurverlies: 'We hebben geen moment te verliezen'

MPs De Groot and Jetten asked the Prime Minister about the outcome of the One Planet Summit, whether the Netherlands joined the 30% land and sea protection goal ahead of the Kunming biodiversity summit, the link between biodiversity loss and COVID-19, and how the Jetten/De Groot motion was followed up. The Prime Minister answered that the summit built momentum, that the Netherlands joined the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People, that the zoonosis link is acknowledged by researchers but the SARS-CoV-2 origin is not settled, and that the summit contributed to implementing the motion.
The Netherlands has become a member of the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Nederland is lid geworden van de High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de veiligheid van medewerkers bij de NVWA

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister about NVWA staff from animal welfare teams who feel misrepresented by an internal report, reports of intimidation for contacting politicians, and how confidential report passages became identifiable and public. The minister confirmed staff concerns, said contact with politicians is not forbidden but issues should first be raised internally, announced an external integrity commission with its own complaints point, and released the report for transparency despite identifiable passages.
In addition to these existing internal procedures, I am establishing an external integrity commission with its own reporting point.
Naast deze bestaande interne procedures stel ik een externe integriteitscommissie in met een eigen meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Vogelgriep bij pluimveebedrijf in Hekendorp'

MP De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a bird flu outbreak at a poultry farm in Hekendorp, near housing, including the number of birds culled, neighbour nuisance, and schemes for sanitation or conversion to circular farming. The minister confirmed about 120,242 chickens were culled, said local authorities handle nuisance and siting, declined to comment on individual cases, and listed general subsidy schemes but no national scheme specifically for odour nuisance from poultry farms.
Local authorities are responsible for policy on the siting of poultry farms and housing and for taking measures in case of nuisance.
Lokale overheden zijn verantwoordelijk voor het beleid ten aanzien van de vestiging van pluimveebedrijven en woningen en voor het nemen van maatregelen bij eventuele hinder.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, De Groot, Graus, Bromet, Futselaar en Moorlag over het opnemen van de haas en het konijn op de lijst bedreigde zoogdieren, terwijl beide nog steeds bejaagd worden

MPs from six parties asked the minister why the hare and rabbit, newly listed as threatened on the Red List of mammals, may still be hunted, and whether they will be removed from the huntable species list. The minister answered that both are listed as 'sensitive' rather than threatened, that the hunting season for hares has ended and for rabbits ends in January, and that research on population decline and hunting effects will be commissioned, with possible further protection measures to follow.
Next year I will have further research carried out into the decline of these species.
Het komende jaar zal ik verder onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de afname van deze soorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en De Groot over het bericht dat er wensballonnen in omloop zijn die niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen.

Two D66 MPs asked ministers whether sales of wish balloons that fail safety rules are rising during the fireworks ban, and what enforcement and public information exist. The government replied that it has no data on rising sales, that the NVWA enforces product safety rules and that municipalities may ban releases, while placing responsibility for safe use on consumers.
I am not aware whether sales of these products are increasing, because the NVWA has not carried out any research into this.
Het is mij niet bekend of er een toename is in de verkoop van deze producten omdat daar door de NVWA geen onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het artikel 'Eerste besmetting met westnijlvirus in Nederland'

D66 MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the ministers about the first human West Nile virus infection in the Netherlands, expected case numbers, measures against mosquitoes, and a letter warning about the tiger mosquito. The minister said case forecasts are not possible, mosquito control for West Nile is still under study with a first advice expected in December, and the tiger mosquito is unrelated to West Nile transmission and is already being eradicated by the NVWA.
A first advice from the zoonoses response team is expected at the beginning of December.
Begin december wordt een eerste advies verwacht vanuit het responsteam zoönosen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over de relatie tussen besmetting met de parasiet Toxoplasma gondii en het risico op ongevallen en geestelijke aandoeningen

MPs Diertsen and De Groot asked whether Toxoplasma gondii infection is linked to traffic accidents and mental disorders, what is known about infection rates and prevention in the Netherlands, and whether prevention is proportionate. The minister answered that the associations are not causal, that the Dutch evidence finds no link to depression or anxiety, and that current prevention and consumer advice are the best feasible approach, with a committed cost-benefit review and a meat-safety project underway.
It therefore cannot be concluded that toxoplasmosis increases the chance of being involved in a traffic accident.
Er kan dus niet worden geconcludeerd dat toxoplasmose de kans vergroot om betrokken te raken bij een verkeersongeval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Groot over de artikelen ‘Waar kalkoenen klokken zwijgen de hijskranen’ en ‘Helaas het stikstofprobleem is niet opgelost met het uitkopen van 25 piekbelasters al helpt het wel’

MPs Bromet and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about nitrogen 'peak emitters' near Natura 2000 areas, the targeted buy-out scheme, a Gelderland study and provincial roles. The minister answered that provinces control targeting and timing, that the evaluation of the first tranche will guide future steps, and declined to give some data (such as the number of applicants) until spring 2021; she also failed to complete answers to questions 16 and 17 on time.
I am not aware whether these companies are aware of this.
Het is mij niet bekend of deze bedrijven hier van op de hoogte zijn.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Veldman en De Groot over het bericht ‘SARS-CoV-2 mink-associated variant strain – Denmark’

MPs Veldman and De Groot asked how the Netherlands responded to reports of a mink-associated SARS-CoV-2 variant in Denmark, what steps follow, whether the WHO call for sequencing and data sharing was followed, whether Dutch capacity exists, and whether further mutations are expected. The minister answered that RIVM contacted Danish researchers, advice went to the ministries, sequencing already occurs in the Netherlands and data are shared, capacity exists, and mutations are a natural phenomenon detected by sequencing.
Sequencing of the virus already takes place in the Netherlands, both for virus strains found in humans and in mink.
Sequencen van het virus gebeurt al in Nederland, zowel bij virusstammen gevonden bij mensen als bij nertsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Deze supermarkten stunten nog steeds met varkenshaasjes’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that supermarkets still promote pork tenderloin without the Beter Leven quality mark, despite a voluntary agreement, and whether the Minister will hold them to account. The Minister answered that the agreement is between private chain parties, that she cannot verify the figures or whether the agreement is kept, and that she will discuss progress with supermarkets and report on a sustainability reporting standard before summer 2021.
This concerns an agreement that chain parties have made among themselves.
Dit gaat om een afspraak die ketenpartijen onderling met elkaar gemaakt hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over EKO1000-vallen voor ratten en muizen

An MP asked the minister whether EKO1000 rat and mouse traps cause unnecessary suffering, whether the sedative liquid was approved by the Ctgb, and whether the traps may still be sold and what enforcement the ILT has taken. The minister answered that no scientific evidence shows unnecessary suffering, that WUR research is commissioned with a report due Q4 2021, that the liquid lacks Ctgb approval and is not permitted, and that the importer has stopped sales while others still offer it online.

Enquiries with Wageningen University & Research (WUR) and the Pest Animal Knowledge and Advice Centre show that there is no scientific research data on the basis of which it can be concluded that the EKO1000 trap causes unnecessary suffering.

Navraag bij Wageningen University & Research (WUR) en het Kennis- en Adviescentrum Dierplagen leert dat er geen wetenschappelijke onderzoeksgegevens beschikbaar zijn op basis waarvan geconcludeerd kan worden dat de EKO1000-val leidt tot onnodig lijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht 'Olieplatform verbrijzelt koraalrif op Curaçao – en daarna werd het stil'

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a reported oil platform that damaged coral reef off Curaçao in 2017 and 2019, including whether Dutch assistance would be offered and what rules have changed. The State Secretary answered that the matter is the responsibility of the Curaçao government, that no assistance has been requested, that no safety rules have changed yet, and that the investigation is still ongoing.
No assistance has been requested from the Netherlands.
Er is geen assistentie gevraagd aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Extreem gevoelig; Corona besmettingen op nertsenfokkerijen’

The MP De Groot asked the Agriculture Minister about reports of COVID-19 infections on mink farms, including questions on hygiene protocols, screening timing, worker testing, escaped minks and possible intentional infection. The minister answered that the transmission route is unknown, that hygiene measures are adequately followed, that the NVWA-IOD found no evidence of intentional infection, and that the investigation was closed.
I can only repeat that the researchers of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine have not yet been able to determine how the virus spreads between mink farms.
Ik kan slechts herhalen dat de onderzoekers van de Faculteit Diergeneeskunde bij het onderzoek naar de insleeproutes nog niet hebben kunnen achterhalen hoe het virus spreidt tussen nertsenbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Dierenbeschermers willen verbod op reptielenbeurs in Houten: ‘Kan in coronatijd niet door de beugel’’

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Health about a reptile fair in Houten held during the coronavirus crisis, including exotic species, possible zoonotic risks, legality of origin and enforcement by the NVWA. The minister replied that neither the Besluit houders van dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid allows preventive bans on animal fairs, that inspections and enforcement are carried out, and declined to answer the questions again in the committee debate.
Neither the Besluit houders van dieren under the Wet Dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid grants powers to preventively prohibit animal fairs.
Noch het Besluit houders van dieren onder de Wet Dieren, noch de Wet publieke gezondheid geeft bevoegdheden om beurzen met dieren preventief te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en De Groot over het bericht ‘Fundering van 1 miljoen huizen bedreigd door laag grondwaterpeil’

MPs Van Eijs and De Groot (D66) asked about a report that about 1 million homes risk foundation damage from low groundwater, and about the responsibilities of water boards, farmers, municipalities and the state. The Minister answered that the damage estimate is per owner and largely modest, that government supports owners through viewers, funding funds and knowledge centres, and that owners are responsible for their foundations, while referring several questions to other levels and ministries.
This problem does not primarily lie with the water boards.
Deze problematiek ligt niet primair bij de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoek: Sjoemelende boeren. Ten koste van mens en milieu’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about a newspaper report alleging that farmers cheat on animal and manure rights, and about discrepancies between RVO herd figures, permits and satellite-measured nitrogen deposition. The Minister answered that the CDM advice confirms low-emission stables do not always deliver expected reductions, that existing enforcement powers are adequate, that the rVDM monitoring system is being pursued, and that no additional action is needed on this specific report.
I see no reason to take additional action following this specific article.
Ik zie naar aanleiding van dit specifieke artikel geen reden om aanvullende actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en De Groot over het bericht dat een onomkeerbare ontwikkeling van regenwoud naar savanne dreigt voor de Amazone

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government is aware of a study warning the Amazon is nearing a tipping point toward savannah, whether this warrants intensified forest protection, and what measures can keep deforestation-linked products out of the European market. The minister confirmed the study fits earlier warnings, said Dutch forest efforts were stepped up this year and will continue, pointed to EU-level legislative and non-legislative work on deforestation-free supply chains, and reported that Brazil has agreed to dialogue following the Amsterdam Declarations Partnership letter.

Within the European Union, legislative and non-legislative measures are being developed, partly under the Green Deal, to help reduce the ecological footprint of EU consumption and make supply chains deforestation-free.

Binnen de Europese Unie wordt, mede in het kader van de Green Deal, gewerkt aan wetgevende en niet-wetgevende maatregelen, die helpen bij het verkleinen van de ecologische voetafdruk van de EU-consumptie en het ontbossingsvrij maken van handelsketens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Beukering-Huijbrechts over de berichten ‘Slachthuis mocht openblijven ondanks vele coronabesmettingen’ en ‘Dit is waarom slachthuis Vion open mocht blijven ondanks de vele

Two D66 MPs asked why slaughterhouses Vion and Rooi Meat were allowed to stay open despite many COVID-19 infections, including why the safety region did not intervene at Rooi Meat when staffing exceeded the agreed level and why the NVWA did not stop slaughter. The minister answered that the safety region weighed the case, issued a warning rather than a sanction, deemed the situation safe, and that NVWA had no reason to halt operations, while promising to inform parliament on sector talks and noting a new national coordination platform.
The chair of the safety region weighed the situation and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction.
De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Belhaj en De Groot over munitiedumps in de Deltawateren en Noordzeekust

Three D66 MPs asked the government about the munitions dump in the Oosterschelde and North Sea sites, including the risks, monitoring, clean-up or capping costs, and whether a dedicated management fund exists. The government answered that research results will be sent to parliament in 2021, that monitoring shows no danger, that no clean-up or capping is planned under current assessments, and that only existing monitoring budgets are available.
The results will then be submitted to your House in 2021.
De resultaten worden dan in 2021 aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de staat van de Waddenecologie

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about invasive alien species in the Wadden Sea, their ecological and economic risks, climate change effects, and the Waddenvereniging's criticism of the Wadden 2050 agenda. The minister answered that monitoring and a trilateral action plan are in place, that no specific species currently cause concern, and that climate and ecosystem measures will follow in the implementation programme, while noting no dedicated budget for exotic-species research in the agenda.
On my own initiative, I spoke with the director of the Waddenvereniging last summer.
Op mijn initiatief heb ik afgelopen zomer gesproken met de directeur van de Waddenvereniging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg , Futselaar, Bromet, De Groot, Moorlag en Graus over de onderbouwing voor de Nederlandse inzet voor de bescherming van honingbijen, hommels en wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for the scientific basis behind the Dutch position on protecting honeybees, bumblebees and wild bees in the EU bee guidance, including the BEEHAVE model, percentile choice, EFSA test runs and consultation of independent experts. The minister answered that the chosen option keeps colony size within natural variability, that the protection goal is still to be set, that a technical meeting is expected in late October, and that documents will be made public beforehand.
I will inform your House about this in advance of the meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan deze bijeenkomst daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, De Groot en Verhoeven over verlengen certificaten voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the ministers whether the brown fleet of historic sailing ships, facing low revenue and costs from extended safety certificates during COVID-19, deserves more help and further postponement of certificate inspections. The government answered that EUR 15 million has been made available to secure the fleet, that existing schemes also apply, and that inspections need not be postponed further, while leaving room to reconsider extensions case by case.
With the additional EUR 15 million now made available, it is moreover not expected that entrepreneurs will still choose to postpone inspections.
Met de aanvullende € 15 miljoen die nu beschikbaar is gesteld, is het bovendien niet te verwachten dat ondernemers er nog voor zullen kiezen om keuringen uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘NVWA nalatig na signalen over slachthuizen als 'corona-hotspot'’ en de uitzending ‘Nieuwsuur, seizoen 2020 Afl. 186

MP De Groot (D66) asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that the NVWA neglected warnings about unsafe conditions for workers in slaughterhouses during the coronavirus crisis, including vets feeling unheard, the adequacy of RIVM-guideline enforcement, management layers, and shift planning. The Minister rejects the characterisation of NVWA negligence, explains the internal survey, mask provision, letters to slaughterhouses and joint inspections with Inspectie SZW, and says an evaluation will come later without a set timeline.
I do not recognise the picture that the NVWA acted indifferently or negligently.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de NVWA onverschillig of nalatig heeft geopereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Weyenberg over het bericht 'Angstcultuur in vleessector: slachterijwerkers zwijgen opgelegd'

D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports of a fear culture in the meat sector, where migrant slaughterhouse workers feel threatened with dismissal if they report sick, and about hygiene, COVID-19 testing, and abusive temp agencies. The government acknowledges the dependency problem, points to existing inspection and reporting channels, and commits to advisory follow-up and a national cooperation platform, but gives mostly general answers and declines to reconsider the sampling-based testing approach.
The cooperation platform will be fully operational from 1 September.
Het samenwerkingsplatform is vanaf 1 september volledig operationeel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de berichten: ‘Flu virus with 'pandemic potential' found in China’ en ‘Zorgen in China over nieuwe griep, die mogelijk kan uitgroeien tot pandemie’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of a swine-origin H1N1 influenza virus with pandemic potential found in China and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister answered that existing zoonosis structures and hygiene protocols are adequate, the virus shows no sustained human-to-human transmission so far, and current vaccines do not work well against it, while WHO will assess whether a new vaccine is needed.
I informed your House about the COVID-19 lessons learned process in my letter of 15 June 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer over het proces t.a.v. COVID-19: «lessons learned» geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 15 juni 2020
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de verruimde vergunning voor garnalenvissers

MP De Groot (D66) asked whether shrimp fishing permits in Natura 2000 areas were expanded, how fishing speed and ecological impact were assessed, and whether a new appropriate assessment is needed. Minister Schouten answers that the permitted hours were recalculated and corrected via decisions on objection, that no new appropriate assessment is required, and that she sees no adverse ecological effects warranting intervention.
No, I refer to my answers to questions 5 and 6.
Nee, ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen 5 en 6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en De Groot over stikstofuitstoot

D66 MPs asked why provinces permitted two power plants to switch to biomass with higher nitrogen emissions by using intern salderen on old permits, and whether this conflicts with the government's nitrogen reduction goals. Minister Schouten defends the permits as lawful and within existing rules, says the new permits set lower maximum emissions, and declines to reopen or tighten permits or launch wider investigations.
I see no possibility to apply stricter policy or to further restrict permits that have become final in law.
Bovendien zie ik geen mogelijkheid om een strenger beleid te hanteren of in rechte vaststaande vergunningen verder in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over Het bericht ‘Experts: ‘Megaslachterij Vion zou gesloten moeten worden’

An MP asked the government why the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel stayed open despite high COVID-19 infection among workers, and about worker protection, testing and enforcement. The minister answered that closures are decided case by case by the safety region chair on GGD advice, that the causes of infection are not yet scientifically proven, and that enforcement and inspection measures are in place, without committing to closing slaughterhouses or a breeding ban.
It is up to the chair of the safety region, within infectious disease control, to take the most appropriate control measures case by case.
Het is aan de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio in het kader van infectieziektenbestrijding om per geval de meest geëigende (beheers)maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Pimpelmezen gaan massaal dood, net nu ze ons van de jeukrups moeten verlossen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of mass deaths of great tits and blue tits linked to the spraying agent Xentari used against oak processionary caterpillars, and whether the government would investigate, halt use, or take steps on the bird deaths and a related bacterium. The minister answered that Xentari was approved as safe for birds, that the reported 33% mortality was not supported by data, that no mass mortality or link to pest control was found, and that no measures were needed.
For the time being there is no mass mortality of great tits and blue tits in the Netherlands.
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van massale sterfte van kool- en pimpelmezen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en de Groot over het bericht ‘Koning krijgt ten onrechte subsidie voor het Loo’

MPs Sneller and De Groot asked whether the Minister knew of reports that the King receives subsidy for Het Loo despite exemptions from subsidy conditions, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the subsidy decision would be shared and the legal procedure monitored. The Minister confirmed knowledge, said the Chamber had been informed through budget debates and a letter, shared the subsidy decision as an attachment, defended the subsidy as lawfully granted, and committed to report on the court outcome and to inform the Chamber before any new subsidy is granted.
Yes. I have included the subsidy decision as an annex to this letter.
Ja. Ik heb de subsidiebeschikking als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de voedselveiligheid in de palingketen

An MP asks the minister about dioxin and PCB exceedances in eels caught near Urk in the IJsselmeer, including whether the catch should be banned, whether affected eels can be traced, and whether the area will be resampled. The minister answers that the area will be closed to fishing if exceedances recur this year, that eel quality elsewhere in the IJsselmeer meets limits except the Ketelmeer zone already closed, and that monitoring results are published.
If the results at Urk again show an exceedance of one of the limits this year, that area will be closed.
Indien de resultaten bij Urk dit jaar opnieuw een overschrijding van één van de limieten laten zien dan zal dat gebied worden gesloten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten 'Vleessector vindt kritiek op hygiëne in coronatijden niet terecht' en 'Schouder aan schouder aan de lopende band: slachterijen willen coronatests'

An MP from D66 asked ministers how food safety in meat processing is guaranteed during the coronavirus crisis, how infections among slaughterhouse workers are being prevented, and whether testing of workers should be done. The government answered that the NVWA keeps official meat inspection running as usual, that Inspectie SZW has issued guidance and accepts complaints, and that testing will be risk-based and phased in outbreak locations.
If the NVWA finds that slaughterhouses do not comply with all RIVM guidelines, no inspections take place.
Indien de NVWA constateert dat slachthuizen zich niet houden aan alle RIVM-richtlijnen vinden er geen keuringen plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het onderzoeksrapport van Investico over stalbranden

The MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about an Investico report on barn fires, their rising trend and animal deaths, and whether current fire-safety measures and larger barns are adequate. The Minister answers that the existing action plan is risk-based, notes a fall in fires and casualties since 2017, says no statistically significant link between barn size and fire risk has been found, and promises further measures in a forthcoming letter.

To further limit the number of barn fires and animal casualties, I have asked the partners of the Action Plan to examine which additional measures are possible and which existing measures can be accelerated.

Om het aantal stalbranden en dierlijke slachtoffers verder te beperken heb ik de partners van het Actieplan gevraagd om na te gaan welke aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk zijn en welke bestaande maatregelen versneld kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Weyenberg over de berichten: 'Coronaslachters Groenlo mogelijk aan het werk in plaats van in quarantaine' en 'Varkensstallen dreigen vol te raken door sluiting slachthuizen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports of Groenlo slaughterhouse workers possibly working while in quarantine, overcrowded pig stables due to slaughterhouse closures, and related labour, enforcement and animal welfare concerns. The government answered that the regional safety authorities and the NVWA/Inspectie SZW are responsible for enforcement, that a breeding ban is disproportionate, that borders cannot be closed to EU live animals, and that sectors will develop short-term scenarios.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht “Wederom kleuren Nederlandse akkers oranje-geel door gebruik van het omstreden middel glyfosaat”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report on glyphosate use on Dutch fields, whether EU directives allow a ban on glyphosate outside integrated pest management, and why Luxembourg could ban it. The Minister replied that a ban is not justified on current scientific grounds and would conflict with EU approval rules, but that a 'no, unless' policy will apply to specific uses agreed with the sector.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vergeten diesels blijken ernstige vervuilers'

MPs Schonis and De Groot asked whether a news report that diesel machines on construction sites emit far more nitrogen oxides than assumed is correct, and whether models like AERIUS underestimate deposition. The government confirms measured emissions of four machine types exceeded type-approval norms by 25% to 350%, has raised the emission factor and promised further measurements, but says full model impacts are not yet known.
I find it undesirable that emissions from mobile machinery in practice are higher than the official norm.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat de emissies van mobiele werktuigen in de praktijk hoger zijn dan de officiële norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sienot over de aanhoudende droogte, natuurbranden en het verband met het snel opwarmende klimaat

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about recurring drought, forest and nature fires in the Netherlands and Europe, their link to rapid warming, economic damage, prevention measures and whether the climate targets should be tightened. The minister answered that fire statistics only exist since 2017, that drought risk grows with warming, that prevention runs through regional fire-risk programmes and drought and adaptation policy, that the Copernicus report confirmed known trends without prompting a new European meeting, and that the Netherlands supports a higher EU 2030 target.
The Copernicus report has not given rise to organising a European meeting or to accelerating climate measures.
Het Copernicus-rapport is geen aanleiding geweest voor het organiseren van een Europees overleg of klimaatmaatregelen versneld kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over verdroging in Nederland

An MP from D66 asks the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about drought and groundwater lowering (verdroging) in the Netherlands, including irrigation by farmers, the influence of agriculture on water governance, the composition of water board boards, and follow-up on Beleidstafel Droogte recommendations. The minister responds that drought measures are in place, structural programmes are under way, and several studies (flexibilising groundwater permits, drinking water restrictions) will report in 2021, while stating that the question of guaranteed agricultural seats is left to an advisory commission.
I will send this advice to your House once the commission has presented it to me.
Ik zal dit advies, zodra de commissie het aan mij heeft aangeboden, aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Belangenverstrengeling zaait twijfels over giftig zaad’

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked whether industry co-funding of research on bee decline, pesticide approval studies and Wageningen University & Research (WUR) funding compromise independence, and whether pesticide studies should be public. The minister answered that the 2011 bee study was fully publicly funded, that WUR's private co-funding is limited and governed by integrity rules, that pesticide approval relies on company-funded but quality-checked studies with some publication, and that open access is a policy goal.
Underlying studies can be made public on request, within the limits of European and national legislation.
Onderliggende studies kunnen op verzoek openbaar worden gemaakt, binnen de grenzen van Europese en nationale wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten ‘Glyfosaatverbod in pachtcontract onwettelijk en ‘Brabant mag verbod glyfosaat eisen van pachters'

MP De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture whether a glyphosate ban in tenancy contracts by Brabant province and Gilze en Rijen municipality is lawful, why bans are allowed for short leases, and why the motion on glyphosate outside integrated crop protection has not been implemented. The Minister answered that the Central Land Tribunal allowed the Brabant one-year ban, the municipality is appealing a ruling against its ban, and an IPM step-plan inventory of alternatives to glyphosate is underway as the motion's implementation.
I am awaiting the ruling of the Central Land Tribunal in this case.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van de Centrale Grondkamer in deze casus af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Trillende handen, dementie, depressie: landbouwgif is zo onschuldig niet'

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about reported links between pesticides and Parkinson's and other neurological conditions, the Gezondheidsraad advice, EU action on mancozeb, and timing of the advice. The minister said she takes the concerns seriously, asked the Gezondheidsraad to examine health risks, requested the European Commission to revise neurological data requirements, and pressed the Commission to finalise the mancozeb decision, with the Gezondheidsraad advice expected in summer.

I expect the Gezondheidsraad advice on the health risks of exposure to crop protection products in the summer and will share it with your House, together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport and the Minister for Environment and Housing.

Ik verwacht het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de gezondheidsrisico's van blootstelling aan gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de zomer en zal dit, samen met de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport en de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen, met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Universiteit Wageningen ontdekt nieuwe methode onkruidbestrijding spoorbermen‘

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about a Wageningen University method for heat-treating excavated soil to kill Japanese knotweed roots, and whether ProRail's trial could use it and replace glyphosate. The minister answered that the method applies only to excavated soil, is impractical along railways, and that ProRail's pilots will test other techniques, with full phase-out of chemical herbicides by 2025 if pilots succeed.
If the pilots ProRail has underway are successful, ProRail is aiming for full phase-out in 2025.
Wanneer de pilots die ProRail in uitvoering heeft succesvol zijn, zet ProRail in op een volledige uitfasering in 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bouali over het bericht ‘Hoe aquaria wereldwijd het koraalrif bedreigen; Vissen op Nemo’s’

MPs De Groot and Bouali asked ministers about imports of tropical aquarium fish and coral through Schiphol, possible illegal wild capture, and EU enforcement under CITES. The minister answered with 2019 import figures for CITES-listed species, described CITES permit and customs controls, and said the EU and Switzerland and the US had proposed a CITES study of unprotected species trade.
For species not protected under CITES, no figures are available.
Voor de soorten die niet beschermd zijn onder CITES zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en De Groot over rechtswetenschappelijke onderzoek naar de Habitatrichtlijn en Vogelrichtlijn

MPs Groothuizen and De Groot asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a legal study on domestic cats and the EU Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether cat predation is a significant threat and how permits for trap-neuter-return programmes are handled. The minister answered that cat predation is not shown to significantly affect protected species, that provinces are responsible for permits and nature measures, and that no ban on letting cats roam is considered necessary.
It is not known how many animals are killed by cats in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel dieren in Nederland door katten worden gedood.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over de aflevering van Zondag met Lubach «de slacht & NVWA» van 24 november 2019

D66 MPs asked the ministers about shortages of veterinary staff at the NVWA, the training and selection of large-animal vets, and whether slaughter volumes endanger food safety, following a Zondag met Lubach episode. The minister answered that the shortage raises workload but does not directly affect inspections, outlined training figures and recruitment steps, and said capacity gaps do not automatically mean food-safety risk.
The mentioned shortage of veterinarians has no direct consequences for the execution of the inspections carried out on the slaughter process.
Het genoemde tekort aan dierenartsen heeft geen directe consequenties voor de uitvoering van de keuringen die worden uitgevoerd op het slachtproces.
