Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten ‘VEH: Huishoudens betalen 'onredelijk veel' waterschapsbelasting’ en ‘Succesje voor honderden boze boeren: waterschapsbelasting minder fors omhoog’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that households pay an unreasonable share of water board levies and about the share of each user group in the watersystem levy. The minister gave detailed answers on cost shares, board representation and the 'polluter pays' principle, while stating that some figures cannot be determined and that a revision of the levy system is still under study.
This percentage cannot be determined, but may roughly be correct.
Dit percentage is niet te achterhalen, maar kan bij benadering kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Het Waddenfonds als grabbelton’

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about press reports that the Waddenfonds lacks independent or central government oversight of subsidies and their results, and about possible conflicts of interest. The ministers answered that there is no direct central oversight because the fund is decentralised, that they stand by its policy, and that they will consider a specific grant mechanism via SiSa accountability to improve control.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) the provinces would then account to me annually for the spending charged to the specific grant.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) leggen de provincies dan jaarlijks aan mij verantwoording af van de bestedingen ten laste van de specifieke uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘NVWA en Marktplaats laten huisdierenleed links liggen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture why banned pet advertisements (docked animals, animals too young to be separated from their mother) remain on Marktplaats, and what the NVWA and the platform are doing about it, including warnings, keyword filtering and fees. The minister answered that such ads are hard to verify from text and photos, that inspections and removals follow reports, that Marktplaats now requires more seller fields, refers buyers to LICG, and that paid listings for dogs and cats have roughly halved ads since August 2019.
Based on an advertisement text and photos, it generally cannot be established whether there is a violation of the relevant prohibitions or not.
Op basis van een advertentietekst en foto’s is in de regel niet vast te stellen of er sprake is van een overtreding van de betreffende verboden of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Medewerkers NVWA: mobiel slachthuis werkt dierenleed in de hand’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that NVWA inspectors and vets are concerned a mobile slaughter unit (MDU) pilot allows animal suffering and unfit animals into the food chain, asking for national investigation, a halt to the pilot and clarification of how animals were handled. The minister answered that ante- and post-mortem inspection prevents unfit meat entering the food chain, that the pilot is lawful, that no national investigation is warranted and that the pilot will not be stopped pending its evaluation.
There is no reason based on the MDU pilot to establish a national investigation.
Er is op grond van de pilot met de MDU geen aanleiding om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Rijksvastgoedbedrijf biedt 825 hectare pachtgrond aan’

MP De Groot asked whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) offers 825 hectares of state farmland under liberalised lease, what conditions apply on soil quality, biodiversity and climate, how compliance is supervised, and how this fits the government's policy on circular agriculture. The state secretary confirmed 42 plots are offered by open tender under liberalised leases of two to six years, with contract conditions on soil analysis and land use, private-law enforcement, and an ongoing review of allocation criteria with no firm timetable for biodiversity monitoring data.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) currently offers, via a public tender, 42 plots with a total area of 825 hectares of land.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) biedt momenteel, via een openbare inschrijving, 42 kavels aan met een totale oppervlakte van 825 hectare grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Eikenprocessierups: waar spot jij hem?'

An MP asks the minister about the large nuisance from oak processionary caterpillars, its health risks, control methods, and whether national coordination is needed. The minister explains the causes of the increase, lists health risks and control measures, places the duty to control on oak owners with municipalities' public health role, and reports on a new national knowledge platform and website.
I attach importance to adequate information being offered in one central place about the oak processionary caterpillar and its control.
Ik hecht er belang aan dat op één centrale plek adequate informatie wordt aangeboden over de eikenprocessierups en de bestrijding daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘Bonaire overspoeld met Sargassum zeewier’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the recurring sargassum seaweed influx on Bonaire, its ecological and economic damage, causes, responsibilities, clean-up means, and circular use. The minister answered that the Openbaar Lichaam (island authority) is responsible for prevention and clean-up, that the Rijk has financially supported some equipment, and that it is willing to consult the island government and STINAPA and to address sargassum in the upcoming nature policy plan.
The actions taken to bring the problem under control fall under the responsibility of the Openbaar Lichaam.
De acties die ondernomen worden om de problematiek onder controle te krijgen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Inval bij veevoederbedrijf, mogelijk afvalstoffen in het voer’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a police raid on a feed company suspected of mixing waste into animal feed, whether public health was at risk, and whether the company was already known to the food authority. The Minister confirmed the raid, said health and animal risks were assessed as low so far, that the activities were halted pending a criminal investigation, and that the food authority had found irregularities in 2016 that were resolved.
Since this is an ongoing criminal investigation, no further statements can be made.
Aangezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, kunnen verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het debat inzake het rapport van de commissie-Sorgdrager over de fipronilcrisis

MP De Groot asks the minister to confirm past statements that contaminated egg products could not be diluted and that processors had to recall products above the MRL, and questions whether the NVWA took effective measures in the fipronil crisis. The minister confirms the statements are based on existing law, states the NVWA intervened when companies failed to comply, and denies that contaminated eggs were knowingly processed with government consent.
I cannot give you the names of the Big8; in this I am bound by privacy legislation.
Ik kan u niet de namen van de Big8 geven, hierbij ben ik gebonden aan gebonden aan privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'De EU heeft zijn criteria afgezwakt, en dus mag het meeste landbouwgif gewoon worden gebruikt'

MP De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that EU criteria for endocrine-disrupting pesticides were weakened, the Dutch position in 2009 and later, the health and biodiversity risks, and whether science guides pesticide decisions. The minister rejected the claim that the criteria were weakened, outlined the Dutch negotiating position, said authorised products contain no substances disruptive under the 2009 criteria, and affirmed reliance on EFSA, ECHA and Ctgb advice.
I consider it very important that decisions on the reassessment of these substances be taken as quickly as possible, so that they are assessed on the basis of the most recent scientific insights.

Ik vind het van groot belang dat er zo snel mogelijk besluiten worden genomen over de herbeoordeling van deze stoffen, zodat deze beoordeeld zijn op basis van de meest recente wetenschappelijke inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Brussel wil vegaschnitzel verbieden'

An MP from D66 asked the government whether EU proposals to restrict meat and dairy names for plant-based substitutes were justified, what the Dutch position is, and whether consumers are misled. The minister answered that the amendments are only committee proposals, that labelling must not mislead, that no Dutch research on consumer deception exists, and that a clarifying policy line will be published before summer 2019.
The line I intend to follow regarding the labelling of vegetarian products will be further clarified before summer 2019 and published on the NVWA website.
De lijn die ik ten aanzien van de etikettering van vegetarische producten wil volgen, zal vóór de zomer 2019 nader worden geduid en worden gepubliceerd op de website van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Olievlek drijft richting Waddeneilanden’

An MP asked ministers whether an oil slick drifting toward the Wadden islands, its cause, the response by authorities, and whether further protection of North Sea and Wadden nature was needed. The minister said the slick was not from offshore installations, described the Coast Guard and Rijkswaterstaat response, and pointed to existing directives and an upcoming North Sea agreement without committing to new measures.
The source of the oil pollution is so far not known.
De bron van de olieverontreiniging is vooralsnog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat ‘de sterfte van kalfjes op 1200 boerderijen schrikbarend hoog is’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about RTL's report that calf mortality exceeds 20 percent on about 1,200 farms, whether an action plan is needed, and who supervises calf welfare. The minister confirmed the figures (1,265 farms), said enforcement lies with the NVWA, pointed to existing sector initiatives and promised further discussion with the sector and a letter in summer.
I am concerned about the figures and believe all calves deserve the best care.
Ik ben bezorgd over de cijfers en vind dat alle kalveren de beste zorg verdienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over kleine en middelgrote slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland

MPs Geurts (CDA) and De Groot (D66) asked the minister about small and medium slaughterhouses in the north of the Netherlands, including the handling of about 30,000 kg of condemned meat and an independent investigation into NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the 30,000 kg concerned 31 cattle in 2017, all of which were traced to Rendac for destruction, with only administrative irregularities found, and that an independent external inquiry and an internal audit of NVWA oversight are ongoing.
As I also indicated during the NVWA General Consultation of 23 April, the NVWA investigated the 30,000 kilograms.
Zoals ik ook tijdens het Algemeen Overleg NVWA van 23 april jl. heb aangegeven, heeft de NVWA onderzoek gedaan naar de 30.000 kilo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Boetes voor verstoren natuur op Waddenzee worden niet meer uitgedeeld'

MP De Groot asks whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why, and whether monitoring of blackbox systems in shrimp fishing and speeding enforcement are adequate. The minister replies that enforcement continues through several bodies, that some blackbox systems still do not function properly and are being fixed, that enforcement capacity is considered sufficient, and that a Wadden Sea management authority decision and a review of disturbance enforcement will follow.
I am in consultation with the parties involved to arrive at an adequate solution.
Ik ben in overleg met de betrokken partijen om tot een adequate oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bromet over het bericht 'Mest barst van chemicaliën en dat is slecht nieuws voor de weidevogels'

MPs De Groot and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report linking pesticide residues in manure to declining meadow bird populations, and about whether permitting rules and organic standards are strict enough. The minister confirmed the reported findings, said a causal link to meadow bird decline has not been shown, and pointed to pending EFSA-based permit reassessments and a forthcoming pesticide vision and implementation programme.
Once EFSA's risk assessment of cumulative exposure to substances via residues is ready, it will be implemented and applied by the Ctgb in the permitting policy for plant protection products.

Zodra de risicobeoordeling van EFSA van cumulatieve blootstelling van stoffen via residuen gereed is, zal deze worden geïmplementeerd en toegepast door het Ctgb in het toelatingsbeleid van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Die gevaarlijke pijnstiller uitbannen lukt maar niet’

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about a study and news report on pharmaceutical residues (diclofenac) in water, including EU priority substance listing, waterboard monitoring, province and Rijkswaterstaat action, hospital wastewater treatment and the Green Deal Duurzame Zorg. The minister agrees on the urgency, notes the EU has postponed revising the priority list, points to the chain approach and biomonitoring experiments, says hospital treatment depends on local circumstances, and promises to keep the Chamber informed on the Green Deal follow-up.
I will gladly keep you informed of the progress on both topics.
Ik zal u graag op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken op beide onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Het bos is vogelvrij’

An MP asked the minister whether forest plots are being clear-felled and replanted with full soil disturbance, whether the 2010 clear-felling code remains in use unrevised despite the new Nature Conservation Act, and how clear-felling and replanting will be assured to be forestry-sound and climate-compatible. The minister acknowledged that large-scale felling sporadically occurs but is not monitored nationally, said the 2010 code is a species-protection code being updated in consultation with the sector, and committed to agreement on the update this year and to climate tools.
I expect to reach agreement with the VBNE this year on updating the current code of conduct.
Ik verwacht dit jaar tot overeenstemming komen met de VBNE over de actualisatie van de huidige gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over het bericht ‘vier jaar geëist tegen vleesfraudeur Willy Selten’

MPs Geurts and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture about a prosecution request in a meat-fraud case, the status of Taskforce Voedselvertrouwen action plan items on meat chain quality systems, slaughter of cows, supervision of fattening farms and preventing non-slaughter-worthy cows entering consumption. The Minister answered most questions with reference to ongoing work, promised a further report before the summer recess, and stated that the NVWA checks risk-based but does not register fattening farms separately.
I will also include this topic in the independent external investigation about which I informed you in my letter on slaughterhouses in Northern Netherlands
Dit onderwerp zal ik ook betrekken bij het onafhankelijke externe onderzoek waarover ik u heb geïnformeerd in mijn brief over slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Ook afname weidevogels op biologische boerenbedrijven mogelijk gevolg van aanwezige pesticiden'

De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture whether pesticides in manure, their combined ecological effects, and their impact on meadow birds and insects are adequately regulated and studied. Minister Schouten replied that existing authorisation rules already cover residues in manure, that no evidence yet confirms ecologically relevant pesticide levels in manure, and that she shares concern about bird and insect decline and will address pesticide dependence in a forthcoming vision document.
I am concerned about the decline of meadow birds and insects.
Ik maak mij zorgen over de afname van weidevogels en insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht dat alleen een radicaal ander dieet in 2050 alle monden kan voeden

D66 MPs asked whether the EAT-Lancet report on a radically different diet for 2050 warrants changes to health and food policy, how it compares with the Preventieakkoord and the Schijf van Vijf, and how it fits agriculture and climate goals. The government replies that the report supports current healthy-eating policy, that the Schijf van Vijf broadly matches EAT-Lancet, and that it will rely on existing climate and circular-agriculture plans without new binding measures.
No, this report supports the policy on healthy nutrition, and the impetus indicated together with the National Prevention Agreement.
Nee, dit rapport ondersteunt het beleid op het gebied van gezonde voeding, en de impuls die daar mede met het Nationaal Preventieakkoord aangegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht omtrent schadelijke stoffen in lippenbalsem

MPs De Groot and Van Eijs asked the health minister about a Belgian study finding possibly carcinogenic mineral oil fractions (MOSH/MOAH) in children's lip balms sold in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch regulation and NVWA inspection were adequate. The minister replied that the Cosmetics Regulation prohibits carcinogenic mineral oils, that the NVWA had requested the study data and saw no reason for additional research or inspection, and that the ingredients are labelled as paraffinum liquidum and similar terms.
The NVWA therefore sees no reason to carry out additional research.
De NVWA ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Weverling en Von Martels over het bericht dat patenten toch mogelijk zijn op veredelde groenten en planten

MPs De Groot, Weverling and Von Martels asked whether the European Patent Office appeals board allowing patents on natural plant traits and classically bred plants undermines Dutch law, and what the government will do. The minister says the written ruling is not yet available, that the government opposes such patents and will push for a lasting EU-level solution, but has not yet decided whether treaty amendment is the right route.
I am in favour of a swift and lasting solution to this matter.
Ik ben voor een snelle en duurzame oplossing van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

Member De Groot (D66) asked the ministers about the research on migratory fish near the Haringvliet sluices, the monitoring of bycatch, the failed voluntary fishing-restriction proposal and its financing, and the cost of the Kier decision. Minister Schouten answered that the study measures fishing impact on migratory species, that bycatch registration exists for relevant fisheries, that the current evidence shows limited impact so extra protection seems unnecessary pending results, and that the government did not take a passive role.
Individual catch records of fishers cannot be shared with third parties under the GDPR as business (economic) data.
Individuele vangstregistraties van vissers kunnen op grond van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) als bedrijfs-(economische) gegevens niet met derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat Nederlandse supermarkten fors meer zijn gaan stunten met goedkoop kippen-, varkens-, en rundvlees

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that supermarkets are increasingly offering deep discounts on chicken, pork and beef, and how this fits with animal welfare and circular farming goals. The minister said the government does not track meat promotions, that supermarkets set their own pricing, and that talks with supermarkets on sustainability and animal welfare are ongoing, including an agro-nutrimonitor at the ACM.
Supermarkets themselves decide on their pricing policy.
Supermarkten gaan zelf over hun prijsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Bij sterft sneller door verdelger’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a study linking bee mortality to glyphosate, whether it warrants asking EFSA to review its glyphosate opinion, and the status of a motion to restrict glyphosate use. The minister answered that the Ctgb found both studies methodologically flawed and not reliable, so no EFSA referral or new national restrictions are warranted, and that a full Ctgb reassessment is due by end 2019 after which the Chamber will be informed.
I will inform the Chamber separately about the implementation of the De Groot motion once the results of the Ctgb reassessment are available.
Ik zal uw Kamer separaat informeren over de uitvoering van de motie De Groot als de resultaten van de herbeoordeling van het Ctgb beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat zelfzuivelaars een forfaitaire melkproductie van 7.500 kilo per koe mogen hanteren

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether self-dairy farmers may use a flat-rate milk yield of 7,500 kg per cow for phosphate calculation, and whether this creates unfair competition and circumvents phosphate-rights rules. The Minister confirmed the flat rate applies to a limited group of about 200 self-processing farms, said the rules apply equally to all, and will monitor phosphate production without committing to changes now.
I will keep a close eye on phosphate production by self-dairy farmers.
Ik zal de vinger aan de pols houden waar het gaat om de fosfaatproductie door zelfzuivelaars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Duitse vissers willen verbod beroepsvisserij'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether commercial fishing near the Haringvliet sluices is compatible with Natura 2000 goals, given changes from the Kier decision. The Minister says existing permits were assessed against Natura 2000 targets, that a study on migratory fish impacts is being updated and due in Q1 2019, and that future water projects should consider fisheries from the outset.
I will inform your House of the results at that time.
Over de uitkomsten hiervan zal ik uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

An MP asked whether fishing near the Haringvliet sluices threatens fish migration investments, including how much fishers earn, compensation, and whether fishing has increased. The minister answered that fishing has actually decreased near the sluices since 2011, that migratory species are largely not targeted, and that no large-scale problem requires additional restrictions.
The precise turnover of the various fishing activities taking place near the Haringvliet sluices is unknown.
De precieze omzet van de verschillende visserijvormen die in de omgeving van de Haringvlietsluizen plaatsvinden is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat een hogere productie per koe goed voor economie, milieu en klimaat zou zijn

MP De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture about a tweet by the chair of the Topsector Agri&Food praising higher milk output per cow as good for the economy and climate, and whether this conflicts with the minister's circular agriculture vision. The minister confirmed the tweet, said it does not give a full picture of the sector's broader agenda, and pointed to the Kennis- en Innovatieagenda and missions framework as consistent with the vision, without committing to new action.
These statements by Mr Dijkhuizen do not give a complete picture in light of the broader agenda of the Topsector Agri&Food.
Deze uitingen van de heer Dijkhuizen geven geen volledig beeld in het licht van de bredere agenda van de Topsector Agri&Food.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘1700 illegale geiten ontdekt bij boer in Waalre’

An MP asks whether the national agencies RVO and NVWA, and municipalities, can ensure that animals are lawfully located, after 1,700 illegal goats were found at a farm in Waalre, and proposes information-sharing and a national audit. The minister answers that environmental permits are the responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that information sharing is not justified given privacy rules and efficiency, and that no national investigation will be launched.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het afschieten van verwilderde katten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about shooting feral cats, the scale of the cat population and predation, the TNR method, sterilisation obligations and cat registration. The minister answered that feral cats cause health and nature problems, that TNR is not an alternative to shooting for protecting birds, that sterilisation obligations are hard to enforce so none will be introduced, and that municipalities are responsible for registration, which is being discussed with them.
The number of stray cats outside shelters is estimated in that handbook at between 135,000 and 1.2 million.
Het aantal zwerfkatten buiten opvangcentra wordt in genoemd Handboek geschat tussen de 135.000 en 1,2 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Nederland medeschuldig aan olifantenslachting'

De Groot (D66) asks whether existing EU rules on pre-1947 ivory trade are effective given reports that legal trade feeds illegal poaching, whether the Netherlands supports closing the EU ivory market, and whether the minister will act. Minister Schouten says current rules already restrict trade, the EU study on domestic ivory markets is due for discussion in September, the Netherlands supports EU-level measures, and she is prepared to ban ivory trade nationally if EU action fails.
If this does not produce results or takes too long, I am willing to take stricter national measures myself to ban the trade in ivory in the Netherlands.
Als dit echter geen resultaten oplevert of te lang op zich laat wachten, ben ik bereid zelf stengere nationale maatregelen te nemen om de handel van ivoor in Nederland te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Kweekvlees is er! Maar we mogen het niet proeven’

An MP asks the ministers of Agriculture and Medical Care about the status of approval of cultured meat under EU novel food rules, EU efforts to speed approval, remaining legal barriers, and the NVWA's sealing of cultured meat packages. The government replies that cultured meat is not yet approved or in the EU list, no application has been filed, speeding up is very limited, no other legal barrier exists, and it supports the NVWA's enforcement action.
I support the NVWA's actions in this matter.
Ik ondersteun het optreden van de NVWA in deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Natuurclubs willen af van landbouwgif dat akkers oranje kleurt'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, after a newspaper report that nature groups want to stop glyphosate use, whether using glyphosate to reset grassland fits integrated pest management and whether its use should be restricted on land owned by nature organisations or government. The minister replied that the Ctgb is re-assessing all glyphosate uses, that she is in talks with LTO on reducing glyphosate use including grassland renewal, and that nature organisations can already set conditions in agreements with farmers.
I am now in talks with LTO Nederland about reducing the use of weedkillers and crop protection products based on the active substance glyphosate.
Ik ben inmiddels in gesprek met LTO Nederland over het terugdringen van het gebruik onkruidbestrijdingsmiddelen en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op basis van de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Weedkiller products more toxic than their active ingredient, tests show'

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that glyphosate-based weedkiller products are more toxic than their active ingredient, and whether it should prompt reconsideration of the EU glyphosate approval. The minister said the study does not disclose product composition, so it cannot be assessed, and that the Ctgb is reassessing all glyphosate products including co-formulants, while the EU decision concerned only the active substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Veluwse kwarteleitjes van Jumbo kwamen van Franse legbatterij'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the sale of quail eggs from caged French hens labelled as free-range is consistent with EU rules, and whether the EU should ban caged quail egg production and require origin codes. The minister agreed quail should have further EU restrictions and origin coding, said she would push for this in Brussels without Dutch leadership, and considered current sanctions sufficient.
When this comes up in Brussels, I am certainly willing to campaign hard for it.
Wanneer dit in Brussel ter sprake komt, ben ik zeker bereid mij daar hard voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Experts luiden de noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug’

An MP asks the health minister whether invasive mosquito species should be prevented entirely, whether imports of used tyres and Lucky bamboo should be banned, and who is liable for a local epidemic. The minister answers that complete prevention cannot be promised, that NVWA will impose technical-hygienic rules on tyre importers but will not publish company names, and that liability cannot be determined in advance.
The names of the companies where exotic mosquitoes are found, I will not make public.
De namen van de bedrijven waar exotische muggen gevonden worden, zal ik niet bekend maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Futselaar over het bericht dat Brussel een kenniscentrum opricht voor bestrijding van voedselfraude en het bevorderen van voedselkwaliteit

MPs De Groot and Futselaar asked about the European Commission's planned knowledge centre on food fraud and food quality, including its tasks, staffing, budget, effect on national food authorities such as the NVWA, and legal basis. The minister answered that the centre supports the EU Food Fraud Network without changing national enforcement roles, that FTE and budget are unknown, and that the Commission alone decided on it without Dutch involvement.
I do not know how many FTE will be deployed for the knowledge centre and how many of these will be found within the existing staff of the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission.
Het is mij onbekend hoeveel fte zullen worden ingezet voor het kenniscentrum en hoeveel daarvan binnen de bestaande formatie van het Joint Research Centre van de Europese Commissie worden gevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Producten van nieuwe genetische modificatietechnieken moeten strikt als GGO gereguleerd worden’ van het European Network of Scientists for Social and Environmenta

An MP asked the government to comment on an ENSSER article calling for strict GMO regulation of new genetic modification techniques, including off-target effects, biohacking, miniaturisation and bioterrorism risks. The government welcomed the scientific debate, said existing licensing and risk assessment cover these risks, and announced a separate letter on modernising biotechnology regulation.
Your House will shortly be informed in a separate letter about the progress of the modernisation process.
Uw Kamer wordt binnenkort in een separate brief geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het moderniseringstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het advies 'Nieuwe landbouwhuisdieren' van de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet advice on new farm animals such as insects and worms, including whether they contribute to the manure problem and whether a separate manure category should be created. The Minister acknowledges the advice, says insects and worms do excrete manure and contribute to the problem, and promises a decision on possible changes to the regulation before summer 2018.
I will make a choice before the summer of 2018.
Ik zal voor de zomer 2018 een keuze maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht «Hap, slik en weg is het insectenbedrijf»

De Groot (D66) asked the minister whether insects are nutritious and environmentally better than meat, why the NVWA was slow issuing an export certificate, whether EU rules on insect feed and food are unclear, and whether government will help insect firms with legal problems. Minister Schouten answered that insects are nutritious and have lower planetary impact, that the NVWA needed more time due to initial uncertainty and Swiss extra conditions, that EU rules are being clarified step by step, and that a Green Deal and talks with the sector are underway.
My ministry will also soon enter into talks with Venik about the information needed to obtain export certificates.
Tevens gaat mijn ministerie op korte termijn in gesprek met de Venik over de benodigde informatie voor het verkrijgen van exportcertificaten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht “Experts luiden noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Agriculture about expert warnings that the approach to the tiger mosquito is failing, and whether the NVWA can monitor and control invasive exotic mosquitoes and their introduction via products such as used tyres and Lucky Bamboo. The minister says the NVWA monitors risk locations and businesses with traps, that the ministries fund monitoring and control, and that existing preventive measures are sufficient, while acknowledging that the imported products cannot be checked directly at borders given free movement in the EU.
I consider the monitoring of and supervision over businesses and the monitoring at risk locations (see also the answer to question 2) sufficient.
Ik acht de monitoring van en het toezicht op bedrijven en de monitoring op de risicolocaties (zie ook het antwoord op vraag 2) voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het rapport The Hidden Cost of UK Food

MP De Groot asked whether the government would commission a Dutch equivalent of the UK 'Hidden Cost of Food' report, with attention to underpayment of farmers, and how it views initiatives to make external costs transparent. Minister Schouten answered that the government will explore with stakeholders and research institutes how to test practical approaches to external costs, without committing to a new report on farmer underpayment.

I intend, as a follow-up to the study by Wageningen Economic Research and True Price and other relevant studies, as well as the results of 10 October, to explore in discussion with societal parties and knowledge institutions the desirability and possibilities.

Ik heb het voornemen om als vervolg op de studie van Wageningen Economic Research en True Price en andere relevante studies, alsook de resultaten van 10 oktober in gesprek met maatschappelijke partijen en kennisinstellingen de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Greenpeace beschuldigt Nederlandse bedrijven van handel in 'bloedhout''

MP De Groot (D66) asked the ministers whether Brazilian timber from Para, Mato Grosso and Rondonia should be treated as high risk, whether NVWA enforcement will be strengthened, and how illegal timber can be kept off the Dutch market after Greenpeace accused Dutch firms of trading illegally logged hardwood. Minister Schouten answered that illegality is widespread in Brazilian forestry, that the NVWA is sharpening its intervention policy from early 2018, that enforcement capacity will be reviewed without firm commitment, and that the primary responsibility lies with importers, so illegal timber cannot be fully excluded.
Instead of always warning first, the NVWA will directly impose an order subject to a penalty for certain serious violations.
In plaats van altijd eerst waarschuwen zal de NVWA bij bepaalde, zware overtredingen direct een last onder dwangsom opleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over oprukkende varkenspest in Polen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that African swine fever is spreading westward in Poland, including the risk to the Netherlands, NVWA preparedness, and extra border hygiene checks. The minister answered that the risk is taken seriously, that the NVWA is prepared through exercises and standby contracts, and that existing EU and national transport and disinfection rules apply, with the sector reminded of its responsibilities.
Yes. The NVWA has experience in combating contagious animal diseases.
Ja. De NVWA heeft ervaring met het bestrijden van besmettelijke dierziekten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Groot over het bericht 'Volkerak weer deels opengesteld'

A D66 MP asked the ministers whether opening part of the Volkerak to eel and mitten crab fishing is justified given dioxin and PCB contamination, ICES advice against eel fishing, and proposed EU zero catch limits. The minister answered that the opening followed the policy rule applied to measured eel contamination, that two extra areas were closed, that a national autumn fishing ban exists, and that the EU measures and 2018 reporting will be monitored.
I consider this decision to be correct, because the policy rule has been applied.
Ik beoordeel dit besluit als juist, omdat de beleidsregel is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Aanzienlijk minder dieren in Noordzee'

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether she knew of reports of a sharp decline in North Sea animal life, whether the reported 30% average decline could be confirmed, and what the causes were and how the decline would be halted. The minister confirmed awareness and said a single average figure cannot be drawn from the CBS data across 140 species, and referred to an earlier answer for causes and measures.
I refer you for this to the answer to question 4 from Member Futselaar (SP)
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar het antwoord op vraag 4 van het lid Futselaar (SP)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Aardbeien zes keer giftiger dan ander fruit door cocktaileffect’

MP De Groot asked whether the NVWA assesses combination effects of pesticide residues on strawberries, whether standards exist, and why the EFSA cumulative assessment method, required since 2005, is still not in place. The minister answered that MRLs cover single substances only, that a cumulative method is under development with EFSA and RIVM, and committed to urging EFSA to speed up the process and requesting a timetable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het plan van 100.000 hectare nieuw bos

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the status of a sector proposal to create 100,000 hectares of new forest, which is part of an Action Plan Forest & Timber with an estimated extra CO2 storage of 4.2 Mton per year by 2050. The minister answered that a draft programme plan was presented, that the parties want to discuss implementation with the national government, and that she is willing to explore with the sector how forests can contribute to the climate ambitions.
I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over Roundup

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about glyphosate (Roundup): its effects on soil life, use in grassland reset and pre-planting weed control, and discrepancies between sales figures from Nefyto and CBS usage statistics. The Minister said current soil norms are not exceeded so further research is not needed, promised an inventory of glyphosate use and talks with the sector, and said she would discuss better measurement of use with CBS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Veel glyfosaat in landbouwgronden: Verlenging toelating niet verstandig'

MP De Groot (D66) asked the minister whether she knew of research showing glyphosate in agricultural soils, whether she would ask the Ctgb for advice on its implications for renewing glyphosate's approval, and whether EFSA should review the research. The minister confirmed knowledge of the research, said she had asked the Ctgb for advice and informed parliament of it, and said EFSA review was unnecessary because EFSA had already advised the Commission with a similar conclusion.
I have now asked the Ctgb for advice and have informed your House of the outcome.
Ik heb het Ctgb inmiddels om advies gevraagd en heb uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan geïnformeerd

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het rapport van de Europese Commissie waarin stevige kritiek wordt geuit op de manier waarop de veiligheid van ons voedsel aan de Europese buitengrenzen (Schiphol e

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers about an EU Commission audit criticising the document checks on food imports at Schiphol and Rotterdam, including scanned rather than original certificates. The government acknowledged the findings, defended the current approach for non-animal products, and said an impact analysis and concrete actions would follow.
I acknowledge the conclusions and the accompanying recommendations.
Ik erken de conclusies en de daarbij horende aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Groot, Geurts en Lodders over gegevensverstrekking aan Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw voor het programma Onderzoek en Innovatie

MPs asked whether the minister should give the agricultural sector body BO Akkerbouw the names, addresses and acreage data of non-member farms, given data-protection limits and administrative burden, for a mandatory research levy. The minister declined direct transfer of the data, offering instead KvK data transfers and an opt-in consent route via RVO.nl, arguing this is proportionate and workable under the Wbp.
This means that providing the acreage data, without the farms having given consent, does not meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Dit maakt dat het verstrekken van de areaalgegevens, zonder dat de akkerbouwbedrijven daar toestemming voor gegeven hebben, niet voldoet aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat fipronilkippen ondanks een verbod toch verkocht zouden zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a report that fipronil-contaminated hens were sold despite a ban, including how many blocked farms sold hens, whether the NVWA's permit procedure was sound, and why a quote was removed from the RTL article. The minister answered that two breeding farms supplied hens to laying farms that were then also blocked, that the exemption to move hens was granted on animal welfare grounds via a NVWA permit procedure, and that the NVWA only corrected factual errors in the article.
The blocked breeding farm submits a request for exemption to the NVWA.
Het geblokkeerde opfokbedrijf dient bij de NVWA een verzoek in voor ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid De Groot over de toepassing van de MIA/VAMIL-regeling op potstallen

An MP asked whether potstallen (pot stables) improve manure quality and soil, whether MIA/VAMIL tax schemes require listing in the Rav annex or MDV certification, and what other support exists. The State Secretary answered that the potstal is excluded from the Rav and cannot be built since 2015, that MDV-certified and certain low-emission or proefstal systems qualify for MIA/VAMIL, and that no other national subsidy supports potstallen.
The potstal system is not listed as a housing system in Annex 1 of the Rav.
Het potstalsysteem staat niet als huisvestingsysteem in bijlage 1 van de Rav.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de schade aan het koraal voor de kust van Curaçao

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about coral damage off Curaçao, whether the permit was breached, enforcement, compensation, Dutch assistance and treaty compliance. Minister Plasterk answered that investigations are ongoing, that permitting and enforcement are matters for Curaçao's own government, and that nature protection there is not the Kingdom's responsibility.
Permit granting and construction work on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten are matters for the countries themselves.
Vergunningverlening en bouwwerkzaamheden op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten zijn landsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Diertens en Van Meenen over de oproep om een gezonde voedselomgeving te bevorderen

MPs De Groot, Diertens and Van Meenen asked about a call by food scientists to make healthy eating the easy choice, including reported plans by Dunkin' Donuts to open outlets in schools and hospitals. The state secretary said the government supports a healthy food environment, works with schools, municipalities and food partners through existing programmes, and has no known plans for fast-food outlets in schools or hospitals.
As far as is known, there is currently no question of Dunkin' Donuts or any other fast-food chain opening outlets in schools and hospitals.
Antwoord 3, 4 Voor zover bekend is er momenteel geen sprake van een eventuele vestiging van Dunkin» Donuts of een (andere) fastfoodketen in scholen en ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink mer over het militaire strafproces

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Justice whether officier-raadsmen (military officers acting as defence counsel) can provide adequate legal defence in military criminal proceedings, and whether they should be replaced by lawyers. The state secretary rejected abolishing the role, explaining that officier-raadsmen give free assistance in minor cases, receive training, and must act with functional independence, while noting Salduz-related access to counsel is guaranteed via lawyers and the military bar.
No record is kept of this.
qn: Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk inzake de mogelijke ondergang van het veteranenhuis in Veendam

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Veteranenhuis in Veendam, a veterans' meeting centre, faces closure from 1 January 2013 for lack of structural funding, and whether it could qualify for Veterans Fund support. The minister acknowledged the risk but said funding decisions rest with the independent Veteranenfonds and that Defence has no role, while stating that veterans' meeting centres are important in peer-level care.
It is up to the Veteranenfonds to assess whether the Veteranenhuis in Veendam qualifies for a grant.
Het is aan het Veteranenfonds te beoordelen of het Veteranenhuis in Veendam in aanmerking komt voor een vergoeding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper Van Dijk over de Navo oefening Steadfast Noon

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the NATO exercise Steadfast Noon, in which the Netherlands participates at Büchel air base, rehearses procedures for deploying tactical nuclear weapons, and whether Dutch participation conflicts with nuclear disarmament policy. The government declined to give details of the exercise citing international agreements, and argued that NATO remains a nuclear alliance while pursuing a world free of nuclear weapons step by step.
Based on international agreements, no statements are made on this matter.
Op basis van internationale afspraken worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het artikel “Defensie wisselt technici duur in”

An MP asked the Defence minister about reports that the armed forces will cut about 1,100 technical posts in the Royal Army and whether a EUR 10,000 recruitment premium for technicians is wise instead of filling vacancies internally. The minister said the reorganisation is not yet final so the number of technical staff leaving is unknown, that EUR 1.1 million is budgeted for 550 technicians per year, and that external recruitment is needed because too few technicians of the required rank are available internally.
It is therefore not yet known how many technically trained staff the defence organisation will have to leave.
Het is nog dus nog niet bekend hoeveel technisch geschoolde medewerkers de defensieorganisatie zullen moeten verlaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink over het artikel “Defensie wisselt technici duur in”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence is dismissing technically trained staff while recruiting external technicians with bonuses, and how many staff will leave by rank and unit. The minister answered that the reorganisation numbers are not yet known, explained that the numerus fixus instrument explains the mismatch, and confirmed that staff and headquarters will be cut by 30 percent.
It is therefore not yet known how many technically trained staff the defence organisation will have to leave.
Het is nog dus nog niet bekend hoeveel technisch geschoolde medewerkers de defensieorganisatie zullen moeten verlaten.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Recourt over de rechtsmacht over militairen die koopvaardijschepen tegen piraten beschermen

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Dutch military protection teams on merchant ships could be prosecuted by other states, who holds jurisdiction in different maritime zones, and whether SOFAs are needed. The government answered that UNCLOS gives clear jurisdiction, Dutch flag vessels remain under Dutch criminal law, the Dutch prosecutor reviews any use of force, and there is no criminal immunity.
There is no question of criminal immunity.
Van strafrechtelijke immuniteit is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over opschorting training van Afghaanse rekruten

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the suspension of training for new Afghan recruits and about rising 'green on blue' and 'green on green' attacks, and whether the Dutch police training mission in Kunduz should be ended early. Minister Hillen answered that the suspension concerns Afghan Local Police trained by US forces, not the Dutch-trained police in Kunduz, that vetting procedures are followed there, and that the government sees no reason to end the mission early.
The cabinet sees no reason to consider early termination or adjustment of the integrated police training mission in Kunduz.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding de vervroegde beëindiging of aanpassing van de geïntegreerde politietrainingsmissie in Kunduz te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Eijsink over de bestrijding van drugssmokkel via Schiphol

MPs Marcouch and Eijsink asked whether the Schiphol team combining Customs and Marechaussee officers is effective against drug smuggling and whether it is being dismantled. The minister denied plans to split the teams, said the integrated approach will be extended, and promised to inform parliament once an ongoing review of the team's functioning is complete.
Once the review is completed, I will inform your House of the outcomes and the consequences for the Schiphol team.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond, informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en de consequenties hiervan voor het Schipholteam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez over het bewapeningsprogramma van Turkije

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about press reports on Turkey's ballistic missile programme and whether it conflicts with NATO's collective approach, and whether the government will raise it at the next NATO defence ministerial. The minister answered that Turkey has announced intentions for a missile interceptor and satellite capability, no formal decisions have been taken, such capabilities are also of NATO interest, and there is no reason to see it as a signal of drifting from transatlantic cooperation, so he sees no reason to raise the issue at NATO.
No formal decisions have yet been taken on this.
Hierover zijn nog geen formele besluiten genomen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

MP De Roon asks whether the Dutch shipping sector's use of armed private security guards aboard vessels, absent a legal basis, is acceptable, and whether the government will guarantee affordable, flexible naval protection or legislate for certified private guards. The minister answers that the government prioritises naval Vessel Protection Detachments, will keep monitoring level-playing-field effects and may consider further measures, while stating that the current demand for VPDs is below capacity and that Defence does not compete commercially with private firms.
The cabinet will examine whether, and if so which, additional measures, such as a further reduction of the shipowners' contribution, are needed.
Het kabinet zal bezien of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen, zoals een verdere verlaging van de bijdrage van de reders, nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutch shipowners deploy armed private security despite a legal ban, and whether this breaches the law and undermines the government's VPD arrangements. The government answered that it cannot accept law-breaking, will raise compliance in the working group with shipowners, the prosecutor is assessing whether to act, and it reaffirmed its anti-piracy strategy.
Of course I cannot accept a situation in which the law would be broken.
Uiteraard kan ik mij niet verenigen met een situatie waarin de wet zou worden overtreden.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

Mr Van Bommel asks whether the government will prosecute shipowners who illegally deploy armed private guards on Dutch merchant ships, and what measures it has taken. The government answers that such use is a criminal offence the Public Prosecution Service can pursue, that it has lowered the shipowners' contribution and processes all navy protection requests, and that prosecution decisions and sentencing are for the prosecutor and courts.
The Dutch public prosecution service has jurisdiction over this and can therefore institute criminal prosecution.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft hierover de jurisdictie en kan derhalve strafrechtelijke vervolging instellen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Nederlandse hulp bij tankdeal met Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked whether the government granted an export licence for a Leopard 2 tank used in Saudi Arabian trials, whether it was a lease, whether parliament was informed, and whether arms-export criteria were applied. The Defence Minister answered that the tank remains Defence property on loan to KMW, that no sale or export occurred so no licence or criteria test was needed, and that parliament was not separately informed.
There is no agreement with Saudi Arabia that would have to be tested in any way.
Er is geen sprake van een overeenkomst met Saoedi-Arabië die op enigerlei wijze zou moeten worden getoetst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over berichten dat Indonesië mogelijk van Duitsland Leopard-tanks wil kopen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia may buy surplus German Leopard tanks, and why negotiations were not halted after a parliamentary motion, and whether a parliamentary rejection counts as a denial notification to EU states. The government answered that it considers the sale possible within export policy, that it ended negotiations after a parliamentary majority opposed the deal, and that a parliamentary rejection is not itself a denial notification since only negative licence decisions under the EU criteria are notified.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een dodelijke aanval door piraten op een schip bij Nigeria

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly pirate attack on a ship off Nigeria that resulted in four kidnappings, and how such an attack could happen despite navy protection. The government said it has no information on the Nigerian navy's role, does not see a need for Dutch naval protection of merchant ships, and points to industry self-protection measures.
Regarding the circumstances and how it happened, the Nigerian authorities have so far made no statements.
Over de toedracht en de omstandigheden hebben de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten tot dusver geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink over eerherstel voor drie mariniers

Two PvdA MPs asked whether three marines convicted in 1948 for refusing to burn a kampong should receive full rehabilitation and be held up as examples of integrity. The minister replied that the courts found the burning militarily necessary, that no facts justify revising that judgment, that the marines were pardoned and partly restored, and that judging them by today's standards would not be careful.
However, I do not consider it prudent to reassess the conduct of these marines against today's standards and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het echter niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van deze mariniers te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over de behandeling van mensen in Nederlandse en Nederlands-Indische overheidsdienst die indertijd hebben geweigerd mee te doen aan de politionele acties

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked ministers about rehabilitation and treatment of Dutch and Dutch East Indies civil servants and military personnel who refused to take part in the police actions, including how many were punished and whether they will be rehabilitated. The government answered that the numbers of refusers among civil servants and colonial staff are unknown, declined to discuss an individual case, and said it will not reassess past individual conduct against today's norms.

Recognising that the period in question is now viewed in a different light, I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against today's norms and with present-day knowledge.

In het besef dat de desbetreffende periode nu in een ander licht wordt gezien, acht ik het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Afghaanse politie-eenheid loopt over naar de Taliban”

MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports that an Afghan police unit defected to the Taliban, including numbers, weapons, training links and prevention measures. The government answered that the facts are unclear, eleven Afghan Uniformed Police officers reportedly defected with small arms, it cannot confirm NATO training, gives no explanation, and describes intake and mentoring measures to limit future defections.
It is unclear exactly what happened in Farah province (southwest Afghanistan).
Het is onduidelijk wat zich precies heeft afgespeeld in de provincie Farah (Zuidwest-Afghanistan).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Wolbert over het bericht “Defensie in zee met USG voor reorganisatie”

MPs Eijsink and Wolbert asked the Defence minister about the outsourcing of job placement for surplus Defence staff to USG People, including why SMEs and reintegration firms were not involved. The minister answered that the tender followed EU rules with quality and price criteria, that Defence is responsible for work-to-work support and works with various firms including SMEs, and that results will become visible in 2013.
The public tender for the placement organisation contract was carried out in accordance with European directives.
De openbare aanbesteding van het contract voor de bemiddelingsorganisatie is volgens de Europese richtlijnen uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over straffeloosheid van sleutelfiguren in de Somalische piraterij

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Somali and Puntland authorities shield Somali piracy kingpins, why the UK blocked UN Security Council sanctions on pirate leaders, and the status of a regional anti-piracy prosecution centre. The minister found the reports worrying, said Somali authorities must respond to the UN Monitoring Group findings, noted international debate on whether sanctions would criminalise ransom payments, and reported that the RAPPICC centre is being set up with a Dutch commitment of EUR 300,000 and two experts, expected to be operational in early 2013.
I find these reports worrying. The Somali authorities must provide an account and explanation of the findings of the UN Monitoring Group.
Ik vind deze berichten zorgwekkend. De Somalische autoriteiten moeten tekst en uitleg geven over de bevindingen van de UN Monitoring Group.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hernandez over bezuinigingen op de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government had informed party leaders about the consequences of further defence cuts, how further cuts would affect NATO obligations, Dutch security, operational capacity and naval protection, and whether the armed forces could absorb cuts. The minister answered that further cuts would reduce operational capabilities, breach NATO commitments and weaken Dutch influence, while declining to commit to notifying party leaders beyond regular contacts.
I maintain regular contacts about Defence with politicians, including party leaders.
Ik onderhoud op reguliere basis contacten over Defensie met politici, waaronder fractievoorzitters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

An MP asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families, including in Curaçao, have their child benefit reduced under the residence-country principle, and whether they should be exempt given they pay Dutch premiums. The minister confirmed benefits are indexed to the cost level of the child's country of residence and rejected an exemption for deployed soldiers, since the rule applies to all exported benefits without special categories.
The residence-country principle means the amount of a benefit is aligned with the cost level of the country in which the beneficiary or the child lives.
Het woonlandbeginsel houdt in dat de hoogte van een uitkering wordt afgestemd op het kostenniveau van het land waarin de belanghebbende of het kind woont.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over mogelijke fraude bij bouwconcern Ballast Nedam

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether the government knew of possible fraud by Ballast Nedam in building the Kromhout barracks, whether there were signs of competition-restricting conduct raising Defence's costs, and what action it would take. The minister answered that the competition authority is only verifying claims, that offers were assessed without finding harm to Defence, that Defence had been informed earlier, and that it will cooperate with any investigation and act if restrictive conduct is found.
Naturally, Defence will cooperate with the NMa investigation if requested.
Vanzelfsprekend zal Defensie desgevraagd medewerking verlenen aan het NMA-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Hamer over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

MPs Eijsink and Hamer asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families are harmed by the new country-of-residence principle reducing child benefit, and whether they should be compensated. The minister replied that child benefit is now set at the cost level of the child's country of residence, that the law was not intended to target soldiers, and that no increase in the foreign allowance is planned.
The purpose is to prevent benefits paid outside the Netherlands from diverging from local standards.
Doel hiervan is te voorkomen dat uitkeringen die buiten Nederland worden verstrekt, met lokale maatstaven uit de pas lopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke over de NH-90

MPs Ten Broeke asked whether Portugal and Norway were considering cancelling NH-90 helicopter orders, what the consequences would be for the programme and Dutch deliveries, and whether freed-up production capacity could speed up Dutch helicopters for search and rescue. The minister answered that Portugal has announced withdrawal and cancellation of ten helicopters with consequences being studied, that Norway has not announced cancellation, and that Dutch deliveries are unaffected.
Given the relatively limited size of the Portuguese order in relation to the total number of helicopters ordered from NHIndustries, these costs will however be limited.
Gezien de relatief beperkte omvang van de Portugese bestelling in verhouding tot het totale aantal helikopters dat bij NHIndustries besteld is, zullen deze kosten echter beperkt zijn.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Eijsink over het besluit van Canada zich terug te trekken uit het AWACS-programma

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Canada's withdrawal from the NATO AWACS programme, its reasons, the effect on the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands would reconsider its own participation. The minister answered that Canada cited a strategic defence review and budget cuts, that no other partners are known to be considering withdrawal, that financial consequences are still under discussion, and that ending Dutch participation is not on the agenda.
Ending the Dutch participation in the AWACS programme is not on the agenda.
Beëindiging van de Nederlandse deelneming in het AWACS-programma is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel inzake Nederlandse oorlogsmisdaden op Zuid-Celebes

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about alleged Dutch war crimes in South Sulawesi in 1946-47 (summary executions, knowledge at top levels, the 1954 decision not to prosecute, and release of the Van Rij/Stam report). The government answered that over 3,000 people died in the actions, that political and military leadership were informed from December 1946, that the 1954 non-prosecution decision was based on the information available, that the facts are now time-barred, and that the report has been deposited for Chamber inspection with personal data caveats.
The report is deposited at the Tweede Kamer registry for the Chamber's inspection, though it should be noted that the report may contain names of still-living persons whose private life is protected.

Tegen deze achtergrond wordt het rapport ter kennisname door de Kamer ter griffie van de Tweede Kamer neergelegd, waarbij moet worden aangetekend dat in het rapport namen van nog levende personen kunnen voorkomen waarvan de persoonlijke levenssfeer beschermd is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht  ‘Afluisterproject splijt AIVD en MIVD’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether the intelligence services AIVD and MIVD obstruct each other in intercepting foreign satellite and radio communications and how cooperation within the National Sigint Organisation would be improved. The minister replied that cooperation has been intensified since 2007, that the services are forming a joint Sigint-Cyber unit to optimise support and use of technical expertise, and that the processing of intercepted communications is under review.
The joint MIVD-AIVD research teams are examples of this.
De gezamenlijke MIVD-AIVD onderzoeksteams zijn hier voorbeelden van.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijke bezuinigingen op de luchtmacht

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister about reports that the F-16 fleet could shrink to 42 aircraft and Leeuwarden air base close due to budget cuts linked to the F-35 costs. The minister replied that the 42-aircraft option came from a technical consolidation document not included in the final coalition draft, that the 2011 policy letter reduces the fleet to 68 with both bases kept open, and that no further reduction or closure is planned, while defending continued F-35 participation.
Defence has no intention whatsoever of further reducing the number of F-16s or closing an air base.
Defensie heeft geen enkel voornemen voor een verdere vermindering van het aantal F-16»s of de sluiting van een vliegbasis.
Antwoord vragen leden Koopmans en Knops over uitbesteding van graslandbeheer op defensielocaties

CDA MPs asked the Defence minister whether the grassland management at Venray air base could be outsourced to a dairy farmer at no cost, saving Defence money, and whether similar outsourcing occurs elsewhere. The minister refused the proposal, arguing that the existing low-intensity grassland management is required for flight safety against bird strikes, that the offer does not reduce costs for Defence, and that the Leeuwarden grassland management is already outsourced.
Defence is therefore not willing to respond to Vreba's proposal to change the current low-intensity grassland management of the military airfield.
Defensie is dus niet bereid in te gaan op het voorstel van Vreba om het huidige schraal grasbeheer van het militaire luchthaventerrein anders in te richten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Schaart over de levering van een SIGMA korvet aan Indonesië

Two VVD MPs asked about the sale of a SIGMA corvette by Damen Schelde Naval Shipbuilding to Indonesia, including contract value, jobs, prior deliveries and whether EU arms export criteria were applied. The government confirmed a contract of about $220 million for one corvette with an option on more, said a positive preliminary assessment against the EU criteria was made, and provided an overview of export licences for Indonesia.
In an exploratory phase, a so-called sondage, a positive opinion was given based on assessment against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position.
In een verkennende fase, een zogenaamde sondage, is een positief advies gegeven aan de hand van de beoordeling van de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over de integriteitskwestie rond luitenant-kolonel Marcel de Haas

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about the integrity dispute involving Lt-Col Marcel de Haas, including alleged structural problems in job allocation, calls for external personnel officers, a criminal investigation, and an external integrity oversight body. The minister replied that the commission's inquiry was thorough and partly substantiated the complaints, but rejected structural problems, criminal referral, and an external oversight body, citing existing appeal and reporting channels.
I do not share the view that there are structural problems in Defence's personnel policy, including in job allocation.
Ik deel de mening niet dat er bij Defensie sprake is van structurele problemen met het personeelsbeleid,ook niet bij de functietoewijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Ten Broeke inzake Antwoorden het bericht 'Politieweb aan grens in gevaar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the national police merger would end the mobile cross-border police teams at the German border, and about results, funding and possible use of Koninklijke Marechaussee teams. The minister answered that cross-border cooperation under the Treaty of Enschede continues, that the Twente joint team's funding runs to July 2013 with a continuity commitment, and that the team's form may change after evaluation.
The ministry is periodically informed about project progress and the (interim) results and deployment of the GPT.
Het ministerie wordt periodiek geïnformeerd over de projectvoortgang en de (tussentijdse) resultaten en de inzet van het GPT.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over een EU-aanval op land in verband met de piraterijbestrijding (Atalanta)

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of an EU air attack on pirate logistics on Somalia's land and whether Dutch forces were involved, including a Lynx helicopter shot at near Somalia. The minister answered that the operation fell under the expanded Atalanta mandate, that no Dutch personnel were involved, that the Lynx was on a separate reconnaissance flight, and that no direct military contribution would be made before consulting parliament.
The Netherlands will not make a direct military contribution to such EU operations before the government has exchanged views with the House of Representatives on the matter.
Nederland zal geen directe bijdrage met militaire eenheden aan dergelijke EU-operaties leveren voordat de regering daarover met de Kamer van gedachten heeft gewisseld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Holtackers en Knops over de aanbieding energiecontract Veteraneninstituut

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Defence about a commercial energy-contract mailing to veteran-pass holders that carried the Veterans Institute's logo and was co-signed by its director, and whether this was acceptable and how privacy is protected. The Minister answered that the Institute is independent, the mailing costs were borne by the energy company, the commercial action is a less desirable development he will raise with the director, and veterans' data remain private via a separate address file.
The commercial action mentioned in the question is a less desirable development. I will call the director of the Veterans Institute to account for it.
De commerciële actie die in de vraag wordt genoemd, is een minder goede ontwikkeling. Ik zal de directeur van het Veteraneninstituut daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het artikel ‘Bemanning Nederlands schip ontvoerd in Nigeria’

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the kidnapping of a Dutch-operated ship's crew in Nigerian waters, the nationalities of those involved, how their release would be secured, and whether Nigeria had been pressed to protect anchored ships. The government answered that the Nigerian authorities are responsible for handling the incident, that Netherlands will assist where possible, and that piracy in West Africa is rising and is being addressed in the UN Security Council and ECOWAS.
Since the robbery and kidnapping took place within Nigeria's territorial waters, handling the incident is a responsibility of the Nigerian authorities.
