Aangezien de beroving en kidnapping heeft plaatsgevonden binnen de territoriale wateren van Nigeria, is de afhandeling van het incident een verantwoordelijkheid van de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de landing van een Apache gevechtshelikopter aan boord van Hr. Ms. Rotterdam

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a test landing of an Apache helicopter on a navy ship changes the earlier position that Apaches are not yet suited to ship operations, and whether results of the study will be shared and anti-piracy deployment pursued. The minister confirmed the landing, said it is part of a broader study whose unclassified results will be shared with parliament, and that any deployment decision will weigh defined goals against available capabilities.
After completion of the study, I will share the relevant, unclassified results with the House as soon as possible.
Na voltooiing van het onderzoek zal ik de relevante, niet geclassificeerde resultaten zo spoedig mogelijk met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord vragen Knops en Holtackers over averij bij proefvaart rubberboot mariniers

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about reported damage (broken seats, torn upholstery, a broken windscreen, bent rails) during sea trials of the FRISC rubber boat for the Marines, and whether the supplier would bear repair costs and whether delays affected operations. The minister answered that the defects are being fixed at the supplier's expense under the contract, that eleven vessels have been delivered, that all remaining vessels will be tested before operational use, and that the delays did not impede Marines or Coast Guard operations.
Defence does not accept vessels that have not been tested.
Defensie accepteert geen vaartuigen die niet zijn getest.
Antwoord vragen  Hernandez over het bericht dat opnieuw een proefvaart van de nieuwe Frisc-rubberboten compleet is mislukt

An MP asks the Defence Minister about reports that another sea trial of the new FRISC rubber boats failed, including broken seats and a torn windscreen, and questions the procurement, contract, and testing history. The minister responds that the trials were successful in meeting Defence requirements, that the defects are being fixed at the supplier's cost, and that no halt or investigation is warranted.
Defence does not accept vessels that have not been tested. In case of bottlenecks, these are resolved by the supplier.
Defensie accepteert geen vaartuigen die niet zijn getest. In geval van knelpunten worden deze door de leverancier opgelost.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenhandel tussen Defensie en de heer Joep van den Nieuwenhuyzen

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether arms dealer Joep van den Nieuwenhuyzen was involved in selling surplus Dutch tanks abroad, whether he received a commission, whether the minister was aware of his involvement in fraudulent transactions, and whether it is acceptable for an arms dealer to play a key role in selling Dutch weapons. The minister denied any involvement by the ministry in using his services, said the ministry did not use his services, confirmed awareness of the fraud matters, and stated that surplus strategic materiel is in principle sold only via government-to-government arrangements, with sales to reputable companies possible if the final destination is known in advance.
The claim that Mr Van den Nieuwenhuyzen is involved in the sale of surplus Dutch tanks abroad is incorrect; the Ministry of Defence makes no use of his services in any way.

De bewering dat de heer Van den Nieuwenhuyzen is betrokken bij de verkoop van overtollige Nederlandse tanks aan het buitenland is onjuist; het ministerie van Defensie maakt op geen enkele wijze gebruik van zijn diensten.

Antwoord vragen Peters en El Fassed over de gebrekkige medewerking van de NAVO bij het onderzoek van de rapporteur van de Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa naar de omgekomen bootvluchtelingen uit Libië

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers why NATO failed to cooperate fully with the Council of Europe rapporteur investigating the deaths of 63 boat migrants from Libya, and why no rescue was offered after a distress alert. The ministers replied that NATO cooperated to the extent possible, that some information lies with member states, that NATO did not command the sea area, and that the alert was a search request rather than a distress call, so NATO bore no rescue obligation.
Part of the requested information can only be provided by member states. It concerns a national competence.
Een deel van de gevraagde informatie kan alleen door lidstaten worden aangeleverd. Het betreft een nationale bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez over het bericht 'Bondgenoot zette aan tot antiwesterse rellen' en andere mediaberichten over de missie in Kunduz.

An MP (PVV) asked the government about reports that a Kunduz provincial council member allegedly incited anti-Western riots, and about the broader Afghanistan mission, including the training of police, its funding, and post-2014 commitments. The minister answered that there is no evidence the council member incited the unrest, that the government backs continued international engagement and Dutch police training through 2014, and that a financial contribution to Afghan security forces will be detailed later.
I deplore the violent protest actions in Kunduz and am concerned about the unrest the incidents have caused among the population.
Ik betreur de gewelddadige protestacties in Kunduz en ben bezorgd over de onrust die de incidenten onder de bevolking hebben veroorzaakt.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk en Van Bommel over de verkoop van tanks aan Indonesië

SP MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the cabinet approved a 200 million euro tank sale to Indonesia and an Egypt defence deal, how these fit human rights concerns and earlier parliamentary motions, and whether the minister misled parliament on timing. The ministers answered that a cabinet discussion took place with follow-up agreements referred to an earlier letter, no decision had been taken on Egypt, the Indonesia question was addressed in that letter, and they denied the allegations of strategic delay and ignored advice.
Given the cabinet's current caretaker status, we wish to weigh these matters with the utmost care before presenting them to your House.
Mede gezien de huidige demissionaire status van het kabinet willen wij deze aangelegenheden met de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wegen, alvorens ze aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over onbemande vliegtuigen (drones)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister about the KRO report on drones, whether General Atomics or other firms were already favoured for the MALE UAV procurement, whether the Reaper was pre-selected in breach of EU tendering rules, and whether armed drones and targeted killing were planned. The minister answered that no product, supplier or Dutch industry arrangement has been chosen yet, that the drones are for surveillance and reconnaissance and not armed, and that existing humanitarian law applies to unmanned systems.
On the results of the various phases of the DMP, including the acquisition strategy, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Over de resultaten van de verschillende fasen van het DMP, waaronder de verwervingsstrategie, zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het bericht ‘Defensie worstelt met zijn mensen’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence struggles with its personnel, including the scarcity of vacancies, outdated listings on the vacancy bank, business partnerships and placement numbers. The minister explained that vacancies are withheld during reorganisation, that listing procedures are being improved, that convenants with industry exist, and that about 2000 staff found new posts via the vacancy bank.
During this year, as the reorganisation progresses, more and more vacancies will be opened and listed in the vacancy bank.
In de loop van dit jaar zullen, door de vordering van het reorganisatieproces, steeds meer vacatures worden opengesteld en opgenomen in de vacaturebank.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over zelfdoding onder veteranen

MPs Bosman, Van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence minister whether suicide among veterans is tracked and whether a higher suicide rate among Balkan veterans is suspected. The minister answered that only CBS records causes of death without veteran status, that a RIVM study found no significant excess suicide among Balkan veterans, and that Defence is studying periodic CBS-based research and may include veteran suicide data in the Veteranennota from 2013.
Defence is studying whether it is possible to carry out periodic research into suicide among veterans based on CBS information.
Defensie bestudeert of het mogelijk is om aan de hand van de informatie van het CBS periodiek onderzoek uit te voeren naar zelfdoding bij veteranen.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Van Klaveren over politieke uitspraken van legerimam Ali Eddaoudi

MPs Hernandez and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether it is acceptable that an Islamic chaplain and defence employee, Ali Eddaoudi, took political positions in an interview that contradict government policy on a face-veil ban and called Dutch people cheese heads. The minister answered that Eddaoudi only estimated the number of face-veil wearers without giving an opinion on the bill, that the term 'kaaskoppen' was not in his view grievous, and that he retains confidence in him.
He does not give his opinion on the bill.
Hij geeft niet zijn mening over het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over de benoeming van een burgermedewerkster tot generaal

MPs Hernandez and Kortenoeven asked the Defence Minister why a civilian employee was appointed to the rank of major general as deputy commander of the Royal Marechaussee, and questioned her lack of military training and whether this undermines military staff. The minister answered that leadership experience is relevant, declined to discuss individual appointment procedures, and denied any link to unrest among military personnel.
I make no statement about the appointment procedure of individual personnel members.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de benoemingsprocedure van individuele personeelsleden.

Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat parlementsleden van de Britse Defensiecommissie zich grote zorgen maken over de dreiging van een EMP-aanval (Electromagnetic Pulse) voor de nationale veilighe

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether he would revise his view that the threat of an electromagnetic pulse (EMP) attack is low, in light of UK parliamentary warnings, and whether he would commission an interdepartmental study of EMP risks to Dutch critical infrastructure. The minister maintained that the threat is low, said intelligence services rate a nuclear EMP attack as unlikely, described improvised EMP devices as causing limited damage, judged protection costs too high to estimate, and declined to form an interdepartmental working group.
I do not consider there to be a need for this.
De noodzaak hiervoor acht ik niet aanwezig.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Jasper van Dijk over het de verlaging van de prestatie-eisen van de F-35 Joint Strike Fighter

MPs Eijsink and Van Dijk asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a Pentagon proposal to lower F-35 performance requirements, whether this was discussed at the JROC and JPO, and whether a new candidate comparison for replacing the F-16 would follow. The minister confirmed prior information, said the 590 nautical mile range requirement was not lowered but the flight profile was adjusted to meet it, and ruled out a new candidate comparison.
Contrary to what the article suggests, during the JROC meeting the range performance requirement for the F-35A of 590 nautical miles was not lowered.
In tegenstelling tot wat het artikel suggereert, is tijdens de JROC-bijeenkomst de prestatie-eis over het vliegbereik van de F-35A van 590 zeemijlen niet verlaagd.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers over niet uitgereikte onderscheidingen aan Libanon-veteranen

MP Holtackers asked the Defence Minister whether Lebanese decorations for Dutch UNIFIL troops, the 1988 UN Nobel Peace Prize, and the 1983 Bronze Shield award were withheld from veterans, and whether they could be issued or recognised. The minister replied that the Lebanese order went to three officers in 1984 without a general intent to decorate all troops, that no new Dutch medal for the Nobel Prize is planned, and that the Shield was given only to the battalion with the existing Lebanon medal considered sufficient recognition.
I therefore see no reason to expand the decoration system following the award of the Nobel Peace Prize.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om naar aanleiding van de toekenning van de Nobelprijs voor de Vrede het decoratiestelsel uit te breiden.
Antwoord vragen  Leden Eijsink, Hachchi en van Dijk over het bericht 'Defensie krijgt export-admiraal'

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister what mandate the new 'export admiral' would have, whether this blurs independence and integrity given the role's links to defence industry exports, and how it relates to EL&I export promotion and export control. The minister answered that the vice-admiral mainly coordinates property, materiel disposal and supports exports without representing companies, that EL&I remains responsible for export licences, and that existing EL&I export consultations continue.
PCDS Nagtegaal will not act as a representative of companies, so conflict of interest does not arise.
PCDS Nagtegaal zal niet optreden als vertegenwoordiger van bedrijven, dus belangenverstrengeling is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed De aanstelling van een export-admiraal

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a special export admiral had been appointed, what his remit was, and how it fits with supporting industry amid defence cuts. The minister confirmed the temporary appointment of vice-admiral Nagtegaal as part of a reorganisation pool, with export support to Dutch defence industry in coordination with other departments, and said arms-export licensing advice does not fall under this role.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation is responsible for issuing licences for arms exports.
Het ministerie van EL&I is verantwoordelijk voor het verstrekken van vergunningen voor wapenexport.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez over de benoeming tot generaal van een burgermedewerkster

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a civilian employee was appointed brigadier general without officer training and whether this disqualifies the officer corps, and how this fits with ending diversity targets. The minister answered that the appointment followed the Management Development selection process, that the official will receive further training, and that diversity was not a consideration.
Yes, she was appointed on 1 December 2011 as an officer with the rank of brigadier general in the Royal Marechaussee.
Ja, zij is op 1 december 2011 benoemd tot officier in de rang van brigadegeneraal van de Koninklijke marechaussee.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Jasper Van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij mogelijke bombardementsmissies op land in Somalië

MPs Irrgang and Van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands was involved in contingency plans for beach bombardment missions against pirate and insurgent camps in Somalia, and whether this would exceed the mandate. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not involved in any such plans, that piracy and terrorism were conflated in the press, and that Atalanta's mandate rests on UN resolutions; they promised to inform parliament once EU decisions on action with effect on land are completed.
As soon as the decision-making in EU context on action from the sea, with effect on land, is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het mandaat van de EU-operatie Atalanta

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU anti-piracy operation Atalanta, including reports of a more robust approach, UK Apache plans and the mandate under UN resolution 1816. The ministers answered that there is no objection to extending the operating area, that the EU decision on land-effect action is still pending and will be reported to parliament by letter.
Once the decision-making at EU level on action from the sea with effect on land is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden, vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Libische opstandelingen

MP Van Bommel asked whether the Canadian ship HMCS Charlottetown, under NATO command, was ordered to let a vessel carrying arms to Libyan rebels pass, and whether the government knew of arms deliveries to rebels and acted against them. The government answered that NATO judged the transfer within Libya not to breach the arms embargo, that it does not consider the ship's conduct contrary to Dutch policy, and that interpreting UN resolutions is for each member state to decide.
The government shares this view and does not consider the conduct of the Canadian ship to be contrary to Dutch policy.
De regering deelt deze opvatting en acht het optreden van het Canadese schip niet strijdig met het Nederlandse beleid.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het terughalen van een Lynx-helikopter van Libië naar Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Defence Minister whether it is true that a Lynx helicopter stranded on the Libyan coast at Sirte will be brought back to the Netherlands and then dismantled, why this serves a national interest, and whether scrapping it in Libya would be cheaper. The minister confirmed the plan, citing national security and strategic defence material rules that Libya cannot meet, and gave an estimated additional cost of EUR 21,000 funded from the crisis operations budget.
Bringing back the helicopter is a national responsibility and serves a national security interest.
Het terughalen van de helikopter is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en dient een nationaal veiligheidsbelang.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de voortgang van de oorlog in Afghanistan

SP MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a US officer's critical article on the Afghan war, including whether insurgents control most land beyond ISAF bases and whether Afghan security forces make non-fire pacts with insurgents. The minister answered that the article reflects limited observations, that the security transition is on plan, that the government disagrees the Taliban controls territory, and that such pacts are only isolated incidents, with a fuller picture to come in a forthcoming progress letter.
In the forthcoming progress letter you will be informed further about the current security situation.
In de komende stand-van-zakenbrief wordt u nader geïnformeerd over de actuele veiligheidssituatie.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het ambtsbericht van de Nederlandse ambassade in Kabul

An SP MP asked why the NATO general's warning about low trainee numbers in Kunduz was not shared with parliament, and whether the Kabul embassy report could be disclosed. The minister confirmed the statements, said parliament was kept informed through successive letters, gave an uncertain estimate of police trainees, and released the report with its internal commentary and names withheld.
Under the Government Information (Public Access) Act, the official commentary at the end of this report and its annex are not made public.
Op basis van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur worden het ambtelijke commentaar aan het slot van dit bericht en de bijlage niet openbaar gemaakt.

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about the Koran burning at Bagram, the riots in Kunduz, police conduct, the suspension of Dutch mission activities, and President Karzai's reaction. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, described police action as effective, and reported that Dutch training activities resumed from late February and early March 2012.
A joint Afghan-ISAF investigation into the precise background of the burning is ongoing.
Een gezamenlijk Afghaans-ISAF onderzoek naar de precieze achtergrond van de verbranding is gaande
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitzending “KRO reporter internationaal”

An SP MP asked three ministers about a KRO broadcast on Dutch private security contractors operating abroad, including the absence of registration of firearms incidents, screening of personnel, and liability for offences. The government replied that Dutch firms operating only abroad fall under the law of the host country, that MFA-contracted guards are screened by the AIVD and meet strict criteria, and that liability depends on the facts and host-country criminal law.
The principle that for security activities the law of the country of deployment, not of origin, applies, I consider logical and correct.
Het uitgangspunt dat voor het uitvoeren van beveiligingswerkzaamheden niet de wetgeving van het land van herkomst maar die van het land van inzet leidend is acht ik logisch en juist.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink, Hachchi, Jasper van Dijk en El Fassed over het bericht ‘JSF duurder door uitstel aankopen VS’

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether and how the government was informed of the US Pentagon's decision to delay 179 F-35 deliveries over five years, and how information flow through the JSF Program Office had improved. The minister answered that the US notified the Netherlands in January 2012, that the JPO was not responsible for the US order schedule, that he had raised timely information with the JPO director, and that financial effects would be reported to the Chamber by 1 June 2012.

The Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is responsible for the development and future further development of the F-35, contract signing, ongoing production of the F-35 aircraft and preparation of maintenance.

Het Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en toekomstige doorontwikkeling van de F-35, de contractsluiting, de lopende productie van de F-35 toestellen en de voorbereiding van de instandhouding.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Hachchi over Flintlock

MPs Van Bommel and Hachchi asked the defence minister about the Flintlock 2012 training exercise in Mali, including security risks, changed locations, and who decided to cancel it. The minister answered that AFRICOM cancelled the exercise in consultation with Malian authorities and the US ambassador, that Dutch planners were kept informed, and that no date for a future exercise has been set.
The commander of AFRICOM, in consultation with, among others, the commander of JSOTF-TS, the Malian minister of Defence and the US ambassador in Bamako, decided to cancel the exercise.
De commandant van AFRICOM heeft in overleg met onder meer de commandant van JSOTF-TS, de Malinese minister van Defensie en de Amerikaanse ambassadeur in Bamako besloten de oefening af te gelasten.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de verhoging van de pensioenpremie door het ABP

An MP asked the ministers whether the government had budgeted for the ABP pension premium increase costing the state over 300 million euros, how the costs would be absorbed and what it means for civil servants' pay, cuts and collective bargaining. The minister answered that the increase was partly foreseeable but not budgeted, that ministries must absorb it through personnel and material savings, that net pay falls about 0.4%, and that the pension agreement measures will be implemented in the ABP scheme.
The shortfall caused by the recovery surcharge on the pension premium does not come entirely unexpectedly.
De tegenvaller vanwege de herstelopslag op de pensioenpremie komt niet helemaal onverwacht.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over het bericht dat Nederland zich niet houdt aan Europese aanbestedingsregels

An MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Netherlands is not complying with EU defence procurement rules, whether it can meet the Commission's two-month deadline, and when the directive will be transposed. The government confirms it received a reasoned opinion, explains the Commission could take the Netherlands to the Court of Justice, and says compliance will follow once the Aanbestedingswet on defence and security is passed by both chambers.
The Netherlands can comply with the Commission's request as soon as the bill is approved by your chamber and the Senate and the law enters into force.
Nederland kan voldoen aan het verzoek van de Commissie zo spoedig als het wetsvoorstel door uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer is goedgekeurd en de wet in werking treedt.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Finance whether Greece will buy costly, unnecessary weapons during its bailout, whether the Dutch government issued export licences and lobbied for German arms sales, and whether Greek defence spending is excessive. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets have fallen since 2007, that the Dutch licence concerns frigate radar components for a Greek shipbuilding programme unrelated to the Die Zeit report, and that Greek procurement is a matter for Greece, declining to confirm several reported claims.
It is for the Greek government to shape its security policy and to set the priorities for its armed forces, and therefore also for its investments.
Het is aan de Griekse regering om haar veiligheidsbeleid vorm te geven, alsook de prioriteiten vast te stellen voor de strijdkrachten en daarmee ook in het doen van investeringen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over gebrek aan openheid over mogelijke tankdeal met Indonesië

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia was kept in the dark about a possible Dutch Leopard tank sale, how the government would implement the parliamentary motion on arms sales to Indonesia, and whether Indonesian parliamentarians had visited the Netherlands. The government answered that confidential talks with interested countries are ongoing, that any agreement would be reported to parliament, that Indonesia was informed of the motion, and that no catalogue or export-country list exists, with overview information provided in the annual MPO.
Should an agreement be reached with one of those countries, it will of course be reported to the House in accordance with the Van den Doel et al. motion.
Mocht het met een van die landen tot een overeenkomst komen, dan zal die uiteraard in overeenstemming met de motie-Van den Doel c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hernandez en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Defensie de eerste islamitische gebedsruimte heeft geopend

MPs Hernandez and Van Klaveren asked the defence minister about the cost and rationale of opening an Islamic prayer room at a Defence base amid budget cuts, and whether Defence is 'Islamising'. The minister confirmed the room, gave the cost (EUR 18,247.57), argued Islam is treated equally to other religions, and rejected the Islamisation claim and the radical characterisation of a chaplain.
Defence spent EUR 18,247.57, from the budget of the Chaplaincy Services, to set up an existing room for Islamic prayer services.
Defensie heeft voor een bedrag van € 18 247,57 – uit de begroting van de Diensten Geestelijke Verzorging – een bestaande ruimte ingericht voor islamitische gebedsdiensten.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en De Mos over het bericht dat het ministerie van Defensie zonnepanelen op scholen en gemeentegebouwen medefinanciert

Two PVV MPs asked Defence Minister Hillen whether Defence co-financed solar panels on schools and municipal buildings in Coevorden, what its interest was, whether this was a wrong signal given cuts to units and barracks, and for overviews of its energy spending and energy-policy staff. The minister confirmed a EUR 121,000 contribution tied to the Coevorden wind park agreement to build local support, said it saves Defence EUR 600,000 a year, and provided figures of about EUR 80 million a year on energy purchases and EUR 65 million for 2009-2017 on efficiency measures, plus roughly nine policy staff partly on energy.
Asked why not if not: answer 4 - at current energy prices Defence spends about EUR 80 million a year on purchasing energy.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4 Bij de huidige energieprijzen besteedt Defensie jaarlijks ongeveer € 80 miljoen aan de inkoop van energie.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink over het artikel “Defensie maakt puinhoop van personeelsbeleid”

An MP asks the Defence Minister why training requests and personal development plans for Defence staff are being refused or delayed despite clear rules, whether an advisory commission is in place, and whether the 'rugzakje' training budget can be guaranteed. The minister answers that the FPS instruments were introduced stepwise, budget cuts lower available training funds, the commission will be installed on 1 March 2012 with a limited role, and training budgets not used by one employee can be used for others.
The commission will be installed on 1 March.
De commissie zal 1 maart a.s. worden geïnstalleerd.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de business case van de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne (VBHKAZ) door de gemeente Doorn

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the defence minister about the Doorn municipality's business case for reusing the Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne, including why Defence did not supply cost data and whether the Zeeland marine barracks figures differ. The minister answered that Defence gave Utrechtse Heuvelrug all requested inputs, uses the same norm amounts for both locations, and will compare the business cases once the Zeeland working group reports.
In the consultation with the House I declared myself willing to provide the necessary information.
In het overleg met de Kamer heb ik me bereid verklaard de daartoe benodigde informatie te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez over het kerstpakket van het CZSK

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether the Royal Navy's Christmas package containing the glossy magazine 'He He ik zit' was published or funded by Defence, how much it cost, and what its added value is for staff. The minister answered that the magazine is a standard component of the supplier's gift package with only the cover adapted, that Defence is not involved in its content, that the package costs EUR 35 per employee of which the magazine's exact cost is unknown to Defence, and that the premise of an expensive publication is incorrect.
Defence is not involved in the content of this magazine.
Defensie is niet betrokken bij de inhoud van dit blad.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Knops over de arbeidsmarkttoeslag voor reservisten

MPs Eijsink and Knops asked the Defence Minister whether ending the labour-market allowance for reservists would reduce reservist availability amid budget cuts, and whether reservists who object would no longer be called up. The minister answered that the allowance is being applied more selectively by the CLAS commander, that he does not expect a major effect on reservists' willingness to serve, and that objecting reservists would indeed not be called up.
This is the responsibility of the commander of the relevant operational command.
Dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van de commandant van het desbetreffende operationeel commando.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de uitstapmogelijkheden van het JSF-programma

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Defence and Economic Affairs whether Dutch industry contracts depend on actually buying JSF aircraft, what exit costs and withdrawal conditions apply, and when the government shared these with parliament. Minister Hillen answered that industry has received orders from the development phase, that order allocation depends on US prime contractors and best-value principles, that partial information has been shared confidentially over time, and that Nederland can exit subject to MoU terms with exit costs to be detailed in the 2011 annual report.
It is contained in the Lockheed Martin Letter of Intent that was sent confidentially to the House on 10 October 2006.
Het is opgenomen in de Letter of Intent van Lockheed Martin die op 10 oktober 2006 vertrouwelijk aan de Kamer is gezonden
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de vermeende puinhoop van het personeelsbeleid bij Defensie

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about union claims of a personnel policy mess at Defence, including vacancy bank problems, opaque selection, standardised rejection letters and advice to leave for training via EBD. The minister said processes are being corrected and vacancy bank adjustments made, rejections are standardised for efficiency with contact persons available, and no known cases of advising early resignation exist.
Employees interested in a particular position can indicate this via the vacancy bank.
Medewerkers die belangstelling hebben voor een bepaalde functie kunnen dit via de vacaturebank kenbaar maken.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het artikel “Uitbrander voor landmachtbaas”

An MP asks the Defence Minister whether the Land Forces commander was reprimanded over quality-based selection in personnel cuts, and about frozen promotions and union agreements. The minister says contact with commanders was discussed, that quality and experience criteria are used, that promotions are limited but not frozen, and that a clarifying letter will follow.
The commander of the CLAS will remove the misunderstandings in a new letter.
De commandant van het CLAS zal in een nieuwe brief de misverstanden wegnemen.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over het Turkse raketprogramma

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Turkey is developing long-range ballistic missiles, whether this breaches NATO philosophy or the non-proliferation treaty, and whether the minister will raise it at NATO. The minister replied that nothing is known to him about a Turkish missile programme, declined to engage with the NATO and non-proliferation questions on that basis, and answered the timing question affirmatively.
I have no knowledge of this and have also been unable to obtain any confirmation of it.
Mij is daarover niets bekend en evenmin heb ik daar enige vorm van bevestiging van kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over het tekort aan soldaten en korporaals

An MP asks the Defence Minister about shortages of soldiers and corporals in the Dutch army, caused by budget cuts that block filling operational posts while surplus officers remain on payroll. The minister acknowledges the problem, says operational units will be fully staffed by 2013 and other units by 2014, and states that recruitment is being pursued and progress reported to parliament.
Once the staffing of an operational unit falls below seventy percent, that unit is no longer deployable.
Zodra de vulling van een operationele eenheid lager is dan zeventig procent is deze eenheid niet meer inzetbaar.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht “Grieken lopen fors achter op schema”

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about reports that Greece is well behind schedule on reforms, including 210 of 300 unimplemented measures, continued pension and disability benefit fraud, and whether the next loan tranche will be blocked. The answer was given in a letter of 28 November 2012, which the summary of the answer text provided here does not include.
Will you block the request for postponement of payment and the disbursement of the next tranche if Greece has not kept to the agreements?
Gaat u de aanvraag om uitstel van betaling en de uitbetaling van de volgende tranche blokkeren als Griekenland zich niet aan de afspraken heeft gehouden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht «Griekenland kan niet aan eisen voldoen»

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Finance Minister whether Greece can meet the conditions for its bailout tranche and why Dutch money should go to a country that fails to reform. The minister replied that the Troika found Greece had met the conditions, so the tranche was released and the loan programme continues.
Following the latest Troika progress report, I judge that Greece has ultimately met the requirements to disburse the tranche from the loan programme.
Naar aanleiding van het laatste voortgangsrapport van de Trojka oordeel ik dat Griekenland uiteindelijk aan de eisen heeft voldaan om de tranche uit het leningenprogramma uit te keren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake derivatenposities van publieke en semi-publieke instellingen

An MP asks the government for an overview of derivative positions across public and semi-public institutions and for details on municipal, provincial and Groningen Seaports exposures. The minister answers that the central government lacks data on local authorities' derivatives, that horizontal supervision applies, that Groningen Seaports is still being assessed, and that an overview is being prepared.
Insight into derivative positions of decentralised governments is not available at national government level.
Inzicht in derivatenposities van decentrale overheden is op Rijksniveau niet voorhanden.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang over het bericht dat Griekenland de afspraken over vermindering van het aantal ambtenaren schendt

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece hired tens of thousands of new civil servants in 2010-2011 despite agreed reductions, and whether the Troika knew. The minister confirmed that the reduction of civil servants was slower than planned due to hiring offsetting departures, cited the MoU target of 150,000 cuts by 2015, and said the Troika will monitor progress closely.
The Troika concluded in March that the main cause was the lack of effective centralised coordination in the public sector.
De Trojka oordeelde in maart jl. dat de voornaamste oorzaak hiervoor het gebrek aan effectieve gecentraliseerde coördinatie in de publieke sector betrof.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over vergoeding schade bij fraude internetbankieren

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about liability for losses from internet banking fraud, including whether banks are shifting liability to customers through security conditions. The minister replied that liability is limited to 150 euro for non-compliance with bank security rules, with full liability only for intent or gross negligence, that banks have been generous but are becoming stricter, and that disputes can go to KiFiD or the courts.
Consumers are liable where there is intent or gross negligence.
Consumenten zijn aansprakelijk als sprake is van opzet of grove nalatigheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de gebrekkige concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about weak competition on the mortgage market, including whether the 2008 state-aid price-leadership ban on ING was a missed chance and how mortgage margins compare to claims by the Vereniging Eigen Huis. The minister says the ban was a Commission condition that was not freely negotiable, that it is now being ended as part of the ING restructuring, and that the government will keep monitoring the market with the NMa and announces transparency and single-tier rate measures.
I cannot therefore endorse the finding that there would have been a missed opportunity.
De constatering dat er sprake zou zijn van een gemiste kans kan ik dan ook niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over het bericht dat de hypotheekrentes in Nederland in internationaal perspectief zeer hoog zijn

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch mortgage margins are too high by international standards, whether the mortgage market is uncompetitive, and whether the price-leadership ban is to blame. The minister said DNB attributes much of the gap to higher bank funding costs, that the NMa found margins had returned to pre-crisis levels in 2011, and that ING's price-leadership ban was lifted and NN Bank will enter the market, with the NMa continuing to monitor.
Because margins may have risen since then, given changed competitive conditions after several parties recently left the Dutch market, I welcome the NMa closely monitoring the mortgage market.

Omdat de marges sindsdien kunnen zijn gestegen, mede gegeven de gewijzigde concurrentieverhoudingen ten gevolge van het feit dat recentelijk een aantal partijen de Nederlandse markt hebben verlaten, juich ik toe dat de NMa de hypotheekmarkt scherp monitort.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer en Vos over de hoge additionele kosten bij het gebruik van een creditcard voor betalingen en specifiek voor boekingen bij vliegtuigmaatschappijen

MPs Nijboer and Vos asked about high credit-card surcharges on payments, especially airline bookings, and whether UK-style rules should apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the EU consumer rights directive caps surcharges at actual costs, including for passenger transport, that a Dutch implementing bill is expected soon, and that the Payment Services Directive revision will be pursued, while consumer-authority enforcement on hidden fees is noted.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer inzake onnodig duur ‘rood staan’ op betaalrekeningen

An MP asks the Finance Minister why people go into overdraft while holding savings, which banks charge high overdraft rates, and whether the maximum credit charge should be lowered. The minister answers that existing consumer-credit rules and AFM monitoring apply, promises a study on lowering the overdraft ceiling in 2013, and says he will discuss avoiding long overdrafts with the sector.
I will start a study into the effects of the maximum credit charge on overdrafts, the possibilities of moving to a lower ceiling, and the justification for this ceiling.

In aanvulling op deze maatregelen zal ik een onderzoek starten naar de effecten van de maximum kredietvergoeding op roodstanden, naar de mogelijkheden om naar een lager plafond te gaan en naar de onderbouwing van dit plafond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de verplichte privatisering van waterbedrijven in ruil voor Europese staatsleningen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Finance whether Greece and Portugal are required to privatise their water utilities as a condition of EU financial support, who sets that condition, and how access to drinking water is guaranteed. The minister answers that privatisation is part of the loan conditionality, that the Memorandum of Understanding for Greece lists water companies for sale, and that the Troika supervises implementation and should ensure full water access for all citizens.

In the case of Greece, more concrete agreements on privatisations were made in the programme agreed in February, and a list of companies to be privatised, including water companies, was also drawn up.

In het geval van Griekenland zijn in het programma zoals overeengekomen in februari, concretere afspraken gemaakt over de privatiseringen en is er ook een lijst opgesteld met te privatiseren bedrijven, waaronder waterbedrijven.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over het betalen van ruim € 4,8 mln. aan zakenbank Lazard voor het omstreden advies over de waarde van ABN-AMRO ten tijde van de overname door de Nederlandse Staat in 2008

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether the ministry paid about EUR 4.8 million to investment bank Lazard for its disputed 2008 valuation of ABN-AMRO and Fortis, and how that fee was structured, benchmarked and monitored, including a further payment in 2011. The minister confirmed the 2008 payment, described it as a fixed fee plus a completion bonus with no hourly rates, defended the fee as reasonable under the circumstances, and said the 2011 advice was procured competitively.
This amount is made up of a fixed fee for the agreed services, an additional amount payable on completion of the transaction, and VAT.
Het bedrag is opgebouwd uit een vaste vergoeding voor de overeengekomen dienstverlening, een aanvullend bedrag betaalbaar bij afronding van de transactie en BTW.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Plasterk over strengere eisen aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf bij het verstrekken van kredieten

MPs Mei Li Vos and Plasterk asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance why SME credit is riskier and more expensive than large-firm credit, whether banks will tighten lending criteria, and what alternative financing and Innovation Fund instruments exist. The minister replied that SME rates reflect structural risk and transaction costs, that credit has broadly held up, and outlined existing and planned financing instruments, while declining to assign BNG a direct SME lending role and leaving the transformation of the Innovation Fund into a national investment bank to a future cabinet.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments regarding credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Braakhuis over de betrokkenheid van een Nederlands trustkantoor bij illegale houtkap

An MP asked the Finance ministry whether a Dutch trust office's involvement in illegal logging in Indonesia was adequately checked by DNB, including UBO transparency, consolidation duties, treaty misuse and substance requirements. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing secrecy rules, explained DNB's supervisory scope and general legal framework, and said no change to the Civil Code was needed.
Due to statutory confidentiality obligations for the Tax Authority and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB), I cannot simply go into the details of this individual case.
Door wettelijke geheimhoudingsverplichtingen voor de Belastingdienst en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) kan ik op de bijzonderheden van dit individuele geval niet zonder meer ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot over de werkwijze van gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs Recourt and Groot asked whether bailiffs allocate collected payments first to costs, then interest, then principal, and whether this creates tax or legal issues, notably in ABN AMRO cases. The government answered that the Article 6:44 BW order applies, found no indications of tax avoidance or criminal conduct, and said the Bureau Financieel Toezicht is conducting an exploratory investigation into bailiffs' interest calculations, expected to conclude in October.
In January 2012 the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) started an exploratory investigation into interest calculation by bailiffs.
In januari 2012 is het Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) gestart met een verkennend onderzoek naar renteberekening door gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether vocational (mbo) institutions that traded interest rate derivatives, now costing them money, stayed within their tasks, and how such risky products could be prevented. The minister answered that institutions must follow the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectorate is investigating derivative use with results expected in autumn, and that action will be considered if unacceptable risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded vocational education institutions.
Ik heb aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht “Ikea opent bank in Nederland – zonder toezicht”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Ikano Bank, which plans to open a Dutch branch without a Dutch banking licence, should need one, and raised misleading website claims about deposit guarantees and a 13% interest rate. The minister answered that the bank operates under an EU passport with Swedish licensing, must notify DNB, has removed the misleading website claims, does not take deposits in the Netherlands, and that AFM supervises the statutory 15% maximum credit charge.
Ikano Bank has a Swedish banking licence and therefore falls under Swedish supervision.
Ikano Bank heeft een Zweedse bankvergunning en valt zodoende onder het Zweedse toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk over het bericht dat het speculeren met derivatencontracten op de staatsschuld tot verliezen heeft geleid

MPs Groot and Plasterk asked the Finance Minister about a Parool report that derivative swaps on the national debt caused losses of around 100 million euro, and about the risk policy and controls. The minister said the state does not speculate, acknowledged about 11 billion euro of swaps taken early in 2011 with a market loss of about 100 million, explained the 7-year risk framework, called the 2.4 billion figure a misunderstanding, and said control procedures were tightened.
I would like to point out that the State does not speculate.
Ik hecht eraan erop te wijzen dat de Staat niet speculeert.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Nederlandse investeringen in leveranciers aan het Syrische regime

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch financial institutions investing in firms supplying monitoring technology to the Syrian regime breach EU sanctions and what the government will do. The government answered that there is no indication of violation by the named firms, so no concrete measures are planned, while describing existing enforcement and supervision of sanctions.
There are no indications that the institutions named in the Profundo research have violated this regulation; there is therefore no direct reason for concrete government measures.

Er zijn geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat de in het onderzoek van Profundo genoemde instellingen deze verordening hebben overtreden; er is daarom geen directe aanleiding voor concrete maatregelen door de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de voorgenomen steunoperaties door de ECB

An MP from the CDA asked the finance minister whether the ECB planned an interest-rate cap for crisis countries, whether this fits the ECB's mandate and the ban on monetary financing, and what the Dutch central bank and the government would do about moral hazard. The minister replied that no cap was introduced, that the ECB is independent and the government will not comment on its bond-buying policy, and noted the conditionality attached to the September 2012 bond-purchase programme.
I further emphasise that the ECB is independent in carrying out its monetary task and accordingly I do not express a view on the ECB's policy regarding the purchase of government bonds.

Ik benadruk verder dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in de uitvoering van de monetaire taak en dienovereenkomstig spreek ik mij niet uit over het beleid van de ECB ten aanzien van de opkoop van staatsobligaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony Van Dijck over het bericht «Bundesbank-voorzitter vecht tegen plannen van het ECB» om weer staatsobligaties van failliete landen op te kopen

An MP asked the finance minister whether he knew of reports that Bundesbank president Weidmann was fighting ECB plans to resume buying sovereign bonds, whether he would speak out against this, and how the Dutch taxpayer's risk on the ECB (including Target-2, SMP and LTRO) could be prevented or quantified. The minister acknowledged the reports, declined to comment on ECB policy citing its independence, and said risks are shared under the ECB capital key without quantifying Dutch exposure.

Regarding the second part of your question, I emphasise that the ECB is independent in carrying out its monetary task and accordingly I do not comment on the ECB's policy regarding the purchase of government bonds.

Aangaande het tweede deel van uw vraag benadruk ik dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in de uitvoering van de monetaire taak en dienovereenkomstig spreek ik mij niet uit over het beleid van de ECB ten aanzien van de opkoop van staatsobligaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke belastingontwijking door NS

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether NS Financial Services Co, NS's financing subsidiary, is based in Dublin to avoid Dutch tax, and what the tax and dividend effects are. The government explains the Dublin location was chosen for lease-company investment conditions, declines to give individual tax figures citing secrecy rules, denies any effect on executive bonuses, and says Dutch tax is not earmarked for public transport.
The confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents disclosing information about individual taxpayers.
De geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat eraan in de weg informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel over de resultaten van het onderzoek door consultancybureau AT Kearney over de kosten van banken

An MP asked the finance minister about an AT Kearney study showing bank cost ratios have barely fallen since the crisis, and asked about causes, Dutch comparisons, pay policy and planned action. The minister answered that the study covers European trends, explained that fixed IT and staff costs and CAO obligations slow cost cuts, and said banks are primarily responsible for cutting costs while he supports their stated goals.
I support this call and trust that banks will take further measures in the coming years to lower their costs.
Ik ondersteun deze oproep en vertrouw erop dat banken de komende jaren verdere maatregelen zullen nemen om hun kosten te verlagen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "overheidsmaffiapraktijken op Sicilië"

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of excessive public spending and clientelism in Sicily, and whether the Netherlands would refuse financial aid to Italy. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, said Italy has made no aid request, and that Italy must address its own problems.
Italy has not submitted a request for support.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitspraken van de Finse minister van Financiën dat het uiteenvallen van de eurozone slechts een kwestie van tijd is

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government to react to Finnish minister Tuomioja's remarks that eurozone breakup is a matter of time, and what the Netherlands is doing to prepare, and whether it will stop signing blank cheques for Brussels. Minister De Jager replied that Tuomioja is foreign minister, not finance minister, that the Finnish government did not endorse his view, that the Dutch government considers various scenarios and aims to strengthen the euro, and that existing measures (SGP automaticity, twopack, conditionality on EFSF aid) already reflect its position.
The government's aim is a strengthened euro.
De inzet van het kabinet is een versterkte euro.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether banks' practice of applying a 2% monthly norm to the total student debt, rather than actual repayments, inflates the mortgage burden and whether they will raise this with lenders. The State Secretary answered that lenders must consider student loan burdens under the Wft, that DUO loans are not consumer credit under that rule, and that banks and insurers agreed to use 0.75% of the original loan from 1 April 2013, with the government endorsing this method.
In good consultation these parties agreed that the mortgage lender will, in future, in principle base the monthly financial burden attached to the student debt on 0.75% of the original loan.

In goed overleg zijn deze partijen overeengekomen dat de hypothecair financier in de toekomst bij de berekening van de aan de studieschuld verbonden maandelijkse financiële lasten in beginsel uitgaat van 0,75% van de oorspronkelijke lening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over onderzoek naar de Libor- en Euriboraffaire

An MP asked the finance minister whether Dutch supervisors are investigating possible Dutch bank involvement in manipulating Libor and Euribor and whether they have sufficient powers to act. The minister answered that DNB and the AFM are jointly investigating with foreign authorities, that DNB has adequate prudential powers, and that criminal prosecution options are limited until EU rules are extended to benchmark manipulation.
DNB has invited the AFM to take part in the investigation, given the AFM's expertise on the conduct of financial institutions and its knowledge of market abuse.

DNB heeft de AFM uitgenodigd aan het onderzoek deel te nemen, vanwege de expertise van de AFM op het gebied van gedrag van financiële instellingen en haar kennis van misbruik op de financiële markten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat ECB president Draghi lid zou zijn van een lobbygroep van grote banken

Green Left MP Klaver asked the Finance Minister about reports that ECB President Draghi was a member of the Group of Thirty, a bank lobby group, and whether he could keep functioning during an ombudsman investigation. The minister confirmed the reports, described the Group of Thirty as a discussion forum, and said he had full confidence in the ECB and would await the ombudsman's decision.
I have full confidence in the European Central Bank and its management and await with interest the decision of the European Ombudsman.
Ik heb alle vertrouwen in de Europese Centrale Bank en haar directie en wacht met belangstelling het besluit van de Europese ombudsman af.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk over het bericht ‘Bank zet trouwe klant in de kou’

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked whether banks have substantially reduced mortgage financing for existing clients with stable incomes, whether banks interpret tightened rules too strictly, and whether high mortgage rates are justified given banks' cheap funding. The minister replied that LTI norms were tightened by recalculated Nibud norms and the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen, that exceptions and room for tailoring remain, that banks face funding and risk pressures, and that the NMa found margins had fallen back to pre-crisis levels by early 2011.
The banks, the AFM and I myself remain in discussion about this.
De banken, de AFM en ikzelf blijven hierover in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Van Vliet over bezoldiging van FMO’s bestuurders

MPs Driessen and Van Vliet asked about state ownership of development bank FMO, its capital base, and whether its executives' pay (directors earning up to 429,000 euro including pensions) fits a development organisation and should be subject to the Balkenende norm. The minister confirmed the state holds 51% and over 90% of equity is state-funded, explained that pay figures include pensions and that the CEO's fixed pay is now capped at 270,000 euro, and argued FMO operates as a market-facing bank so the public/market pay category applies, declining to apply the Balkenende norm or sell the shares.
The public interest is reflected in the way the state, as shareholder, acts on the remuneration policy, which must be sufficiently moderate.
Het publiek belang vindt zijn weerslag in de wijze waarop de staat als aandeelhouder acteert ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid, dat voldoende gematigd moet zijn.
Antwoord vragen Plasterk en Groot over het bericht dat een Mexicaanse telecomgigant een bod doet op 28% van de aandelen in KPN

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister about América Móvil's partial bid for 28% of KPN shares, whether the 30% mandatory-bid threshold should be lowered, and whether the minister could change it by decree. The minister declined to judge the bid, said the 30% threshold was chosen deliberately and remains in line with other EU states, and stated that changing it would require a change in the law.
In view of the above, I currently see no reason to change the threshold for the mandatory bid.
Gezien bovenstaande zie ik momenteel geen reden om de drempelwaarde voor het verplichte bod te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck,  Bontes en Wilders over de berichten "De Jager moet miljard bijlenen voor steun aan Griekenland" en "Merkel pleit voor nieuwe politieke unie in Europa"

MPs Van Dijck, Bontes and Wilders asked whether the government would refuse further Greek support and reject Merkel's call for more EU powers. The government answered that the Greek loan programme is funded via the EFSF without Dutch market borrowing, and that it will respond to the Van Rompuy report on the economic pillar once published.
The cabinet will come with a response to this report as soon as it has been published.
zal het kabinet met een reactie op dit rapport komen zodra dit is verschenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Irrgang over de mogelijkheden in het privaatrecht bonussen terug te vorderen

An MP asked whether private law allows clawing back or refusing excessive bonuses that cause public outrage, and whether contractual freedom is absolute. The minister answered that contractual freedom is not absolute, that bonus contracts are not untouchable under Civil Code provisions on reasonableness and fairness, and pointed to a bonus-adjustment bill and other measures such as pay caps in the public and semi-public sector.
The cabinet does not consider contracts in which high bonuses have been agreed to be untouchable.
Het kabinet acht contracten, waarin hoge bonussen zijn afgesproken, niet onaantastbaar.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over vermeende kartelafspraken

MP Kuiken asked the government about alleged cartel arrangements among oil companies on petrol prices, including a German investigation, whether it extends to the Netherlands, signs of cartel formation in Dutch fuel sales, and steps to lower pump prices. The minister said the German probe is limited to Germany, that NMa has no findings of cartel conduct in the Dutch market but will not comment on ongoing probes, that pricing patterns are for the NMa to assess, and listed tax and crude price factors and a planned tender-information measure.
It is for the NMa to assess whether patterns or conduct in the market point to possible cartel arrangements between the oil companies.
Het is aan de NMa om te beoordelen of patronen of gedragingen in de markt duiden op mogelijke kartelafspraken tussen de oliemaatschappijen.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over de uitzending van Tros Radar over wurghypotheken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about mortgages that borrowers cannot refinance under stricter lending rules, and about the lack of obligation on lenders to offer refinancing and on using savings to repay mortgages. The minister answered that the GHF allows exemptions for refinancing, that the AFM supervises this, that individual lenders decide whether to use the exemptions, and that structural reforms to the mortgage market are planned.
There is no overview available of the nature and extent of the problems in situations where consumers wish to refinance an existing mortgage that does not meet the stricter rules.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van de aard en hoeveelheid problemen die bestaan in de situaties waarbij consumenten een bestaande hypotheek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over de onduidelijkheid tussen de vitaliteitsparagraaf in het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma en die paragraaf in het Stabiliteitsprogramma

MPs Vermeij and Hamer asked why the vitality package's mobility bonuses appear in the National Reform Programme but are cut back in the Stability Programme, and which work bonuses are ended. Minister Kamp answered that the programmes were aligned as far as possible, that the mobility budget is frozen rather than abolished, and that the work bonuses for workers and employers are ended as part of the budget agreement.
The final version of the National Reform Programme submitted to your House on 27 April was aligned as far as possible with the commitments in the Stability Programme.
De definitieve versie van het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma dat op 27 april aan uw Kamer is aangeboden, is zo veel mogelijk afgestemd op de afspraken uit het Stabiliteitsprogramma.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de gevolgen van de woon-werkbelasting voor de huurtoeslag, zorgtoeslag en kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether taxing commuting allowances would reduce housing, healthcare and childcare benefits, and whether affected workers would be compensated. The minister confirmed the reduction effect depends on how employers apply the tax rules, and deferred any compensation discussion to the upcoming budget debate.
There is still sufficient opportunity to address this subject during the relevant legislative debate.
Bij de betreffende wetsbehandeling is er nog voldoende gelegenheid om dit onderwerp te behandelen.
Antwoord vragen Plasterk over het bericht dat ABN Amro kwijtschelding van leningen aan openbaar vervoerbedrijven in Griekenland weigert

Plasterk asks the Finance Minister whether he knew ABN Amro refused to waive loans to Greek public transport companies, whether the IIF negotiated on its behalf, and why uncertainty arose months after the Greek deal. The minister answers that the Dutch government knew of ABN Amro's position, that participation in voluntary haircuts is the institutions' own decision, and that ABN Amro lacked definitive clarity until February 2012.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitbetaling van 4,2 miljard euro aan Griekenland

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the finance minister whether it is absurd to pay 4.2 billion euro to unstable Greece and whether he will stop such payments. The minister replied that the Eurogroup had already approved the Greek loan programme and that the EFSF CEO decided on the timing and amount of tranche payments, with the sum earmarked for bond repayments held by the public sector.
After approval by the Eurogroup, the CEO of the EFSF has the authority to decide on the amount and timing of the various payments of a tranche within the set deadline.

Na goedkeuring door de Eurogroep heeft de CEO van EFSF de bevoegdheid om te besluiten over de hoogte en het moment van de verschillende uitbetalingen van een tranche binnen de termijn die hiervoor is vastgesteld.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Jacobi over de dreigende investeringsstop van provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen

MPs Heijnen and Jacobi asked the Finance Minister whether the planned Wet Hof (sustainable public finances act) would hinder infrastructure investment by provinces, municipalities and water boards, and whether it would be adjusted. The minister replied that decentralised governments must contribute to EU deficit targets, that the Act is under Council of State advice, and that the decentralised governments will give a definitive reaction after the spring consultation.
With the Wet Hof, the main principles of trend-based budget policy will be anchored in law.
Met de Wet Hof worden de belangrijkste uitgangspunten van het trendmatig begrotingsbeleid wettelijk verankerd.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over het bericht ‘Verzekeraar ASR blokkeert claims woekerpolis’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether insurer ASR's requests that policyholders sign waivers of their right to litigate over the woekerpolis (usurious policy) compensation are permissible and whether the government will act. The minister replied that ASR says it no longer requests such release (kwijting) from clients, that it will not rely on past releases, and that the government will monitor insurers' 'best of class' commitments, including on past releases, and engage insurers if clients are shut out of court.
Customers of ASR therefore always still have the right to litigate.
Klanten van ASR hebben daardoor altijd nog het recht om te procederen.
Antwoord vragen Blanksma-van den Heuvel over de voor- en nadelen van liquiditeitssteun van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB)

MPs Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about risks and benefits of the ECB's LTRO liquidity support, including inflation, TARGET2 claims, collateral easing and whether banks are kept artificially alive. The minister declined to comment on monetary policy matters, said the ECB only provides liquidity, not solvency support, and reported Dutch banks' LTRO uptake and DNB's TARGET2 claim of 144 billion euro.

In answering these questions it is appropriate for me as Minister of Finance to show restraint, because they directly concern the monetary tasks of the ECB and DNB as part of the Eurosystem, which are independent in implementing monetary policy.

Bij beantwoording van deze vragen past mij als minister van Financiën terughoudendheid, omdat zij direct raken aan de monetaire taken van de ECB en DNB als onderdeel van het Eurosysteem, die onafhankelijk zijn in de uitvoering van het monetaire beleid.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over 'de invoer van producten uit nederzettingen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever'

MP Van Bommel asked ministers about imports of products from West Bank settlements under the EU-Israel Association Agreement, including labelling, preferential-origin controls, a blacklist of firms, and enforcement. Minister Rosenthal answered that such misuse is very rare, that origin checks are conducted with the Commission moving toward publishing a settlement postcode list, that blacklisting is for the Commission, and that no import ban exists in line with the international position.

Partly at the urging of the European Parliament, the European Commission is currently considering publishing this list with the aim of preventing settlement products from using the tariff preferences.

Mede op aandringen van het EP overweegt de Europese Commissie (EC) momenteel openbaarmaking van deze lijst met als doel om te voorkomen dat nederzettingenproducten gebruik maken van de tariefpreferenties.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Plasterk over consumentenvertrouwen en consumptie

MPs Albayrak and Plasterk asked why Dutch consumer confidence fell and why Dutch consumer spending diverged from Germany's after EU consumer spending stalled in Q4 2011. Minister Verhagen attributed the decline to stock prices, unemployment, inflation and housing prices, said the divergence reflects Germany's stronger recovery, and stressed the government's efforts to preserve confidence in public finances.
The cabinet is therefore working hard to safeguard confidence in the sustainability of public finances.
Het kabinet werkt daarom hard om het vertrouwen in de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën te borgen.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over de besteding van provinciale subsidiegelden

Deputy Driessen (PVV) asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that four provinces spend about half their budgets on subsidies, that many subsidies are not evaluated or evaluated poorly, and whether the government will talk to the provinces about this. Minister Spies answered that provinces are autonomous and responsible for their own subsidies, that the provincial councils and local audit offices should hold the executive to account, and that the provinces will adopt the audit office's recommendations.
The provinces, as autonomous tiers of government, are themselves responsible for granting subsidies, and it is up to the local elected council to form a judgement on this.
De provincies zijn als autonome bestuurslaag zélf verantwoordelijk voor de verstrekking van subsidies en het is aan de lokale volksvertegenwoordiging om hier een oordeel over te vormen
Antwoord vragen Van Bemmel en Tony van Dijck over de storingen bij ING (min ELI)

PVV MPs Van Bemmel and Van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that ING must always be reachable for internet banking, and whether the minister will talk with ING's management about a backup system. Finance Minister De Jager answered that ING has a full shadow backup system, that the outages were a rare combination of human error and technology, and that he sees no reason to discuss it further with ING's management.
In view of the above, I see no reason to exchange further views with ING's management on this.
Gelet op vorenstaande zie ik geen redenen om hier met de directie van ING verder nog over van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord vragen Smilde, Bruins Slot en Blanksma-van den Heuvel over het bericht "dure verzekering voor dikke mensen"

Three CDA MPs asked how a person of normal health but high BMI (1.60 m, 90 kg) can pay higher insurance premiums, and how insurers assess health and lifestyle. The minister explained that insurers may use lifestyle factors including overweight for life and disability insurance, that assessment follows insurers' own policies within legal limits, and that health insurance premiums must generally be uniform.
Insurers may not ask more questions than are included in this model health declaration.
Verzekeraars mogen niet meer vragen stellen dan op deze model-gezondheidsverklaring zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over het beleggen van “overtollig” geld van de provincie Noord-Holland

An MP asked whether the province of Noord-Holland invests surplus funds with private institutions and whether this breaches the schatkistbankieren (treasury banking) arrangement. The minister answered that the Nazorgfonds, a separate entity outside the arrangement, may invest under the Ruddo rules, that no agreement was breached, and that he will raise the topic with provincial associations.

The decision of the Gedeputeerde Staten of Noord-Holland to invest 70% of the Nazorgfonds N-H funds in fixed-income and 30% in equities falls within the legal framework, and therefore no agreement has been breached by Noord-Holland.

Het besluit van Gedeputeerde Staten van Noord-Holland om 70% van de middelen van het Nazorgfonds N-H te beleggen in vastrentende waarden en 30% in zakelijke waarden valt derhalve binnen de wettelijke kaders en er is derhalve geen afspraak door Noord-Holland geschonden.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over het bericht dat grote bedrijven in Zuid Europa de fiscus ontwijken via Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether large companies in Portugal, Italy, Greece and Spain route over 60% of their internal money flows via the Netherlands, whether this lowers their tax burden, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary could not confirm the figures, said the Netherlands aims to keep an attractive investment climate with a reputation for tax integrity, and saw no clear link between Dutch tax policy and deficits in those countries.
I cannot confirm those figures. I have no insight into the total worldwide money flows of large companies, nor into the turnover of Greek and Portuguese companies.
Ik kan die cijfers niet bevestigen. Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale wereldwijde geldstromen van grote bedrijven, noch in de omzet van Griekse en Portugese bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether borrowing for study is responsible and whether banks have tightened mortgage rules for people with student debt. The state secretary replied that student debt is rightly counted in mortgage assessments, that banks have not tightened norms but apply them more strictly, and that starters remain important to the housing market.
From the Dutch Banking Association (NvB) I have learned that the norms for granting a mortgage to people with student debt have not become stricter.
Van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NvB) heb ik vernomen, dat de normen ten aanzien van het verstrekken van een hypotheek aan mensen met een studieschuld niet strenger zijn geworden.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Plasterk over de berichtgeving dat MVO-beleid bij grootbanken te wensen overlaat

Two Labour MPs asked the government whether banks' corporate social responsibility reporting and investment transparency, including of state-supported banks, should be strengthened after reports of slowing progress. The state secretary answered that banks are expected to be transparent, pointed to existing benchmarks and a forthcoming EU transparency proposal, and saw no need to change current transparency requirements.
I will inform your House about the implications for Dutch CSR policy.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de implicaties voor het Nederlandse MVO-beleid.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Finance whether Greece will buy costly, unnecessary weapons during its bailout, whether the Dutch government issued export licences and lobbied for German arms sales, and whether Greek defence spending is excessive. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets have fallen since 2007, that the Dutch licence concerns frigate radar components for a Greek shipbuilding programme unrelated to the Die Zeit report, and that Greek procurement is a matter for Greece, declining to confirm several reported claims.
It is for the Greek government to shape its security policy and to set the priorities for its armed forces, and therefore also for its investments.
Het is aan de Griekse regering om haar veiligheidsbeleid vorm te geven, alsook de prioriteiten vast te stellen voor de strijdkrachten en daarmee ook in het doen van investeringen.
Antwoord vragen Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Koppejan over de groei van crowdfunding en regulering/toezicht

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the growth of crowdfunding and whether it is adequately regulated and supervised. The minister replied that consumer protection applies through the Wet op het financieel toezicht with AFM and DNB guidance, that crowdfunding is a useful addition warranting no current regulatory obstacle, and that a further roundtable with supervisors is planned.
As the document also indicates, the supervisory authorities are willing to consult with the initiators of a crowdfunding platform to inform and/or advise them on the applicable laws and regulations.

Zoals in het document ook wordt aangegeven, treden de toezichthouders graag in overleg met de initiatiefnemers van een crowdfunding platform om hen op de hoogte te stellen en/of te adviseren over de toepasselijke wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de financiering van de wetenschappelijke functie van het Geld- en Bankmuseum

MP Van der Ham asked whether the Geld- en Bankmuseum is ceasing most of its scholarly work after a temporary Finance Ministry subsidy ended, and whether that work could be moved to another institution to preserve expertise. The state secretary confirmed that the temporary supplementary subsidy ended while the regular subsidy continues, and said the museum itself must decide how to handle its scholarly function, which is not among the exceptions to the subsidy cut.
