I am happy to leave it to the Geld- en Bankmuseum itself to decide how the museum's scholarly function is handled.
Ik laat graag aan het Geld- en Bankmuseum zelf over hoe met de wetenschappelijke functie van het museum omgegaan wordt.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over het declaratiegedrag van de directie van De Nederlandsche Bank

MP Braakhuis asked the finance minister about the expense claims of the DNB board and what external control exists, given DNB's court filing that no external audit of them occurred. The minister answered that the external accountant audits the annual accounts including board expenses, DNB applies internal approval and annual compliance checks, and the board will ask the accountant for a specific annual audit of the expense rules.
Finally, the board of DNB has informed me that it will ask the external accountant to carry out a specific annual audit of compliance with the DNB board facilities and expense scheme.

Tot slot heeft de directie van DNB mij laten weten dat zij de externe accountant zal verzoeken jaarlijks een specifieke controle op de naleving van de Faciliteiten- en declaratieregeling directie DNB uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Blanksma-van den Heuvel over de reactie van de AFM op de vernieuwde hypothecaire gedragsregels

An MP asks the Finance Minister why the AFM considers loosening borrowing capacity for dual-income households unwise despite the new conduct code, and how this relates to DNB's call for starters to enter the housing market. The minister answers that the AFM's concerns relate to a Nibud norm, that he will change the process for setting such norms to avoid confusion, and that the borrowing calculation has not changed while capacity for dual earners is somewhat lower than in 2011.
I will take measures to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal maatregelen treffen om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Tony van Dijck over de integriteit van Lodewijk de Waal

PVV MPs Driessen and Tony van Dijck asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs and the finance minister about the integrity of Lodewijk de Waal, a supervisory board member of SNV, over a 2010 Tanzania trip paid for by SNV. The government answered that the trip was SNV's own responsibility, that the costs (about 2,375 euro) were borne by SNV under normal practice, that it sees no reason to doubt the trip's legitimacy, and that it does not consider De Waal's integrity in question nor that he should step down from ING's supervisory board.
Decisions on working visits by members of its Supervisory Board are the responsibility of SNV itself.
Besluitvorming over werkbezoeken van leden van haar Raad van Toezicht is de verantwoordelijkheid van de SNV zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Van Vliet en Lucassen over het bericht dat banken weigeren om tweeverdieners met een modaal inkomen een hogere hypotheek te verstrekken

PVV MPs asked whether the AFM's objection to relaxed mortgage rules for dual-earner households with modal incomes, and its view on the limits of lending, was consistent with its supervisory role, and whether supervisors should refrain from commenting on the housing market. The minister replied that the AFM may state what it considers responsible lending under the open norm, and that the AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to comment on the housing market while respecting existing rules.
The AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to express views on the housing market.
Het staat de AFM en DNB als onafhankelijk toezichthouder vrij om zich uit te spreken over de woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Plasterk over de berichtgeving op 9 januari 2012 over de beperking van de hypotheekruimte voor tweeverdieners

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether major mortgage lenders are refusing to apply the looser Nibud borrowing norm for two-earner households and whether the AFM fines lenders who do so, and what the government will do for households earning up to 40,000. The minister replied that lenders signalled they will follow the AFM, that no fines can be assumed in advance, and that the existing borrowing capacity method is unchanged, with renting as an alternative.

The AFM has indicated that lenders cannot assume in advance that an expansion of borrowing capacity for consumers earning between average and one and a half times average income will be seen by the AFM as responsible lending.

De AFM heeft aangegeven dat de kredietverstrekkers er niet op voorhand vanuit kunnen gaan dat een verruiming van de leencapaciteit voor consumenten met een modaal tot anderhalf keer modaal inkomen door de AFM als verantwoorde kredietverlening wordt gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over mogelijke militaire aankopen door Griekenland van miljarden euro’s

MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked whether Greece plans billions in arms purchases (fighters, frigates, submarines, patrol boats) while relying on EU bailout funds, and whether the Dutch government would confront Greece or cut its funding. Minister De Jager answered that Greece's 2012 budget sets aside only 1 billion euros for defence, that no plans of the claimed size are known to him, and that the Troika would likely not approve such spending.
I am not aware of any plans for military purchases of the above-mentioned magnitude.
Er is mij geen informatie bekend dat er plannen zijn voor militaire aankopen van bovengenoemde omvang.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het functioneren van de MIFID-richtlijn inzake concurrentie tussen beurzen (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

The MP asks the Finance Minister about the functioning of MiFID, best execution compliance, competition between exchanges and option market silos, and the sale of the Amsterdam option market in the NYSE Euronext/Deutsche Boerse merger context. The minister says AFM found compliance adequate but supports improvements, notes significant market share shift from Euronext to new platforms, supports opening clearing, states competition assessment falls outside his mandate, and opposes splitting the option market due to liquidity and operational risks.

That is why, during the current revision of the MiFID Directive, I am pushing for the option for investors, on their own initiative, to request details from an investment firm about the execution of their placed order.

Daarom zet ik tijdens de huidige herziening van de Mifid-Richtlijn in op de mogelijkheid voor de belegger om, op diens initiatief, bij een beleggingsonderneming details op te vragen over de uitvoering van zijn geplaatste order.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over verzekeraars en onderzoeksbureaus. (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether insurers and their in-house investigation bureaus systematically avoid paying out claims, whether independent investigation is warranted, and whether conflicts of interest and the choice of investigator should be addressed. The minister said complaints are few and unfounded according to Kifid and the Consumentenbond, so no trend is seen, promised further research and talks with the insurers' association on the codes and on informing consumers of their right to a counter-expert.
I believe that when a claim is reported, the insurer must act quickly, reliably and efficiently in the interest of the customer.
Ik vind dat er bij een schademelding, in het belang van de klant, snel, betrouwbaar en efficiënt moet worden gehandeld door de verzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Financien over verstrekkers van flitskredieten die de regels ontduiken (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister how flash-credit providers evade the Wft rules by charging no interest but high collection costs after seven days, and whether this justifies a ban. The minister answers that such providers now fall under the Wft and AFM licensing, that total costs including collection fees count, and that consumer protections and the pending collection-cost bill apply, but he declines to rule out further action or discuss specific providers.
I cannot tell you anything about the nature of contacts with specific flash-credit providers. I do not have access to supervision-confidential information.
Over de aard van de contacten met specifieke flitskredietaanbieders kan ik u niets mededelen. Ik beschik niet over toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie.

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Plasterk en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraken van de President van de Nederlandse Bank over noodzakelijke a

PvdA MPs asked the finance and interior ministers whether they agree with the DNB president that mortgage interest deduction must be adjusted given high Dutch mortgage debt, and whether they will pursue a national housing accord and legislation. The government answered that it keeps the mortgage interest deduction, points to existing measures such as the new mortgage code limiting interest-only loans, and sees no need for a housing accord or a debate on changing the deduction.

Vragen van de leden Braakhuis en Sap (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het bericht «G20-landen beloven economie te stimuleren» (ingezonden 8 november 2011).

GroenLinks MPs Braakhuis and Sap asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the G20 pledge that surplus countries would stimulate their economies, Nederland's trade surplus and its causes, and whether the government would change its stance on asymmetric adjustment and domestic stimulus. The minister answered that the G20 commitments are conditional and that the government prioritises restoring public finances and competitiveness, while promising to pursue a European growth package within existing fiscal rules.
As you know, the Netherlands was not represented at the G20 summit.
Nederland was zoals u weet niet vertegenwoordigd op de G20 top.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat hedgefunds profiteren van de eurocrisis (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

Plasterk (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether hedge funds are avoiding the planned Greek bond haircut and profiting from the eurocrisis with taxpayer-funded rescue money, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that hedge funds must join the bond exchange, that they will not make special profits, that free-riding is undesirable, and that the Eurotop mandate already accounts for it.
It is of course undesirable that some private parties could free-ride on the positive effects of the bond exchange without contributing to it.
Het is uiteraard niet wenselijk dat sommige private partijen zouden kunnen meeliften op de positieve effecten van de obligatie-omruil zonder daaraan een bijdrage te leveren.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat de eurocrisis een meevaller van 7,5 miljard euro oplevert (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the finance minister whether a reported 7.5 billion euro windfall from the eurozone crisis is credible, how the crisis affects debt sustainability and the cost of bailouts, and how the government communicates risks versus benefits. The minister answers that interest savings are offset by higher debt, that the net effect is higher interest costs since 2007, that the net balance of bailout interventions is currently slightly positive, and that the government holds a signal margin and pursues reforms.
On balance, interest costs on the national debt have increased since 2007.
Per saldo zijn de rentekosten op de staatsschuld sinds 2007 toegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over Voorschotje.nl (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Voorschotje.nl, a short-term credit provider reportedly in dispute with the AFM over licensing, whether its business model exploits the exemption for credits with negligible costs, and whether shirt advertising must carry the 'borrowing costs money' warning. The minister said he cannot disclose supervisory information on the AFM contacts, that he opposes anticipating payment problems but sees no gap in the law, and that a warning must appear on promotional sponsor shirts.
I cannot tell you anything about the nature of the contacts. I do not have supervisory-confidential information.
Over de aard van de contacten kan ik u niets mededelen. Ik beschik niet over toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de website van financiele woekeraars, zoals www.voorschotje.nl (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the website voorschotje.nl, which provides flash credit, is subject to credit regulation and whether it should be stopped. The minister says the AFM is competent to assess the concrete case, that evading credit rules is undesirable, that the Wet op het financieel toezicht leaves no room for it, and that any loopholes will be closed quickly.
Although I cannot go into concrete cases, I would like to note in general that circumventing the rules on credit is highly undesirable.
Hoewel ik niet kan ingaan op concrete gevallen, wil ik in het algemeen opmerken dat het ontgaan van de regels met betrekking tot kredieten hoogst ongewenst is.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht «De uitvaart wordt duur betaald» in de Volkskrant (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether it is irresponsible that funeral insurers claim average funeral costs will rise to EUR 40,000 when actual costs are around EUR 6,500, and whether commission practices should be curbed and a code of conduct agreed. The minister replied that if the AFM's preliminary findings are confirmed he sees no reason to exempt funeral insurance from a commission ban, and will decide on further steps once the final AFM report is available.
I indicated in that letter that if the AFM's preliminary findings are confirmed in the final report, I see no reason to exempt funeral insurance from the commission ban.

Ik heb in die brief aangegeven dat als de voorlopige bevindingen van de AFM in het definitieve rapport worden bevestigd, ik geen aanleiding zie om uitvaartverzekeringen uit te zonderen van het provisieverbod.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over Defensie in Griekenland (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

MPs Irrgang and Van Bommel asked the Finance Minister about reported Greek defence spending despite fiscal crisis, a US offer of tanks, F-16 purchases and reserve-part contracts, and whether France and Germany use the crisis to push arms sales. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets were cut under EU/IMF terms through postponed and cancelled investment plans and salary measures, that the tank transfer did not go ahead, that F-16 numbers and reserve-part volumes were estimated, and that he could not confirm the arms-sales claim, noting the Troika monitors defence spending.
The Troika closely monitors all expenditure by Greece, including expenditure in the field of defence.
De Trojka houdt nauw toezicht op alle uitgaven door Griekenland, inclusief de uitgaven op het terrein van defensie.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de goudvoorraad (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether DNB lent out or sold its gold, how it is stored and valued, and whether sales were wise, including a claimed 30 billion euro loss. The minister answered that DNB stopped lending gold in 2008, sold 1100 tonnes since 1991 to align with peer countries, and that the claimed loss is roughly of that order but depends on later returns and fluctuating gold prices.
DNB has informed me that it stopped lending gold in 2008.
DNB heeft mij aangegeven dat zij in 2008 is gestopt met het uitlenen van goud.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse zaken over de huisbankier RBS en clustermunitie (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Braakhuis asked whether the Netherlands and the UK should make clear to RBS, as house bank, which financing of cluster munitions producers is acceptable under the Convention on Cluster Munitions, and why RBS does not classify Alliant Techsystems as a producer. The government says it has engaged RBS directly, which it considers sufficient, and that its position on a possible ban (motion Haubrich-Gooskens) is still being considered.
RBS does not comment on matters relating to its clients, given its statutory and contractual confidentiality obligations.
RBS geeft geen commentaar op kwesties die betrekking hebben op haar cliënten, gezien de statutaire en contractuele geheimhoudingsverplichtingen.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het oversluiten van hypotheken (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the finance minister whether banks charging existing customers higher rates when refinancing a mortgage is undesirable and how it fits current rules. The minister says no specific rules apply, announces plans to require lenders to inform customers and make an offer three months before a fixed-rate period ends, and says lenders report no longer differentiating rates for existing customers while noting the NMa and AFM found some price differentiation.
I intend to take a number of measures to reduce switching barriers.
390 ) ben ik van plan om een aantal maatregelen te treffen om overstapdrempels te verminderen.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat de heer Zalm de jaarrekening van DSB bewust te laat uitbracht en daarmee spaarders heeft misleid (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether late filing of DSB's annual accounts, allegedly deliberate and misleading savers, was examined by AFM and DNB, what sanctions apply, and whether ABN Amro's Zalm's position is affected. The minister confirms AFM and DNB considered the filing in their investigations of former DSB directors, cites confidentiality limits, notes possible criminal, administrative and civil liability, and says no reason to doubt sanctions' adequacy.
Any additional information about these investigations I unfortunately cannot give, because it is governed by the confidentiality regime of the Financial Supervision Act.
Eventuele aanvullende informatie over deze onderzoeken kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze wordt beheerst door het regime van vertrouwelijkheid uit de Wet op het financieel toezicht.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Rutte & De Jager niet de slimsten van Europa: Finland heeft bij de Grieken een onderp

The MPs ask whether the Finance Minister knew at the 21 July 2011 Eurosummit that individual states could negotiate bilateral collateral deals with Greece, why the Chamber was not informed, and how the government will avoid unequal treatment. The minister answers that the summit conclusions allowed a collateral arrangement only at euro-area level, not bilaterally, that Finland and Greece acknowledged this, and that the Chamber was informed at several moments.
As I stated in the letter of 22 August (reference BFB 2011-1666M), the Chamber was informed at various moments about the discussions on collateral.
Zoals ik aangaf in de brief van 22 augustus jl. (kenmerk BFB 2011-1666M) is de Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de discussies rond onderpand.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over short-selling maatregelen (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

The MP asks the Finance Minister about the AFM's position on short-selling measures, the volatility on the AEX and other markets, the effects of foreign short-selling bans, when a ban would be considered in the Netherlands, and how the AFM and European coordination (ESMA) are monitoring the situation. The minister answers that he is not particularly worried about volatility, that the AFM has adequate powers and is monitoring closely, that a Dutch ban would only be considered in coordination at EU level, and that the Netherlands will align its disclosure thresholds with the forthcoming EU regulation.
Of course I am in regular contact with the AFM in this context.
Uiteraard heb ik regelmatig contact met de AFM in dit kader.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat woekeraars de wet tegen flitskrediet omzeilen (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether lenders evading the anti-flash-credit rules, with annualised rates up to 400%, are usury and whether he would intervene quickly. The minister said the 2011 amendments bring short-term credit under supervision with a 16% annual cap, that the AFM is the competent supervisor and is monitoring these lenders, and that consumers can go to court.
Naturally I cannot go into specific cases. The AFM, as supervisor, is the designated body to pass judgment on this.
Uiteraard kan ik niet op specifieke casussen ingaan. De AFM is als toezichthouder de aangewezen instantie om hier een oordeel over te vellen.

Vragen van het lid Huizing (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de vraag of de normen van de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG) dan wel de normen van de nieuwe Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering (GHF) leidend zijn

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance whether the NHG mortgage guarantee norms or the stricter new GHF conduct code are binding for mortgage lending, and how this affects the housing market and starters. The minister answered that both are acceptable interpretations of the open norm for responsible lending, that the only material difference is a stricter maximum LTV ratio under GHF (106% versus 108% under NHG at 2% transfer tax), and that CPB analysis shows limited housing market effects.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het oversluiten van hypotheken (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks charge existing mortgage clients higher rates when they refinance than new clients, whether this is lawful and whether banks should be obliged to offer a competitive alternative rate, and how the sector handles refinancing and whether the new mortgage code hinders it. The minister only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and promises answers by 15 September 2011.
I expect to be able to answer the questions by 15 September 2011.
Ik verwacht de vragen wel voor 15 september 2011 te kunnen beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over steunverlening aan Griekenland (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

Plasterk asked whether Finland secured collateral from Greece as a condition of the Greek support package, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether it is acceptable for one euro country to receive collateral while others do not. The minister answered by letter of 22 August 2011, referring to a separate Kamerstuk rather than answering the questions in this document.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 22 August 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, no. 834).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 22 augustus 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, nr. 834 ).
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over steunverlening aan Griekenland (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

Plasterk asks whether Finland secured Greek collateral as a condition of the Greek support package, whether the Dutch government knew of this and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether it is acceptable for only one eurozone country to receive collateral. The minister answers that these questions were addressed in a letter of 22 August 2011, referring to a separate Kamerstuk rather than giving substance in this document.
These questions were answered in the letter of 22 August 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, no. 834).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 22 augustus 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, nr. 834 ).
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over een credit event bij het doorrollen van Griekse staatsobligaties (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

MP Irrgang asked the Finance Minister how credit events are determined for Greek sovereign bond rollovers, whether hedge funds sitting on the ISDA committee should decide CDS triggers despite having interests, and about holdings of Greek CDS. The minister explained the ISDA determinations procedure, said conflicts of interest are possible but mitigated by transparency and diverse positions, and said he lacks a full overview of CDS holders, with EMIR reporting planned from 2013.
I do not have a total overview of the writers and holders of CDS contracts on Greek sovereign debt.
Ik heb geen totaaloverzicht van de schrijvers en bezitters van CDS contracten op de Griekse staatsschuld.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de huisbankier RBS en clustermunitie (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Braakhuis asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about state bank RBS's alleged investments in cluster munitions producers, RBS's assurances, state-supported institutions' services, and the selection criteria for the state's bank. The minister said RBS disputes the report's claims, that the government is reviewing how to respond to a Senate motion on banning such investments, and that it will inform the Senate in writing.
We cannot confirm the claim in the press release, because we are not in a position to establish the accuracy of the press release and the report.
Wij kunnen de stelling in het persbericht niet bevestigen, omdat wij niet in de gelegenheid zijn de juistheid van het bericht en het rapport vast te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht «ETF’s: het nieuwste gevaar voor de financiële markten» (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about risks of ETFs, including synthetic ETFs whose collateral does not match the tracked index, investor transparency, market concentration among few providers, and the FSB warning on financial stability. The minister answers that transparency via prospectuses and AFM guidance is key, acknowledges concentration and synthetic-collateral risks, and announces a renewed AFM study planned for the second half of 2011.
For that reason, ETFs issue a prospectus through which investors are informed.
Om die reden geven ETFs een prospectus uit waarmee beleggers geïnformeerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de lange procedures van vergunningverlening door De Nederlandsche Bank (CDNB) DNB voor Premie Pensioeninstellin

A member of parliament asked why DNB's licensing procedures for PPI pension vehicles were taking so long and whether DNB could demand more than the law allows. The minister replied that the 13-week period is extended for incomplete applications, that the delays are not considered unusual given first-time experience, and that DNB held an information session for market parties.
Every question asked in the context of a licensing process must comply with the laws and regulations relevant to the activity concerned.
Elke vraag die wordt gesteld in het kader van een proces van vergunningverlening moet in overeenstemming zijn met de wet- en regelgeving die van relevant is voor de betreffende activiteit.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en Binnenlandse Zaken over het afschaffen van de overdrachtsbelasting (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

The MP asks the ministers of Finance and Interior about abolishing or lowering the transfer tax, including for first-time buyers, its budgetary cost, required tax increases to cover it, and effects on the housing market. The government replies that it has temporarily lowered the rate on homes from 6% to 2%, gives cost estimates and covering options, and says research shows lower transaction costs increase mobility.
The cabinet has meanwhile decided to temporarily lower the transfer tax rate for homes from 6% to 2%.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om het tarief van de overdrachtsbelasting voor woningen tijdelijk te verlagen van 6 naar 2%.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over speculatie met grondstof

PvdA MPs asked the government about speculation in commodity markets, DNB's warning on leveraged commodity strategies, price volatility, effects on developing countries, and whether EU regulation should match the US. The ministers replied that DNB and AFM supervision is sufficient, that no additional measures are planned now, and that they await European Commission proposals on commodity derivatives regulation.
I consider the financial supervision carried out by DNB and AFM sufficient to address the risks. I do not currently intend to take additional measures.
Ik acht het financieel toezicht uitgevoerd door DNB en AFM voldoende om de risico's te adresseren. Ik ben momenteel niet van plan additionele maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de exposure van Nederlandse banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen op Griekse staatsobligaties (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister for the latest figures on Dutch banks', insurers' and pension funds' exposure to Greek sovereign bonds and CDS, the ECB's bond purchases and collateral, and the likely impact of a Greek default. The minister answered that Dutch banks had about EUR 3.7 billion Greek exposure at end-2010, that much detail is supervision- or monetary-confidential, and that the ECB and DNB figures are partly published while CDS net exposures are not tracked.
Not all questions can be fully answered due to supervisory confidentiality and the monetary secrecy DNB is bound by.
Niet alle vragen kunnen echter volledig worden beantwoord in verband met toezichtvertrouwelijkheid en de monetaire geheimhouding waar DNB aan gebonden is.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over het doorbetalen van pensioenen aan overleden Grieken (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the Finance Minister whether Greece pays about 16 million euros a year in pensions to deceased civil servants and whether Dutch aid to Greece should therefore stop. The minister said he had no reason to doubt the reports, called the fraud serious, and stated that the Dutch loan tranches remain tied to strict conditions, with a further discussion in the Eurogroup and a promise to consult the House before deciding.
Before any decision is taken on this, I will consult the House on the Dutch position.
Voordat besluitvorming hierover plaatsvindt, zal ik met de Kamer over de Nederlandse standpuntbepaling overleggen.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de huisbankier RBS en clustermunitie (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

GroenLinks MPs ask the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the state's house bank RBS, which reportedly ranks among the top five investors in cluster munitions producers, honours earlier assurances, and whether state-linked institutions should be barred from financing such producers. The answer is only a holding notice: the questions cannot be answered within three weeks and require further consultation with the parties involved.
Answering these parliamentary questions requires further consultation with the parties involved.
Beantwoording van deze Kamervragen vergt nader overleg met de betrokken partijen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de benoeming van de nieuwe directeur van het IMF (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why he backs French minister Christine Lagarde for IMF Managing Director, given his earlier support for merit-based, nationality-blind selection, and how this squares with critics' views on European and non-European candidates. The minister confirmed his support, arguing her expertise and broad backing make her the most suitable candidate, that nationality is not decisive, and that the selection process is democratic and transparent.
I can confirm that I support the candidacy of French Finance Minister Christine Lagarde for the position of Managing Director (MD) at the IMF.
Ik kan bevestigen dat ik de kandidatuur van de Franse minister van Financiën Christine Lagarde steun voor de positie van Managing Director (MD) bij het IMF.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nabetaling voor honderden (voormalig) Griekse parlementariërs (ingezonden 12 mei 2011)

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they would ask the European Commission to object to Greek former MPs suing for retroactive pay supplements of about 250,000 euro each while Greek pay and pensions were being cut under EU-backed aid. The government answered that it shared the concern, had raised it with the Commission via the State Secretary, and would report on steps taken through regular channels.
I will inform your House about this through the regular information channels.
Ik zal u hierover via de reguliere informatievoorziening naar uw Kamer informeren.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over speculatie met grondstof

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs and the Ministers of Finance and of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about financial speculation in commodity markets, including DNB's warning on leveraged commodity trading, exposure of Dutch financial institutions, price volatility, effects on developing countries, and whether the EU should match US regulation. The reply from Minister De Jager only announces that answers will be delayed because further consultation is needed.

The answers to the questions from MPs Dikkers, Timmermans and Plasterk (PvdA) of 13 May about speculation in commodity prices cannot be provided within the three-week period because further consultation is needed.

De beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (PvdA) van 13 mei jl. over speculatie met grondstofprijzen kan ik niet binnen gestelde termijn van drie weken realiseren omdat voor beantwoording nadere afstemming nodig is.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de premiepensioeninstelling (PPI) (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the premiepensioeninstelling (PPI), including whether it will shift Dutch pensions from defined benefit to defined contribution and why PPIs focus on the domestic market. The ministers reject the claim that the PPI will cause a shift to DC schemes, say the choice of scheme type is for social partners, and attribute the domestic focus to business decisions and scale considerations.
We favour the best possible quality of pension administration at the sharpest possible price, so that participants and pensioners get as much value as possible for the premium paid.

Wij zijn voor een zo goed mogelijke kwaliteit van pensioenuitvoering tegen een zo scherp mogelijke prijs, zodat de deelnemers en gepensioneerden zoveel mogelijk waarde krijgen voor de ingelegde premie.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het Klachteninstituut Financiële Dienstverlening (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether reports that the financial complaints institute Kifid wrongly rejects complaints justify examining its governance and funding, and whether its recognition as a dispute body under the Wft should be withdrawn. The minister answered that Kifid denies systematic failure, that independent committees review complaints, that the public-law ombudsman study continues, and that there is no reason to withdraw recognition.
I see no reason to proceed to withdraw the licence.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om tot intrekking van de vergunning over te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over hogere kapitaaleisen aan banken (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP (Plasterk, PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about recent calls for much higher bank capital requirements, including Bank of England, Vickers and Swiss proposals, and whether the Netherlands should follow Switzerland. The minister answered that studies give a wide range without a clear optimum, that the effect on lending is likely limited, that Basel III is a minimum the Netherlands can exceed, and that the government will inform parliament on systemically important banks.
Before I make a decision on the national application of the final agreements, I will of course inform your House about this.
Voordat ik een beslissing neem over de nationale toepassing van de uiteindelijke afspraken, zal ik uw Kamer hier uiteraard over informeren.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over Nederlandse garanties over buitenlands spaargeld (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

Plasterk asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch deposit guarantees covering foreign savers at Rabobank's Belgian branch serve Dutch interests, whether such internet savings should be excluded, and for totals by country. The minister explained the EU single passport and home-country rules, said the Rabobank Belgian webtext wrongly suggested advertising and was amended, and gave totals (about 487 billion eligible, 81 billion at EEA branches) without a country breakdown.
However, I have no data on how these deposits are divided per country.
Ik heb echter geen gegevens over hoe deze deposito's per land zijn verdeeld.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-Van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over bonussen voor de LeasePlan-directie (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asks the finance minister about large bonuses paid to LeasePlan's management despite state guarantees, and whether the minister was involved or will change bonus policy for state-supported financial institutions. The minister says he was not involved, the supervisory board decides bonuses, guarantees did not condition bonus abstention, and he plans a bonus ban and wider state-aid definition for future support.
I was not involved in the decision to grant this variable remuneration to the LeasePlan management.
Ik ben niet betrokken geweest bij het besluit om aan de LeasePlan-directie deze variabele beloning toe te kennen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aansprakelijkheid voor kernongevallen (ingezonden 30 maart 2011).

An MP asked the government whether the state reserves 14 billion euros against nuclear accident liability, whether insurers exclude nuclear damage, and whether the rules should change after Fukushima. The minister answered that the 14 billion is a state guarantee rather than a cash reserve, that insurers' exclusions are cushioned by a Dutch atomic pool and state policies, and that the liability law amendment will follow treaty ratifications and OECD review.
The cabinet has told the House that all lessons from Japan will be incorporated into nuclear energy policy.
Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer aangegeven dat alle lessen uit Japan zullen worden meegenomen in het kernenergiebeleid.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de invoering van de Code Banken (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

Plasterk (PvdA) asks the finance minister whether the Monitoring Commission's delay in reporting on the Banking Code will obstruct implementation of the De Wit Commission recommendations, which parliament unanimously wanted before September 2011. The minister answers that the commission will report in September 2011 and that he has drawn parliament's motion to the banks' attention and will report to parliament before September.
I will inform the House about this before September 2011, in accordance with the motion.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover – overeenkomstig de motie – voor september 2011 berichten.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de onhoudbaarheid van de hypotheekaftrek (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the government will address the mortgage interest deduction after the IMF and DNB called for reform, and why the government does not accept their arguments. The minister answers that the housing market is currently stable, the government's position is known, and the market needs calm rather than a renewed debate, referring to a separate letter on mortgage lending norms.
The housing market now needs calm, not a renewed discussion of the arguments for and against the mortgage interest deduction.
De woningmarkt heeft nu behoefte aan rust, niet aan een herhaalde discussie over de argumenten voor en tegen de hypotheekrenteaftrek.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse belangen van Kadhafi (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about Gaddafi-linked Libyan investments in the Netherlands, asset freezes, conservatory seizure, and EU sanctions. The government said it does not register foreign shareholdings, described the EU asset freezes and their effects on Dutch firms, saw no short-term route to conservatory seizure, and said EU-level freezing without a request from another state is possible but should be done collectively.
The government does not register which foreign persons or entities invest in Dutch companies.
De overheid registreert niet welke buitenlandse personen/entiteiten investeren in Nederlandse bedrijven.
Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de aanscherping normen hypothecaire kredietverlening (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether AFM chair Hoogervorst's call to also convert existing mortgages was government policy and how it relates to the new mortgage code. The minister replied he does not intend to affect existing interest-only mortgages, but agreed with the AFM to cap the interest-only share of new mortgages at 50% of home value from 1 August 2011.
I do not intend, through the proposed measures, to also affect existing interest-only mortgages.
Ik ben niet voornemens om middels de beoogde voorstellen tevens bestaande aflossingsvrije hypotheken te raken.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de biedingsstrijd om NYSE Euronext (ingezonden 6 april 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the bidding contest for NYSE Euronext, its possible split or merger with Deutsche Börse, and the role of the ministry and supervisors. The minister said neither the ministry nor DNB or AFM is currently involved, that German and US law applies, and that a formal assessment under Wft 5:32d will follow once a no-objection declaration is requested, though information is still lacking.
Only when the parties request a declaration of no objection, possibly combined with a licence amendment, will the Ministry, DNB and AFM take a role in the process.

Pas wanneer de betrokken partijen een verzoek doen om een verklaring van geen bezwaar, al dan niet gecombineerd met een wijziging van de vergunning, zullen het Ministerie, DNB en AFM een rol gaan spelen in het proces.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het alternatieve voorstel van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en de verzekeraars voor tophypotheken (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Braakhuis asks the Finance Minister about the banks' and insurers' alternative mortgage proposal, which they argued justified delaying tighter rules, and whether NHG repayment norms are an adequate substitute, and whether the delay caused unnecessary forced sales. The minister replies that the sector's new Gedragscode offers comparable consumer protection, that banks cap interest-only lending at 50% of market value, and that no link to forced sales is known.

I am, after consultation with the Authority for the Financial Markets, of the view that this new code of conduct offers a comparable level of consumer protection as the decree on the mortgage lending assessment framework.

Ik ben, mede na onderhoud met de Autoriteit Financiële Markten, van mening dat deze nieuwe gedragscode een vergelijkbaar niveau van consumentenbescherming biedt als het besluit toetskader hypothecaire kredietverlening.
Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de aanscherping normen hypothecaire kredietverlening (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MPs Blanksma-van den Heuvel and Van Bochove asked the Finance Minister about the tightened mortgage lending norms, including the new LTV norm, the AFM findings on overlending, and the NVB proposal and its economic effects. The minister answered that the LTV norm caps loans at 104% of market value plus transfer tax with at most 50% interest-only, that the AFM report is public, and referred the economic-effects questions to attached answers.
Question 4: Can you confirm that the letter also states that the NVB proposal is a good interpretation of the open norm for responsible mortgage lending?
Vraag 4 Kunt u bevestigen dat in de brief tevens staat dat het voorstel van de NVB een goede invulling vormt van de open norm voor verantwoorde hypothecaire kredietverstrekking?
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de afwikkeling van de woekerpolisaffaire (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

Plasterk asks the Finance Minister about a court ruling that awarded more compensation than the ASR settlement in the woekerpolis affair, the number of unit-linked policies ASR sold, and the financial consequences for the State as shareholder. The minister declines to comment on the pending case, says the number of policies is not meaningful to estimate while the case is ongoing, and states the State's financial impact cannot be given, only the earlier settlement's expected impact of EUR 780 million before tax.
It therefore does not seem desirable to me to make statements about this now.
Het lijkt mij dan ook niet wenselijk dat ik daarover nu uitspraken doe.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de omwisselkoers van de gulden (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Socialist Party research bureau study on guilder purchasing power at euro conversion should change the government's reliance on CPB findings that the guilder was fairly priced, and whether an independent study of the effects of undervaluation should be commissioned. The minister answered that the study does not conclusively show undervaluation, that he relies on CPB analysis, and declined to commission further research because effects were likely temporary and modest and lack current policy relevance.
I therefore see no reason to renounce these statements.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om afstand te doen van deze uitspraken.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Dikkers en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën, Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over banken die olie en mijnbouwbedrijven onvoldoende aa

MPs Timmermans, Dikkers and Plasterk asked ministers whether they share concern that Dutch banks insufficiently challenge oil and mining firms over human rights abuses, and whether banks report adequately on corporate social responsibility and how the minister holds them to account as shareholder. The minister replied that CSR is primarily the banks' own responsibility, pointed to the annual Transparency Benchmark (banks score best among sectors), cited the Code Banken with possible future legal measures if compliance lags, and said he raised transparency with ABN AMRO as shareholder.
In my capacity as shareholder I hold banks to account on the presence of concrete CSR policy and transparent communication in this area.
Zo spreek ik banken in mijn hoedanigheid van aandeelhouder aan op de aanwezigheid van concreet MVO-beleid en transparante communicatie op dit gebied.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over autokredieten (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

Braakhuis asked the Finance Minister how he views car dealers acting as credit intermediaries, whether conduct supervision and commission transparency apply to consumer credit, and whether 'borrowing costs money' warnings in car-financing ads are effective. The minister replied that dealers fall under AFM conduct supervision with past enforcement, that consumer credit is excluded from the commission ban for now, and that he will investigate whether additional measures such as transparency rules are needed.
I therefore consider it important to closely monitor market developments and will investigate whether additional measures are needed for consumer credit.
Ik vind het daarom van belang om de marktontwikkelingen goed te volgen en zal onderzoeken of bij consumptief krediet aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse belangen van Kadhafi (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about Libyan state investments in the Netherlands (including Oilinvest B.V.), the government's freezing options, support for EU sanctions and a Swiss initiative on freezing dictators' assets. The government's reply only announces that the answers could not be given within the deadline because they require further coordination given the changed situation in Libya.
Due to the changed situation in Libya and the recent amendments to EU sanctions regulations in response, a number of already coordinated answers to the questions need to be revised.

Vanwege de gewijzigde situatie in Libië en de recente aanpassingen van de EU sanctieregelgeving in reactie daaropis het noodzakelijk dat een aantal reeds afgestemdeantwoorden op de gestelde vragen wordt aangepast.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes die worden gebruikt door Kadhafi in Nederland (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance routes allegedly used by Gaddafi in the Netherlands, including whether the tax authority makes special deals with multinationals and whether dictators misuse such routes, and asked about sanction tools and the tax authority's moral responsibility. The government's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because of the changed situation in Libya and needed revisions to EU sanctions-related answers.
Due to the changed situation in Libya and the recent amendments to EU sanctions regulations in response, it is necessary to revise a number of already coordinated answers to the questions asked.

Vanwege de gewijzigde situatie in Libië en de recente aanpassingen van de EU sanctieregelgeving in reactie daaropis het noodzakelijk dat een aantal reeds afgestemdeantwoorden op de gestelde vragen wordt aangepast.

Vragen van de leden Bashir, Van Bommel en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de staatssecretaris en minister van Financiën en de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederland als vestigingsplek voor h

SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and ministers of Justice and Security and Foreign Affairs whether the Libyan company Oilinvest (Tamoil) is managed from Ridderkerk for tax benefits, whether it has tax rulings, and how Dutch tax structures and frozen-assets measures apply. The government answer is a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because the situation in Libya and EU sanctions changed, requiring further coordination.
Due to the changed situation in Libya and the recent adjustments to EU sanctions regulations in response, it is necessary that a number of already coordinated answers to the questions be adjusted.

Vanwege de gewijzigde situatie in Libië en de recente aanpassingen van de EU sanctieregelgeving in reactie daaropis het noodzakelijk dat een aantal reeds afgestemdeantwoorden op de gestelde vragen wordt aangepast.
Vragen van de lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over Marokkaanse banken (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Moroccan banks entering the Dutch market would be fully supervised by DNB, whether they should be excluded from the deposit guarantee scheme, and whether their Islamic banking products hinder integration. The minister replied that EEA branches fall under home-country prudential supervision and are not covered by the Dutch DGS, and referred the integration question to the Interior Minister.
This means that EEA banks can, among other things, open branches in other EEA member states without applying for a new banking licence in the host member state.
Dat betekent dat EER-banken onder andere bijkantoren kunnen openen in andere EER-lidstaten zonder in de «lidstaat van ontvangst» een nieuwe bankvergunning aan te vragen.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over erfrecht (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Blanksma-van den Heuvel asked the Finance Minister about the status of a common banking policy on requiring a certificate of inheritance (verklaring van erfrecht) before releasing deceased account holders' funds, and whether the absence of such a policy warrants follow-up steps. The minister replied that the Dutch Banking Association has set up an expert pool to advise on a uniform policy, coordinated with the Interior Ministry, with the integrated advice due before summer and then communicated to members.
The integrated advice will be finalised by the NVB before summer, then submitted to the banks for approval and subsequently communicated by the NVB to its members.
Het integrale advies zal voor de zomer door de NVB worden afgerond, vervolgens ter goedkeuring aan de banken worden voorgelegd en daarna door de NVB aan haar leden worden medegedeeld.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de onevenwichtige gezamenlijke lobby van Financiën en verzekeraars in Brussel (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

Braakhuis (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Minister whether Finance's joint lobbying with insurers, intermediaries and asset managers toward the European Commission on packaged retail investment products was balanced given consumer protection goals. Minister De Jager answered that it was a single joint written consultation response, that the initial line was set after broad consultation including the Consumentenbond, and that consumer organisations are routinely consulted.
There is no question of a joint lobby; it concerns a written consultation response in which several parties can find themselves.
Van een gezamenlijke lobby is geen sprake, het betreft een schriftelijke consultatiereactie waarin meerdere partijen zich kunnen vinden.
Vragen van de leden Huizing en De Boer (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over particuliere erfpacht en hypotheekverstrekking (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Huizing and De Boer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks refuse mortgages on privately leased land (particuliere erfpacht) and whether they treat these differently from municipal leasehold. The minister said banks are hesitant due to unclear contract terms and future canon levels, that he has raised concerns with the NVB, and that the AFM will talk with stakeholders about a possible facilitating role.
I have discussed this with the NVB and conveyed my concerns to the NVB.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met de NVB en heb mijn zorgen bij de NVB neergelegd.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financien over wanpraktijken bij het verlengen van hypotheken (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MPs Jansen and Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister about high mortgage rates on renewal, the deadline for renewal offers, and whether banks may charge existing customers more than new ones. The minister answered that the NMa is studying the mortgage market in two stages, that the first quick scan signals serious problems, that pricing is for lenders to decide, and that he is consulting parties and the AFM on possible follow-up.
The NMa is currently examining competition in the mortgage market in more depth in a second study.
Momenteel onderzoekt de NMa in een tweede onderzoek meer diepgaand de concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het alternatieve voorstel van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en de verzekeraars voor tophypotheken (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asks the finance minister about a banking and insurance industry proposal on top mortgages, the AFM's view on responsible lending, and whether delayed regulation caused unnecessary home sales. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and need further coordination.

In response to written questions from MP Braakhuis (GroenLinks) about the alternative proposal of the Dutch Banking Association and insurers for top mortgages, I inform you that it is not possible to answer these questions within the set deadline.

Naar aanleiding van schriftelijke vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) over het alternatieve voorstel van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en de verzekeraars voor tophypotheken, deel ik u mee dat het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de afwikkeling van de woekerpolisaffaire (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the woekerpolis affair: whether a claimant won more in court than in the ASR settlement, whether ASR will compensate more than agreed, how many unit-linked policies ASR sold and the possible cost, and the state's financial scenarios as majority owner of ASR. The minister replies only that the answers need more research and cannot be given within the deadline.
I regret that I cannot answer the questions of Member Plasterk on the settlement of the woekerpolis affair of 14 February within the set deadline.
De vragen van lid Plasterk over de afwikkeling van de woekerpolisaffaire van 14 februari jl. kan ik helaas niet binnen de gestelde termijn beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Koolmees (D66) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de bankiersverklaring (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MPs Koolmees and Braakhuis asked whether the banker's oath is a token gesture, why DNB did not take a coordinating role, and whether it should be formalised and enforced as a condition for approval of bank directors. The minister acknowledged the oath's importance, noted it is embedded in the legally anchored Code Banken, and committed to consulting the NVB, DNB and AFM on giving it a more formal status, including possible linkage to DNB suitability checks.
In light of this, I will consult with the Dutch Banking Association, DNB and the AFM on giving the moral-ethical declaration a more formal status.

Mede gelet hierop zal ik met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (hierna: de NVB), DNB en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (hierna: de AFM) in overleg treden over een meer formele status van de moreel-ethische verklaring.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over autokredieten (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about car-financing practices shown in a Tros Radar broadcast, including whether dealers' commission must be disclosed for consumer credit, whether conduct supervision by the AFM is needed, and whether advertising warnings are adequate. The response is a procedural notice stating that the answers cannot be provided within the three-week deadline because further consultation is required.
The answers to the questions from MP Braakhuis (GroenLinks) of 18 February about car credit cannot be provided within the set three-week period because further coordination is needed to answer them.

De beantwoording van de vragen van lid Braakhuis (Groenlinks) van 18 februari jl. over autokredieten kan ik niet binnen gestelde termijn van drie weken realiseren omdat voor beantwoording nadere afstemming nodig is.

Vragen van de leden Harbers en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Nederlandse staatsschuld hoger door lening aan Ieren» en het persbericht «The statistical recording of operations und

Two VVD MPs asked the finance minister whether Eurostat's proportional recording of EFSF loans in member states' gross debt, which raises the Dutch debt by up to about 2 percent of GDP, would force Dutch consolidation under the Stability and Growth Pact and would disadvantage contributing countries. The minister confirmed the recording, said the 60 percent debt rule is applied to gross debt but that EFSF claims will be taken into account, so no forced measures follow, and said an arrangement on this has been agreed.
Member states will therefore not be forced under the SGP to take additional measures to reduce their debt.
Lidstaten zullen dan ook niet op basis van het SGP gedwongen worden om extra maatregelen te nemen om hun schuld terug te brengen.

Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over verhoging van de EMU (Europese Monetaire Unie)-schuld door garantiestelling aan het Europees noodfonds (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

The MP asks whether Eurostat's decision to count guarantees to the European rescue fund (EFSF) as EMU debt is known, who is politically responsible, and by how much Dutch EMU debt would rise, including effects on Stability and Growth Pact thresholds. The minister confirms knowledge, states Eurostat is an independent body applying agreed rules, and refers the quantitative questions to answers given to other MPs.
Eurostat is an independent organisation that, according to internationally agreed rules and procedures, weighed the consequences of the EFSF loan for the gross debt of the participating countries.

Eurostat is een onafhankelijke organisatie die volgens de internationaal afgesproken regels en procedures een afweging heeft gemaakt over de gevolgen van de EFSF-lening voor de bruto schuld van de in het EFSF participerende landen.
Vragen van de leden Koolmees (D66) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de bankiersverklaring (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MPs Koolmees and Braakhuis ask the Finance Minister about the bankers' oath, whether DNB should coordinate it, why bankers do not sign it, and how seriously it is treated. The text is only the questions and a notice that the minister cannot answer within three weeks, so no substantive answers are given.
I hereby inform you that the questions from MPs Koolmees and Braakhuis on the bankers' declaration cannot be answered within three weeks, as parts require further consideration.
Hierbij bericht ik u dat de vragen van de leden Koolmees en Braakhuis over de bankiersverklaring niet binnen drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden, nu onderdelen nadere overweging vergen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over het bijdrukken van geld door de Ierse centrale bank (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Van Dijck asks the Finance Minister whether the Irish central bank prints money, whether other euro-area central banks do, whether the ECB can guarantee it does not print money, and how much it has bought of weaker euro-area government bonds. The minister answers that national central banks cannot independently print money, that the ECB is independent and prioritises price stability, and that the ECB's SMP bond purchases (EUR 76.5 billion) are fully sterilised and accountable to the European Parliament.
No, the Irish central bank does not print money. National central banks do not have the authority to do so.
Nee, de Ierse centrale bank drukt geen geld bij. Nationale centrale banken hebben hiertoe niet de bevoegdheid.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Financiën over de tijdelijke voorziening van de omwisseling van de Antilliaanse gulden in Nederland via GWK-kantoren in de periode van 18 januari 2011

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the temporary exchange facility for Netherlands Antillean guilders in the Netherlands was limited to mid-2011, why the public was informed and why exchange was not offered at more ABN Amro branches, and when a Caribbean Netherlands exchange scheme would be in place. The minister answered that the facility was a response to a parliamentary motion, that DNB and the media publicised it, that exchange is a commercial matter for ABN Amro, and that the island exchange offices were designated by DNB on 18 January 2011.

The period until 30 June 2011 is long enough to give travellers who were surprised last year by GWK/Travelex's decision to stop buying Antillean guilders ample opportunity to sell their remaining guilders.

De geboden termijn tot en met 30 juni 2011 is lang genoeg om reizigers die vorig jaar verrast werden door het besluit van GWK/Travelex om geen Antilliaanse guldens meer aan te kopen, ruimschoots in de gelegenheid te stellen hun overgebleven Antilliaanse guldens alsnog te verkopen.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bankproduct «Turks Fruit Deposito» (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Garanti Bank 'Turks Fruit Deposito' misleadingly presents as a regular savings product, whether deposit guarantee should cover currency risk, and what supervisory oversight applies. The minister answered that it is a foreign-currency deposit under Dutch supervision, that the AFM oversees information provision and DNB oversees deposit guarantee coverage, and that exchange-rate risk is not covered by the guarantee.
The AFM is responsible for supervising the provision of information about financial products, including information on the website.
De AFM is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op de informatieverstrekking over financiële producten, waaronder informatieverstrekking op de website.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van tenders (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the finance and interior ministers about a sudden halt to Rijksgebouwendienst building tenders, covering which projects, costs to government and market parties, team capacity, consistency with a PPS tender for the Supreme Court, and effects on market competition and trust. The government's reply is only a procedural notice: interdepartmental decision-making is ongoing and the substantive answers will follow by 15 February 2011.
I therefore inform you, on behalf of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations as well, that the answers to the parliamentary questions will be sent to you by 15 February 2011 at the latest.
Daarom bericht ik u, mede namens de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, dat de antwoorden op de kamervragen uiterlijk op 15 februari 2011 aan u verstuurd zullen worden.

Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de suggesties dat de jaarcijfers van Schiphol zijn gemanipuleerd om de bonussen van topbestuurders

MP Dijksma asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether suggestions that Schiphol's annual accounts were manipulated to inflate executive bonuses were true, and how the state as shareholder controls bonus policy, the CFO's mandate and possible corruption. The minister denied knowledge of manipulation, said an audit by the supervisory board is pending, described the bonus criteria including public-interest targets, and explained the shareholder's oversight via the articles of association and general meeting.
I am awaiting the outcome of that investigation before drawing conclusions about the allegations and/or the internal procedures at Schiphol.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af alvorens conclusies te trekken over de beschuldigingen en/of de interne procedures bij Schiphol.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis aan de minister van Financiën over betalingsverkeer via internet (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

MP Braakhuis asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING customers' basic data could be retrieved online and whether DNB allowing payment by mandate without signature enables fraud, asking about risks of online payment methods and guarantees for customers and webshops. The minister answered that a one-off direct debit requires a signed written mandate, that other online payment methods carry no substantially new risks, that overlay services may need regulation at EU level, and that he cannot guarantee no one will fall victim to fraud.
If it turns out that regulation is ultimately needed to guarantee the security of payment traffic at a sufficient level, I will not fail to do so.
Mocht het zo zijn dat uiteindelijk regelgeving nodig is om de veiligheid van het betalingsverkeer op een voldoende niveau te kunnen waarborgen, dan zal ik dat niet nalaten.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Financiën over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen met betrekking

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister for measurable, accountable targets on sound public finances, including indicators, baselines, interim targets, actions and reporting. The minister confirmed the goal of restoring the budget, pointed to the Startnota expenditure and revenue frameworks and an 18 billion euro package in 2015, but declined separate effect and performance indicators and gave only general reporting through budget documents.
Apart from the stated objective, using separate effect and performance indicators is not under consideration.
Naast genoemde doelstelling is het hanteren van separate effect- en prestatie-indicatoren niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Braakhuis en Sap (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over maatregelen met betrekking tot tophypotheken (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister why the banks were given until 1 February 2011 to self-regulate mortgage lending limits, whether the AFM was involved, and whether self-regulation would be enforced given past breaches. The minister replied that a draft general administrative order (AMvB) tightening mortgage norms has been sent to the Council of State, while the Dutch banking association may offer a revised code by 1 February that the minister will assess before deciding whether self-regulation with AFM supervision suffices.
I will involve the House of Representatives in this consideration.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer betrekken in deze overweging.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over financiering lobby door Aegon (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asks the Finance Minister whether it is acceptable that Aegon, partly state-supported, funded a US Chamber of Commerce campaign against financial regulation, and whether the US Chamber functions as a lobby organisation. The minister replies that he does not intervene in daily operations of companies Aegon, that Aegon's US foundation gave $3 million to the Chamber's National Foundation, and that the Chamber opposed certain parts of the legislation, while accepting that the US Chamber functions more as a lobby organisation.
In general, even in my capacity as shareholder of the state holdings, I do not interfere in the daily operational activities of the companies concerned.
In algemene zin geldt dat ik zelfs in mijn hoedanigheid van aandeelhouder van de staatsdeelnemingen niet treedt in de dagelijkse operationele activiteiten van de betreffende deelnemingen
Vragen van de leden Irrgang (SP) en Blanksma (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over compensatie voor woekerpolissen (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MPs Irrgang and Blanksma asked the Finance Minister how he reacted to a Kassa broadcast on woekerpolissen, including whether insurers should actively inform policyholders when switching is cheaper, and whether extra switching costs and Kifid rulings and legal procedures should be allowed. The minister declined substantive comment on the broadcast, said insurers will actively communicate about switching options, and stated that compensation agreements are sufficient, leaving individual advice to advisers.
Yes, I discussed this with insurers and they indicated in the attached letter that they indeed want to actively communicate about options to adjust or convert existing products.

Antwoord 5 Ja, dat heb ik besproken met verzekeraars en zij hebben mij daarover in bijgevoegde brief 2 aangegeven dat zij inderdaad actief willen communiceren over mogelijkheden tot aanpassing of omzetting van bestaande producten.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een onderzoek naar verantwoord ondernemen (ingezonden 18 november 2

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about a VBDO benchmark showing smaller insurers lag on responsible investment, whether the 2002 sector code on transparency has worked, and whether the issue will be raised in Europe. The government answered that CSR cannot be imposed as a result obligation, that companies should decide themselves in dialogue with stakeholders, and that the topic is already on the European Commission's agenda.

Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Knops (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over aflossingsvrije hypotheken (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether Rabobank's halt to fully interest-only mortgages in shrinking regions such as Groningen breaches equal treatment and encourages shrinkage, and whether they would seek agreements with banks. The minister replied that Rabobank denies any policy to stop interest-only loans, that advice depends on the client's personal situation, and that the postcode rule in the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering prohibits discrimination on area grounds.
Under the Mortgage Lending Code, the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular postcode area cannot be grounds to reject the application.
Het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaald postcodegebied kan volgens de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering geen grond zijn om de aanvraag af te wijzen.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over toezicht van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op reclame-uitingen (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Irrgang and Bashir (SP) asked the Finance Minister how the AFM supervises advertisements for investment products that promise high fixed returns below the 50,000 euro threshold, whether the threshold should be raised, and whether the AFM considers tax-benefit claims and undisclosed risks in such ads acceptable. The minister answered that the AFM monitors advertising and acts through informal or formal enforcement, that the threshold is being doubled to 100,000 euro, and that risks should be disclosed, while declining to discuss individual supervisory cases.
Naturally, individual supervisory cases cannot be discussed here.
Uiteraard kan hier niet ingegaan worden op individuele toezichtcasussen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bedrijf Future Life Insurance Broker SA (FLIB) (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010)

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister why the Luxembourg home supervisor and the Dutch AFM and DNB did not act sooner against FLIB, an unlicensed insurance broker, and why enforcement orders were published late and the directors were not targeted earlier. The minister answers that the regulators lacked sufficient information, were limited against foreign firms, pursued the matter through criminal referral and enforcement orders, and will explore consumer complaints to the Ombudsman and push for stronger host-supervisor powers in Europe.
The (legal) possibilities to tackle companies established abroad that are active on the Dutch market are limited.
De (wettelijke) mogelijkheden om ondernemingen gevestigd in het buitenland, die actief zijn op de Nederlandse markt, aan te pakken zijn beperkt.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het omwisselen van de Naf (Antilliaanse gulden) (ingezonden

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked why Antillean guilders can no longer be exchanged in the Netherlands, why the fixed-rate exchange into US dollars is limited to Caribbean Netherlands residents, how citizens were informed, and what remedy exists for travellers holding guilders. The minister explains that GWK/Travelex stopped buying guilders, that the restriction aims to prevent license fee avoidance, that an information campaign was run, and that DNB may be asked to consider a temporary exchange facility in the Netherlands.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over financiering lobby door Aegon (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asks the Finance Minister about Aegon's reported multi-million funding of a US Chamber of Commerce campaign against financial regulation, and whether Dutch financial firms' foreign political lobbying is desirable or should be known. The government only sent a Mededeling that answers will follow later because further consultation is needed.
I hereby inform you that the written questions submitted on 27 October with the above subject cannot be answered within the usual period, because the answer still requires further consultation.

hierbij bericht ik u dat de op 27 oktober jl. ingezonden schriftelijke vragen met bovengenoemd onderwerp niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, doordat de beantwoording nog nadere afstemming vergt.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang (SP) en Blanksma (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over compensatie voor woekerpolissen (ingezonden 4 november 2010).
