MPs Irrgang (SP) and Blanksma (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about compensation for woekerpolissen (costly investment-linked insurance policies) after a Kassa broadcast, covering insurer client-centricity, active informing of policyholders, switching costs, the Kifid ruling and evaluation of the Wabekel norm. The minister's reply notes that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because some parts require further consultation, so no substantive answers are yet provided.
I hereby inform you that the questions from members Blanksma and Irrgang on investment insurance cannot be answered within three weeks, as parts require further consultation.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de vragen van leden Blanksma en Irrgang over beleggingsverzekeringen niet binnen drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden, nu onderdelen nadere afstemming vergen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over de BKR-registratie en privacy (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MPs Van der Steur and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether the 8 June 2010 Arnhem court ruling on BKR credit registration and the Personal Data Protection Act should lead to changes in BKR policy, including proportionality of registration, the complaints committee, and a right to request removal. The minister declined to comment on the pending Supreme Court case, stated that registration is legally required and that the existing correction and complaint routes remain available.
In the case in question, cassation has been lodged with the Supreme Court. Therefore I cannot go into this case, nor anticipate the outcome of the further proceedings.
In de genoemde zaak is cassatie ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad. Daarom kan ik niet op deze zaak ingaan, noch vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de verdere procedure.
Vragen van de leden Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Financiën inzake de BKR-regeling (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Schaart and Van der Steur asked whether telecom firms withdrawing from BKR credit registration over disproportionate effects should lead the government to change policy, and whether obligated parties should be free to leave the system. The minister answered that BKR registration remains useful for creditworthiness checks, that registration does not mean automatic refusal, and that any changes to the BKR rules are for participants to decide, with talks reported to have resumed.
Any amendments to the BKR regulations are for the participants of BKR.
Eventuele aanpassingen van het reglement van BKR zijn aan de deelnemers van BKR.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over het artikel «Hypotheek duur voor klant» (ingezonden 10 augustus 2010).

The CDA MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper report that Dutch banks' revenue rose sharply in 2009 partly due to high mortgage margins, whether banks give insufficient insight into mortgage rate build-up, whether lower money-market rates pass through slowly to mortgages, and whether competition is limited. The minister cites CBS figures attributing the rise mainly to ECB rate cuts, notes the NMa quick scan finds mortgage margins high since mid-2009 but no evidence of collusion, and promises consultation with market parties and a planned AMvB on variable-rate transparency.
I do not wish to wait until spring and will shortly consult various parties to consider how these signals should be followed up.
Ik wil dan ook niet afwachten tot het voorjaar en zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met verschillende partijen om te bezien hoe er opvolging gegeven moet worden aan deze signalen.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over het niet doorberekenen van lage marktrentes aan klanten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MP Weekers asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether high mortgage margins, a limited competitive market and the passing-on of low market rates were addressed, and how cross-border competition has developed. The minister confirms high Dutch mortgage margins in the NMa quick scan, promises follow-up talks with stakeholders, and says more information on competition will follow after the second NMa study phase.
I do not want to wait until spring and will shortly consult various parties to consider how these signals should be followed up.
Ik wil dan ook niet afwachten tot het voorjaar en zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met verschillende partijen om te bezien hoe er opvolging gegeven moet worden aan deze signalen.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financien over te dure hypotheken (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether mortgage pricing, including the business model of banks, the share of variable-rate mortgages, ECB policy, and mortgage interest deduction, explains high Dutch mortgage rates and whether studies and talks with banks are warranted. The minister answered that the business model is a commercial choice subject to supervision by the NMa and AFM, that the NMa is studying margins with results due in spring 2011, and that no separate CPB study is needed for now.
Thus it is for the NMa to assess whether the business model used by Dutch financial institutions encourages coordinated behaviour and whether this constitutes a breach of the Competition Act.
Zo is het aan de NMa om te beoordelen of het verdienmodel dat Nederlandse financiële instellingen hanteren gedragsafstemming in de hand werkt en of dit een overtreding vormt van de Mededingingswet.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over hypotheekrentes (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

Labour MP Plasterk asked the Finance Minister about high mortgage margins, whether the four largest banks priced below cost, the length of fixed-rate periods and switching costs, and whether banks should give customers earlier notice of renewal. The minister answered that NMa research shows margins high since mid-2009 and a 75-80% market share for the top four, that further NMa study will examine switching barriers, and that he will consult parties on follow-up measures.
I do not want to wait until spring and will shortly consult with various parties to consider how these signals should be followed up.
Ik wil dan ook niet afwachten tot het voorjaar en zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met verschillende partijen om te bezien hoe er opvolging gegeven moet worden aan deze signalen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bedrijf Future Life Insurance Broker SA (FLIB) (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010)

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister why the Luxembourg home supervisor and the Dutch AFM failed to act earlier against FLIB, which allegedly operated without a licence in the Netherlands, and why enforcement orders were published late; he also asks about the Ombudsman's remit and calls for stronger host-supervisor powers. The minister replies only that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because parts require further investigation.

the answers to the parliamentary questions from MP Irrgang (SP) about Future Life Insurance Broker SA cannot be provided within the three-week period because parts of the questions require further investigation

beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) over het bedrijf Future Life Insurance Broker SA niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden nu onderdelen van de vragen nader onderzoek vergen

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Samsom (PvdA) en Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over mogelijke significante verhoging transfertarieven (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

MPs from CDA, VVD, PvdA and PVV asked the Finance Minister about a possible significant rise in Schiphol transfer tariffs and whether this breached earlier commitments to freeze tariffs. The minister, as shareholder, answered that the limited tariff increase is consistent with Schiphol's commitments, deferred questions on network quality to the state secretary, and said he has no formal control over tariffs or the consultation process.
As a shareholder, I do not decide on Schiphol's tariffs.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik niet over de tarieven van Schiphol.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het beloningsbeleid van Aegon en ING (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

MP Blanksma (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about reports that Aegon and ING would be exempt from a bonus cap in the insurers' code, and whether the insurers' code matches the Code Banken and the De Wit committee's recommendation 8. The minister replied that insurers will adopt the Code Banken remuneration provisions integrally, including for foreign subsidiaries and top holdings, so there is no exemption for Aegon or ING.
There is therefore no question of an exceptional position for AEGON and ING.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van een uitzonderingspositie voor AEGON en ING.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over beloningsbeleid bij verzekeraars Aegon en ING (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the finance minister whether insurers Aegon and ING should be bound by the Dutch banking pay code and whether their pay policy meets public support. The minister says an insurers' code should follow the banks' pay principles, that both firms have adopted compliant pay policies, and that the sector's own insurers' code will integrate the banks' pay rules.
I am pleased that insurers have announced these steps and expect the code to be finalised in the short term.
Ik ben verheugd dat verzekeraars deze stappen hebben aangekondigd en verwacht dat de code op korte termijn tot stand zal komen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over topmannen van Nederlandse beursgenoteerde ondernemingen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

The SP MP Irrgang asks the Finance Minister why Dutch listed companies change CEOs more often than foreign ones, whether boards are under more shareholder pressure, whether outside CEOs underperform, and whether the Netherlands is the least shareholder-protected market. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed because parts of the questions require further research.

I hereby inform you that the answers to the parliamentary questions from MP Irrgang (SP) on top executives of Dutch listed companies cannot be provided within the set three-week period, as parts of the questions require further investigation.

Hierbij deel ik u mee dat de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) over topmannen van Nederlandse beursgenoteerde ondernemingen niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden nu onderdelen van de vragen nader onderzoek vergen.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Financiën over pinpasfraude (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

MP Teeven asks the Justice and Finance ministers about professionalising pinpas (debit card) fraud, its scale, victim numbers, whether losses are passed on to customers, and whether victims are compensated. The ministers answer that fraud is indeed growing in sophistication, damages were about 36 million euro in 2009, a joint public-private anti-skimming initiative exists, victims are fully compensated by banks, and fraud appears to be declining in 2010.

The Ministry of Justice holds periodic consultations with the Dutch Banking Association, Currence, Equens, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to exchange knowledge and experience on preventing and combating skimming.

Het ministerie van Justitie heeft periodiek overleg met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken, Currence, Equens, Politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om kennis en ervaring uit te wisselen met het oog op het voorkomen en bestrijden van skimmen.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over kwijtschelding van de heffingen van Waterschap Veluwe (ingezonden 9 september 2010)

An SP MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about Waterschap Veluwe's narrower debt-relief norm for low-income residents, its effect on equal treatment across municipal boundaries, and whether a minimum national norm should be imposed. The government answers that local water boards may set relief above the 90% national norm, that local autonomy on this is intentional, and that it sees no need to impose a higher minimum or intervene.
We are of the view that in the field of tax and levy remission there should be legal equality at the level of the central government, municipalities and water boards.
Wij zijn van mening dat op het gebied van kwijtschelding van belastingen en heffingen sprake moet zijn van rechtsgelijkheid op het niveau van rijk, gemeenten en waterschappen.
Vragen van de leden Smeets en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over de problemen tussen de belastingdienst en ZZP-ers (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

PvdA MPs Smeets and Groot asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about recurring conflicts between the Tax Authority and self-employed workers without staff (ZZP-ers), including the rejection and withdrawal of VAR declarations and whether Dutch demands are stricter than abroad. The government's response is only an interim notice announcing that answers will be delayed because coordination is not yet complete.
The reason for this is that the necessary coordination will not be ready in time.
Reden hiervoor is gelegen in het feit dat de nodige afstemming niet tijdig klaar zal zijn.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over bezuinigingen op de belastingdienst (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about cuts to the Tax Administration, including reasons for letters urging around 6,000 staff to seek other jobs, staffing levels, and whether horizontal supervision reduced supervision capacity. The minister said the cuts follow government savings targets, that the letters aim to avoid forced mobility and were not age-based, and that there are no signs work quality has suffered.
No distinction was made by age.
Er is geen onderscheid gemaakt naar leeftijd.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de ministers voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie en van Financiën over het niet verhypothekeren van huizen op erfpacht door banken (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asks ministers whether banks are refusing mortgages on private leasehold (erfpacht) homes, the Amsterdam municipality's solution, how many such cases exist, and whether the competition authority NMa is examining bank coordination on these mortgages. The government says banks are very reluctant due to unclear lease terms, that Amsterdam and the NVB will help owners via buy-out or municipal leasehold, that the Kadaster counts about 8,078 private leasehold parcels, and that the NMa sets its own investigation priorities.
I will continue to closely monitor this process.
Ik zal dit proces nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over problemen met huurtoeslag bij straatnaamwijzigingen (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how about twenty Vlaardingen households lost their rent allowance and had to repay 2009 benefits after a street renaming, and how this would be prevented. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that a renaming looks like a move in the GBA-based administrative check, stopped recovery, and promised to alert municipalities and landlords in future.
The Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances will alert municipalities and landlords to this.
De Belastingdienst/Toeslagen zal gemeenten en verhuurders hierop attenderen.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de effectiviteit van besteding van belastinggeld door btw-verlaging in de bouw (ingezonden 10

D66 MPs asked whether the temporary VAT reduction on labour costs in construction (renovation and repair of homes) is an effective and efficient use of tax money, citing differing impact estimates from ABN AMRO and Bouwend Nederland, and asked when the evaluation of housing-market measures would be available. The minister acknowledged the estimates, argued the measure is a targeted temporary stimulus that the industry committed to pass on to consumers, said the effects can only be judged after the measure ends, and stated that the EIB evaluation will be sent to parliament in 2011.
In the course of 2011 the final report will be sent to the House of Representatives.
In de loop van 2011 zal de eindrapportage naar de Tweede Kamer worden gestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Financiën over het rapport van de AFM met de bevindingen kwaliteit accountantscontrole en kwaliteitsbewaking (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM report finding insufficient improvement in audit quality at the Big 4 firms, including its limited sample, the timing and tone of publication, anonymity of firms, and the risk of false audit opinions. The minister answered that the AFM sets its own approach and publication practice, that its supervision is adequate, that firms are taking remedial measures, and that the AFM will monitor and use enforcement powers where needed.
The AFM supervises all audit organisations that carry out statutory audits.
De AFM houdt toezicht op alle accountantsorganisaties die wettelijke controles verrichten.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het online aanbieden van woekerleningen door een Fins bedrijf dat zich aan Nederlands toezicht en consumenten bescherming probeert

MPs Plasterk and Spekman ask the Finance Minister about online flash loans offered by a Finnish firm trying to avoid Dutch supervision and consumer protection, and about rising debt problems and other providers. The minister confirms awareness, says flash credit is a significant problem case, notes the planned Wet op het financieel toezicht and maximum credit cost rules, but declines a new survey of providers because no licensing register exists and the coming law will reshape the sector.
Given that there is not yet a licensing requirement, and therefore no register of all providers is kept, no overview of all providers can be given at this moment.
Gezien het feit dat er nog geen vergunningplicht is, en dus geen register van alle aanbieders wordt bijgehouden, kan op dit moment geen overzicht gegeven worden van alle aanbieders.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het online aanbieden van woekerleningen door een Fins bedrijf dat zich aan Nederlands toezicht en consumenten bescherming probeert

MPs Plasterk and Spekman asked the Finance Minister about online flash-credit websites run by a Finnish company that advertise loans without BKR checks and may escape Dutch supervision. The minister answered that such short-term loans currently fall outside the Wet financieel toezicht, that the consumer credit directive implementation will bring them under supervision and a 15% cap, and that the AFM has warned providers and can act against unfair practices in the meantime.

After the consumer credit directive implementation bill takes effect, flash credits and all other credits with a term under three months on which more than negligible costs are charged will fall under financial supervision.

Na inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van de richtlijn consumentenkrediet (kamerstukken 32 339 ) vallen flitskredieten en alle andere kredieten met een looptijd korter dan drie maanden waarbij meer dan onbetekenende kosten worden gerekend wél onder financieel toezicht.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Kabinet geeft FIFA ongekende privileges en overtreedt de regels» (ingezonden 12 augustus 20

Green Left MP Klaver asked ministers of Finance and Health about reports that the cabinet granted FIFA extraordinary tax privileges and whether the World Cup bid book would be published. The government answered that the bid book is owned by the Dutch and Belgian football associations but was sent to parliament after the KNVB raised no objection, that FIFA would be compensated for VAT not otherwise paid, and that the tax forgone could reach a maximum of 300 million euros.
Whether or not (fully) publishing the bid book is therefore primarily reserved for the two football associations.
Het al dan niet (volledig) openbaar maken van het bidbook is dan ook primair voorbehouden aan beide voetbalbonden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de aftrekbaarheid van golfkosten (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether golf club membership costs should be tax-deductible, whether a court ruling widened the concept of representation costs, and whether the law should be clarified to prevent precedent for other leisure costs. The minister replied that the court rejected the deduction because the representation-cost rules applied, that existing articles 3.14 and 3.15 give the tax authority sufficient tools, and that no legislative change is planned.
I therefore see no reason for legislative intervention.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot wettelijk ingrijpen.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ABN AMRO een cacaodeal mede financiert (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether ABN AMRO co-financed a purchase of 240,000 tonnes of cocoa, and what its effects on cocoa markets and farmers would be. The ministers answered that ABN AMRO acted only as a broker within normal exchange rules, that the purchase does not affect farmers' incomes in the short term, and that speculation falls outside the development policy aimed at structural improvement.
ABN AMRO acted in line with the applicable laws and regulations of the futures market.
ABN AMRO heeft in lijn met de geldende wet- en regelgeving van de termijnmarkt gehandeld.

Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over verlies van inleg op obligaties als gevolg van afhandeling van faillissement van Lehman Brothers Treasury Co B.V. (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a US Chapter 11 proposal to treat Lehman Treasury notes claims at 50% would harm Dutch noteholders and disadvantage non-American creditors, and what the government would do. The minister answered that he cannot interfere in individual cases or foreign court proceedings, that affected parties may take legal action themselves, and that he knows of no comparable cases.
It is not open to me to interfere in individual cases.
Het staat mij niet vrij mij in individuele zaken te mengen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over de mogelijke verkoop van Strukton (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks the ministers of Transport and Finance about the planned sale of NS subsidiary Strukton to Oranjewoud, its timing, the shareholder's role, governance conditions and union demands. The government answers that NS's board, with supervisory board approval, decided the sale without requiring shareholder approval, that the deal was signed on 23 July 2010 and will close in Q3 or Q4, and that the matters raised are for NS's board and union protocol to settle rather than the shareholder.
The decision on whether to sell Strukton falls within the mandate of NS's board and supervisory board.
Het besluit om al dan niet tot verkoop van Strukton over te gaan valt binnen het mandaat van de directie en de raad van commissarissen van NS.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de mogelijkheid voor het introduceren van een EU-belasting (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he supports an EU-level tax on aviation and/or financial transactions, offset by lower national EU contributions, and how a demissionary cabinet would handle such proposals in the EU budget review. The minister answers that taxation is a member-state competence, that the Netherlands prefers the GNI-based own resource as sole EU financing source, that a financial transaction tax would fail to stabilise markets, and that the issue will be left to a future cabinet.
First of all, I would point out that taxation is a competence of the member states and the Treaty provides no autonomous taxing power for the EU.
Allereerst wil ik er op wijzen dat belastingheffing een bevoegdheid van de lidstaten is en het Verdrag geen autonome heffingsbevoegdheid voor de EU kent.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over het artikel «Hypotheek duur voor klant» (ingezonden 10 augustus 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper article claiming that Dutch banks' revenue rose sharply partly due to higher mortgage margins, that banks give little insight into mortgage rate structures, pass on lower money-market rates only gradually, and that competition in the mortgage market may be limited. The government's reply is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because further coordination is needed.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over het niet doorberekenen van lage marktrentes aan klanten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MP Weekers (VVD) asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether Dutch banks pass lower market interest rates on to mortgage customers, citing high mortgage margins, limited competition and cross-border competition. The government's reply is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because they require further coordination.
Answering the parliamentary questions requires further coordination.
De beantwoording van de kamervragen vergt nadere afstemming.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financien over te dure hypotheken (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about high mortgage rates, the business model of Dutch banks, variable versus fixed-rate mortgages, ECB monetary policy and the effect of mortgage interest deduction on prices. The government only responds with a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because they require further coordination.
that it is not possible to answer these questions within the set deadline.
dat het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het declaratiegedrag van de directie van de AFM (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister about improper expense claims by the AFM board, including whether he knew of the supervisory board's critical letter and what amounts were involved. The minister says he was not informed of the internal correspondence, puts the questionable amount at about 10,000 euros, and states the AFM is an independent body where he does not intervene in internal operations.
Yes. Question 6: Are you willing to call the AFM to account for the improper expense claims
Ja. Vraag 6 Bent u bereid de AFM aan te spreken op de ondeugdelijke declaraties
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Fiscus geeft overleden man geld terug» (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister how a tax assessment for 2009 could be issued to a man who had died 25 years earlier, and what would prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledged a human error caused by a sofi-number mix-up in a paper return, said no special action was planned, and maintained that the control system is sound while noting the paper process is error-prone.
Given the cause of the error and its exceptional nature, I do not intend to take special action.
Gezien de oorzaak van de fout en het uitzonderlijke karakter ervan, heb ik niet het voornemen bijzondere acties te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over de mogelijke verkoop van Strukton (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

The SP member Bashir asks the ministers of Transport and Finance about the possible sale of NS subsidiary Strukton to Oranjewoud, covering the shareholder's role, timing, corporate governance, union demands and job guarantees. The government's reply is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the three-week deadline because interdepartmental consultation is needed.
Given the necessary (interdepartmental) coordination, a careful answer to the questions within that period will not prove possible.
Gelet op de noodzakelijke (interdepartementale) afstemming zal een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen binnen die termijn niet mogelijk blijken.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de perceptiekosten en administratieve lasten van de integrale vennootschapsbelasting en wijkenheffing (ingezonden 25

An MP asked the Finance and Housing ministers whether the government had measured the actual administrative burden on housing corporations from the integrated corporate tax and the neighbourhood levy, and whether a claimed €40 million and €8 million annual burden was acceptable. The minister answered that no ex-post measurement was done, that the burden is expected mainly in 2008–2009 and varies per corporation, and that the Tax Administration has taken steps to limit it, with no new study planned.
No ex-post calculation has been made of the effects of introducing the integrated corporate tax liability for housing corporations on staffing and administrative burden.

Er is niet op basis van nacalculatie nagegaan wat de effecten zijn van de invoering van de integrale belastingplicht voor de vennootschapsbelasting (VPB) bij woningcorporaties op de formatie en de administratieve last.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het dumpen van Zuid-Europese staatsobligaties door Ageas (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asks the Finance Minister about reports that Ageas dumped about 4.8 billion euro of Southern European government bonds, whether a gentlemen's agreement against such dumping exists, and what measures could prevent it. The minister answers that Greece must implement its adjustment programme, that the IIF and Dutch banks pledged support, that banks cannot be obliged to hold Greek bonds, and that he has no insight into individual institutions' positions.

Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over verlies van inleg op obligaties als gevolg van afhandeling van faillissement van Lehman Brothers Treasury Co B.V. (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether Dutch holders of Lehman Notes issued by Lehman Brothers Treasury Co B.V. will receive only 50 percent of book value under the US Chapter 11 proceedings, whether non-US creditors are disadvantaged, and what the government will do to protect Dutch holders. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because he received a request for a meeting from the operator of a claims website, and promises answers after that meeting.
I will send your House the answers to your questions as soon as possible after the conversation with Mr Zeilmaker.
Ik zal uw Kamer de beantwoording van uw vragen zo spoedig mogelijk na het gesprek met de heer Zeilmaker doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over onduidelijkheid rond ontwijking van btw-afdracht door ING en DSB (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's tax director's statements about a Swiss procurement route avoiding VAT were consistent with the minister's claim of not having known of it, whether a covenant with the tax authority can continue if avoidance is deliberate, and asked for answers withheld pending an investigation. The minister answered that the tax inspector was the competent authority and was informed in 2008, that the minister learned of the case only via press in March 2010, that covenants are not automatically terminated for transparent taxpayers, and that the forthcoming investigation will address the scope of such structures, with some questions deferred until the report is published.

Vragen van de leden Vos, Heijnen en Vermeij (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Belastingdienst als slechte werkgever (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MPs Vos, Heijnen and Vermeij (PvdA) asked the Finance and Interior ministers whether the Belastingdienst is a poor employer, questioning lower pay, the lack of permanent contracts for agency workers at Belastingdienst Toeslagen, and their costs. The minister denied the pay gap claim, said agency work is tied to temporary tasks that will end once the new benefits system is rolled out, and gave cost figures per hour.
The answer to this question depends on the nature of the work.
Het antwoord op deze vraag hangt af van het karakter van de werkzaamheden.
Vragen van de leden Besselink , Heijnen en Blom (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de sluiting van het belastingkantoor in Terneuzen (ingezonden 31 maart 2010).

MPs Besselink, Heijnen and Blom asked the Finance Minister whether the closure of the Terneuzen tax office conflicts with government policy against withdrawing services from shrinking regions and with a motion asking that reorganisations strengthen such areas, and asked him to confirm the office stays and extend the lease. The minister said housing needs are under review with decisions expected in the first half of 2011, no concrete decisions on individual offices yet, and that the lease was extended for one year to 30 June 2012.
Concrete decisions on the structural housing situation of the individual offices are only taken after that.
Concrete besluiten over de structurele huisvestingssituatie van de afzonderlijke kantoren worden pas daarna genomen.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de dreigende sluiting van het belastingkantoor in Terneuzen (ingezonden 31 maart 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the finance minister about the threatened closure of the Terneuzen tax office, the planned merging of offices, whether concentrating rather than closing Terneuzen was considered, and whether budget cuts should not fall on declining regions. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report and said the housing needs assessment will lead to decisions expected in the first half of 2011, with concrete office-level decisions only after that.
Decision-making is expected to take place in the first half of 2011.
Besluitvorming zal naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2011 plaatsvinden.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de perceptiekosten en administratieve lasten van de integrale vennootschapsbelasting en wijkenheffing (ingezonden 25

An SP MP asked the Finance and Housing ministers whether the Tax Service has measured the effects of the integrated corporate tax on housing corporations' staffing and administrative burden, and whether the wijkenheffing's administrative costs and CFV staff cost rise have been assessed. The government replied only that the questions could not be answered within three weeks due to interdepartmental coordination, promising a later answer.
Given the necessary interdepartmental coordination, a careful answer to the questions within that period has not proved possible.
Gelet op de noodzakelijke interdepartementale afstemming is een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen binnen die termijn niet mogelijk gebleken.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Spies en Koopmans (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over rijden op groen gas (ingezonden 20 a

Three CDA MPs asked the finance, transport and housing ministers about tax incentives for driving on biogas/green gas, how they compare with other alternative fuels, and whether the regime is technology-neutral. The ministry answered that green gas is taxed like natural gas, that LNG/LBG are taxed at the LPG rate, that the biofuel obligation is technology-neutral, and that a letter comparing fuel treatment would follow.

For the comparison of the tax treatment of biogas/green gas with other sustainable alternatives such as other biofuels, electricity and hydrogen, I refer to my commitment made during the General Consultation of 8 April to send Parliament a letter before the summer with an integral overview of the treatment of the various fuels in traffic.

Voor de vergelijking van de fiscale behandeling van biogas/groen gas met die van andere duurzame alternatieven zoals het rijden op andere biobrandstoffen, elektriciteit en waterstof verwijs ik naar mijn toezegging gedaan tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 8 april jl. om voor de zomer een brief aan uw Kamer te sturen
Vragen van het lid Aptroot (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het artikel «Belastingdienst nekt transportsector» (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Finance and Transport ministers about reports that IT problems at the Belastingdienst were stranding transport firms waiting for VAT refunds on EU cross-border claims, and whether the problems would be fixed quickly. The Finance minister answered that the new electronic refund portal has had teething problems that have been largely fixed, that about 500 technically blocked claims are being processed, and that the EU-level rules and the four-month decision period leave room for delay.
If it turns out that businesses suffer damage as a result, the regular channel offers the possibility of compensation.
Indien blijkt dat ondernemingen hierdoor schade ondervinden, staat daarvoor via het reguliere kanaal de mogelijkheid van schadevergoeding open.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Financiën over tegenstrijdige uitspraken over de winst op ABN (ingezonden 31 mei 2010).

MP Pechtold asks the Finance Minister to explain why former minister Bos promised a profit on the sale of ABN Amro while Zalm now doubts the state can recover its bank investment. The minister says the bank rescue was driven by financial stability rather than commercial motives, gives no odds on a profitable sale, and states the government still aims for a favourable exit.
Recovering the investment was therefore not the aim, but it is the objective.
Terugverdienen van de investering was derhalve niet het doel, maar is wel het streven.
Vragen van de leden Sap (GroenLinks) en Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Justitie over het gebruik van de Edelweissroute (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

MPs Sap and Bashir asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the use of the Swiss 'Edelweiss route' to hide inheritances from successierecht, including whether all heirs and executors must sign the tax return and whether executors' professional secrecy hinders tax evasion prevention. The Finance Minister answered that every heir should file, that executors sign on behalf of heirs, that heirs can still report hidden assets for a supplementary assessment, and that notaries and lawyers face disciplinary and Wwft reporting duties rather than new signing rules.
No, both the person invited to file the return and the appointed executor(s) are obliged to fulfil all obligations imposed by the Successiewet 1956.
Nee, zowel diegene die is uitgenodigd tot het doen van aangifte als de aangewezen executeur(s) zijn gehouden tot vervulling van al de bij de Successiewet 1956 opgelegde verplichtingen.
Vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven-Kok en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de btw-vrijstelling voor kunsteducatie aan cursisten van boven de 21 jaar (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

MPs Van Vroonhoven-Kok and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about a Tax Authority decision extending the 19% VAT rate to adult arts education beyond music, and about its effects on adult cultural participation. The minister said the VAT exemption for under-21 arts education is set by law, that the specific case is confidential and under objection and appeal, and that he intends to amend the law so the inspector's designation of cultural institutions can be limited or withdrawn.
As you know, the duty of confidentiality does not allow me to discuss the tax affairs of individual taxpayers.
Zoals u bekend is, staat de geheimhoudingsplicht mij niet toe in te gaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over het vrijgeven van het spaarloon (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether unblocking the savings-wage scheme (spaarloon) would boost household consumption and the economy, given weak spending and households using holiday pay to cover shortfalls. The minister answered that roughly 1 billion euro is releasable this year, that CPB estimates of the boost are modest (about 0.25% consumption, 0.1% growth in the base case), and that the cabinet does not plan to unblock now, deferring the decision to coalition talks.
The cabinet is currently not planning to unblock the savings-wage balances.
Het kabinet is op dit moment niet van plan om de spaarloontegoeden te deblokkeren.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over tussenpersonen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether DNB was wrong to block service subscriptions for financial intermediaries and whether the law should be changed so such subscriptions avoid insurer licensing. The minister answered that DNB's stance concerns insurance-like features and licensing, that intermediaries may already be paid by subscription where there is no uncertainty element, and that the provision regime will be reviewed in the upcoming evaluation.
This point will be taken into account in the evaluation of the commission regulations.
Dit punt zal in de evaluatie van de provisieregelgeving worden meegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de weigering van de DSB-top van het conceptrapport Scheltema (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister why DSB's former management is denied the full draft Scheltema report for hearing and rebuttal while AFM and DNB receive it, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replies that the independent commission sets its own procedure under its establishing decree, that AFM and DNB were consulted on confidentiality, that the minister will not intervene, and that the commission's response deadline was too ambitious.
If I were to intervene in the procedure that the Commission has autonomously established, I would in fact act contrary to this establishing decree and undermine the Commission's independence.

Als ik zou interveniëren in de procedure die de Commissie op autonome wijze heeft vastgesteld, zou ik juist handelen in strijd met dit instellingsbesluit en afbreuk doen aan de onafhankelijkheid van de Commissie.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over onduidelijkheid rond ontwijking van btw-afdracht door ING en DSB (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

MP Bashir (SP) asks the Finance Minister 13 questions about a Swiss procurement route that ING and DSB allegedly used to avoid VAT, including what the minister knew and when, and whether the study will reveal the scale of the problem. The minister's reply is only an interim notice saying the answers cannot be provided within the requested deadline and will follow as soon as possible.
Following your letter mentioned above, I inform you that it has not been possible to respond within the deadline you set.
Naar aanleiding van uw bovenvermelde brief deel ik u mede dat het niet mogelijk is gebleken om binnen de door u gestelde termijn te reageren.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over de buitenlandse activiteiten van de NS (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asks ministers of Transport and Finance about NS's foreign activities, including limits set by the state shareholder, the share of foreign revenue and staff, financial exposure through subsidiaries, transparency to parliament, and the Deutsche Bahn lawsuit. The ministers answer that foreign activities are limited by agreed conditions, about 15% of revenue is foreign, liability is ring-fenced, and they will examine whether the strategy still fits and inform parliament.

If, despite the above answers to questions 3 and 4, your House has concerns about the effects of the international activities on continuity in the Dutch home market, both ministers are of course willing to inform your House about this.

Indien er ondanks bovenstaande antwoorden op vragen 3 en 4 zorgen bestaan vanuit uw Kamer over de effecten van de internationale activiteiten op de continuïteit op de Nederlandse thuismarkt zijn beide ministers vanzelfsprekend bereid om uw Kamer hierover te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verhalen van schade toegebracht in het verkeer in landen buiten de Europese Unie (EU) (ingezonden 9 april 2010)

An SP MP asked the ministers of Transport and Foreign Affairs whether insurers should have representatives in non-EU countries popular with Dutch drivers to make recovering damages easier, and whether they would arrange this with insurers. The minister answered that EU law provides a basis for such arrangements, but no equivalent exists for non-EER countries where Dutch authority has no regulatory power, so insurers' cooperation is limited and private insurance is the main option.
The latter is all the more difficult because the situations you raise concern insurers not established in a member state, over which the Dutch government has no regulatory competence whatsoever.

Dat laatste is des te moeilijker omdat het in de door u aangesneden situaties om niet in een lidstaat gevestigde verzekeraars gaat waarover de Nederlandse overheid geen enkele regelgevende bevoegdheid heeft.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Spies en Koopmans (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over rijden op groen gas (ingezonden 20 a

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance, Transport and Housing/Environment whether they knew of the first European truck running on liquefied biogas, for an overview of tax measures promoting biogas/green gas vehicles compared with other alternatives, whether current policy is technology-neutral, and whether the tax regime should change. The government replied only with a holding notice that the questions could not be answered within three weeks due to interdepartmental coordination.
that the questions asked by MPs Omtzigt, Spies and Koopmans (CDA) about driving on green gas cannot be answered within a period of three weeks.
dat de vragen gesteld door de Kamerleden Omtzigt, Spies en Koopmans (CDA) over rijden op groen gas, niet binnen een termijn van drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over ING Direct (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ING Direct's use of the Dutch deposit guarantee scheme in France, including the French coverage gap, the amount of guaranteed French deposits, and whether ING's foreign branches should switch to local schemes. The minister confirms the coverage difference, says the advertising is not in breach of the rules, withholds the exact French deposit figure while citing about 11.3 billion euro in customer deposits, and rejects the demand to restructure the branches while promising stronger EU supervisory cooperation.
As is customary, I do not comment on confidential information regarding individual institutions.
Zoals gebruikelijk laat ik mij niet uit over vertrouwelijke informatie aangaande individuele instellingen.

Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de werking van het verdrag ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting tussen Nederland en Duitsland voor Rijnvaartschippers (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the Dutch-German tax treaty and Dutch law give enough clarity on the 'home port' concept that determines where Rhine barge operators are taxable, and why the government did not start the treaty consultation procedure before assessments were final. The minister explains that home port is defined through case law and the OECD model, that Germany also regards these skippers as non-resident, and that he has discussed the problem informally with German authorities and will open a consultation procedure if needed.
However, I am of course willing to enter into mutual consultation with the German competent authorities, as soon as there is reason to do so, in order to eliminate double taxation where necessary.

Ik ben echter uiteraard bereid om – zodra daartoe aanleiding bestaat – met de Duitse bevoegde autoriteiten in onderling overleg te treden teneinde in voorkomend geval dubbele belastingheffing weg te nemen.
Vragen van het lid De Nerée tot Babberich (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over fraude bij Goldman Sachs (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

The MP asks whether ABN Amro or RBS suffered damage from Goldman Sachs fraud, whether it affected the consortium unwinding, whether ING and others are similarly affected, and whether the AFM is investigating similar practices. The minister confirms damage of about USD 841 million borne by RBS (not state-held ABN Amro), says the matter is for RBS, declines to comment on other institutions, and states the AFM operates independently and he has no overview of its investigations.
It is unknown to me whether the AFM is currently investigating practices comparable to the fraud Goldman Sachs is accused of.
Het is bij mij onbekend of de AFM thans onderzoek doet naar praktijken die vergelijkbaar zijn met de fraude waar Goldman Sachs van wordt beschuldigd.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Veel ZZP-ers plakken hun eigen VAR» (ingezonden 15 februari 2010).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that many self-employed workers forge their own employment-relationship declarations (VAR), whether the Tax Authority has figures on this and on companies facing tax problems, and whether a central register to verify VARs will be created. The minister answered that only some forged VARs are known, which are referred to fraud coordinators and may lead to prosecution, that no figures exist on companies in trouble, and that the legal framework does not currently allow a public register, though the application procedure may be revised.
At present the legal framework is not sufficient to set up such a public register, and it is questionable whether this would solve the problems.
Thans is het wettelijk kader niet toereikend om een dergelijk openbaar register in te richten en het is de vraag of dit de problemen oplost.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie (ingezonden 1 februari 2010).

MP Bashir asks the State Secretary of Finance about a student report critical of the Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie (VAR), including the lack of pre-issuance checks, unclear forms, the risk of misuse, and the VUR constructions. The minister defends the VAR as a self-declaration assessed on stated conditions, rejects tighter pre-checks as unfeasible, and promises to clarify liability guidance and the brochure.
There is an assessment of the conditions the taxpayer states under which he says he will carry out the work.
Er vindt er een beoordeling plaats van de door de belastingplichtige aangegeven condities waarin hij zegt de werkzaamheden uit te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de gevolgen van een negatieve BKR-registratie (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MP Weekers asked the Finance Minister whether a BKR credit-registration of small arrears (e.g. a €90 phone bill) causing five years of exclusion from mortgages is proportionate, and whether a threshold, BSN use, and access/notification rights for registrants should be introduced. The minister defended the registration system as a tool against over-indebtedness, noted arrears must last 60 days and be pre-announced, opposed a €500 floor, and pointed to pending legislation giving notice of rejection and free access, with BSN use blocked by the privacy college.

In the bill pending before your House implementing the consumer credit directive, it is provided that when a credit application is rejected on the basis of a BKR registration, the person concerned is informed of this free of charge.

Antwoord 5 en 6 In het bij uw Kamer aanhangige wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van de richtlijn consumentenkrediet 3 wordt geregeld dat, wanneer een kredietaanvraag wordt afgewezen op grond van een BKR-registratie, de betrokkene daarover kosteloos wordt geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over carrouselfraude (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

Mr Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister whether linking VAT payment to the right to deduct it, as proposed in a dissertation by Mr Wolf, could prevent carousel fraud and whether it is technically feasible. The minister answered that the idea is attractive but would impose large administrative burdens on all businesses, requires an EU Directive change, and raises technical and proof issues, while the Commission is studying it and the tax authority has launched a fraud information line.
We look forward with interest to the Commission's findings and will assess proposals in this area against the general principle Netherlands applies.
Wij wachten de bevindingen van de Commissie met belangstelling af en zullen voorstellen op dit gebied beoordelen

Vragen van de leden Ten Hoopen, De Nerée tot Babberich en Blanksma-van den Heuvel (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Winkeliers boos op Brussel» (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the European Commission's recommendation would oblige shopkeepers to accept small coins and high-denomination notes, and whether it should be opposed. The minister answered that the Netherlands has agreed arrangements allowing shopkeepers to pre-declare accepted denominations and rounding, that the recommendation departs from Dutch practice, and that he would argue against binding rules if they were proposed.
I will ask the Payments Consultation Forum whether consumers consider the current choices offered by banks to be too limited.
Ik zal het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer vragen of consumenten de huidige keuzemogelijkheden die banken bieden als te beperkt ervaren.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieper (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Private equity ligt niet voor het oprapen» (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Pieper asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper article on SME financing difficulties, whether the government supports SME finance and what it will do, and when an SME-investment box-3 exemption will be implemented and the status of EU state-aid approval. The minister answered that the government supports SME finance and lists crisis measures and guarantee schemes, and that implementation of the exemption awaits European Commission approval, expected within a reasonable time.
It is expected that the Commission will take a decision within a reasonable period.
Naar verwachting zal de Commissie binnen een redelijke termijn een besluit nemen.
Vragen van het lid De Nerée tot Babberich (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over het zogenaamde arrest Gielen (ingezonden 29 maart 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about the implications of the ECJ Gielen judgment (C-440/08) for the Dutch income tax act, and whether measures would follow. The Minister answered that foreign taxpayers must have hours worked in other member states counted for the self-employed deduction hours criterion, that a policy decision will set out implementation, and that a legislative amendment is still under review.
A policy decision to be published soon will set out how the Tax Authority will implement the Gielen judgment.
In een binnenkort te publiceren beleidsbesluit zal worden aangegeven op welke wijze de Belastingdienst uitvoering zal geven aan het arrest Gielen.

Vragen van de leden Tang, Eijsink en Leerdam (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatssecretaris van Defensie over het bericht dat Aruba een belastingparadijs is voor Amerikaanse defensiebedrijven (ingezond

Three PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister and Defence State Secretary whether US defence contractors use shell subsidiaries in Aruba and the Dutch Antilles and whether this affects Dutch defence procurement such as the JSF. The minister answered that the GAO report does not show Aruba to be a tax haven for defence firms, that the Antilles and Aruba are fiscally autonomous so overviews are not his responsibility, and that procurement policy is not influenced by such tax structures.
Since both the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba are fiscally autonomous, it is not for me to provide an overview
Aangezien zowel de Nederlandse Antillen als Aruba fiscaal autonoom zijn, is het niet aan mij om een overzicht te geven
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht «DSB ontweek ook belasting» (ingezonden 25 maart 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that DSB avoided VAT via a Swiss procurement hub, including supplier involvement, whether the Tax Authority monitors pressure on suppliers, and whether Dutch law could have prevented it. The minister declined to comment on the specific case citing taxpayer confidentiality, pointed to a pending investigation, and said the route was lawful under existing case law and that legislation was an option only partly used.
The confidentiality duty applying to me as Minister of Finance for tax matters of individual taxpayers does not allow me to answer this question or to address the article in question.

De voor mij als minister van Financiën geldende geheimhoudingsplicht voor fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen staat mij niet toe deze vraag te beantwoorden en op het betreffende artikel in te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de effectieve belastingdruk (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

The MP asks the Finance Minister for a breakdown of effective tax burden by income group and household type, beyond the 'Fiscale kengetallen 2010' publication. The minister answers that Eurostat and the ministry lack a detailed breakdown for capital and consumption taxes, refers to the Studiecommissie belastingstelsel report for labour and income tax distribution, and notes the progressive structure of the tax system.
Neither Eurostat nor I have a detailed breakdown of the effective tax burden on capital income and consumption for different household situations and income groups.
Eurostat noch ik hebben een gedetailleerde uitsplitsing voor de effectieve belastingdruk op inkomen uit vermogen en op consumptie voor verschillende leefsituaties en inkomensgroepen.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de positie van het instituut Kifid (ingezonden 22 maart 2010).

MP Vos asked the Finance Minister about the independence of the complaints institute Kifid, the departure of its ombudsman, a possible British-style model, and collective compensation for small-scale damages. The minister said there is no reason to doubt Kifid's independence, an evaluation is underway with consumer and VEB involvement, and the government is studying collective redress for mass damages.
At this moment I have no reason to doubt the independence of the institute, partly in light of the fact that an evaluation of Kifid is underway
Op dit moment heb ik geen reden om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid van het instituut, mede in het licht van het feit dat binnen Kifid een evaluatie gaande is

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de teruggave van de ouderschapsverlofkorting (ingezonden 19 maart 2010).

The SP MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's checks on the parental leave tax reduction, which is capped at the year-on-year salary drop, fail to look beyond annual totals on the employee's income statement and whether this should be changed. The ministers answer that the Tax Authority applies the law as written, that a finer rule would be impractical, and that about 600 of roughly 9,000 beneficiaries in 2006 had part of the reduction corrected, totalling 0.5 million euro.
There is no shortcoming in the implementation. The Tax Authority carries out the law on this point as it reads.
Er is geen manco in de uitvoering. De Belastingdienst voert de wet op dit punt uit zoals deze luidt.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de schikkingsvoorstellen van beleggingsverzekeringen («woekerpolissen») (ingezonden 20 januari 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether fee structures for investment insurance policies (woekerpolissen), including a cost percentage over the full term, are reasonable, and about compensation letters and TER transparency. The minister declined to judge the fee level as a civil dispute, pointed to ombudsman-brokered compensation agreements and to transparency rules, and said he would consider further regulation.
It is not for me to pass judgment on this, because this concerns a civil dispute between insurer and policyholder.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover een oordeel te vellen, omdat het hier gaat om een civiel geschil tussen verzekeraar en polishouder.
Vragen van de leden Blok en Elias (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over het urencriterium voor zelfstandigenaftrek (Ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his announced flexibility on the hours criterion for the self-employed deduction was really new, given union criticism that it was empty. The minister confirmed the press reports and said the 2009-2010 decision relaxes how the tax authority assesses hours for crisis years and informs entrepreneurs which hours count.

The new element in this decision is that the Tax Authority will, in case of possible doubt, show leniency for the (crisis) years 2009 and 2010 in assessing the plausibility of the number of hours spent on business activities.

Het nieuwe element in dit besluit is dat de Belastingdienst, in geval van mogelijke twijfel, voor de (crisis)jaren 2009 en 2010 soepelheid zal betrachten bij de beoordeling van de aannemelijkheid van het aantal bestede uren voor zakelijke activiteiten.
Vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over de kosten van betaalrekeningen die door de banken weer flink zijn verhoogd (ingezonden 3 februari 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether bank fees for basic payment accounts had risen up to 20 percent and for a ten-year overview of costs, and whether banks should be prevented from raising fees annually. The minister said he could not give a precise picture, pointed to the Consumentenbond and the NMa as monitors, argued Dutch account fees remain among the lowest in Europe, and said the NMa can intervene in case of anticompetitive conduct.
It is not really possible for me to give the (average) citizen a precise picture of how the costs of payment traffic have developed over recent years.
Het is voor mij niet goed mogelijk om voor de (gemiddelde) burger een precies beeld te schetsen van hoe de kosten van het betalingsverkeer zich de afgelopen jaren hebben ontwikkeld.
Vragen van de leden Vos en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over bancaire dienstverlening aan de Vereniging voor Cannabis Consumenten (ingezonden 26 februari 2010).

MPs Vos and Bouwmeester asked the Finance Minister whether he agreed that banks refusing accounts to the Cannabis Consumers Association without reasons or clear criteria is undesirable, and what he would do if banks keep refusing. The minister answered that categorical exclusion without individual assessment is undesirable, that the banking association agreed to assess applications individually, and that he prefers voluntary acceptance but will not intervene in individual refusals, which belong in the courts.
I do not intend to comment on each individual refusal; in such a civil dispute, recourse to the courts is more appropriate.
Ik ben niet voornemens om mij uit te spreken over elke individuele weigering; bij een dergelijk civiel conflict ligt de gang naar de rechtspraak immers meer in de rede.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vos (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het verkopen van kredieten door drogisterijketen Kruidvat (ingezonden 19 febr

MPs Spekman and Vos asked whether it is responsible for drugstore chain Kruidvat to sell personal loans and credit alongside shop goods, and whether consumers are adequately protected. The government replied that Kruidvat meets current legal requirements, credit is only arranged online or by phone, and existing Wft rules and consumer education suffice, though the choice remains the consumer's responsibility.
On the basis of my investigation it has become clear that Kruidvat meets the current statutory requirements.
Op grond van mijn onderzoek is gebleken dat het Kruidvat aan de huidige wettelijke eisen voldoet.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de nieuwe rol van drogisterijketen Kruidvat als kredietverstrekker (ingezonden 23 februari 2010).

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether it is desirable that the drugstore chain Kruidvat offers consumer loans, given widespread payment arrears, and whether such borrowing is safe, whether staff give financial advice, whether Kruidvat meets financial-provider requirements, and whether competition from non-financial firms is desirable. The minister replies that such firms are bound by strict rules, that loans are only sold by phone or online, and that competition lowers interest rates, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
I do not find it undesirable that organisations outside the financial sector enter the consumer credit market, because companies wanting to offer financial services are bound by strict rules.

Ik vind het niet onwenselijk dat organisaties buiten de financiële sector zich op de markt voor consumptief krediet begeven, omdat bedrijven die financiële dienstverlening willen aanbieden aan strenge regels gebonden zijn.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bankgeheim in Zwitserland (ingezonden 1 februari 2010).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Swiss federal court ruling blocking the US-Swiss UBS data deal and what it means for tackling Dutch tax evasion via Swiss accounts, and whether a new tax treaty would allow information exchange. The minister answered that the ruling does not affect the Dutch approach, that a new Dutch-Swiss tax treaty was signed on 26 February 2010 with ratification to be pursued, and that Switzerland resists bulk or automatic information exchange.
I will make every effort to ratify this new treaty as soon as possible.
Ik zal mij inspannen voor een zo spoedig mogelijke ratificatie van dit nieuwe verdrag.

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether failing to issue a dividend note was a criminal offence before 2010, how many prosecutions occurred, whether the rule should be retained, and whether transitional law applied retroactively. The minister confirmed the former criminal regime, reported no known prosecutions, announced electronic dividend notes with relief for some cases, and kept retroactive application of the lighter administrative fine.
The Tax Authority has informed me that it is not aware of any prosecution in recent years for these offences.
De Belastingdienst heeft mij laten weten niet bekend te zijn met enige vervolging in de afgelopen jaren voor deze feiten.

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the 30-year mortgage interest deduction limit applies to individuals, cohabiting or married couples, and couples who separate or marry after 1 January 2001. The minister answers that the 30-year period runs per individual with an owner-occupied mortgage debt, that partners' income allocation does not double the period, and that the outcomes for the separation and marriage examples depend on who held the mortgage debt before 1 January 2016.
For both partners the period starts when the home is purchased and the owner-occupied mortgage debt is taken on, and ends 30 years later.
Voor beide partners start de termijn bij aankoop van de woning en het aangaan van de EWS en eindigt 30 jaar later.

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether stretch limousine rental firms are unable to reclaim BPM because wedding transport and promotional trips count toward the 10% private-use allowance, and whether the rules should be changed. The minister replied that the BPM refund and motor vehicle tax exemption apply only to vehicles used almost entirely for public or taxi transport, that wedding transport falls outside that scope, and that no change is planned.
I see no reason to extend the BPM refund and motor vehicle tax exemption to transport other than public transport and taxi transport within the meaning of the Passenger Transport Act 2000.

Ik zie geen aanleiding de hier bedoelde teruggaaf van BPM en vrijstelling van motorrijtuigenbelasting uit te breiden tot ander vervoer dan openbaar vervoer en taxivervoer in de zin van de Wet personenvervoer 2000.

An MP asked the finance minister whether loans can still be taken out via the Frisia, Becam and Postkrediet websites of the failed DSB group, how that is possible, and whether brokers still earn commissions of around 80% on insurance sold with loans. The minister confirmed the sites still broker credit from other providers via an AFM-licensed intermediary, that DSB Bank's curators are responsible for compliance, and that new commission-transparency rules apply since 1 January 2010 with AFM supervision.
Since 1 January 2010 payment protection insurance intermediaries fall under new rules. Intermediaries must now be transparent about the commission they receive for their brokering.
Sinds 1 januari 2010 vallen betalingsbeschermers onder nieuwe regels. Bemiddelaars dienen nu transparant te zijn over de provisie die zij voor hun bemiddeling ontvangen.

Two VVD MPs asked whether residents of private care homes pay service, rent and care costs that are not covered by the AWBZ, how different tax regions treat deductions for these costs under the medical expenses deduction, and whether a uniform national policy is needed. The State Secretary confirmed the cost difference, stated that the deductible component is set per institution under a national policy decision applied uniformly, and saw no reason to change the policy.
I consider the current policy line sufficiently clear and adequate.
Ik acht de huidige beleidslijn voldoende helder en toereikend.

An MP asks why a taxpayer received three Tax Authority letters in quick succession about repaying part of a 2008 childcare allowance, and whether this could be done in one letter and whether it happens systematically. The State Secretary confirms receiving the letter, explains that separate systems prevent integrating correspondence, and says the third letter was sent at the request of parliament.
Because different systems are used for different activities, such as calculating and paying allowances, it is not always possible to integrate correspondence.
Doordat voor verschillende activiteiten, bijvoorbeeld het berekenen en betalen van toeslagen, verschillende systemen worden gebruikt is het niet altijd mogelijk om de correspondentie te integreren.

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance whether the groundwater levy should be abolished, given its competitive disadvantage for Dutch firms, its declining environmental rationale, its revenue and administrative cost, and when it will be evaluated. The state secretary confirmed the levy is higher than elsewhere in Europe and that abolition could be considered later within a budget framework, but deferred separate steps until the Studiecommissie belastingstelsel reports, and gave revenue figures (about 170 million euros a year) and the evaluation timetable.
Attention was also requested for the simplicity of the Dutch tax system.
Daarnaast is er ook aandacht gevraagd voor de eenvoud van het Nederlandse belastingstelsel.

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority has reportedly stopped pursuing debts under 1500 euro and stopped sending bailiff orders under 1000 euro, and asks about the reasons, the revenue loss, and whether policy will be changed. The state secretary denies the reports are accurate, explains that collection measures remain applied and that the choices concern targeting of enforcement instruments, and says the write-off percentages will not be affected.
The reports referred to in question 1 are not consistent with reality.
De berichten waarvan in vraag 1 gewag wordt gemaakt, kloppen niet met de werkelijkheid.

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether the tax authority requested Swiss bank data from Germany, whether the Netherlands would pay for stolen bank data as Germany considered, and when a promised letter on tip money would arrive. The state secretary confirmed the request to Germany, said the Netherlands would learn soon whether the data was relevant, and defended the tipster agreement and the tip money policy by referring to earlier advice and a later letter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Medewerkers Ongehoord Nederland ’stiekem gefilmd’ op redactie: ’Het overschrijdt alle grenzen’'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that staff at public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland were secretly filmed in the newsroom, and about integrity and social safety in public broadcasting. The minister calls covert filming unacceptable, says employers are responsible, and points to the Commissariaat voor de Media, which has the signal under consideration, and to the NPO's action plan, without committing to a direct conversation with the broadcaster.
The Commissariaat voor de Media supervises compliance with the Mediawet 2008, the Beleidsregels governance en interne beheersing 2017 and the Gedragscode Integriteit Publieke Omroepen.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Mediawet 2008, de Beleidsregels governance en interne beheersing 2017 en de Gedragscode Integriteit Publieke Omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat inspecties signaleren dat criminele netwerken de zorg hebben ontdekt

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers how they will respond to inspection findings that criminal networks have infiltrated healthcare through staffing agencies and fake diplomas, including whether oversight will be improved and whether profit-making in care should be curbed. The minister acknowledges the concern, promises to inform parliament in autumn about follow-up measures, rules out statutory profit caps on legal grounds, and proposes a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn.
Uw Kamer zal hier dit najaar over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Minder dan helft Amsterdamse jongeren zegt homoseksualiteit te accepteren'

An MP asked the government about a report that fewer than half of Amsterdam youths accept homosexuality, and about causes, school obligations and planned action. The State Secretary answered that acceptance has fallen sharply in the Gezondheidsmonitor Jeugd, that no causal research exists, that data cover only the regions surveyed, and that the government will consult COC and others and encourage Amsterdam to act.
I will share these reports with your House.
Ik zal deze rapporten met uw Kamer delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk en Tuinman over het bericht dat de Europese coördinator van het in Duitsland verboden Samidoun, genaamd Mohammed Khatib, op 10 juni 2024 komt spreken op de Radb

MPs Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk and Tuinman asked whether the government would engage Germany on Samidoun's Radboud University talk, bar the speaker from entry, ban the organisation, and push for EU terrorist listing. The minister answered that the government will talk with Germany, that the universities bear responsibility for event conditions, that the entry ban law does not allow refusing entry, and that listing is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and the Foreign Ministry, with the motion being investigated.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to consider whether there are grounds to ban an organisation, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bezien of er redenen zijn waarom een organisatie verboden moet worden, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Tseggai en Kathmann  over opleidingsniveau als risico-indicator voor fraude

MPs asked whether education level (mbo, hbo, wo) was used as a fraud risk indicator, including by DUO, and whether it is ethically justified given government goals to value all forms of education equally. The government acknowledged the former DUO risk profile, said no fraud-related algorithm in the register uses education type, stated that education type is generally an unjustified criterion and that DUO has stopped using it, and referred the broader question to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over Sociale veiligheid TU Delft

MPs Stultiens asked about TU Delft removing an article on social unsafety from its journalism platform under pressure, and about the independence of university media, non-disclosure clauses and social safety in the CAO. The minister regrets the removal, sees no reason for a broad study of press freedom but will press institutions on it, says he has no view on the number of settlement non-disclosure clauses and that an inventory is ongoing, and states social safety is the employers' responsibility under the Arbo law.
I regret that this article was taken offline.
Ik betreur het dat dit artikel offline is gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en De Kort over het artikel 'Havo-leerlingen stappen vaker over naar het mbo'
