MPs Martens-America and De Kort asked about rising numbers of havo students leaving secondary school without a diploma for mbo vocational training, and whether basic skills and startkwalificatie are secured. The minister answers that numbers have risen, that the trend is largely positive, that basic skills plans and a planned study on the beroepshavo are underway, and that a tracking study shows 85% of such transfers obtained an mbo diploma.
In the autumn I will commission a study to gain insight into this.
Ik zal in het najaar een onderzoek uitzetten om hier zicht op te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over het artikel 'Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a police-ended pro-Palestinian protest camp at the University of Amsterdam, including intimidation of Jewish students, journalists being hindered, and UvA publishing links with Israeli institutions. The Minister condemned intimidation and antisemitism, said he is in ongoing contact with universities and the local security triangle, pointed to a joint protest guideline and a forthcoming letter on safety and international cooperation criteria, and noted PersVeilig support for journalists.
Question 1: Are you aware of the article 'Police end demonstration by pro-Palestinian protesters on UvA campus'?
Vraag 1 Bent u bekend met het artikel «Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA»?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten ver de artikelen 'Pro-Palestinian protesters are backed by a surprising source: Biden’s biggest donors' en 'Qatar is oversaturating US Universities with funds, directly affecting

MP Van Zanten asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether foreign funding, including from Qatar, reaches Dutch universities and fuels antisemitism, and what measures exist compared with the US. The minister answered that no such cases are known, that transparency on external funding is being pursued through a forthcoming guideline and the Wtmo bill, and that universities are responsible for their own safeguards.
We do not know whether money from these or other foreign organisations has reached Dutch educational institutions.
We weten niet of er ook geld van deze of andere buitenlandse organisaties terecht is gekomen bij Nederlandse onderwijsinstellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het nieuwsbericht 'Kunstacademie stopt samenwerking met Israël: Eisen van studenten worden ingewilligd' en het bijbehorende Instagrambericht op het profiel van Kabkstudentun

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Royal Academy of Art (KABK) suspending its cooperation with an Israeli institution after student demands, and about a related Instagram post with the phrase 'Global intifada'. The Minister answered that institutions decide on international cooperation autonomously within the law, that KABK is developing an ethical framework, that no sanctions or funding cuts are planned, and that the government does not monitor such decisions.
Because institutions have the right and freedom to decide on their international cooperation, there is no question of sanctioning measures or stopping funding.
Omdat instellingen het recht en de vrijheid hebben om te beslissen over hun internationale samenwerkingen is er geen sprake van sanctionerende maatregelen of het stopzetten van bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘ME grijpt in bij bezetting gebouw Universiteit Leiden in Den Haag‘

MP Stoffer asks the education minister whether it is acceptable that Leiden University engaged with Students for Palestine and masked activists during an occupation, and whether institutions should adjust policy under pressure from protesters. The minister answers that universities follow a shared protest guideline, that contact with masked protesters was a de-escalation choice not negotiation, that demands to cut Israeli ties conflict with academic freedom, and that protest legality is for mayors and courts to judge.
I will not hold the executive board to account for the decision to seek contact with the protesters who were wearing face coverings.
Ik zal het college van bestuur niet aanspreken op het besluit contact te zoeken met de protestvoerders met gezichtsbedekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de discriminerende vooringenomenheid door het gehele controleproces van fraude bij DUO

An MP asked the Minister of Education about indirect discrimination in DUO's fraud-control process, including a new study finding bias across the whole selection process. The Minister acknowledges the bias is worse than thought, apologises, promises a changed control system, a review of signal handling, and a letter to parliament in the autumn.
That the situation is worse than we already suspected is extremely disappointing.
Dat de situatie slechter is dan we al vermoedden is buitengewoon teleurstellend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Kwijtschelding studieschuld voor medische gronden

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the number and handling of requests to write off student debt on medical grounds, the criteria used, the processing delays, privacy safeguards and the role of medical advisers. The minister reports a backlog of about 800 applications and processing times of 12 to 14 months, explains the narrow criteria and the discretionary hardship clause, and describes measures to speed up decisions, but gives limited detail on some points such as applicant time investment and does not change the rules.
DUO also faces a sharp increase in the number of applications.
DUO heeft daarnaast te maken met een sterke toename van het aantal aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Martens-America over het hoofdstuk 'Zo krijg je geld terug van DUO' in het boek DRUKS 2

MPs Van Eijk and Martens-America asked whether DUO's prestatiebeurs (performance grant) facilities are widely misunderstood, whether a generic 'structural functional limitation' note suffices, whether late claims are allowed, and whether a book promoting ways to get money back from DUO is undesirable. The minister answered that DUO staff know the rules, that medical claims require a signed medical form and a causal link, that late claims are possible with justification and a five-year coulance term, and that free public information is not objectionable.
However, I see the task of ensuring that (former) students are informed through our own channels so well that no external explanation or help is needed.
Wel zie ik de taak om ervoor te zorgen dat (oud-) studenten via onze eigen kanalen zo geïnformeerd worden dat er verder geen externe toelichting of hulp nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over te hoge boetes voor studentenreisproducten.

An MP asks about a court ruling that DUO did too little to prevent former students from accruing unnecessary public transport fines after their student travel product should have been stopped, and why it is still not automatic. The minister says DUO is appealing, describes the 30-day blacklist delay and planned OV-pas migration, gives a 2013-2023 fine table, and declines to commit to an investigation or compensation while the case is pending.
I cannot respond to a pending court case.
Ik kan niet reageren op een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'WO II-voorstelling afgelast vanwege antisemitisme'

Two MPs asked whether cancelling a WWII performance due to antisemitism signals capitulation to anti-Jewish hatred and what role government plays in safeguarding cultural events. The State Secretary condemned such cancellations, said culture must remain free, and outlined cooperation with the sector, local security triangles and a forthcoming broader antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a clear directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'Reeks muzikale holocaustherdenkingen afgelast door antisemitische dreiging: ‘Risico is veel te groot’

MPs asked whether the cancellation of Holocaust commemoration concerts due to antisemitic threats is unacceptable and what measures will be taken to keep such events going, and whether the sector's exposure to antisemitism will be mapped. The Staatssecretaris condemns antisemitism, says cultural events must not be cancelled over Jewish themes, and reports sector agreements on protocols and a round-table, while committing to inform parliament further on the antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Tseggai over restitutie les- en cursusgeld mbo-studenten

MPs Westerveld and Tseggai asked why mbo students, unlike hbo and wo students, generally do not receive automatic refunds of tuition fees when they leave their studies early, and about related follow-up on a promised exploration, the use of unrefunded fees, and support needs. The minister answered that mbo refunds are available only under specific conditions such as serious illness, that the difference reflects the aim of encouraging a starting qualification, and that changing the policy is not feasible for 2024–2025 and is left to the next cabinet.
It is not feasible to realise this for the 2024–2025 study year.
Het is niet haalbaar om dit te realiseren voor het studiejaar 2024–2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over de individuele studietoeslag

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked how municipalities grant the individual study allowance under the Participatiewet, whether it is withheld when students spend part of a compulsory curriculum abroad, and whether it should continue in that case. The minister explains the allowance's purpose, notes the government lacks a full picture of municipal decisions, states that a student keeps the right abroad unless the main residence has moved, and says students with a disability should be enabled to gain study-related experience abroad without unnecessary barriers.
It is up to the municipality to assess this.
Het is aan de gemeente om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over Kritiek op besluit provincie Friesland tegen actief regenboogbeleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether rainbow provinces should be obliged to run active LGBTI policy, after Friesland's decision to drop such a stance, and requested figures on discrimination reports and police reports in Friesland. The minister answered that the rainbow-province label is a provincial initiative with no national conditions, that policy content is for provinces themselves, and supplied reporting figures from Tumba and the police.
I am happy to work together with the provinces on this, but as stated, the content of rainbow policy is ultimately up to the provinces themselves.
Ik werk hierin graag samen met de provincies, maar zoals gezegd is de invulling van het regenboogbeleid uiteindelijk aan de provincies zelf.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over lesmateriaal voor seksuele voorlichting en vorming op basisscholen

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Chamber could receive all sex education teaching material for primary schools developed by Rutgers, and if not, why not. The minister answered that the ministry does not own the material, that Rutgers' lesson packages are largely available online, and that the Chamber can request access itself, with Rutgers deciding how to provide it.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science does not own teaching material or lesson packages.
Het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is geen eigenaar van lesmateriaal of lespakketten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het CPB-onderzoek ‘de relatie tussen de arbeidsmarkt en studie-inschrijvingen'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about a CPB report showing weaker labour-market prospects for some graduates and whether students should be steered via numerus fixus, funding or better career information. The minister agrees that study choice should consider labour-market prospects, points to existing and planned measures, and says numerus fixus raises accessibility concerns and is still being studied.

Furthermore, I am currently having research carried out into whether and what effects steering measures in vocational, higher vocational and university education have in encouraging students to pursue programmes leading to occupations with sustainable labour-market prospects.

Daarnaast laat ik momenteel een onderzoek uitvoeren of en welke effecten sturende maatregelen in het mbo, hbo en wo hebben om studenten te interesseren voor opleidingen die opleiden voor beroepen met een duurzaam arbeidsmarktperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel ‘Gendersensitieve aanpak nog onvoldoende aanwezig in bestaand beleid, gemeenten en Rijksoverheid aan zet’

Parliamentary questions from MP Paulusma (D66) asked about the application of the gender quality requirement and gender test in policy-making, following a College voor de Rechten van de Mens article. The minister answered that the gender test is not mandatory to report, so its use cannot be tracked, that responsibility lies with individual ministries, and that ZonMw research on gender effects in policy will be delivered in 2024.
The policy compass does not require the gender test to be included in the explanatory memorandum or policy document.
Het beleidskompas verplicht niet tot het opnemen van de gendertoets in de memorie van toelichting of beleidsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het persbericht ‘Oekraïense school in Breda moet sluiten, onbegrip is groot’

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked why the Ukrainian school in Breda, a temporary education facility, must close on 14 July 2024, and whether Ukrainian language instruction can be preserved for displaced children. The minister explained the temporary legal exemption expires by statute, that Ukrainian-language education is not a task of publicly funded schooling, and that talks with the school and municipality on alternatives are ongoing.

I understand the importance for Ukrainian children of maintaining their connection to their own language and culture. However, this is not a task of formal publicly funded education, as it is not for other newcomers either.

Ik begrijp het belang voor Oekraïense kinderen om de verbinding te houden met de eigen taal en cultuur. Dit is echter geen taak van het formele bekostigde onderwijs, zoals het dat ook voor andere nieuwkomers niet is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Boon over het bericht ‘Woede over besluit Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen’

MPs Blaauw and Boon asked the minister whether the Hogeschool Utrecht's cancellation of Holocaust lectures sends the wrong signal and what the government will do to ensure the lecture series goes ahead. The minister said Holocaust education is important, that the first lecture has already taken place after a postponement for safety reasons, and that how the lectures are made publicly available is for the organisers to decide.
This concerns a lecture series organised by the Hogeschool Utrecht in cooperation with CIDI.
Het betreft hier een lezingenreeks die is georganiseerd door de Hogeschool Utrecht in samenwerking met het CIDI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over woede over het besluit van de Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen

MPs Martens-America and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister of Education about the Hogeschool Utrecht's reported cancellation of Holocaust lectures and about combating antisemitism in education. The Minister said the lecture series was postponed for security reasons, not cancelled, that Holocaust education is a curriculum requirement, and pointed to planned national antisemitism strategy and reporting channels.
The Utrecht University of Applied Sciences has stated that it does not let the content, form and implementation of its education be guided by interest groups or activists.
De Hogeschool Utrecht heeft aangegeven dat zij zich bij de inhoud, vorm en uitvoering van het onderwijs niet laat leiden door belangengroeperingen of activisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het NPO-programma Sekspedia voor jongvolwassenen

An MP asked the government about the NPO program Sekspedia, its content, public funding, whether the NPO should give sexual education to youth, and whether the program presents a representative view of sex. The state secretary declined to judge the program's content or conservatism, said she did not know the production cost, and pointed to the Mediawet and the Commissariaat voor de Media, saying educational content is part of the public broadcaster's remit.
As State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science, I do not give personal assessments of specific programmes.
Als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap geef ik geen persoonlijke beoordelingen over specifieke programma's.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de nog altijd bestaande oververtegenwoordiging van mannen in de top van grote Nederlandse bedrijven en de stijging van het aantal vrouwen die maar heel beperkt blijft

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the persistent underrepresentation of women in the top of large Dutch companies, the slow rise in women, and why many firms did not report under the Topvrouwenwet. The minister acknowledged the increase is too slow, said it is too early to draw conclusions, and committed to writing to non-reporting companies and issuing a progress report.
I am going to send a letter to the companies that did not report.
Ik ga aan de bedrijven die niet gerapporteerd hebben een brief te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en De Hoop over het bericht 'Woondiscriminatie: Studentenhuis vaak niet beschikbaar voor mbo’ers'

MPs Tseggai and De Hoop asked how the government responds to reports that student housing is often unavailable to MBO students, and whether education level should become a protected discrimination ground. The minister answered that most social student housing corporations admit MBO students, pledged to urge the remaining ones to do so, and will request advice from the College voor de Rechten van de Mens on banning distinction by education level.
All partners in student housing, by signing the LAS, have endorsed the accessibility of education for MBO, HBO and WO alike and stand for equal opportunity in education.

Alle samenwerkingspartners bij studentenhuisvesting hebben met het ondertekenen van het LAS de toegankelijkheid van onderwijs, voor zowel mbo, hbo als wo, onderschreven en staan voor kansengelijkheid in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het platform ScienceGuide

MP Stultiens asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the closure of the independent science news platform ScienceGuide due to lack of funding is regrettable, whether the government will help secure its future, and whether it will convene talks with the platform and institutions. The Minister regrets the closure, says funding is the responsibility of the institutions and ScienceGuide itself, and declines to convene talks for now.
At present I see no reason to enter into consultations about the continued existence of ScienceGuide.
Momenteel zie ik geen aanleiding om in overleg te treden over het voortbestaan van ScienceGuide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Paarse Vrijdag? ‘Ongewenste gekkigheid uit de Randstad’

MP Stoffer asked the minister whether parental and student concerns about Paarse Vrijdag are growing, whether schools have apologised for overreach, and whether students may opt out. The minister replied that schools decide how to implement it, that schools have a duty to protect safety and teach diversity, that students are not exempted from diversity lessons, and that no signals of school apologies have reached him.
I currently see no reason to enter into discussion with the sector councils about this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hierover in gesprek te gaan met de sectorraden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Paternotte over het bericht 'Mbo’er Sem (20) zoekt al drie jaar een studentenwoning in Amsterdam: ‘Ik wil hier mijn eigen leven beginnen’'

MPs Beckerman and Paternotte asked whether it is acceptable that MBO students are refused student housing and how the government will ensure access, including whether this counts as housing discrimination and whether landlords will be engaged. The minister answered that MBO students should have access, that a Human Rights Institute advice on banning distinction by education level is being requested, and that 11 of 13 Kences corporations admit MBO students, with the rest being asked to change.

On behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will shortly request advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights on the desirability of a ban on distinction by education level in the General Equal Treatment Act.

Mede namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal ik op korte termijn advies vragen aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over de wenselijkheid van een verbod op onderscheid naar opleidingsniveau in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Toekomst studie Fries zorgelijk: 'Zo snel mogelijk fulltime professor nodig'’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that academic Frisian studies need a full-time professor, the KNAW advice, the restructuring into a track, and the Council of Europe charter obligations. The minister agreed to structurally fund EUR 340,000 for academic Frisian, will explore a bachelor programme with the RUG, and plans a covenant with the institution to meet the parliamentary motion.
As regards Frisian at university level, which the KNAW report's recommendations target, I am willing to structurally make EUR 340,000 available in line with the amendment.

Voor wat betreft het Fries op universitair niveau, waar de aanbevelingen in het KNAW-rapport op gericht zijn, ben ik bereid om hiervoor conform het amendement € 340.000 structureel beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Faber-van de Klashorst over het bericht ‘Ramen Universiteitsbibliotheek vernield en beklad met pro-Palestinaleuzen’

PVV MPs Blaauw and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether he would condemn the vandalism and pro-Palestinian slogans at the Groningen university library and engage the university board. The minister condemned the vandalism as a crime, noted the university has already filed a police report and issued a statement, and said he sees no reason for a separate meeting with the board, while promising ongoing talks with the sector.
I currently see no reason to enter into talks with the Executive Board of the RUG about these events.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om samen met het College van Bestuur van de RUG in gesprek te gaan over deze gebeurtenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Elk jaar stoppen tienduizenden jongeren zonder diploma met school'.

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Education about reports of tens of thousands of youths dropping out of school yearly, the lack of orientation programmes in vocational education (mbo), and related issues such as pilot design, the binding study advice, and personal development. Minister Dijkgraaf answered most questions substantively, explaining that orientation programmes will be set up within existing law, a policy rule is forthcoming, funding of EUR 14 million per year is available during the pilot, and evaluation will follow.
I do not have a precise picture of the number of students participating in orientation programmes.
Een scherp beeld van het aantal studenten dat deelneemt aan oriëntatieprogramma's heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over antisemitisme in Nederland

MPs Bikker and Ellian asked about rising antisemitism in the Netherlands after the Hamas attack on Israel, including Jewish pupils' safety, reporting channels and EU cooperation. The minister answered that the government is in close contact with the Jewish community, that the NCAB and police monitor the situation, and that schools are encouraged to hold dialogue, though the answers largely restate existing policy and do not give concrete numbers or new measures.
I have tried to comply with your request. However, gathering the necessary data took some time.
Ik heb getracht aan uw verzoek te voldoen. Met het verzamelen van de benodigde gegevens ging echter enige tijd gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over klimaatstress onder jongeren

An MP asks the government how it will increase youth participation in climate policy, track climate-related stress and mental health among young people, and address communication, polarisation and related concerns. The government answers with planned youth consultations, a youth climate campaign, RIVM research on health effects, and mental health programmes, while rejecting the claim that its climate communication causes youth stress.
A meeting with young people will therefore be organised in the short term, together with the National Climate Platform, to map the opportunities and barriers to more and better participation.

Er zal daarom op korte termijn in samenwerking met het Nationaal Klimaatplatform (NKP) een bijeenkomst met jongeren georganiseerd worden waarin de kansen en belemmeringen voor meer en betere participatie geïnventariseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over de dreigende financiële dreun aan het openbaar vervoer in de regio

MPs Krul and Peters asked about a projected cut of about 260 million euros to student public transport budgets, arguing the 2021-2022 base year was unrepresentative due to COVID. The minister answered that the recalibration uses the 2022-2023 measurement period, that the freed-up funds (about 207.5 million) will be used once in 2024 to support public transport, and that a 2025 recalibration is proposed.
I therefore do not share the view that this recalibration study is not representative.
Ik deel daarom niet het standpunt dat dit herijkingsonderzoek niet representatief zou zijn.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid van der Graaf over mbo-nieuwkomersonderwijs

An MP asked the ministers about the Alfa-college's extra Dutch and maths support for newcomers in MBO vocational courses, whether they would engage with the college, and whether they would prepare a statutory basis for MBO education for non-Dutch speakers. The minister confirmed awareness and willingness to talk, and said a future-exploration and national dialogue on newcomer education is underway, with scenarios to be shared before summer 2024.
We aim to share future scenarios with your House before summer 2024.
Wij streven ernaar om voor de zomer van 2024 toekomstscenario's met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het artikel '‘Verstoorde arbeidsverhouding’ als ontslaggrond ondermijnt sociale veiligheid’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about the use of the 'disrupted working relationship' dismissal ground, its relevance for dismissals in education and for social safety, and whether the employer's culpability plays a role. The minister answered that data on the ground is not registered, that the employer's culpability can weigh in but is not decisive, that no separate research on education is planned, and pointed to existing workplace safety measures and a forthcoming handbook for employers.
This ground is not always explicitly mentioned in the request and is therefore not registered as such.
Deze grond wordt niet altijd expliciet in het verzoek genoemd en wordt dan dus ook niet als zodanig geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het bericht dat twee op de drie werkende Nederlanders zich niet door zijn werkgever gestimuleerd voelen om zichzelf te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van e

MPs Westerveld and Kathmann asked whether workers should receive a lifelong personal learning budget, how government can encourage employers to stimulate training, and how to reduce learning reluctance among practically educated workers, citing STAP-budget lessons. The ministers answer that lifelong learning is important, that employers bear primary responsibility, point to existing schemes (SLIM, leercultuur, LLO collectief, levenlanglerenkrediet) and say a personal learning budget is a decision for the next cabinet, referring to a November 2023 exploration.
Weighing the various pros and cons of introducing a development budget and the further decision-making on it is up to a next cabinet.
Het afwegen van de diverse voor- en nadelen van invoering van een ontwikkelbudget en de verdere besluitvorming daarover is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Universiteit Leiden keurt demonstratie locatie Wijnhaven af’

An SGP MP asked the Education Minister whether universities can prevent unauthorised demonstrations that cause insecurity among Jewish students, what powers they have to stop repeated pro-Palestinian events that voiced support for Hamas, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replied that universities set their own house rules, can act proportionately including reporting crimes to police, and that Leiden has tightened security and is evaluating the matter, so no further intervention is currently warranted.
Universities have, appropriate to the context of their institution, further rules on how demonstrations may take place on their campuses.
Universiteiten hebben, passend bij de context van hun instelling, nadere regels over de wijze waarop er demonstraties kunnen plaatsvinden op hun campussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Beertema over het verspreiden van antisemitische flyers op de Universiteit van Leiden

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Beertema asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an antisemitic flyer distributed near Leiden University, whether it glorifies violence, and whether the university board and the Minister will take stronger measures against such leaflets and hate speech. The Minister acknowledged the flyer contains objectionable texts, said decisions on criminality rest with the prosecutor and universities, and declined to order stronger measures, pointing to the board's existing steps and ongoing monitoring.
I have great appreciation for the teachers and administrators who make difficult conversations possible at their institutions, and I want to urge them to keep doing so.
Ik heb grote waardering voor de docenten en bestuurders die het moeilijke gesprek op hun instelling mogelijk maken en ik wil hen ook oproepen om dat te blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Beertema over het verspreiden van antisemitische flyers op de Universiteit van Leiden

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Beertema asked the minister why Leiden University did nothing after being warned in October 2023 about antisemitic flyers, and whether the Executive Board and Supervisory Board should be pressed to step down. The minister answered that the university says it instructed security to prevent such flyers, that dismissal via the Supervisory Board is reserved for exceptional cases and he sees no reason for it, and that he sees no need for further talks with universities.
Intervention via the Supervisory Board only happens in very exceptional cases.
Ingrijpen via de Raad van Toezicht gebeurt alleen in zeer uitzonderlijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onrust op de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven over de groeiende invloed van het bedrijfsleven op onderzoek aan de universiteit

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about unrest at TU Eindhoven over growing business influence on research, including academic freedom, governance and supervisory board independence, and the open letter on criticism. The Minister rejected the analysis of structural governance failure, argued existing safeguards and KNAW/Rathenau-type frameworks suffice, and promised no new fund or specific action beyond general reflection.
I do not share your analysis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de miljarden aan onderwijsgeld die niet aan onderwijs worden besteed

An MP asks why school funding in the Netherlands is not better specified, monitored and accounted for, despite years of criticism from parliament, the inspectorate and the Court of Audit. The minister responds that a reform of governance and funding is underway with a letter due in early 2024, that school boards are accountable through audited annual reports, and that a new funding instrument with spending conditions is being prepared.
That is why I am in discussion with the sector to examine which improvements can be made on governance, funding and terms of employment.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met het veld om te kijken welke verbeteringen door te voeren zijn op de thema's zeggenschap, bekostiging en arbeidsvoorwaardenvorming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Zembla-reportage ‘Het transgenderprotocol’

Van Haga asked the ministers of Health and Education about a Zembla report criticising the evidence base of the Dutch transgender care protocol, including the consent process, financing, and whether care should be paused. Minister Kuipers replied that medical content is for the professional field, that the Kwaliteitsstandaard is being evaluated by KIMS, and that no pause or new investigation is planned, while noting school civic education frameworks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht 'Roemeense NGO licht DUO op. Betaald voor niet-bestaand werk.'

Member Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Romanian NGO, the Global Confederation of Romanian Students, helped students claim Dutch study finance for non-existent work, asking when DUO knew of it, what was done, how many students benefited, and whether such abuse is common. The minister answered that DUO received first signals in 2018 and passed them to the labour inspectorate and tax authority, that about 260 people received study finance linked to the NGO, that DUO lacks authority to investigate the organisation itself, and that the ministry will examine further measures.
DUO is therefore not authorised to independently investigate the activities of a particular organisation.
DUO is dus niet bevoegd zelfstandig onderzoek in te stellen naar de werkzaamheden van een bepaalde organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het wetsvoorstel Screening kennisveiligheid, naar aanleiding van de brief van de Minister 'Sectorbeeld kennisveiligheid universiteiten'

An MP asks why the Screening of Knowledge Security bill was postponed and whether this weakens knowledge security, plus questions on consultation, risk areas, screening definitions and timing. The Minister cites the need for careful design, feedback on feasibility and scope, the ongoing Justis preliminary study, and promises to inform parliament in a progress letter in early 2024.
On the adjusted timeline of the bill and the date of entry into force, I will inform your House in the next progress letter on the knowledge security approach.
Over het bijgestelde tijdpad van de wet en het moment van inwerkingtreding zal ik uw Kamer in de volgende voortgangsbrief aanpak kennisveiligheid informeren.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over toenemende online lhbti+-haat naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Tijd voor geweld tegen deze lui'

GroenLinks MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked the government about rising online hostility toward LGBTQI+ people, including whether platforms should be responsible, what the DSA and DMA require, and how the government will tackle online hate. The government answered that it finds the trends worrying, lists existing measures (reporting office, DSA obligations, interdepartmental approach, prevention campaigns), and says it is still evaluating policy and awaiting further research.
The cabinet is currently evaluating the measures from the LGBTI Safety Action Plan 2019–2022.
Het kabinet evalueert momenteel de maatregelen uit het Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI 2019–2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cursor op zwart'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the dismissal of the Cursor editor-in-chief at TU Eindhoven and alleged pressure on the independence of university newspapers. The Minister says journalistic independence is a great good, finds the situation undesirable, notes an integrity-commission investigation into alleged censorship at TU/e, and declines to start a broader investigation for now.

I consider it up to the Executive Board, as publisher of Cursor, the editorial board and the Cursor editorial staff to discuss with each other the editorial statute, especially in light of what has happened.

Ik vind het aan het College van Bestuur, als uitgever van Cursor, de redactieraad en de redactie van Cursor om, te meer naar aanleiding van hetgeen is voorgevallen, met elkaar het gesprek te voeren over het redactiestatuut
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het BIT-advies vervolgonderzoek project Doorontwikkelen Applicatielandschap Bekostiging bij DUO

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the Adviescollege ICT-toetsing's warning that DUO's billing IT project will take 8 years and cost €25-30 million rather than 2.5 years and €6 million, and why Blueriq was found unsuitable only late. The Minister disputes the scale of the overrun, admits two earlier re-baselinings and a reconsideration of Blueriq, and promises an external analysis with a decision and informing the Chamber later.

In consultation with DUO I will make a careful assessment of the continuation of the IT project. In due course I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes of the analysis and the choice for the continuation.
In overleg met DUO maak ik een zorgvuldige afweging voor het vervolg van het IT-project. Te zijner tijd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van de analyse en de keuze voor het vervolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Pestgedrag, intimidatie en seksuele relaties tussen hoogleraren en studenten op Radboud Universiteit'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports of harassment, intimidation and sexual misconduct by professors at Radboud University and whether complaint and reporting structures at universities are adequate. The minister acknowledged shortcomings flagged by the Inspectorate, committed to further research into complaint procedures, a possible national reporting point and a regulatory duty of care, but declined to share signals between institutions citing privacy law.
I will inform your House of the findings of the research in due course.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de inzichten uit het onderzoek te zijner tijd nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht ‘Studenten betalen volgend jaar ruim vijf keer meer rente over hun studielening’

An MP asked the Education Minister whether student loan interest rising more than fivefold for 2024 was confirmed, why this conflicted with promised relief, and about banding, repayment, and mortgage effects. The minister explained the rate is statutorily linked to government borrowing costs, noted existing income-dependent repayment and mortgage rules, and said no fundamental change was warranted now, pointing to an evaluation with alternative options.
At this moment I see no reason for fundamental adjustment of the system, see also my evaluation of the interest on student loans that I sent to your House.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden voor fundamentele aanpassing in het stelsel, zie ook mijn evaluatie over de rente op studieleningen die ik naar uw Kamer heb gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Rente op studieschuld vanaf volgend jaar meer dan vijf keer zo hoog'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about the sharp rise in interest on student loans for 2024 and how it squares with the government's pledge of financial security for students. The minister replied that the rate is linked to the state's borrowing rate by law, that repayment is income-dependent, and that he cannot promise the rate will not rise further.
No, I cannot make that commitment.
Nee, die toezegging kan ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Pouw-Verweij en Bisschop over het bericht dat Joodse studenten zich onveilig en ongewenst voelen op de Universiteit van Amsterdam

MPs Beertema, Pouw-Verweij and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Jewish students feel unsafe and unwelcome at the University of Amsterdam, including a pro-Palestinian occupation and a professor's alleged promotion of BDS. The minister condemned the calls for violence, said institutions are responsible for safe environments and complaint procedures, announced an integrated social safety approach and review of complaint procedures, but declined to see grounds for further talks with the UvA or for a broader pattern.
Institutions are responsible for providing a safe learning and working environment in which everyone feels at home and can develop.
Instellingen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van een veilige leer- en werkomgeving, waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en zich kan ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de hoogte van het collegegeld voor Oekraïense studenten

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education about tuition fees for Ukrainian students, whether institutions should lower fees for new Ukrainian students, the financial consequences, and the number of students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that fee-setting is for individual institutions, that he stands by his call for lower fees, that no separate financial scheme will be created, and that the wider financing question is left to a new cabinet.
I do not intend to set up a financial scheme for this group because it concerns the competence and responsibility of the institution.
Ik ben niet voornemens een financiële regeling voor deze groep op te zetten omdat het hier de bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) over het bericht 'Mbo’er loopt vaak lang en onbetaald stage'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that MBO students often do long, unpaid internships and are used as regular workers, and whether minimum internship pay and enforcement are needed. The minister condemns misuse of interns, points to the Labour Inspectorate and the Stagepact, and leaves pay to sector social partners while promising monitoring and possibly harder agreements later.
I find it unacceptable when students are improperly deployed.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar wanneer studenten oneigenlijk worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afkalvende bestaanszekerheid voor mensen met publieke beroepen door kostenstijgingen en loonbeslag

An MP from the PvdA asked several ministers about falling financial security among care and public-sector workers, including reports that many skip doctor or dentist visits and that some have wage garnishments. The government answered that it lacks sector-specific garnishment data, that such garnishments are not shown to be more common in the public sector, and pointed to existing debt-relief measures and the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, with no change to the exempt amount planned.

The cabinet does not have figures on wage garnishment in (subsectors of) care and cannot say whether the share of employees with a wage garnishment among district nurses and nursing home staff is larger than among other occupational groups or branches within care.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers over loonbeslag in (subsectoren van) de zorg en kan dus ook niet zeggen of het percentage medewerkers met loonbeslag onder wijkverpleegkundigen en zorgpersoneel in verpleeghuizen groter is dan onder andere beroepsgroepen dan wel branches binnen de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het artikel ‘Universiteit van Amsterdam beloofde EY wetenschappelijk advies in ruil voor sponsordeal’

MP Kwint (SP) asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to react to reports that the University of Amsterdam promised EY scientific advice in exchange for sponsorship, including a benefits memo and EY-funded blockchain research led by an EY partner, and whether this safeguards scientific independence. The Minister answers that the memo's promised benefits were not part of the agreement and were not delivered, that the UvA will conduct an internal evaluation to report in spring 2024, and that the Codes of Conduct evaluation and Supervisory Boards' oversight responsibilities are under review.
In my view, the existence of the memo alongside the agreement creates the appearance of dependence and conflict of interest.
Naar mijn mening wekt het bestaan van het memo naast de overeenkomst de schijn van afhankelijkheid en belangenverstrengeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Omtzigt over het feit dat werkstudenten uit EER-landen, die 8 uur per week werken, aanspraak kunnen maken op een Nederlandse basisbeurs (€ 439,- per maand) en een Nederlan

MPs Van der Woude and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education whether EEA students working 8 hours a week can claim Dutch basic and supplementary grants, and what this means for Dutch universities. The Minister answered that migrant-worker status is assessed on a 32-hour monthly benchmark per the Centrale Raad van Beroep, that a 24-hour, six-month rule applies, that the supplementary grant cannot be means-tested against foreign price levels under EU law, and that legislation on internationalisation is being prepared.
In view of the CRvB ruling, I consider a working-hours norm higher than 32 hours legally untenable.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de CRvB acht ik een urennorm hoger dan 32 uur juridisch niet houdbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hans Teunissen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen bij DUO: studiebeurs een raadsel voor bijna 90 procent ouders van mbo’ers

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a survey showing most parents of vocational students do not understand the student grant and some do not know about helpful tools such as the OV-jaarkaart, and asked about uptake, monitoring, information efforts and planned actions. The minister confirmed the survey, reported high uptake of the basic and supplementary grants, said the effect of the DUO campaign is hard to isolate, and listed information measures and a promise to send the full answers before the committee debate.
I will investigate how we can better inform parents of prospective students about all administrative matters relating to studying, including applying for student finance.
Ik ga onderzoeken hoe we ouders van aankomend studenten in aanvulling hierop beter kunnen informeren over alle regelzaken rondom studeren, dus ook het aanvragen van studiefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Minder extra opleidingsplekken voor GZ-psychologen dan gehoopt: ‘Hiermee gaan wij de wachtlijsten niet wegwerken’’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport why the Capacity Body's preferred 920 extra training places for GZ-psychologists, via vertical substitution, were not adopted, and whether fewer places will leave mental health waiting lists unresolved. The minister defends the chosen scenario on quality statute, integrated care agreement, budget and quality grounds, and says extra places would not reduce waiting lists since no new workforce is added.
I cannot agree with the picture that no weighed decision was taken and that no account was taken of the fact that there is growing demand for care.
Ik kan mij niet vinden in het beeld dat er geen gewogen besluit is genomen en dat er geen rekening is gehouden met het feit dat er sprake is van een groeiende zorgvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel 'Universiteit van Amsterdam geeft Netflix belastingadvies vermomd als wetenschappelijk onderzoek’ op onderzoeksplatform Follow the Money

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Follow the Money report that the University of Amsterdam gave Netflix tax advice disguised as research, including a memo of promised benefits beyond the contract, and asked about integrity, funding, transparency and a professorship. The Minister answered that the memo's benefits are not part of the signed contract and were not granted, while acknowledging that the memo creates an appearance of dependence and conflict of interest, and that the university will evaluate the project.
In my view, the existence of the memo alongside the contract creates the appearance of dependence and conflict of interest.
Naar mijn mening wekt het bestaan van het memo naast de overeenkomst de schijn van afhankelijkheid en belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over het bericht dat kinderen soms langer dan een jaar wachten op logopedie

MPs Sahla and Hagen asked about reports that children sometimes wait over a year for speech therapy, including waiting-list data, the Treek norm, therapist numbers, tariffs, insurer duties and measures to reduce waits. The minister reported that over half of first-line practices had waits exceeding one year in 2022, that insurers must ensure access and mediate, and that he will consult the NZa on more intensive supervision, while stating that tariff adequacy cannot yet be judged.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision of speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Nijboer over de Amsterdamse voorrangsregeling op woningen voor docenten, die nog altijd onvoldoende merkbaar is voor onderwijspersoneel dat daar werkt

MPs Mohandis and Nijboer asked whether Amsterdam's priority housing scheme for teachers is effective given housing scarcity, what national rules hinder it, and how teacher shortages can be tackled. The government answered that 99 social and 29 mid-rent homes were allocated to teachers, that scarcity persists, that a law change lets municipalities allocate up to 50% of freed affordable rentals to vital professions, and that regional teacher-shortage convenants and wage measures are being pursued.
It is up to the municipalities to weigh the interests of the different groups of housing seekers carefully when making policy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de belangen tussen de verschillende groepen woningzoekenden goed te wegen bij het maken van beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Paul over het bericht ‘Kinderen wachten soms langer dan jaar op logopedie: Gevolgen worden onderschat’

MPs Tielen and Paul asked the health and education ministers about reported long waiting lists for speech therapy for children, their causes, administrative burden, the link with school advice, and digital options. Minister Kuipers reported rising waiting lists (half of first-line practices with waits over a year in 2022), said data cannot yet be split further, promised to discuss more intensive supervision with the NZa, and pointed to existing initiatives while giving no firm new measures.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision over speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het manifest van studenten- en belangorganisaties over inclusieve stilteruimtes op onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the education ministers about a manifesto calling for inclusive quiet rooms at schools and universities, and whether the government would require or guide such rooms. The ministers answered that institutions decide themselves, that the government will not mandate or issue guidance, and pointed to existing student-wellbeing agreements.
It is not for the government to take a prominent position in the discussion on setting up, or obliging, quiet rooms.
Het is niet aan de overheid om een prominente positie te kiezen in de discussie over het inrichten, dan wel verplichten, van stilteruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Zuidas die meebeslist over docenten en inhoud van het universitair onderwijs over direct belastingen.

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about sponsorship of indirect tax education at four universities by Zuidas law firms and the Tax Authority, including funding, accreditation, quality, professors tied to PwC, and commercial influence on higher education. The minister answered that the cooperation dates from 2008, sponsorship totals about 128,750 to 135,000 euros per year plus secondment, programmes are accredited, universities will tighten contract transparency, and no separate investigation is needed beyond the upcoming external accreditation visitations.
Additional investigation beyond this assessment within the external accreditation is therefore not considered necessary at this moment.
Extra onderzoek naast deze beoordeling in het kader van de externe accreditatie acht ik daarom op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘De woedeaanvallen van minister Wiersma zijn geen incident, maar een patroon’

An SP MP asked 13 questions about a newspaper report describing a pattern of angry outbursts by the minister for Primary and Secondary Education, including whether the Chamber can monitor his self-improvement, staff departures, communication staffing and local journalism. The answer is a cross-reference to a separate letter published in response to a Woo request, so the substance of the answers is not given in this document.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about the report 'The rage attacks of Minister Wiersma are not an incident but a pattern' (2023Z09138) have been answered by means of a letter (Publication of documents following a Woo request regarding conduct of former Minister Wiersma).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over het bericht «De woedeaanvallen van Minister Wiersma zijn geen incident, maar een patroon» ( 2023Z09138 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande minister Wiersma

The SP MP Kwint asks the government about reports that Minister Wiersma behaved aggressively during a work visit and towards the Inspectorate of Education, including what the complaint and 'difficult conversations' involved and how the inspectorate's independence will be safeguarded. The minister refers the questions to a letter on Woo-published documents concerning Wiersma's conduct, without answering them substantively in this reply.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about various reports concerning Minister Wiersma (2023Z11630) have been answered by letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over diverse berichten aangaande Minister Wiersma ( 2023Z11630 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over onderzoek naar mogelijk discriminerende algoritmen door DUO

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked the minister about a possibly discriminatory DUO fraud-detection algorithm targeting students with a migration background, and about transparency, privacy checks, and oversight. The minister answered that an independent external investigation is announced, the algorithm is suspended pending results, DUO will only do random checks, and publication and the Algorithm Register are being pursued.
As indicated in my letter to the House of 21 June, I find these signals very disturbing and I have immediately announced an independent external investigation.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 21 juni vind ik deze signalen zeer verontrustend en heb ik direct een onafhankelijk extern onderzoek aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over Bevindingen onderzoek DUO naar fraude met studiefinanciering

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether DUO's student-finance fraud findings, which reportedly fall disproportionately on students with a migration background, reflect indirect discrimination and whether the risk-indicator algorithm will be adjusted. The Minister says most DUO decisions survive appeal, will await an external independent investigation of DUO's working method before drawing conclusions, and will not set aside striking outcome patterns in advance.
I am having DUO's working method investigated externally and independently.
Ik laat de werkwijze van DUO extern en onafhankelijk onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'COC meldt 'homohaat tegen kinderen', pand in Eindhoven belaagd'

An MP asked the ministers about reports of anti-LGBTI harassment linked to football supporters, the frequency of discriminatory chants and sanctions, and the KNVB's enforcement of its anti-discrimination rules. The minister gave partial answers: investigations were ongoing, incident data were not recorded in the requested form, and several questions were answered by describing existing policy and planned follow-up action.
At this moment I cannot make any statements about this in connection with ongoing investigation.
Op dit moment kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen in verband met lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Saudische universiteit betaalde Nederlandse wetenschappers voor prestige'

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Saudi university paid Dutch scientists to list it as their first employer for prestige, and about the human rights record of Saudi Arabia. The Minister said such constructions are troubling, that universities as employers should decide on sanctions (noting Wageningen's suspension of one professor), and pointed to transparency measures and a forthcoming evaluation of the research integrity code.
I am not aware of the extent to which Saudi Arabia is trying to improve its international prestige with this kind of arrangement.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre Saudi-Arabië met dit soort constructies probeert haar internationale prestige te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Universiteit Leiden nam in stilte afscheid van haar omstreden Confucius Instituut’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Confucius Institutes at Dutch universities, their funding, continued cooperation and risks such as Chinese state influence and espionage. The minister answered that academic freedom is important, that some institutions were advised to end cooperation, and that continued contact and knowledge-security measures are in place.
I would like to emphasise that I attach great importance to safeguarding academic freedom and scientific integrity at educational and research institutions.
Ik wil graag benadrukken dat ik groot belang hecht aan het waarborgen van academische vrijheid en wetenschappelijke integriteit door onderwijs-en onderzoeksinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Joodse student voelt zich onveilig’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a Jewish student feeling unsafe, a 'Israeli Apartheid Week' at the University of Groningen, a moderator's ties to a pro-Palestine group, BDS, and recording antisemitic incidents. The government condemned antisemitism, said universities must allow controversial views within legal limits while ensuring safe environments, and referred prosecution decisions to the prosecutor and courts.
In individual cases it is for the public prosecutor to assess whether there is discrimination or criminal liability under the articles of the Criminal Code.
Het is in individuele gevallen aan het openbaar ministerie om te beoordelen of er sprake is van discriminatie, c.q. strafbaarheid op grond van de artikelen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Sneller over ‘Versterking kennisfunctie van de Rijksoverheid’

Sneller (D66) asked how the government has followed up on a 2018 KWINK report on open publication of ministry research and protection against political or civil-servant steering, whether a Rijksbrede knowledge function should be strengthened (Rijkslab, chief science officers), and whether ministries should have their own knowledge institutes like the WODC.
