The minister answered that departments already promote open publication, that no government-wide stakeholder study is needed, that the knowledge function remains a departmental responsibility with only possible interdepartmental agreements, and that the answers could not be given before the committee debate.
I therefore see no need for a government-wide stakeholder study.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak voor een Rijksbreed stakeholdersonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over de subsidiëring van jongerenorganisaties

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked about government subsidies and study-grant (bestuursbeurzen) schemes for youth organisations, including who qualifies, representativeness, rejected applications and the treatment of vocational students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that no integral overview exists, explained the eligibility criteria and rejections, and largely declined to change the scheme's scope beyond planned extensions for mbo students.
There is no integral overview of all youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Er is geen integraal overzicht van alle jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel door Hoger Onderwijs Persbureau op Punt Avans ‘Experiment flexstuderen stopt abrupt, Dijkgraaf denkt na’.

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education whether the flexible-study experiment would be halted or delayed and whether the House had been informed, plus questions on student numbers, consequences, and a broader rollout to older master's students. The Minister admits delaying the bill, says the experiment ends on 1 September 2023 because no bill was submitted in time, and promises a compensation arrangement for current participants while the broader need is still being assessed.
I decided to prepare and submit the flexible-study bill only after my policy response to the future exploration.
Ik heb de afweging gemaakt om het wetsvoorstel flexstuderen voor te bereiden en in te dienen ná mijn beleidsreactie op de toekomstverkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het debatcentrum de Balie

An FvD MP asked the Culture minister about the Ministry's funding relationship with debate centre De Balie, a Russian tank exhibit, a director's assault on a journalist, and whether the subsidy should be reconsidered. The state secretary confirmed BIS subsidies and COVID support, called programming and the director's conduct matters for others to assess (the Raad voor Cultuur and the supervisory board), and declined to reconsider the subsidy relationship.
It is not for me to assess the programming of a cultural institution.
Het is niet aan mij om de programmering van een culturele instelling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de voortgang van de doelen wat betreft het emancipatiedossier

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about progress on the emancipation agenda, including the Rainbow election accord, discrimination enforcement, LGBTQ+ rights, gender equality in the labour market and related measures. The Minister answered most questions with descriptions of ongoing work, timelines and planned reports to parliament, without withholding requested information.
I am only truly satisfied at the moment that emancipation is accomplished.
Ik ben pas echt tevreden op het moment dat de emancipatie volbracht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het recordaantal uitvallers in het mbo door groenpluk van het bedrijfsleven

An MP asked the education ministers about the record number of early school leavers in vocational education, the causes (labour market, corona, lighter exam rules), the binding study advice, employer responsibility, diploma incentives, and budget cuts to the VSV scheme. The minister attributes dropout to a combination of lighter exam rules, corona-related motivation and mental health problems, and a strong labour market, plans a VSV action plan after the summer, and says the VSV scheme ends in 2024 with funds redirected.
It is therefore not possible to make a breakdown of which share of early school leavers stops for which reason.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een verdeling te maken welk deel van de voortijdig schoolverlaters om welke reden stopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het aanpassen van boeken

JA21 MPs Eerdmans and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the government objects to publishers altering classic books such as those by Roald Dahl, Agatha Christie and Ian Fleming after sensitivity readers flagged wording, and about copyright protections for deceased authors. The government replied that word changes are a matter for publishers, writers and translators, that copyright and moral rights (including the author's right to object to harmful changes) are explained, and that designating national heritage is not a government task.
I do not see it as a government task to prescribe which books belong to our national heritage.
Ik zie het niet als een taak van de overheid voor te schrijven welke boeken tot ons nationale erfgoed behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over het nieuwe NWO-programma voor onderzoeksfinanciering dat de etniciteit van academici beoordeelt

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an NWO research programme on equity in academia that targets researchers with a migration background and mentions ethnic quotas. The Minister answers that the programme aims to promote diversity and equal opportunity, that NWO and the researchers are responsible for its content, and that there are no government plans to introduce quotas.
It is not for me to interpret a research project subsidised by NWO.
Het is niet aan mij om een door NWO gesubsidieerd onderzoeksproject te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld voor gevluchte Oekraïense studenten

An MP asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences have made national agreements for 2023-2024 so Ukrainian students pay the statutory tuition rate rather than the higher institutional rate, and what is being done for affected students. The minister says the sector bodies agreed to lower institutional tuition for continuing Ukrainian students to the statutory level, that institutions can decide case by case, and that a generic measure will be considered within broader cabinet migration discussions that are not yet concluded.
I call on the institutions to also support this group of students where necessary next academic year, using the current powers they have to do so.
Ik roep de instellingen op om deze groep studenten waar nodig ook volgend studiejaar te ondersteunen vanuit de huidige bevoegdheid die zij daartoe hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en El Yassini over Artikelen ‘Kansengelijkheid helpt de wetenschap vooruit’ en ‘Nieuw onderzoeksprogramma voor kansengelijkheid en inclusie academische wereld’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Interior about NWO's funding of research into quotas for racialised academic staff and whether NWO's remit covers diversity goals. The ministers answered that individual merit matters, that no quota policy is planned, that NWO's core statutory task is research quality, and that they see no reason to act while awaiting the research results.
NWO is funding research into quotas for racialised academic staff. As funder, NWO is not responsible for the details of this research.
NWO financiert een onderzoek naar quota voor geracialiseerd academisch personeel. NWO gaat als financier niet over de details van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over de berichtgeving over jongvolwassenen met psychische problemen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education about reports of high levels of psychological complaints among young adults, including why girls are more affected, the role of social pressures, social media, and youth care demand. The government answered that mental health concerns are long-standing and worsened by COVID-19, pointed to existing research and the cross-ministerial mental health programme, and said it is in dialogue with youth, parents and professionals while it does not identify causal links to foreign ideologies.
To learn more about the causes of and solutions for these feelings of anxiety, uncertainty and stress, on 25 April I held a conversation with young people, parents, care workers and administrators.

Om meer te weten te komen over de oorzaken van en oplossingen voor deze gevoelens van angst, onzekerheid en stress, ben ik 25 april jl. in gesprek gegaan met jongeren, ouders, hulpverleners en bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Studenten vertraagd door long covid: ‘Ik moest mijn spaargeld opeten voordat ik in de bijstand mocht’'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about students delayed by long covid who must spend savings before receiving welfare, and whether more research and support is needed. The minister acknowledged the problem but said privacy rules prevent counting affected students, pointed to existing hardship funds and non-financial support, and saw no reason for extra measures specifically for long covid students.
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), illness is a special category of personal data.
Ziekte is onder de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) een bijzonder persoonsgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Woude en Peters over het recht op studiebeurzen voor EU-studenten in Nederland na herinvoering van de basisbeurs

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the entitlement of EU/EEA students to Dutch student finance after the reinstated basic grant, including worked examples, cumulation with foreign aid, verification of parental income, and European cooperation. The minister answered that a full legal analysis on portable student finance will follow before summer, that cumulation with foreign student finance is not allowed but enforcement is hard without international agreements, and that the questions and related motions are being worked on.
I will include this part in a letter that your House will receive before the summer.
Dit deel zal ik opnemen in een brief die uw Kamer voor de zomer ontvangt.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over 'Wokegedram van het LAKS'

An MP asks the minister to end subsidy to the national pupils' union LAKS over its inclusive language guide and to redirect the funds to teacher shortages. The minister answers that schools may choose whether to use the guide, that inclusivity matters, and that there is no reason to end the subsidy relationship.
We therefore see no reason to end the subsidy relationship with the LAKS.
We zien dan ook geen reden om de subsidierelatie met het LAKS te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het steeds internationaler worden van kunstacademies

The MP asks whether the recruitment stop for international students and the 2011 art-education volume agreements apply to art academies, and whether Dutch students are disadvantaged by competition with international applicants. The minister confirms the recruitment stop covers art programmes, says the volume agreements do not distinguish by student origin, and acknowledges accessibility concerns while pointing to pre-education and cultural education measures.
Art programmes do not fall within this category and therefore this recruitment stop for international students also applies to this type of programme.
Kunstopleidingen vallen niet binnen deze categorie en daarom is deze wervingstop voor internationale studenten ook voor dit type opleidingen van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over de puntennorm voor het bindend studieadvies

An MP asks the Minister of Education about capping the binding study advice (BSA) norm at 30 credits in year one, raising concerns about student stress, lowered standards, and vocational training. The Minister replies that the change only limits when students can be dismissed, keeps curriculum and degree requirements unchanged, and aims to reduce performance pressure through better support.
This only concerns an adjustment of the situation in which a student may be removed, not an adjustment of the curriculum or the difficulty of the programme.
Dit betreft slechts een aanpassing van de situatie waarin een student verwijderd mag worden en geen aanpassing van het curriculum of de zwaarte van de opleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het rapport 'State of play of academic freedom in the EU Member. States Overview of de facto trends and developments'

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will respond to a European Parliament report on academic freedom in the EU, including hierarchical university governance, political steering via funding, temporary contracts, online threats, cancel culture, social safety and critique without fear of retaliation. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that further research (KNAW, DJA, an ongoing study on self-censorship) is underway, that existing funding conditions and accreditation protect independence, and that temporary-contract abuse will be addressed via labour law and more structural funding, with results expected in autumn.

I would like to await the results of the ongoing research into self-censorship, academic freedom and the limitation of diversity of perspectives in research and higher education before deciding on the need to sharpen the concept of academic freedom.
Ik wacht graag de resultaten af van het lopende onderzoek naar zelfcensuur, academische vrijheid en beperking van diversiteit van perspectieven in het onderzoek en hoger onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het openbaar jaarverslag van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD)

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government responds to MIVD annual report signals about Chinese military-civil fusion, CSC scholarship PhD students, and knowledge security, and whether screening legislation and MIVD cooperation will be accelerated. The minister answers that the signals are shared with knowledge institutions, a CSC inventory study is ongoing without MIVD involvement, the screening bill timeline will be pursued with some acceleration while remaining careful, and existing knowledge security measures continue.
I will regularly inform the House about the progress of the legislative process.
Ik zal de Kamer regelmatig informeren over de voortgang van het wetstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de kritiek op 'the Dutch approach' groeit

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and education ministers about criticism of the Dutch approach to transgender youth care, including the role of Finnish, Swedish and UK bodies, the role of ZIN, ongoing research funded via NWO and ZonMw, and openness about research proposals. Minister Kuipers answered that government does not interfere in medical content of care, that the research proposal is withheld as an NWO matter under the Woo, and that ongoing studies are being commissioned, while declining to give a view on whether to be restrained in treatment pending research.
NWO is an independent administrative body that holds the information about the research proposals.
NWO is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat beschikt over de informatie betreffende de onderzoeksvoorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Opinie: "We moeten meer tandartsen opleiden, maar hoe dan?"'

MPs Van den Hil and Van der Woude asked the ministers of Education and of Health about the shortage of dentists, regional disparities, the status of motions on shortening training and task-shifting, and whether ministries will make firm agreements on training. The ministers replied that a joint policy response to the Capacity Council advice will be sent to Parliament this spring, and that the task-shifting experiment evaluation is expected at end 2023, but they did not give concrete numbers or commitments on specific training expansions.
This spring a joint policy response by VWS and OCW to the Capacity Council advice will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Dit voorjaar zal een gezamenlijke beleidsreactie van VWS en OCW op het advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan aan de Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over de werkwijze van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO)

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee ask whether DUO misuses the Passport Act to list former students abroad and whether a former student must repay study finance despite timely graduation. The minister denies misuse, explains the conditions for passport signalling, says the hardship clause is theoretically available, and promises a review of statutory deadlines.
I intend to conduct a study into the various deadlines in the law and whether they still fit how we now view our citizens and their capacity to act.
Ik ben voornemens om een onderzoek te doen naar de verschillende termijnen in de wet en of die nog passen bij hoe we nu naar onze burgers kijken en hun doenvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht hoe een nieuwe onderwijsmethode onrust naar Fontys bracht

An MP (PVV) asked the Minister of Education about the HILL teaching method at Fontys, including its alleged failure, staff conflict, the role of Prof. Dochy on accreditation panels, and whether the Inspectorate and government should act. The Minister answered that accreditation and quality assurance are adequate, acknowledged the Dochy panel membership should have been scrutinised more critically, and declined to launch a separate investigation.
The NVAO independence requirements for panel members state that panel members must have had no direct or indirect ties with the institution or programme they assess for at least five years.

In de onafhankelijkheidseisen van de NVAO die gelden voor panelleden is opgenomen dat panelleden ten minste vijf jaar geen directe of indirecte banden hebben gehad met de instelling of opleiding die zij beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over het bericht 'MBO-scholen helemaal klaar met stakingen in streekvervoer: 'Sommige klassen zitten maar halfvol'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how MBO students were affected by regional transport strikes, what steps schools and the government would take, and whether the social partners should be urged to resume talks. The minister acknowledged the impact, noted that a collective agreement was reached on 7 April ending the strikes, and said further measures are no longer needed.
I therefore cannot state in general terms what the impact of regional transport strikes on education is.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven wat de invloed is van stakingen in het streekvervoer op het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over loyaliteitsverklaringen bij Chinese promovendi

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Chinese PhD candidates, including those funded by the China Scholarship Council, sign loyalty pledges, and what the government will do about it. The minister says the government cannot change what another state requires of its citizens, points to knowledge-security measures, an ongoing study of CSC students in the Netherlands, and a screening framework bill, but has no details of the contracts and does not commit to new action beyond the study.
It is very difficult to determine exactly what is included in all contracts, because a different contract is concluded with each institution and researcher.
Het is erg lastig te achterhalen wat er precies in alle contracten is opgenomen, omdat er met elke instelling en onderzoeker een ander contract wordt afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over loyaliteitsverklaringen bij Chinese promovendi

Dutch MP Van der Woude asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether he knows of reports that Chinese PhD students funded by the China Scholarship Council must report to their embassy, and whether this occurs in the Netherlands, and asked for research into how many CSC PhD students are in the Netherlands. The Minister replies that similar reports have reached him, that it is hard to establish the contract terms and degree of Chinese influence, and that a study by the China knowledge network of the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and OCW has started, with findings to be shared before year end.
It is very difficult to establish what is in each contract, because CSC concludes different contracts with all knowledge institutions in the Netherlands, but also in Europe.
Het is erg lastig te achterhalen wat er in elk contract staat, omdat CSC met alle kennisinstellingen in Nederland, maar ook in Europa, andere contracten afsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de invloed van het bedrijfsleven op het onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how the government will limit business influence on academic research and teaching, ensure independence where companies fund chairs, and address gaps in universities' information on external funding. The minister answered that academic independence is the universities' own responsibility under supervision of supervisory boards, pointed to a UNL overview of external funding and a national register of ancillary activities due by end 2023, and said the broader funding review will not be adapted.
I consider it important that universities have current, complete and publicly accessible information on external funding of chairs.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat universiteiten informatie over externe financiering van leerstoelen actueel, volledig en publiek toegankelijk hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over de artikelen ‘Voor het eerst in kaart gebracht: wie betalen onze hoogleraren?’ en 'Geen excuses meer, het zicht op financiers in hoger onderwijs moet er komen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press articles on external funding of professorships and the transparency of university financiers, including knowledge security. The minister answered that universities should publish complete, current information on external funding, that UNL is compiling an overview, and that he will discuss transparency with rectors, while an independent evaluation of the integrity code is expected in Q4 2023.
I consider it important that universities have current, complete and publicly accessible information on external funding of professorships.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat universiteiten informatie over externe financiering van leerstoelen actueel, volledig en publiek toegankelijk hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het door universiteiten verbreken van banden met verschillende bedrijven

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about universities cutting ties with companies such as Shell, including whether mandatory sustainability education and academic freedom are affected. The Minister answers that universities are autonomous and decide their own curricula and partnerships, that the government will not steer them, and that research on academic freedom and diversity of perspectives will be shared in October.
It is for universities themselves to set their curriculum and to judge the relevance of particular material for the various programmes.
Het is aan universiteiten zelf om hun curriculum op te stellen en de relevantie van bepaalde materie voor de verschillende opleidingen in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kröger over het bericht ‘Studenten eisen dat UvA banden verbreekt met Shell, bezetten universiteitsgebouw’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether fossil-industry research funding (Shell at UvA) is compatible with research integrity codes, what frameworks govern public-private partnerships, and whether universities should cut ties with Shell. The minister answered that universities are autonomous under academic freedom, cited the NGWI code under evaluation and existing independence frameworks, and declined to set content-based restrictions on partnerships.
On the basis of these freedoms, it is not possible to steer substantively the public-private partnerships universities enter into, and no frameworks can be set that infringe on academic freedom.

Op basis van deze vrijheden kan niet inhoudelijk gestuurd worden op de publiek-private samenwerkingen die universiteiten aangaan en kunnen geen kaders gesteld worden die inbreuk maken op de academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Terwijl bedrijf uit Kampen stopt, wachten talloze studenten nog op schoolboeken én geld: 'Heel zuur’'

An MP asks the Education Minister about reports that the Kampen textbook distributor TLN is closing, leaving students without books or refunds, and about the risks of dependence on a single distributor, commercial intermediaries, unused materials and bundled sales. The minister answers that orders are being refunded or delivered, that digital licences remain accessible, that alternative supply routes exist, and that he will discuss the distributor dependency and the unused-materials problem with schools and student councils, promising a letter before summer.
I will keep a close eye on developments in the coming period to see whether students get into financial trouble in the short term and whether they actually get their money back.
Ik zal vinger aan de pols houden de komende periode om te bezien of er door deze situatie studenten op korte termijn in de (financiële) problemen komen en of ze daadwerkelijk het geld terug krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Miljoenentekort voor magneten- en laserlab HFML-FELIX, personeel kampt met hoge werkdruk

An MP asked the minister about a multi-million euro funding shortfall for the HFML-FELIX magnet and laser lab, which is currently financed from the Radboud University science faculty pending a structural NWO solution, and about workload pressure on staff. The minister answered that NWO and Radboud are discussing continued funding, that he will inform parliament this year, that funding stability is primarily for the institutions, and that the future institute status is for NWO to decide.
Currently NWO and Radboud University are discussing the possibilities to continue the cooperation and funding. I will inform your House this year about the solution.
Momenteel bespreken NWO en de Radboud Universiteit de mogelijkheden om de samenwerking en financiering voort te zetten. Ik zal uw Kamer dit jaar informeren over de oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het artikel van Times Higher Education “CV-blind’ grant review divides Dutch scientists.’

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Times Higher Education article criticising NWO's two-phase, CV-blind grant review and the evidence-based CV. Minister Dijkgraaf defended the changes as reducing workload, said NWO will evaluate and adjust them, and disputed claims about recruiting reviewers and the quality risks.
NWO will test this new way of assessing and also evaluate it and adjust it where necessary.
NWO toetst deze nieuwe manier van beoordelen en zal deze ook evalueren en waar nodig bijsturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Beertema over het artikel ‘Hoe wokecultuur docent het zwijgen oplegt’

MPs Bisschop and Beertema asked whether student complaints about exposure to opposing views, and a programme director distancing himself from a lecturer's views on non-binary identity, undermine academic freedom and the university's duties. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that social safety does not mean shielding students from disagreeable views, that free speech and academic freedom are not unlimited, and that he cannot judge the specific Amsterdam case, which is under independent review.
I can only answer your question in general terms and not specifically with regard to the reporting about the University of Amsterdam
Ik kan uw vraag alleen in algemene zin beantwoorden en niet specifiek met betrekking tot de berichtgeving over de Universiteit van Amsterdam
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld bij deeltijdstudies in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked whether institutions may charge two times the institutional tuition for two-year part-time programmes, including teacher training, and how a motion on institutional tuition is being implemented. The minister answered that institutions set institutional tuition, that it should not exceed the cost-covering rate, that a subsidy exists for second teacher training, and that the bill is still under consideration.
I am of the view that the institutional tuition fee for a Dutch student taking a second study should not be higher than the cost-covering rate.
Ik ben van mening dat de hoogte van het instellingscollegegeld voor een Nederlandse student die een tweede studie volgt niet hoger zou moeten zijn dan het kostendekkende tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Van der Woude, El Yassini en Rajkowski over kunstmatige intelligentie in het onderwijs

MPs from the VVD asked the education and economic affairs ministers about the risks and opportunities of AI such as ChatGPT in schools, teacher preparedness, research, and cooperation with the Dutch AI Coalition. The ministers answered that they support schools through Kennisnet, SURF, the national education lab NOLAI and funding, but offered no measures to check or constrain executive power.
It is important that school boards and teachers are sufficiently aware of the risks of AI for education, in addition to its opportunities.
Het is belangrijk dat schoolbesturen en leraren naast de kansen ook voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de risico's van AI voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over tekstgenerator ChatGPT

An MP asked the education ministers whether ChatGPT use by pupils undermines writing skills, whether its risks should be investigated and banned from classrooms, and whether lessons on media literacy could help. The ministers answered that schools and teachers decide how to deal with AI, pointed to existing research (NOLAI, Onderwijsraad) and to teaching approaches such as assessing the writing process, without committing to a ban or new investigation.
It is up to schools and teachers to provide good education and organise it according to their own judgement.
Het is aan scholen en leraren om goed onderwijs aan te bieden en naar eigen inzicht in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het kinderboekenweekgedicht door Pim Lammers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the government should intervene over the choice of Pim Lammers to write the Children's Book Week poem, given controversy over his work and claims about sexualising children. The State Secretary replied that the CPNB, an independent sector body, makes this choice, that freedom of expression applies, that the government will not intervene, and that the government does not consider itself responsible for the selection.
It is up to the CPNB to weigh whether or not to heed such calls.
Het is aan de CPNB de afweging wel of niet gehoor te geven aan dergelijke oproepen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt c.s. die oproept tot het ontwikkelen van heldere normen voor de artikelen 1.3, lid 5 en 7.2 WHW en te bevorderen dat de Inspectie van het Onderwijs deze normen

An MP asks the Minister of Education why the motion requiring clear norms for Dutch as the default language in higher education (WHW articles 1.3(5) and 7.2) and their enforcement by the Inspectorate has not yet been implemented, and questions the reading of the exceptions in article 7.2. The Minister acknowledges the 1992 legislative intent and the Inspectorate's findings that the provisions are hard to enforce, promises a policy letter addressing the motion, and provides student mobility figures.
I agree. The current law requires institutions to justify in a code of conduct when the necessity criterion applies.
Ik ben het hiermee eens. De huidige wet vereist dat instellingen in een gedragscode moeten onderbouwen wanneer er sprake is van het noodzaakcriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over het bericht ‘Financieel niet rond kunnen komen tijdens opleiding in de zorg’

MPs Agema and Beertema asked whether medical students cannot afford their clinical rotations and whether the stipend of 100 euro per month is adequate. The minister replied that students can access student finance including loans during rotations, that no data exists on dropouts for financial reasons, and that the basic grant is being reintroduced.
No figures are available on the number of medical students who stop their clinical rotations each year for financial reasons.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal Geneeskundestudenten dat jaarlijks stopt met coschappen om financiële redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de Universiteit Leiden ‘slimme’ camera’s toch weer wil aanzetten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Leiden's plan to re-activate smart sensor cameras that count people, raising privacy and safety concerns, with questions on purpose, data, costs, suppliers, other institutions, the DPIA and a shared guideline. The minister answered that the university has since decided not to use the cameras, that only anonymised person counts would be produced, that the DPIA is already public, and that no extra guideline is needed since the GDPR applies.
Universities and universities of applied sciences are not obliged to report the use or intended use of 'smart' cameras.
Universiteiten en hogescholen zijn niet verplicht tot het melden van het gebruik of het voornemen van gebruik van «slimme» camera’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en De Hoop over 'En toen was er geen hoogleraar Friese taal en cultuur meer, tegen de afspraken in'

MPs Peters and De Hoop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Groningen university's failed appointment of a Frisian language and culture professor and about legislation to anchor Frisian academic education. The minister said the hiring is the university's own matter, that a legislative proposal is being explored with a letter due in spring 2024, and that the Frisian programme continues within a broader minors programme.

I am currently exploring the possibilities to implement the motion requesting legal anchoring of Frisian academic education and will inform your House further this autumn on the implementation of the motion.

Ik verken momenteel de mogelijkheden om de motie die vraagt om wettelijke verankering van wetenschappelijk onderwijs in het Fries uit te voeren en zal uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het stopzetten van Erasmusbeurzen voor Hongaarse studenten

The MP asks whether it is fair that Hungarian students lose Erasmus grants because of EU measures against Hungary's rule-of-law problems, and whether Erasmus should stay free of political sanctions. The minister replies that the Dutch government supports the Council measures under the MFK rule-of-law regulation, that the measure targets Hungary's budget and not students, and that Hungary should continue paying the grants until the measure is lifted.
The cabinet supports the Commission's decision of 15 December 2022 to impose measures on Hungary via the MFK rule-of-law regulation.
Antwoord 3, 4 en 5 Het kabinet staat achter het besluit van de Commissie op 15 december 2022 om maatregelen op te leggen aan Hongarije via de MFK-rechtsstaatsveror dening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Belhaj over het bericht 'Medewerker diversiteit hoger onderwijs geïntimideerd en bedreigd

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Education and of Justice about reports that diversity officers in higher education were intimidated and threatened online, and what the government would do to strengthen their position. The minister condemned the doxing and threats, pointed to a pending bill criminalising doxing and a forthcoming approach to online discrimination, but gave only general answers on strengthening diversity officers' position, deferring responsibility for staff safety to institutional boards.
The cabinet will develop an approach in 2023 to intensify cabinet policy against online discrimination, racism and hate speech.
Het kabinet zal in 2023 een aanpak ontwikkelen voor een intensivering van het kabinetsbeleid voor het tegengaan van online discriminatie, racisme en hate speech.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Verenigde Naties bereikt nieuw dieptepunt in campagne tegen Israël’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why three Dutch publicly funded higher education institutions appeared as signatories to a pro-Palestinian statement on the ECCP website, and whether this compromised institutional neutrality and student safety. The minister replied that the institutions say they did not sign or know of the statement, that no board decision lay behind it, and that no political position was taken, so no roundtable with sector bodies is planned.
The signing was not based on any decisions by the institutions' boards, so no position was taken by the institutions.
Aan de ondertekening liggen geen besluiten van de instellingsbesturen ten grondslag, er is dus ook geen positie gekozen door de instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht ‘UvA neemt afstand van uitspraak docent over ‘het verschijnsel non-binair’'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the University of Amsterdam was right to distance itself from lecturer Laurens Buijs's criticism of 'woke' culture and non-binary identity, and whether the board's handling of his complaint is acceptable. The Minister answers that every employee may criticise the organisation, defends the programme director's letter as clarifying policy, says academic freedom and student safety must be balanced by the university boards, and states confidence in the board, which has set up an independent commission to examine the complaint.
The executive board has in the meantime set up an independent committee to investigate the report.
Het college van bestuur heeft inmiddels een onafhankelijke commissie ingesteld om de melding te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over de bedreiging van de academische vrijheid aan Nederlandse universiteiten

Member Dekker asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether academic freedom at Dutch universities is threatened, citing lecturer Laurens Buijs, who reports social exclusion and job loss after criticising COVID policy and diversity policy at the UvA. The Minister says such exclusion is unacceptable in principle, leaves the individual case to the UvA and its independent investigation, and denies that academic freedom is not safeguarded.
The executive board has since set up an independent committee to investigate the report.
Het college van bestuur heeft inmiddels een onafhankelijke commissie ingesteld om de melding te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Paniek en slaapgebrek door tijdelijke contracten in wetenschap’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports of precarious temporary contracts in academia, including repeated short contracts, job-grading practices and braindrain. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to structural investments and sector plan conditions favouring permanent contracts, but said legal bans on successive contracts are not within his remit and that universities are autonomous employers.
I have not mapped whether, and if so which, institutions apply the practice mentioned in the question, and from my system responsibility I have no role in mapping it.
Ik heb niet in kaart of en, zo ja, welke instellingen de in de vraag genoemde werkwijze hanteren en heb vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid ook geen rol bij het in kaart brengen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het onderzoeksrapport van Casual Academy over precaire werkomstandigheden in het hoger onderwijs

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she would respond to a Casual Academy report on precarious, temporary contracts in Dutch higher education, including their effects on wellbeing, education quality, and whether universities deliberately deny staff permanent contracts. The Minister acknowledged the negative effects of temporary contracts, pointed to employer responsibility, planned monitoring, sector plan funding and CAO agreements, but declined to add structural new research or direct measures beyond these.
I do not recognise this, but if it happens, I consider that undesirable.
Ik herken dit niet, maar als het gebeurt, acht ik dat onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over studenten met Long COVID

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Ministers of Health and of Education about students with Long COVID, including their numbers, dropout, unequal support across institutions, access to and funding of the profileringsfonds and mbo student fund, and reintegration and benefit entitlements. The minister replied that institutions cannot record students' illnesses under the GDPR, that much information is unavailable or pending RIVM research, and that existing rules and institutional support apply, with no new concrete measures announced.
Institutions may not, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), inquire about a student's medical condition.
Instellingen mogen i.v.m. de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) niet informeren naar het ziektebeeld van een student.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het feit dat de basisbeurs niet voor alle studenten gaat gelden

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether students who study longer than four years will lose the basic grant, and questions the fairness of loans, the lack of warnings, and the restrictions on second studies for this 'unlucky generation'. The Minister answers that around 270,000 students will lose entitlement, that the loans carry zero interest under existing law, that a one-off compensation scheme for loan-era students has been included, and that second studies were abolished in 2010 for policy reasons.
The bill reintroducing the basic grant in higher education includes a compensation scheme for students who studied under the loan system.
In het wetsvoorstel herinvoering basisbeurs hoger onderwijs is een tegemoetkoming opgenomen voor studenten die onder het leenstelsel hebben gestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Mbo wil financiële steun van kabinet en gemeenten voor student in armoede'

MPs Bouchallikh and De Hoop asked the Minister of Education about reports that vocational (mbo) students face rising poverty, the adequacy of the mbo student fund, budget coaches, free meals, school costs, the energy allowance, dropout and student housing. The minister answered that the government shares the concern, points to income measures and the student fund's adequacy, and promises further studies, consultations and information to the House, but largely refers to existing policies without new commitments on several points.
Early 2023 the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions will commission research among a representative group of municipalities into the use and implementation of the energy allowance.

Begin 2023 zal de Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen een onderzoek uit laten voeren onder een representatieve groep gemeenten naar het gebruik en de uitvoering van energietoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Westerveld over het STAP-budget

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about training-subsidy (STAP) budget being captured by course providers through price rises and marketing, and whether the budget should target labour shortages in energy, education and care. The government acknowledges misuse signals, promises price checks, a cap on subsidies per course, a gift/affiliate marketing review, and a study of prioritising shortage sectors, while declining to commit to specific price agreements or a fixed budget split.
Your House will be informed early next year about the outcome and the further approach to this.
Uw Kamer wordt begin volgend jaar geïnformeerd over uitkomst en de verdere aanpak hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht ‘Kritiek op (on)toegankelijkheid Langeveldgebouw voor mensen met functiebeperking’

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about reports that the Erasmus University Langeveld building is inaccessible for people with various disabilities, and about the diversity of accessibility standards. The minister acknowledged the problem, noted the university chose the stricter NEN-ISO 21542 standard, said formal inspection is due early next year, and described a forthcoming national NEN accessibility norm expected end 2023.
I have given NEN the assignment to do so.
Ik heb daartoe opdracht gegeven aan NEN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel van AD VALVAS ‘Chinese promovendi in Nederland moeten trouw beloven aan de communistische partij.’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a student newspaper report that Chinese PhD candidates in the Netherlands must pledge loyalty to the Chinese Communist Party, and whether this shows they are not free to act independently, asking also about screening and whether other universities follow Erasmus. The minister answered that party membership is not a stated requirement for the CSC scholarship but return to China after the PhD is, that knowledge-security measures are landen-neutral, that universities are doing risk assessments, and that a broader knowledge-security letter would follow.
As far as I am aware, membership of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) is not a requirement to receive this state scholarship.
Voor zover mij bekend is partijlidmaatschap van de Chinese Communistische Partij (CCP) geen vereiste om deze staatsbeurs te kunnen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Peters over de onderwijsbevoegdheid voor de lerarenopleidingen ITEPS en ITESS

MPs Van der Molen and Peters asked whether graduates of the ITEPS and ITESS teacher programmes, which overlap with pabo and teacher training but do not confer a Dutch teaching qualification, can be deployed in classrooms and quickly obtain a qualification given the teacher shortage. The ministers answered that the programmes are separate, were approved on labour-market grounds, that graduates can enter schools under conditions while completing top-up training, and that they will hold a conversation with the institution.
In the conversation we announce in answer to question 5, we will also pay attention to differences between the various programmes.
In het gesprek, dat wij in antwoord op vraag 5 aankondigen, zullen wij ook aandacht hebben voor verschillen tussen de verschillende opleidingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemend drugsgebruik onder studenten

An MP asked the state secretaries of health and education about rising drug use among students, the effects of COVID measures on student wellbeing, and planned action. The government answered that it is running prevention programmes and a mental health approach, but declined to give cost-benefit or risk analyses, citing unclear trends and data limits.
For this reason, among others, I cannot provide a risk analysis of the consequences of health problems from drug use for society and the labour market as a whole.
Mede om deze reden kan ik geen risicoanalyse geven voor de gevolgen van gezondheidsproblemen door drugsgebruik op de maatschappij en de arbeidsmarkt als geheel.
Antwoord op van de leden Van der Molen en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Neerlandici lopen weg bij vergadering Taalunie'

MPs Van der Molen and Van der Woude asked the minister about reports that Dutch-language scholars walked out of a Taalunie meeting and why the international Dutch studies funding impulse track has taken so long. The minister confirmed the 2022 spending and promised concrete activities for 2023-2024, a structural 1 million euro investment, and continued engagement with the field.
Following the amendment by MP Van der Molen during the 2023 budget debate, structurally 1 million euros will be invested to secure the future of international Dutch studies.

Naar aanleiding van het amendement van het lid Van der Molen bij de begrotingsbehandeling 2023 zal structureel 1 miljoen euro geïnvesteerd worden om de toekomst van de internationale Neerlandistiek veilig te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel 'Schilderij met 'sigaarrokende oude mannen' na kritiek weg uit Universiteit Leiden: 'Heel dom''

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether removing a painting from Leiden University without debate, over diversity concerns, is discriminatory and whether the ministry's anti-racism agenda encourages such activism. The Minister replies that the university made no official decision, the painting has been rehung, the university will convene a diverse committee on its display, and that public debate on the matter is taking place.
First of all, an educational institution itself decides on the layout of its building and the art it displays.
Allereerst gaat een onderwijsinstelling zelf over de inrichting van haar gebouw en over de kunst die zij toont.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Van Strien over de artikelen 'ESA-baas: Nederland moet meer investeren in Europeseruimtevaart' en 'Experts: niet landen zelf, maar satellieten gaan straks CO2-uitstoot met

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about news reports urging more Dutch investment in European space programmes and satellite CO2 monitoring, including sovereignty and broadening Dutch access to greenhouse gas data. The minister answered that the Netherlands invested EUR 389 million via ESA at CM22 (37% more than 2019), with EUR 61 million for Earth observation, and that broader ESA investment and a budgetary review will be considered in 2023.
Therefore, under the amended Van Strien motion 7 et al., a budgetary exploration will be included in the development of the Long-Term Space Agenda in 2023.
Daarom zal in het kader van de gewijzigde motie Van Strien 7 c.s. een budgettaire verkenning worden meegenomen bij de uitwerking van de Lange Termijn Ruimtevaartagenda in 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over voortgezet onderwijs voor kinderen, die in de residentiele jeugdzorg en GGZ geen onderwijs of geen passend onderwijs hebben kunnen volgen

An MP asked the ministers of Education and of Primary and Secondary Education about routes to higher education for youths in youth care who missed schooling, including lowering the age for the colloquium doctum, dropping the binding study advice, reinstating the propedeuse diploma, extending vavo funding, and applying the thumb rule to state exam candidates. The ministers declined most proposals, citing uniform diploma rules and existing support, while promising to explore case-specific deviations on the colloquium doctum and to inform parliament in spring 2023.

We will check with relevant parties such as secondary schools, universities of applied sciences and universities whether in specific cases a deviation from the age limit for the colloquium doctum can be made.

We zullen daarom met betrokken partijen zoals vo-scholen, hogescholen en universiteiten nagaan of er in specifieke gevallen afgeweken kan worden van de gehanteerde leeftijdsgrens voor het colloquium doctum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over Iraanse studenten in Nederland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked how many Iranian students and academics are in the Netherlands, how institutions support them amid protests in Iran, and what consequences the protests have for cooperation with Iranian institutions. The minister gave counts (424 Iranian first-nationality HBO and 475 WO students), described existing support services and cooperation, and provided no commitments to new action.
For staff data, educational institutions are bound by privacy legislation. Nationality is a special category of personal data that may not simply be disclosed.
Voor de personeelsgegevens geldt dat onderwijsinstellingen gehouden zijn aan de privacywetgeving. Nationaliteit is een bijzonder persoonsgegeven dat niet zondermeer mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Onderzoek naar financiële transacties van/naar Stichting Open Nederland

An MP asked ministers whether they knew of a private investigation report into financial transactions of Stichting Open Nederland and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether the report was forwarded to ministries and press. The government answered that the report was unreliable, that VWS commissioned its own check finding no evidence of the transactions, that the report cannot be published pending possible legal proceedings, and that it was not informed of the investigation when it took place.
Pending possible legal proceedings and measures, the research report commissioned by VWS cannot currently be made public.
In afwachting van mogelijke juridische procedures en maatregelen kan het in opdracht van VWS opgeleverde onderzoeksrapport nu niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het rapport 'Opvattingen over seksuele en genderdiversiteit in Nederland en Europa 2022'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the SCP's decision to end its LHBT monitor and how monitoring on LGBTI people will be continued, including questions on scope, independence and consultation with LGBTI organisations. The Minister answered that periodic monitoring will continue every two years, that a new research body is being explored for the LHBT monitor, and that the scope will be broadened, without yet naming the new institution.
As stated in the Emancipation Note 2022–2025, both monitors will continue to be published every two years in this cabinet period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Emancipatienota 2022–2025, blijven deze beide monitors ook in deze kabinetsperiode elke twee jaar verschijnen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Studentgegevens ondanks kritiek massaal in de Amerikaanse cloud gezet’

An MP asks the Minister of Education about a report that student data was massively moved to American cloud services despite warnings, and about risks of dependence on big tech and espionage. The minister answers that institutions are responsible for their own cloud choices under the GDPR, points to DPIAs, the Leidraad Kennisveiligheid, export rules and EU measures such as the DMA, but gives no own data on university cloud use.
I do not have my own data on cloud use by universities.
Eigen gegevens over het cloudgebruik door universiteiten heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat studentgegevens ondanks kritiek massaal in de cloud zijn gezet

An MP from the SP asks the Minister of Education whether storing student data with US tech companies' cloud datacenters, despite criticism, is acceptable given privacy and US access risks, and asks for alternatives and overviews of payments. The Minister answers that institutions are autonomous and responsible for risk assessments, that SURF supports Data Protection Impact Assessments, Privacy Shield has been invalidated and a new EU-US framework is being implemented, and that ending external storage is not a starting point, while no overview of payments or concrete alternatives is provided.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ephraim over de inbreuk op de privacy van Nederlandse studenten door Amerikaanse techbedrijven

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about privacy risks from US tech companies holding Dutch student data, and whether online teaching should be limited and universities should build their own platforms. The minister answers that outsourcing is compatible with university autonomy, points to DPIAs, SURF support, open-source exploration and a privacy audit framework, but rejects building in-house platforms and does not answer the questions in time.
The independence and integrity of universities are not (by definition) at stake through the use of cloud services.
De onafhankelijkheid en integriteit van universiteiten is niet (per definitie) in het geding door het gebruik van clouddiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Van der Molen, Knops en Inge van Dijk over studeren op kosten van een brievenbusfirma

MPs asked whether Dutch universities should be subject to anti-money-laundering checks on tuition payments from foreign students, including screening for PEPs and cash payments. The government replied that universities are not obliged institutions under the Wwft, that the National Risk Assessment shows no indication of laundering risk in university services, and that cash tuition payments may be justified in some cases, with the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen receiving about 300,000 euro in cash in 2022.
It is therefore not desirable to make the obligations under the Wwft apply to universities.
Het is daarom niet wenselijk de verplichtingen uit de Wwft voor universiteiten te laten gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Inge van Dijk over universiteitsfondsen nemen meer beleggingsrisico

MPs Van der Molen and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about university funds taking on more investment risk, including staff paid by universities working for the funds, and the transparency of donations. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that public funds must not pay for fund activities, that the minister's role is to clarify the rules via a policy rule, and that the funds are not covered by the higher education act, so transparency cannot be tightened through it.
I think that in these cases state-funded universities should, when asked, have to demonstrate that no public funds are used for staff costs for university funds.
Ik vind dat in deze gevallen rijksbekostigde universiteiten desgevraagd dienen aan te tonen dat er geen publieke middelen worden aangewend voor personeels-kosten ten behoeve van universiteitsfondsen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Collegegeld hoeft misschien maar 67 euro te stijgen’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether a news report suggesting the tuition fee rise for 2023/2024 could be only 67 euro, instead of 105 euro, was accurate, and whether the fee would be reduced if so. The Minister said the 2023/2024 statutory tuition fee of 2,314 euro was already fixed in October 2022 using the CPI average method, that a possible CBS change in energy price calculation would not affect this year's fee, and that it could at earliest apply to 2024/2025.
The level of the statutory tuition fee for academic year 2023/2024 was set at 2,314 euro in October 2022.
De hoogte van het wettelijk collegegeld voor studiejaar 2023/2024 is in oktober 2022 vastgesteld op € 2.314.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Collegegeld hoeft misschien maar 67 euro te stijgen'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education why the tuition fee calculation was changed so that the 2023 increase is 105 euros instead of 212 euros, and whether the fee could be kept lower pending a revised CBS inflation method. The minister answered that the indexation method was amended by decree, that the fee was fixed before 1 November 2022, and that the CBS's new energy-price method would not affect the 2023/2024 fee, so no change was committed.
Through the amending decree published in the Staatsblad on 4 October 2022, I changed the method of indexing the statutory tuition fee.
Via het op 4 oktober 2022 in het Staatsblad gepubliceerde wijzigingsbesluit 2 heb ik de wijze van indexatie van het wettelijk collegegeld aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het nieuwsbericht dat duizenden basisschoolleerlingen in Overijssel insecten in een lespakket over duurzame en gezonde voeding, aangeboden kregen

An MP asked the Education Minister about a school insect-based lesson package given to thousands of Overijssel pupils, questioning its origin, parental and school say, health risks and whether it amounts to pressure on children. The minister answered that the package came from Wageningen University & Research without government involvement, that schools are responsible for their teaching materials, and that the inspectorate can act if laws are breached.

The school is responsible for the educational offering; when pupils or parents have ideas or complaints about it, this can be raised in the participation council or the school's formal complaints procedure.

De school is verantwoordelijk voor het onderwijsaanbod, wanneer leerlingen of ouders daar ideeën bij of klachten over hebben, kan dit ter sprake komen in de medezeggenschap of in de formele klachtenprocedure van de school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over ongedocumenteerde studenten die eigenlijk niks kunnen met hun diploma als ze hun opleiding hebben afgerond

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked whether undocumented youths who finish vocational training cannot use their diplomas, whether they were overlooked in labour-shortage measures, and how the government views their exclusion from work, including the German 'Duldung' approach. The State Secretary answered that undocumented migrants are not part of the labour-shortage plan, that admitting them to the labour market is undesirable for migration and welfare reasons, and that this changes no existing policy.
The answers have no consequences for the existing policy.
De antwoorden hebben geen consequenties voor het geldende beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over de vastgestelde sectorplannen

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the sector plans for science funding were prioritised, including the role of the new independent National Commission on Sector Plans, its mandate, the involvement of other ministries, and why there is no informatics sector plan. The Minister answers that UNL proposed the domain split, the independent commission advised on sector plans, the mandate and framework are attached, and an informatics element will be developed by March 2023.
I asked the Universities of the Netherlands (UNL) to provide me with a broadly supported proposal for allocating funds at domain level.
Ik heb de Universiteiten van Nederland (UNL) gevraagd mij een breed gedragen voorstel voor een verdeling van middelen op domeinniveau aan te reiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht dat bedrijven de door de mbo-school aangedragen stagiair moeten accepteren

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Education whether the plan to require companies to accept a school-nominated intern undermines their freedom to choose, and what risks and alternatives exist. The minister defended stagematching for first-year students as a way to combat stage discrimination, argued companies bear shared responsibility, and said the stagepact would set out a broader package of measures.
I am working to improve internship supervision and to strengthen contact between the training company and the school for all internships.
Ik zet mij in om de stagebegeleiding te verbeteren en ook het contact tussen leerbedrijf en de school te versterken voor alle stages.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de berichten 'Uitpuilende collegezalen en ellenlange wachtlijsten: universiteiten willen niet meer groeien' en 'UvA: minder buitenlandse studenten toelaten'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about reports on overcrowded lecture halls, waiting lists, and the UvA limiting foreign student intake, including English-language programmes, equal access for Dutch students, and possible legal tools to steer international inflow. The Minister answered that institutions set their own language policy, that a review of language and internationalisation will report in early 2023, and that a labour-market numerus fixus is a last resort to be avoided for now.
I have already asked the NVAO to prepare a report on how the language of instruction has been assessed by the NVAO in the recent period and what conclusions have been drawn.
Ik heb de NVAO reeds verzocht om een rapportage op te stellen over de wijze waarop de opleidingstaal in de afgelopen periode door de NVAO is beoordeeld en tot welke conclusies dit geleid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Rente over studielening op komst, vooral mbo'ers gaan meer betalen’

An MP asks the education minister why mbo students face a higher interest rate on study loans than hbo and university students, and whether this inequality will be removed. The minister answers that the two regimes will be aligned via the reintroduced basic grant bill, so mbo students will get the same repayment terms, and commits to working toward equal treatment of students.
The basic grant reintroduction bill proposes to adjust the repayment regime for mbo students as well and align it with the regime for ho students.

In het wetsvoorstel herinvoering basisbeurs hoger onderwijs is het voorstel opgenomen om het terugbetaalregime ook voor mbo-studenten aan te passen en dit gelijk te trekken aan het regime voor ho-studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Rente over studielening op komst, vooral mbo'ers gaan meer betalen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Education why mbo students face a different interest calculation on student loans than hbo/university students, and whether this is fair. The Minister defends the separate regimes as justified for now, says the rate follows government bond yields, rejects a fixed low rate, and points to income-based repayment and payment-free months as safeguards.

Partly because of my ambition to eliminate differences as much as possible and increase equal opportunity, I choose to keep the more social repayment conditions in higher education with the reintroduction of the basic grant and to also introduce them for mbo students.

Mede vanwege mijn ambitie om de verschillen zo veel mogelijk weg te werken en de kansengelijkheid te vergroten, kies ik ervoor om met de herinvoering van de basisbeurs de socialere terugbetaalvoorwaarden in het ho te laten bestaan en deze ook in te voeren voor mbo-studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat uitgeverijen boeken pas leveren in november en dat tienduizenden mbo’ers nog zonder boeken zitten

An MP asked the education ministers about late delivery of textbooks by publishers to vocational (mbo) and secondary school students and whether publishers should be obliged to deliver. The ministers answered that logistics problems caused delays, that schools improvised with alternative materials, that digital licences were decoupled from print delivery, and that they expect parties to find solutions while market and Wet Gratis Schoolboeken issues will be addressed in a later policy response.
We therefore expect institutions to work with students, where possible, towards appropriate solutions to prevent and limit any learning delays.
Van instellingen verwachten wij daarom dat zij waar mogelijk samen met studenten tot passende oplossingen komen, om eventuele leerachterstanden te voorkomen en te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en El Yassini over het onderzoek dat JOB MBO deed naar ongebruikte leermiddelen

MPs Kwint and El Yassini asked the Minister of Education about a JOB MBO study showing 93 percent of vocational students must buy unused textbooks, and about compliance with the mandatory buy-back scheme. The minister reports that 43 of 57 institutions have a scheme, seven are working on one, and he commits to talks with the remaining institutions and to publicising the scheme, while declining for now a single universal scheme and stating he will consider legal obligation only if institutions fail to comply.
After inquiry it has emerged that 43 of the 57 vocational education institutions have established a scheme for unused learning materials.
Na uitvraag is gebleken dat 43 van de 57 mbo-instellingen een regeling voor ongebruikte leermiddelen hebben ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht 'Tienduizenden mbo'ers nog zonder boeken: 'bang voor een leerachterstand''

An MP asked the education minister about tens of thousands of vocational students still lacking textbooks after a supplier's system failure, and whether this would cause learning delays and how to mitigate it. The minister answered that the supplier's problems were largely resolved, that schools compensated with alternative materials, and that digital licences would follow, but offered no binding guarantees beyond calling on parties to act.
It is very unfortunate that some students had to wait longer for textbooks.
Het is heel vervelend dat een deel van de studenten langer heeft moeten wachten op schoolboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het niet doorsturen van het ADR-rapport inzake de belangenverstrengeling van Shula Rijxman

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the ADR report on Shula Rijxman's conflict of interest, held by the ministry since 23 August, was only sent to the House a month later, and when it would arrive. The minister answered that intensive consultations with the Secretary-General preceded sending the report with the ministry's reaction on 27 September, and that the MP could receive the report on that date, while denying that it was outdated and referring a related e-mail to a pending Woo request.
I wanted to inform the House about the outcome of this process at the same time as presenting the report.
Over de uitkomsten van dit proces wilde ik uw Kamer tegelijk met het aanbieden van het rapport informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de aanpak van het lerarentekort

An MP from the Labour party asked the education ministers how they would tackle the teacher shortage, including whether pabo students who fail the entrance test may continue, whether school closures and four-day school weeks are stopgap measures, and how these fit the Primary Education Act. The ministers answered that the teacher shortage is a risk to quality, that a strategy and an independent advisory team (Van de Bunt) will propose cooperation, that the pabo entrance-test experiment gives students one extra year, and that four-day weeks are allowed only seven times a year and are not acceptable beyond that, with the inspectorate ordering a remedy plan.

The inspectorate, which has intensive contact with the school, has given the school board a remedy order to come up with an action plan so that children can return to five-day school weeks as soon as possible.
De inspectie, die intensief contact heeft met de school, heeft een herstelopdracht gegeven aan het bestuur om met een plan van aanpak te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Associate degree ver weg voor student buiten stedelijk gebied'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that Associate degree programmes in the north and east of the Netherlands are offered in only five places, and why, and what could be done to expand them. The Minister answered that access should not depend on residence, that location decisions lie largely with universities of applied sciences, and that expansion is possible through regional cooperation and a monitoring study to be sent to parliament.
It is important that everyone who wishes to can follow an Ad programme, regardless of where they live.
Het is belangrijk dat iedereen die dat wil een Ad-opleiding kan volgen, ongeacht de woonplek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het bericht: ‘Enquête: toestroom buitenlandse studenten zet kwaliteit onder druk’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a survey claiming that the inflow of foreign students harms higher-education quality, housing, and staff burden, and asked whether the government would curb the inflow or allow institutions to refuse foreign students. The minister acknowledges the housing and support challenges, cites a Bestuursakkoord and a forthcoming future exploration on internationalisation, but rejects the claim of an excessive burden and defers the option of letting institutions refuse students until early 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht: ‘Veel tweedejaars internationale studenten dreigen ook dakloos te worden: "Voel me verraden en misleid"’

MP Beertema asks the Minister of Education about reports that second-year international students risk becoming homeless, questioning whether universities deliberately pursued internationalisation for funding and whether they bear responsibility, and why the bill on managing international student inflow was postponed. The Minister acknowledges housing limits, says internationalisation remains valuable, points to the 2022 governing agreement, the student housing action plan and a future-oriented review, and promises to ask institutions to explore options for affected students.

In my letter to the House about internationalisation last June I informed the House that I am not proceeding further with the Language and Accessibility bill and that I am holding it in abeyance for now.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer over internationalisering afgelopen juni heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik nog niet verder ga met het wetsvoorstel Taal en Toegankelijkheid en dat ik het wetsvoorstel voorlopig aanhoud
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Studieschuld niet afbetaald? Dan geen paspoort. 'Ik begrijp niet waarom Duo dit doet''

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the ministers about DUO withholding passports from former students with unpaid study debt, including whether this is a fair pressure tool and how often hardship clauses are used. The government answered that DUO uses passport signalling only as a last resort, that the Paspoortwet legally allows it to protect state finances, and that the Staatssecretaris of BZK will evaluate the system.
DUO does not register how often a tailored solution is reached or how often the hardship clause is applied.
DUO registreert niet hoe vaak een maatwerkoplossing getroffen wordt of de hardheidsclausule wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over de bedreiging van het wokisme

JA21 MPs asked the education minister whether alarming signs of woke-culture intimidation at universities, such as students at Erasmus University fearing backlash, were being downplayed, and whether the minister would act on academic freedom. The minister found no threat to academic freedom in the cited cases, said debate should be respectful, and promised to report on talks with universities on self-censorship by year end.
I will inform your House of the outcomes before the end of this calendar year.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het einde van dit kalenderjaar op de hoogte stellen van de uitkomsten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel ´Academische tirades tegen conservatieven; Studenten Erasmus komen in het geweer: ´We willen dat de universiteit een neutrale instelling is´

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a newspaper report on Erasmus University students complaining of political bias and pressure against conservative views, and about teachers, pronouns and inspectorate findings on students' freedom to speak. The minister says the examples do not show a threat to academic freedom, that teachers may hold political views but should invite dialogue, that the inspectorate is following up, and that he is discussing the matter with universities' associations and will report to parliament by year end.
I see no threat to academic freedom, freedom of expression or the quality of education in these examples.
Ik zie in deze voorbeelden geen bedreiging van de academische vrijheid, de vrijheid van meningsuiting of de kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht dat er steeds meer tijdelijke contracten worden gegeven in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that temporary contracts in education are increasing and whether this undermines retention amid teacher shortages. The ministers answered that permanent work should be the norm, outlined measures such as tightening rules on temporary contracts and strategic HRM legislation, and provided university and hogeschool contract ratios for 2015-2021.
