The cabinet's starting point is that structural work is in principle organised on the basis of permanent employment contracts.
Het uitgangspunt van het kabinet is dat structureel werk in principe wordt georganiseerd op basis van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over de dood van Mahsa Amini en de protesten in Iran

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it condemns the death of Mahsa Amini and the repression of protests in Iran, and what it is doing on demonstrators' rights, an independent inquiry, sanctions, women's rights, the nuclear deal and travel advice. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly condemned the violence and urged Iran bilaterally and multilaterally to respect peaceful protest and conduct an impartial inquiry, and that it supports EU human rights sanctions while not pre-announcing specific measures.
In principle, however, the cabinet does not comment on concrete proposals for new sanctions, so as not to undermine the element of surprise and thus the effectiveness of such measures.

Het kabinet doet in beginsel echter geen uitlatingen over concrete voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties, om zo het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen niet te ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht dat honderden verdwijnstudenten uit het buitenland misbruik maken van studentenvisa

Opposition MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether international students using study visas who then disappear from view, and whether a quota and higher fees would help. The minister answered that such misuse is undesirable, that the IND is investigating Bangladeshi student cases, that a quota has no legal basis, and that more monitoring and sector measures will follow.
This gave the IND cause to examine this further.
Dit was voor de IND aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht 'lucratieve bijverdiensten voor fulltime topbestuurders'

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked whether top executives in the (semi-)public sector who earn above the WNT pay cap through side functions as supervisors should be restricted, and about their workload and transparency. The minister answered that the anti-cumulation rule was deliberately limited to executive posts, that no data on cumulative earnings exist, that a public side-function register would add administrative burden, and that the government will examine tightening the rule within a planned WNT amendment.
As part of the planned WNT amendment that the cabinet recently announced, I am willing to examine the pros and cons of further tightening the anti-cumulation provision.

In het kader van de wetswijziging Wnt die ik namens het kabinet onlangs heb aangekondigd, ben ik wel bereid om nader uit te laten zoeken wat de voor- en tegens zijn van het verder aanscherpen van de anticumulatiebepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de bijdrage van de stichting Femmes for Freedom aan  emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond

MP Palland asked the ministers whether the 2020 Peters motion on a lasting role for Femmes for Freedom in the theme of self-determination had been carried out, and what concrete arrangements had been made. The minister answers that the foundation is a durable partner for the government on inclusion and emancipation, lists its involvement in consultations, awareness material, a bill on marital captivity and a funded alliance, while noting other parties may also apply for subsidies.
The Foundation Femmes for Freedom is a durable discussion partner of the national government on issues of inclusion and emancipation of girls and women with a bicultural background.

De Stichting Femmes for Freedom is een duurzame gesprekspartner van de rijksoverheid waar het gaat om vraagstukken op het gebied van inclusie en emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Engelse voetballer komt uit de kast, nu nog in Nederland’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of openly gay professional male footballers in the Netherlands, low acceptance ratings in football, and the handling of homophobic remarks. The government acknowledged that homophobia does not belong in sport and pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen) but committed to no new concrete action.
Homophobia and negative expressions do not belong in sport and therefore also not in football.
Homofobie en negatieve uitingen horen niet thuis in de sport en dus ook niet in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht Opleidingsinstituten profiteren massaal van royale subsidieregeling

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Hagen (D66) asked whether training providers inflating course prices to exhaust the STAP training budget is acceptable, how providers can circumvent rules, why public institutions offer little STAP-funded training, and how supervision can be strengthened. Minister Van Gennip answered that price inflation is unacceptable, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors and sanctions providers (removal from the register, reclaiming subsidy, possible criminal investigation), that four providers received intent-to-remove notices, and that the regulation will be reviewed.
Improper price increases are highly undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Podt over het bericht ‘Friese mbo's verliezen deel van inburgeraars’

MPs Hagen and Podt asked why Friese Poort and Friesland College declined to tender for the B1 and Z integration routes, citing non-cost-covering fees, and what consequences this has for newcomers and for the government's funding of the education route. The minister replied that court rulings found the regional bandwidths reasonable, that a contract for both routes has been secured in Friesland, and that additional funding and a structural solution are being prepared.
In view of these rulings, I see no reason to take further measures.
Met het oog op deze uitspraken zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Blijf weg als je geen kamer hebt’

MPs Boulakjar and Van der Laan asked whether universities advising international and Dutch students without housing to stay away, and how the government ensures sufficient student housing. The ministers acknowledged the advice, pointed to shared responsibility with municipalities and housing providers, and referred to a national action plan, forthcoming legal steering instruments and the Kronenburg short-stay question under study.
Question 1: Is the Minister aware that the Vrije Universiteit and the University of Amsterdam urge international students not to come to the Netherlands if they have no housing?
Vraag 1 Is de Minister ervan op de hoogte dat de Vrije Universiteit en de Universiteit van Amsterdam internationale studenten oproepen om niet naar Nederland te komen als zij geen huisvesting hebben?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Antispieksoftware herkent zwarte VU-studente niet, daarom dient ze klacht in'

An MP asked whether the minister is aware of a VU student's complaint about proctoring software that failed to recognise her as a Black student, whether discrimination occurred, whether the minister will discuss apologies with UNLI and the VU, and how institutions can avoid discriminatory software. The minister acknowledged the complaint, said the VU found no proven discrimination based on the vendor's confidential study and regretted the situation, placed responsibility on institutions, and urged them to scrutinise software and use the SURF purchasing system.
Educational institutions themselves decide on the procurement and use of software and technology and therefore bear responsibility for it themselves.
Onderwijsinstellingen gaan zelf over de inkoop en het gebruik van software en technologie en dragen daarin dus zelf verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en De Kort over het artikel 'Minister Schouten wil terugkeer schooltandarts'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of health and of education about a news report that the minister wanted to bring back the school dentist, and about dentist shortages and the plans for children's dental care. The government answered that it is consulting dental organisations on a plan to increase children's dental visits, that preventive measures beyond school dentists are also being considered, and that a letter on dental care will follow by early October 2022.

I will explain the proposals for measures to encourage visits to the dental care provider in my letter on dental care, which I will send to the House of Representatives by early October 2022 at the latest.
Ik zal de voorstellen voor maatregelen om het bezoek aan de mondzorgverlener te stimuleren, toelichten in mijn brief over mondzorg die ik uiterlijk begin oktober 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Laan over een geweldsincident tijdens de Amsterdam Pride

MPs Van Ginneken and Van der Laan asked the government about a violent incident involving an Uber driver during Amsterdam Pride, whether data exist on LHBTIQ+-related violence and refusals in taxis, and about the effectiveness of Uber's discrimination button and the Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI. The state secretary answered that no specific figures are kept for taxi-sector incidents, that the investigation is ongoing, and pointed to existing general reports, a pending study and future policy letters.
No specific figures are kept on violent incidents in the taxi sector against LHBTIQ+ persons.
Er worden geen specifieke cijfers bijgehouden over geweld gerelateerde incidenten in de taxisector tegen LHBTIQ+-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het oordeel van het College voor de rechten van de mens van 23 mei 2022 over de taaleis van de Haagse Hogeschool

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the College voor de rechten van de mens's ruling that the Haagse Hogeschool's requirement of excellent Dutch language skills for certain vacancies was not shown to be necessary, and about the administrative burden and wider culture of lowering standards. The minister replied that requiring good Dutch can be legitimate where necessary, supports the independent institute's role in judging equal treatment, and said the school was asked to better justify the requirement, while declining to start talks with sector bodies on excellence beyond exploring the future of higher education.

The College voor de rechten van de mens ruled in this case that the Haagse Hogeschool 'did not demonstrate that it was necessary for all vacancies open at the time to set a language requirement', let alone that the highest level of proficiency was necessary for all of them.

Het College voor de rechten van de mens heeft in dit geval geoordeeld dat de Haagse Hogeschool «niet heeft aangetoond dat het voor alle op dat moment opengestelde vacatures noodzakelijk was om een taaleis te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Mutluer over mbo-studenten die niet worden toegelaten in Utrechtse cafés, andere uitgaansgelegenheden en sportfaciliteiten

MPs De Hoop and Mutluer asked whether refusing mbo students at Utrecht bars and sports facilities, while admitting university and HBO students, amounts to discrimination and whether it is covered by the constitutional non-discrimination clause. The minister condemned the unequal treatment and noted a conversation with the café owner, but said refusal by level of education is not legally prohibited and falls outside the equal-treatment statutes, relying on moral persuasion and a forthcoming mbo work agenda.
In horizontal legal relationships, meaning relations between citizens, citizens can invoke various equal treatment laws
In horizontale rechtsverhoudingen, waarmee de relatie tussen burgers onderling wordt bedoeld, kunnen burgers wel een beroep doen op verschillende gelijke behandelingswetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Onprofessionele geneeskundestudent moet makkelijker weggestuurd kunnen worden'

Two VVD MPs asked why medical schools cannot more easily expel students who repeatedly behave unprofessionally, and whether the Iudicium Abeundi rules should be changed. The minister answered that the IA is reserved for exceptional cases involving patient safety, that institutions can adapt their rules themselves, and that amending the statute is not desirable.
Amending the statutory provisions is not something I consider desirable.
Aanpassing van de wettelijke bepalingen acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over Uitsluiting en exclusie Pride walk Amsterdam

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the exclusion of Stichting De Roze Leeuw from the Amsterdam Pride Walk was acceptable and whether the government would intervene with the organisers and threaten subsidy withdrawal. The minister replied that the national government does not subsidise the Pride Walk or Pride Amsterdam, has no say over participation, and sees no reason to engage the organisers unless they request it.
The Pride Walk and indeed all of Pride Amsterdam is not subsidised by the national government.
De Pride Walk en verder ook de gehele Pride Amsterdam wordt niet gesubsidieerd door de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Als studenten zelf alarm slaan over hun cocaïnegebruik, dan is er wat aan de hand’

MPs Slootweg and Van der Molen asked the government about reports of rising hard drug use among students since COVID, the 12.5% lifetime cocaine use figure, trends, prevention in student houses, public campaigns and cooperation with student associations. The state secretary answered that monitors show no excessive rise, outlined existing prevention programmes, said mass public campaigns risk backfiring, and promised continued contact with student associations.

Because the signal from the student association is worrying, I have had periodic consultations with the National Chamber of Associations, the national student association cooperative, and will continue this contact to keep a finger on the pulse.

Omdat het signaal van de studentenvereniging verontrustend is, heb ik periodiek overleg gehad met de Landelijke Kamer van Verenigingen, het landelijke samenwerkingsverband van studentenverenigingen, en zal dit contact voortzetten om een vinger aan de pols te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de in

MPs Leijten and Kwint asked what the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science has done after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship-causing laws, the review of such rules, its information management and handling of FOI requests. The minister answered that departmental inventories of hardship-causing regulations are underway under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, with results and timelines to be sent to parliament, and that chat-message retention follows government-wide rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën grote invloed had op hoogleraarsplek Erasmus Universiteit

SP MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked whether the Ministry of Finance sponsored and influenced a tax-law professorship at Erasmus University, and about transparency and the funding of special chairs. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that Finance initiated the sponsorship arrangement, a selection procedure with a Finance representative on the committee was held, transparency should be improved, and he will consult the sector on the balance between regular and special professors.
I will send the Chamber the overview as soon as it is ready.
Ik zal de Kamer het overzicht doen toekomen zodra het gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan aandacht voor de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand op rechtenopleidingen

MP Van Nispen asked whether law degree programmes neglect subsidised legal aid (sociale advocatuur), citing individualism, career focus and possible influence from large law firms, and what should change. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that curricula are for institutions to decide, that shortages are being studied by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that talks with universities and the NOvA are ongoing, and that the internship scheme has been reopened.
Talks are being held with universities and universities of applied sciences on whether the curriculum sufficiently connects with social legal practice.
Met de universiteiten en hogescholen worden gesprekken gevoerd of binnen het curriculum voldoende aansluiting bestaat met de sociale advocatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Belastingdienst, die leerstoelen en hoogleraren financiert

MP Omtzigt asks the Finance and Education ministers about Tax Authority funding of university chairs, including whether the Leiden sponsorship was disclosed, which chairs are funded, the transparency of related publications, and whether funding should go through the education budget. The minister answers that seven chairs are financed by the Finance ministry, declines to provide individual publication or PhD overviews, promises to ask UNL and the code authors for an evaluation of the integrity code, and says a full overview of other funded chairs will follow later.
No statements are made about individual employees.
Er worden over individuele medewerkers geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over gesponsorde hoogleraren

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about externally funded endowed professorships at Dutch universities, including chairs financed by the Tax Authority and accounting firms that were not disclosed. The minister listed seven Finance-funded chairs, said the rules on private chairs are intended to guarantee independence, and promised an independent evaluation of the research integrity code while noting the Inspectorate has no legal basis to enforce on external funding.
As to the extent to which accounting firms have been open about matters, I cannot make a statement.
Over de mate waarin accountantskantoren openheid van zaken hebben gegeven kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Wel minimum inkomen, uitgesloten van compensatie: de eindjes aan elkaar knopen is voor studenten nu wel heel lastig'

MPs Kwint asked the ministers about reports that students struggle to make ends meet and whether government will raise support, cap student loan interest, extend energy allowances and housing benefit, or address student housing costs. The government answered that the basic grant returns from 2023/2024, the minimum wage will rise, a national student housing action plan is being drafted, and it sees no room to increase funding or extend housing benefit to rented rooms for now.
I am always willing to enter into discussion with students.
Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit Leiden sponsoring hoogleraar door Belastingdienst verzweeg

MPs Kwint and Jasper van Dijk asked why Leiden University did not disclose that a professorship in tax law was funded by the Tax Authority, and what sanctions or transparency measures would follow. Minister Dijkgraaf acknowledged the lack of openness, said the university has adjusted its disclosures and is reviewing the case, but stated the ministry cannot impose sanctions and promised a letter to parliament on registration of side activities.
The ministry does not have the power to impose sanctions.
Het ministerie heeft niet de mogelijkheid sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Poetin noopt de RUG tot uitbreiden blended onderwijs'

An MP asked whether the government is concerned that a university's expansion of blended online teaching, driven by rising energy prices, undermines in-person education, and what support and sustainability policy applies to education buildings. The minister replied that institutions themselves are responsible for their teaching vision, that compensation via energy tax and price indexation is available, and outlined the sustainability roadmaps and building rules without committing to new funding or changes.
Educational institutions are themselves responsible for their educational vision and quality.
Onderwijsinstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de onderwijsvisie en -kwaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en de Hoop over het bericht 'stagiair wordt ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether unpaid internships, which are widespread and may amount to cheap labour, are acceptable, and whether a fixed internship allowance or a reporting point for abuse should be introduced. The minister replied that internships are for learning, that employers are not legally obliged to pay, that he will discuss voluntary agreements with the education and labour sectors, and that the Labour Inspectorate handles complaints about unpaid work under the minimum wage act.
I will therefore enter into discussions with the education and labour sectors to make agreements on how more employers can be ensured to offer an appropriate internship allowance.
Ik zal daarom met het onderwijs- en werkveld in gesprek gaan om afspraken te maken hoe er gezorgd kan worden dat meer werkgevers een passende stagevergoeding bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Kwart van de studenten met stage ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about a report that a quarter of students on internships felt used as cheap labour and nearly half receive no internship pay, and about proposals from the ISO student union on stage abuse, mandatory pay and internship agreements. The Minister answered that interns are entitled to minimum wage when doing regular work, that the Labour Inspectorate can fine employers, and that talks with education and employers will explore better oversight, pay and standard agreements, while delaying a monitor of internship supply and quality until end of 2022.
I will therefore explore, in consultation with students, educational institutions and employers, how we can get better insight into the improper use of interns.
Ik zal daarom in overleg met de studenten, onderwijsinstellingen en werkgevers verkennen hoe we beter zicht krijgen op oneigenlijk inzet van stagiairs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint over het bericht 'stagiair wordt te vaak ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht

An SP MP asks the ministers whether internships are misused as cheap labour, whether a minimum internship allowance and enforcement are needed, and about internship shortages and 'green plucking' of students. The minister says employers are not legally required to pay internship allowances, promises talks with education and employers, notes the Labour Inspectorate can fine employers for regular work done by interns, and says the government sees no role in covering employers' costs.
The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate checks whether interns are improperly deployed and can fine a company if this is the case.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie controleert of er sprake is van oneigenlijke inzet van stagiairs en kan een boete uitdelen aan een bedrijf als hier sprake van is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over 'Nederlandse universiteiten die gevoelige militaire informatie delen met China'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Dutch universities share sensitive military knowledge with China's National University of Defense Technology, and what oversight exists. The minister acknowledged the risk, said universities may have shared dual-use technology and cannot be ruled out, and pointed to the national knowledge security guidelines, an external audit and a screening framework as measures.
I therefore cannot rule out that Dutch universities have shared military-relevant technology with the NUDT.
Ik kan dus niet uitsluiten dat Nederlandse universiteiten militair relevante technologie met de NUDT hebben gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het verbod van een Apartheid panel op de Universiteit Leiden

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Leiden University's cancellation of a panel on Israeli apartheid, the questioning of moderator Dina Zbeidy's neutrality, the handling of past panels, and CIDI lecture-series credits. The Minister defends the university's conduct as a matter for institutional house rules and academic neutrality, says no exclusion occurred, and gives a partial account of the past practice.
It is up to the institution itself to draw up good house rules for making its facilities available, and so every institution has a degree of room to make decisions.

Het is aan de instelling zelf om goede huisregels op te stellen voor het beschikbaar maken van hun voorzieningen en daarmee heeft elke instelling tot een bepaalde hoogte ruimte om beslissingen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Interesse in kerncentrales groeit, maar: waar zijn de nucleair specialisten?'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a shortage of nuclear specialists for planned nuclear plants, including staffing estimates, plans to strengthen knowledge infrastructure, and recruitment from abroad. The minister answered that no shortage estimate is possible yet, described an interdepartmental study and working group, and promised letters to parliament later in 2022 on results.
No estimate can be made in advance of a possible shortage of workers for the construction of new nuclear power plants.
Er is op voorhand geen inschatting te maken van een eventueel tekort aan arbeidskrachten voor de bouw van nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat Poetin de RUG noopt tot uitbreiden blended onderwijs

MP Kwint asked whether the RUG's plan to expand blended and hybrid teaching because of energy prices from the war in Ukraine was justified, and whether it conflicts with a motion making in-person teaching the norm. The minister answered that institutions decide their own teaching format based on their educational vision, that blended learning was already part of the RUG's 2021 strategy, and that there is no reason to contact the RUG.
Educational institutions are themselves responsible for their educational vision and quality.
Onderwijsinstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de onderwijsvisie en – kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de rente op studieleningen en de verhoging van het collegegeld

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about the possible end of the 0% interest on student loans and the expected rise in tuition fees, including whether this burdens students unfairly and whether it deters students with religious objections to interest. The Minister confirmed that interest will likely rise above 0% (set at year end), committed to reintroducing the basic grant and examining options to prevent the tuition increase, and promised answers before the committee debate.
I am currently examining those options.
Ik ben die mogelijkheden op dit moment aan het onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het nieuwe abonnementssysteem voor schoolboeken het Licentio-Folio systeem (LiFo) waarbij geen hergebruik meer wordt gemaakt van de schoolboeken, maar deze óf digitaal worden a

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the LiFo licence model for school textbooks, its paper waste and effect on competition and choice for schools. The Minister said schools choose freely, the evaluation shows mixed effects, no study of LiFo's sustainability has been done, and she agreed new entrants should get a chance.
After the summer I will send your House a policy response to the evaluation of the Free School Books Act (WGS)
Na de zomer stuur ik uw Kamer een beleidsreactie op de evaluatie van de Wet Gratis Schoolboeken (WGS)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'Nationaal Coördinator tegen Racisme: 'Stop met solliciteren voor stageplek''

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Education minister how the government views the call to have schools arrange internships to combat internship discrimination, and about direct placement pilots and their effects. The minister says stage discrimination must be tackled, points to a revised mbo approach due after summer and ongoing research on matching, but states that no study yet specifically examines direct placement and that effects on workload are not being mapped.
Depending on the outcomes, I will consider whether follow-up research into the effects of direct placement is desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten bekijk ik of een vervolgonderzoek naar de effecten van direct placement wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Voorbereidend jaar Twente Pathway College sluit onvoldoende aan bij UT-onderwijs'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that nearly 60% of students in the Twente Pathway College foundation year fail the binding study advice, the public cost of such students, the separation of public and commercial funds, the clarity for students about a commercial, uninspected provider, and the future of these programmes. The Minister answered that the 40.9% figure is not comparable with other data, that public funds may only be used under the investment policy rule and no public funding goes to non-EEA students, that self-regulation through the Code of Conduct applies, and that a stricter quality framework for the foundation year is being introduced with evaluation.
After one year a first evaluation will be carried out, in which my colleague of Justice and Security and I will be involved.
Na één jaar zal een eerste evaluatie worden gedaan, waarbij mijn collega van JenV en ik betrokken zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Men realiseert zich onvoldoende welke gevolgen de krimp zal hebben’

An MP asks the Education Minister about reports that declining student numbers from demographic shrinkage may force hbo institutions such as Saxion to close programmes, and asks for forecasts, lists of threatened programmes, and whether the ministry is informed early about planned closures. The minister acknowledges the urgency, cites the reference forecast and the lack of signals of imminent closures, states that closure decisions rest with institutions, and promises a fuller regional approach in a policy letter in June.
Intentions by an institution to end a programme do not, under the law, have to be submitted to me for approval, and there is also no ground for refusing them.
Voornemens tot beëindiging van een opleiding door de instelling hoeven volgens de wet niet voor instemming aan mij te worden voorgelegd en er is ook geen weigeringsgrond om deze te blokkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Private opleider NCOI verstrekt niet-erkende masterdiploma’s’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about private provider NCOI issuing unrecognised master's degrees, the Inspectorate's findings, and possible sanctions and affected students. The Minister says the Inspectorate found unlawful degrees at five providers, that he will study the reports and may impose administrative fines, and that he has no picture of possible damages, leaving affected students to the civil courts.
I will study these reports carefully and, if there is reason to, take appropriate measures.
Ik zal deze rapporten zorgvuldig bestuderen en, indien daartoe aanleiding is, gepaste maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'The Rights Forum legt absurde eis op tafel'

An SGP MP asked ministers whether a Woo/Wob information request by The Rights Forum, which covered Israeli universities and institutions, could amount to antisemitism and whether institutions can refuse it or be protected from its burden and insecurity. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate Woo request to be assessed by each institution's board under the law's exemptions, such as privacy, while offering the IHRA definition as an aid and noting contact with Universiteiten van Nederland.
It is up to the institution's governing board to further handle this request along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over een kwart van de mbo’ers dat recht heeft op een aanvullende beurs, maar deze niet aanvraagt

An MP asked the Minister of Education why over a quarter of eligible mbo students do not claim the supplementary grant, and how this will be addressed in the reintroduction of the student grant. The minister finds it worrying, points to reasons such as not needing the grant, and commits to measures such as pre-ticking the supplementary grant in the application and budgeting for process changes.
I will tackle the non-use by pre-ticking the supplementary grant on the start screen when applying for student finance.
Ik ga het niet-gebruik aanpakken door bij het aanvragen van studiefinanciering in het startscherm de aanvullende beurs standaard aan te vinken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht ‘DUO en mbo-studenten lopen elkaar mis: ‘Wáár kun je die aanvullende beurs aanvragen?’

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports that many vocational students entitled to the supplementary grant (aanvullende beurs) do not apply for it. The minister acknowledges the non-take-up, promises to make the grant checked by default in the application screen and improve information, but sees little room to simplify the parental-income procedure.
I am therefore taking measures to reduce the non-take-up.
Ik neem daarom maatregelen om het niet-gebruik af te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Zuidaskantoren oefenden invloed uit op publicaties medewerkers belastingrecht'

MPs Van der Molen and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that large law and tax advisory firms influenced publications by UvA tax law staff, and about the balance and ethics of tax law curricula and side jobs. The Minister replied that side jobs are permitted under existing integrity rules and are a university responsibility, promised to discuss transparency with UNL, and said he would await the UvA's independent investigation before drawing conclusions.
I am in discussion with UNL about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met UNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Zuidaskantoren oefenden invloed uit op publicaties medewerkers belastingrecht’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether law professors at Amsterdam's universities holding paid positions at large law and tax firms undermine academic independence, possibly causing self-censorship on tax topics, and what safeguards exist. The minister agreed that undue influence is undesirable, committed to an independent evaluation of the Dutch research integrity code and the sectoral secondary-employment rules, and said the UvA will have an independent committee examine possible self-censorship, while declining to commission sector-wide research or new rules yet.
Not investigating or publishing certain topics because they are deemed socially, politically or commercially undesirable, self-censorship, I consider undesirable.
Het niet onderzoeken of publiceren van bepaalde onderwerpen omdat deze maatschappelijk, politiek of vanuit commerciële redenen onwenselijk worden geacht, zelfcensuur, vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over het bericht van NOS van 6 april jl. waaruit blijk dat geen enkele universiteit de registratie van bijbanen van hoogleraren op orde heeft

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how universities can have unregistered side jobs of professors, and what will be done to keep registers accurate and public. The minister acknowledges the problem, says universities are responsible for registration, is talking with UNL about improvements including a possible central public register, and promises a letter to parliament this autumn.
I will send your House a letter this autumn on the state of affairs regarding the registration of side activities.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit najaar een brief sturen over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de registratie van nevenwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht 'Erasmus Universiteit stopt met onderwijs voor ouderen: 'Schandalig, nalatig, waardeloos!''

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Erasmus University ending its HOVO senior education courses and related questions on lifelong learning, participation numbers, STAP eligibility and exclusion of older generations. The Minister answered that the courses ran at a loss, that HOVO is not publicly funded so must be cost-covering, that HOVO can be listed in STAP under certain conditions, and that the Erasmus Academy denies the framing of the journalist's quote.
HOVO does not fall under the statutory tasks of institutions and is not funded by the government.
HOVO valt niet onder de wettelijke taak van instellingen en wordt niet door de overheid bekostigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de reiskostenvergoeding van jonge nieuwkomers

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked about differing municipal rules and amounts for travel-cost reimbursement for school-going newcomers over 12, the indicators used, and the availability of newcomer schools. Minister Wiersma answered that no statutory duty exists for newcomers with a status, that municipalities decide voluntarily, that the government has no overview of municipal schemes, and that around 120 ISK schools provide nationwide coverage.
However, I do not have an overview of which allowances municipalities provide and under which conditions.
Ik heb echter geen overzicht van welke vergoedingen gemeenten verstrekken en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Studenten noemen mij racistisch en homofoob’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether university lecturers are pressured to revise reading lists and give non-scientific perspectives room, and whether academic freedom is endangered. The minister found no reason to doubt the lecturer's account, said institutions must protect academic freedom, and promised talks with universities and a follow-up on existing inspection and KNAW research.
I have not verified what students are precisely demanding of these or other lecturers.
Ik heb niet geverifieerd wat studenten van deze of andere docenten precies eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Acta biedt medewerkers 1000 euro bonus voor het aandragen van een tandartsdocent'

MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam dental academy (ACTA) had to scale back master's teaching due to a shortage of dental teachers, and about the reliance on foreign-trained dentists and regional distribution of dental programmes. The minister confirmed the teaching cutback was temporary and largely restored, and gave partial answers, promising to raise regional distribution with the Capaciteitsorgaan in its autumn advice.
In consultation with the Capaciteitsorgaan, extra attention will be requested for this aspect in the new advice due to appear in the autumn.
In het overleg met het Capaciteitsorgaan zal extra aandacht gevraagd worden voor dit aspect in het nieuwe advies dat in het najaar zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht 'The giant plan to track diversity in research journals'

MP Van der Woude asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a publishers' plan to voluntarily collect authors' gender identity and ethnicity, and whether this conflicts with a earlier pledge not to register ethnicity. The minister sees the voluntary, anonymised survey as a legitimate step to study discrimination, while stating that participation must remain optional and that the government's earlier pledge applied only to its own action plan, not to private publishers.

If private parties such as scientific publishers, in the Netherlands or abroad, themselves propose to conduct voluntary, anonymised surveys among persons who submit or review articles, that is up to them.

Als private partijen zoals wetenschappelijke uitgevers, in Nederland of het buitenland, zelf met het voorstel komen om op een verantwoorde en geanonimiseerde manier vrijwillige enquêtes uit te voeren onder de personen die artikelen insturen of beoordelen, is dat aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over "kleine opleiders die buiten de boot vallen omdat ze niet kwalificeren voor het STAP-budget",

MP Goudzwaard (JA21) asked whether the government will widen the STAP training budget to small providers that fail the turnover threshold of certain quality marks, and how large that group is. The ministers answer that STAP is being phased in via selected quality marks and branch organisations, a test framework for new quality marks is expected around summer, the size of the small-provider group cannot be precisely determined, and the issue is being prioritised.
Priority is currently being given to developing the assessment framework so that more quality marks can be given the opportunity to join the STAP training register.
Er wordt op dit moment prioriteit gegeven aan de ontwikkeling van het toetsingskader om meer keurmerken in de gelegenheid te stellen om aan te sluiten op het scholingsregister STAP-budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over het bericht 'Geen open wetenschap over de rug van werknemers'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether universities require open access for nearly all publications, including works written outside employment, and whether this conflicts with article 25fa of the Copyright Act, which covers only short scientific works. The minister answered that open access is broader than article 25fa, that universities request but do not oblige staff, that the government sees open access as a shared responsibility and will keep consulting stakeholders, but made no concrete commitment to change the rules.
Article 25fa of the Copyright Act therefore grants creators of a short scientific work a right, not an obligation.
Artikel 25fa Aw verleent makers van een kort werk van wetenschap dus een bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een tweede studie op het gebied van zorg of onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about students doing a second degree, how many take one, and whether the higher institutional tuition for second degrees in care or education should be kept given staff shortages. The minister provided enrolment and graduation figures, said students in care or education second degrees now pay statutory rather than institutional tuition, and said there is no evidence the higher fee deters people, while defending the existing framework including the rule for teacher qualifications.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de voorbereidingen in het funderend onderwijs op de komst van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

An MP asked how education for Ukrainian refugee children and young adults is being prepared, including lessons from the Syrian influx, LOWAN capacity, trauma support, funding for newcomer pupils and data linkage with COA and DUO. The ministers answered that temporary facilities and newcomer schools are being scaled up, LOWAN is reinforced with extra funds, funding rules are adjusted to cover Ukrainian pupils, and that data are incomplete, with an estimated 6,000–7,000 pupils of compulsory school age.
The precise number of pupils subject to compulsory education is not yet available, but based on inflow data and J&V estimates of the minor share (37%), about 6,000–7,000 pupils are assumed.

Het precieze aantal leerplichtige leerlingen is nog niet beschikbaar, maar op basis van gegevens over de instroom en inschattingen van J&V over het percentage minderjarige (37%) wordt uitgegaan van ongeveer 6.000–7.000 leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het collegegeldtarief voor Oekraïense studenten met kenmerk

An ChristenUnie MP asked the education minister whether institutions can lower tuition for Ukrainian and Russian students, whether they will call on institutions to do so, and whether the 1 million euro support fund is sufficient. The minister replied that institutions set their own tuition, have chosen case-by-case support, that a new residence status is being examined for tuition rights, and that concrete steps will be shared if new information arises.
The House will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Hier wordt Uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat de overheidswebsite plat lag vanwege run op aanvraag duizend euro

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked why the STAP training-budget website crashed on opening, whether demand was foreseeable, how many people were blocked, why there was no transition rule for people who started retraining before 1 March 2022, and how training providers are admitted to the register. The ministers acknowledge technical problems and UWV's capacity shortfall, promise improvements and monthly monitoring, but do not give exact figures for blocked applicants and largely explain the existing selection and register procedures.
It is difficult to estimate how many people were unable to submit an application due to the technical problems and rapid exhaustion of the budget.
Het is lastig om in te schatten hoeveel mensen door de technische problemen en snelle uitputting geen aanvraag hebben kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht ‘Universiteit heeft behoefte aan heldere kaders over China; onderzoek samenwerking met omstreden universiteiten, waarschuwt denktank’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views reports that Leiden University cooperates with Chinese institutions rated high-risk, whether a risk analysis should cover such ties, and whether the university's reluctance to sever ties is acceptable. The Minister answers that cooperation must be assessed case by case, that she will ask universities to carry out risk analyses reported to their supervisory boards, and that she will include this case in the forthcoming letter.

I therefore call on knowledge institutions to review their cooperation agreements with foreign knowledge institutions and to examine whether the fundamental values are sufficiently safeguarded in them.

Ik roep kennisinstellingen daarmee op om samenwerkingsovereenkomsten met buitenlandse kennisinstellingen tegen het licht te houden en te onderzoeken of de fundamentele waarden hierin voldoende geborgd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het toekennen van een groot bedrag aan NOW-steun aan een meermaals veroordeeld bedrijf, dat weigert dwangsommen te betalen

Two MPs asked why a company that rents out animals, has repeated court-imposed penalties and enforcement history, received about 170,000 euro in NOW wage subsidy and remains an approved training company. The ministers answered that the NOW scheme does not test animal welfare, that subsidy amounts are advances pending final settlement, and that SBB and the NVWA are monitoring the company.
Animal welfare is not part of these conditions.
Dierenwelzijn is geen onderdeel van deze voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de zorgelijke toestand van etnisch-Russische studenten, docenten en onderzoekers

MPs Podt, Van der Laan and Sjoerdsma asked about the difficult situation of ethnic-Russian and Belarusian students, teachers and researchers in the Netherlands after sanctions, including financial hardship, work-hour limits, unclear visa prospects and knowledge-leakage risks. The minister acknowledged the problems, said work-hour limits will not be changed, urged institutions to support these students, and said residence rights are kept while study conditions are met.
Adjusting the number of hours students may work is not seen as a solution.
Het aanpassen van het aantal uren dat studenten mogen werken wordt niet als oplossing gezien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het artikel ‘Corona lijkt kans op diabetes te verhogen bij kinderen’

An MP asked the health and education ministers whether a CDC study linking COVID infection to higher childhood diabetes risk, uncertain long-term effects, and the reopening of schools were adequately weighed, and demanded guarantees on safety, evaluation, and consultation with parents and teachers. The minister replied that the study does not establish general risk, that school closure carries heavy harms, that safety measures such as testing, masks and ventilation apply, and that consultation with education partners is ongoing.
The government's policy is aimed at keeping schools open.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht scholen open te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over de podcast 'Gaat de wetenschap ten onder aan open science?'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about concerns that the national Recognition and Rewards programme for academics, linked to open science, harms Dutch science's international position and reduces quality and fairness. The Minister rejects that the changes lead to arbitrariness or harm internationally, notes NWO no longer uses journal impact factors or h-index and has shortened CVs, and promises annual reports to parliament on the programme.
I will do so by reporting to your House annually on the progress of the national Recognition and Rewards programme.
Dat zal ik doen door jaarlijks aan uw Kamer te rapporteren over de voortgang van het landelijk programma Erkennen en Waarderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat universiteiten een maximum willen op het aantal internationale studenten vanwege overvolle collegezalen en overwerkte docenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that universities want a cap on international students due to overcrowded lecture halls and overworked staff, and whether funding per student creates a perverse incentive. The minister acknowledged signals of capacity limits, said there is currently no system-wide shortage, and deferred concrete measures and the Engelstalige programme questions to a forthcoming letter.
I refer you for this to the letter I promised during the committee debate on internationalisation and knowledge security on 9 February 2022, which I will shortly send to your House.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor graag naar de brief die ik heb toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat internationalisering en kennisveiligheid op 9 februari 2022 en die ik binnenkort naar uw Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van der Woude over het bericht ‘student zoekt studentenwoning, internationale investeerders net zo goed’

MPs De Groot and Van der Woude asked about rising competition for student housing from international students and investors, and about the link to the housing shortage, sizes of rooms, and loneliness. The minister acknowledged a link but cited multiple causes, described existing monitoring, linked shared-room regulation to the housing points system, and promised a report and an additional monitoring module.
I consider it important to get a better picture of this from the perspective of student housing.
Ik vind het belangrijk om dit vanuit studentenhuisvesting beter in beeld te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Oekraïense studenten die in Nederland studeren en de wetenschappelijke samenwerking met Rusland

An MP asked the education minister about Ukrainian students in the Netherlands, their financial hardship, and continued scientific cooperation with Russia. The minister said institutions are supported with 1 million euros, that formal cooperation with Russian institutions should be frozen, and that a letter was sent to university and research bodies.
I have asked the higher education institutions to take care of Ukrainian students as well as possible and, where possible, support them financially.
Ik heb de hoger onderwijsinstellingen verzocht Oekraïense studenten zo goed mogelijk op te vangen en waar mogelijk (financieel) te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!'

An MP asked the education ministers whether the ministry would support a plant-based diet, join the national meat- and dairy-free week, and adopt a plant-based default for ministry catering. The ministers answered that they follow the Dutch Schijf van Vijf guidance, that the ministry's catering participates in the week, and that plant-based protein is part of the catering policy, but gave no commitment to a plant-based default and answered late.
We tried to send the answers for our department to your House before 7 March. Unfortunately this did not succeed due to interdepartmental coordination on answering your questions.
Wij hebben getracht de antwoorden voor ons departement voor 7 maart toe te sturen aan uw Kamer. Dit is helaas niet gelukt vanwege interdepartementale afstemming over de beantwoording van uw vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en De Hoop over de aangenomen motie van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul over het in kaart brengen van belemmeringen voor zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs (Kamerstuk 35 252, n

MPs Kwint and De Hoop asked whether maternity leave for students in higher education would be legally anchored, and how many institutions had adopted the handreiking for pregnant students. The minister replied that institutions are free in how they implement the guidance, several have adopted it or plan to, that few students report problems, and that an official review of legal anchoring is still ongoing.
The previously announced civil-service exploration into anchoring their legal position is still ongoing.
De eerder aangekondigde ambtelijke verkenning naar de verankering van hun rechtspositie is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Sahla en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Minister zet ventilatie op scholen op 1'

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about ventilation in schools, childcare, vve, mbo, hbo and universities, CO2 measurement, and whether the school helpline extends to these sectors. The government answered that ventilation responsibility lies primarily with providers and institutions, that existing rules and risk-based inspection apply, and that the helpline is not extended, pointing instead to RIVM guidance and an app.
The cabinet has no insight into the measures regarding ventilation at institution level in secondary vocational education (mbo) and higher education (ho).
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de maatregelen met betrekking tot ventilatie op instellingsniveau in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) en hoger onderwijs (ho).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Kröger en Bouchallikh over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Climate and Education about labour shortages blocking climate ambitions, retraining routes, support for career changers and a proposed work-guarantee fund. The ministers answered that labour market shortages are broad, that government role is limited and employers and workers bear primary responsibility, that existing retraining schemes and a forthcoming Action Plan for Green Jobs are being developed, and they rejected a work-guarantee fund as not efficient.
The cabinet does not have an overview of all retraining routes for career changers aimed at the energy transition.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van alle opleidingstrajecten voor zij-instromers, die gericht zijn op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Fort Velsen en het industrieterrein Edam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about damage to Fort Velsen, part of the Stelling van Amsterdam (a rijksmonument and UNESCO World Heritage site), the boundary change for the Edam industrial estate, and enforcement and oversight of the heritage. The State Secretary said the municipality stopped the works and can take enforcement action, that the RCE and province are coordinating, and that the Edam boundary change was approved by UNESCO after a formal procedure, while damage assessment and restoration are still pending.
The fort is a national monument. Municipalities play an important role in maintaining national monuments.
Het fort is een rijksmonument. Gemeenten hebben bij de instandhouding van rijksmonumenten een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg naar aanleiding van de aflevering ‘Buitensporige dierenartsrekeningen’ van Meldpunt van 7 januari 2022

An MP asked the ministers about very high emergency veterinary costs for pets, pre-payment demands, advice to borrow money or rehome animals, VAT, market concentration and vet training numbers. The minister replied that veterinary pricing is a free market, that the ACM oversees competition, that vets must disclose prices, and that a study of the veterinary sector and labour market is underway.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is the independent regulator for competition, a number of specific sectors and consumer protection.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is de onafhankelijke toezichthouder voor mededinging, een aantal specifieke sectoren en de bescherming van consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ginneken, Van der Laan en Simons over de moorden op, geweld tegen en zelfdodingen door trans-personen in Nederland

MPs Simons, Van der Laan and Van Ginneken asked about murders of, violence against, and suicides among trans people in the Netherlands, including official statistics, a registration system, anti-violence and reporting policy, and suicide prevention. The Minister answered that no separate registration system is planned, cited police and prosecution data, and described existing LHBTI safety, reporting and suicide-prevention measures and waiting-list efforts in trans care.
In light of the available material, I see no reason to set up an additional registration system.
In het licht van het beschikbare materiaal, zie ik geen aanleiding om een aanvullend registratiesysteem in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about Chinese funding of a human rights research centre at the VU, raising concerns about academic independence and Chinese influence in Dutch universities. The minister answered that academic freedom can coexist with third-party funding, that the national knowledge security guideline was published, that the RUG Hanban chair was not renewed, and that the government is concerned about human rights in Xinjiang.
I will, together with other ministries and services, keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal daarbij, samen met andere ministeries en diensten, een vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

MPs Van der Woude and Brekelmans asked whether the VU's China-funded human rights research centre (CCHRC) was transparent about its Chinese funding, whether ministers knew, and whether such funding threatens academic independence and Uyghur safety in the Netherlands. The minister answered that funding was recorded internally but not individually in external reports, that the ministries were unaware, that academic independence must be safeguarded through risk assessment without blanket exclusion, and that a foreign-agent register like Australia's is not the answer, while the motion on such a register is still being implemented.
The Ministry of OCW and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs were not aware of this funding.
Het Ministerie van OCW en het Ministerie van BZ waren niet op de hoogte van deze financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en El Yassini over het bericht dat een kwart van de scholen geen terugkoopregeling heeft

MPs Kwint and El Yassini asked the Minister of Education about reports that only 22% of schools publicly post information on the buy-back scheme for unused learning materials, and how schools define unused materials and why unused materials remain on lists. The minister acknowledges the transparency concern, notes 14 of 59 institutions published the scheme online, promises talks with the sector and MBO Raad, and states that definitions and list cleaning are primarily for institutions themselves.
In response to the signal JOB gives, I will discuss this with the sector.
Naar aanleiding van het signaal dat JOB geeft, zal ik met de sector hierover in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar oversterfte tijdens de coronapandemie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the academic study into excess mortality during the pandemic that parliament had ordered by motion, including the timeline, independence of RIVM and CBS, data access, and whether a commission and standards for independent research would be set up. The minister replied that two parallel tracks would deliver results (first around mid-February, the broader one around end of June), that RIVM and CBS are independent by law and will not design the research question alone, and that existing codes suffice, but he declined to set up a commission or ask KNAW/WRR for new standards and gave only partial data access.
I consider independent research very important. Of course RIVM and CBS are fully independent; this is regulated by law.
Ik vind onafhankelijk onderzoek erg belangrijk. Uiteraard zijn RIVM en CBS volledig onafhankelijk, dit is bij wet geregeld.
